    TTCS: Test-Time Curriculum Synthesis for Self-Evolving

    TTCS：面向自我进化的测试时课程合成

    Chengyi Yang, Zhishang Xiang, Yunbo Tang, Zongpei Teng, Chengsong Huang, Fei Long, Yuhan Liu, Jinsong Su

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TTCS co-trains a question synthesizer and solver, using capability-aligned synthetic curricula and self-consistency rewards to improve test-time reasoning. Curriculum composition is a substantive but supporting element; the main contribution directly advances reasoning capability development.

    TTCS 联合训练问题合成器和求解器，利用与模型能力相匹配的合成课程和自一致性奖励来提升测试时推理能力。课程的组合构成了重要的辅助要素；其主要贡献则是直接推动推理能力发展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Test-Time Training offers a promising way to improve the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs) by adapting the model using only the test questions. However, existing methods struggle with difficult reasoning problems for two reasons: raw test questions are often too difficult to yield high-quality pseudo-labels, and the limited size of test sets makes continuous online updates prone to instability. To address these limitations, we propose TTCS, a co-evolving test-time training framework. Specifically, TTCS initializes two policies from the same pretrained model: a question synthesizer and a reasoning solver. These policies evolve through iterative optimization: the synthesizer generates progressively challenging question variants conditioned on the test questions, creating a structured curriculum tailored to the solver's current capability, while the solver updates itself using self-consistency rewards computed from multiple sampled responses on both original test and synthetic questions. Crucially, the solver's feedback guides the synthesizer to generate questions aligned with the model's current capability, and the generated question variants in turn stabilize the solver's test-time training. Experiments show that TTCS consistently strengthens the reasoning ability on challenging mathematical benchmarks and transfers to general-domain tasks across different LLM backbones, highlighting a scalable path towards dynamically constructing test-time curricula for self-evolving. Our code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/TTCS.

    中文

    测试时训练提供了一种有前景的方法，可仅利用测试问题调整模型，从而提升大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。然而，现有方法在困难推理问题上表现不佳，原因有二：原始测试问题往往太难，难以产生高质量伪标签；测试集规模有限，使得持续在线更新容易不稳定。为解决这些限制，我们提出 TTCS，一种协同进化的测试时训练框架。具体而言，TTCS 从同一个预训练模型初始化两个策略：问题合成器和推理求解器。这两个策略通过迭代优化不断演进：合成器以测试问题为条件，生成难度逐步提升的问题变体，构建适配求解器当前能力的结构化课程；求解器则利用原始测试问题和合成问题上的多个采样回答计算出的自一致性奖励来更新自身。关键在于，求解器的反馈会引导合成器生成与模型当前能力相匹配的问题，而生成的问题变体又反过来稳定求解器的测试时训练。实验表明，TTCS 持续增强模型在具有挑战性的数学基准上的推理能力，并能迁移至不同 LLM 主干模型上的通用领域任务，展现了一条可扩展路径，可动态构建测试时课程以实现自我进化。代码和实现细节见 https://github.com/XMUDeepLIT/TTCS。

    CHIMERA: Compact Synthetic Data for Generalizable LLM Reasoning

    CHIMERA：用于可泛化 LLM 推理的紧凑合成数据

    Xinyu Zhu, Yihao Feng, Yanchao Sun, Xianzhi Du, Pingzhi Li, Olli Saarikivi, Yun Zhu, Yu Meng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CHIMERA contributes a compact, structured synthetic dataset and automated validation pipeline for training reasoning across scientific domains, with reported gains from SFT and RL. Reasoning is the direct focus; its taxonomy organizes topic coverage, but the abstract does not establish compositional generalization or model-system mechanisms.

    CHIMERA 提供了一个紧凑、结构化的合成数据集和自动化验证流程，用于训练跨科学领域的推理能力，并报告了通过 SFT 和 RL 获得的提升。推理是其直接研究重点；其分类体系用于组织主题覆盖，但摘要并未证明组合泛化或模型系统机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Models (LLMs) have exhibited remarkable reasoning capabilities, largely enabled by supervised fine-tuning (SFT)- and reinforcement learning (RL)-based post-training on high-quality reasoning data. However, reproducing and extending these capabilities in open and scalable settings is hindered by three data-centric challenges: (1) the cold-start problem, arising from the lack of seed datasets with detailed, long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) trajectories needed to initialize reasoning policies; (2) limited domain coverage, as most existing open-source reasoning datasets are concentrated in mathematics, with limited coverage of broader scientific disciplines; and (3) the annotation bottleneck, where the difficulty of frontier-level reasoning tasks makes reliable human annotation prohibitively expensive or infeasible. To address these challenges, we introduce CHIMERA, a compact synthetic reasoning dataset of 9K samples designed to support generalizable reasoning across domains. CHIMERA is constructed with three key properties: (1) it provides rich, long CoT reasoning trajectories synthesized by state-of-the-art reasoning models; (2) it has broad and structured coverage, spanning 8 major scientific disciplines and over 1K fine-grained topics organized via a model-generated hierarchical taxonomy; and (3) it employs a fully automated, scalable evaluation pipeline that uses strong reasoning models to cross-validate both problem validity and answer correctness, removing the reliance on human annotations. We use CHIMERA to post-train a 4B Qwen3 model with SFT and RL. Despite the dataset's modest size, the resulting model achieves strong performance on a suite of challenging reasoning benchmarks, including GPQA-Diamond, AIME 24/25/26, HMMT 25 and Humanity's Last Exam, approaching or matching the performance of substantially larger models such as DeepSeek-R1 and Qwen3-235B.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）展现出卓越的推理能力，这在很大程度上得益于利用高质量推理数据进行监督微调（SFT）和基于强化学习（RL）的后训练。然而，在开放且可扩展的设置中复现并拓展这些能力，受到三个以数据为核心的挑战阻碍：（1）冷启动问题：缺少包含详细、较长思维链（CoT）轨迹的种子数据集，无法用于初始化推理策略；（2）领域覆盖有限：现有大多数开源推理数据集集中于数学，对更广泛科学学科的覆盖不足；（3）标注瓶颈：前沿推理任务难度高，可靠的人类标注成本过高，甚至无法实现。为应对这些挑战，我们推出 CHIMERA，这是一个包含 9K 个样本的紧凑合成推理数据集，旨在支持跨领域的可泛化推理。CHIMERA 具备三项关键特性：（1）提供由最先进推理模型合成的丰富且较长的 CoT 推理轨迹；（2）覆盖范围广且结构化，涵盖 8 个主要科学学科和 1K 多个细粒度主题，并通过模型生成的层次分类体系组织；（3）采用完全自动化且可扩展的评估流程，利用强推理模型交叉验证问题有效性和答案正确性，无需依赖人工标注。我们使用 CHIMERA 对一个 4B Qwen3 模型进行 SFT 和 RL 后训练。尽管数据集规模不大，所得模型在一系列具有挑战性的推理基准上表现出色，包括 GPQA-Diamond、AIME 24/25/26、HMMT 25 和 Humanity's Last Exam，其表现接近或达到 DeepSeek-R1 和 Qwen3-235B 等大得多的模型。

    Understanding and Defending VLM Jailbreaks via Jailbreak-Related Representation Shift

    通过越狱相关表征偏移理解并防御 VLM 越狱

    Zhihua Wei, Qiang Li, Jian Ruan, Zhenxin Qin, Leilei Wen, Ruiyang Qin, Qingzhuo Wang, Dongrui Liu, Wen Shen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies a jailbreak-related direction in VLM representations, links image-induced movement along it to refusal failures, and uses that mechanism to guide a defense, directly advancing mechanistic interpretability. The inference-time defense has an incidental systems connection, but the abstract gives no substantive contribution to composition or reasoning.

    本文识别出 VLM 表征中的越狱相关方向，将图像诱发的沿该方向移动与拒绝失效联系起来，并以此机制指导防御，直接推进了机制可解释性研究。推理时防御与系统有附带关联，但摘要没有实质性涉及组合能力或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large vision-language models (VLMs) often exhibit weakened safety alignment with the integration of the visual modality. Even when text prompts contain explicit harmful intent, adding an image can substantially increase jailbreak success rates. In this paper, we observe that VLMs can clearly distinguish benign inputs from harmful ones in their representation space. Moreover, even among harmful inputs, jailbreak samples form a distinct internal state that is separable from refusal samples. These observations suggest that jailbreaks do not arise from a failure to recognize harmful intent. Instead, the visual modality shifts representations toward a specific jailbreak state, thereby leading to a failure to trigger refusal. To quantify this transition, we identify a jailbreak direction and define the jailbreak-related shift as the component of the image-induced representation shift along this direction. Our analysis shows that the jailbreak-related shift reliably characterizes jailbreak behavior, providing a unified explanation for diverse jailbreak scenarios. Finally, we propose a defense method that enhances VLM safety by removing the jailbreak-related shift (JRS-Rem) at inference time. Experiments show that JRS-Rem provides strong defense across multiple scenarios while preserving performance on benign tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/LeeQueue513/JRS-Rem.

    中文

    大型视觉语言模型（VLM）在整合视觉模态后，安全对齐往往会减弱。即使文本提示明确包含有害意图，添加图像也可能显著提高越狱成功率。本文观察到，VLM 能够在其表征空间中清楚地区分良性输入和有害输入。此外，即使在有害输入中，越狱样本也会形成一种不同的内部状态，可与拒绝样本区分开来。这些观察表明，越狱并非源于模型无法识别有害意图。相反，视觉模态会使表征朝特定的越狱状态偏移，从而导致拒绝机制未能触发。为量化这一转变，我们识别出一个越狱方向，并将越狱相关偏移定义为图像诱发的表征偏移在该方向上的分量。我们的分析表明，越狱相关偏移能够可靠地刻画越狱行为，为多种越狱场景提供统一解释。最后，我们提出一种防御方法，在推理时移除越狱相关偏移（JRS-Rem），以增强 VLM 的安全性。实验表明，JRS-Rem 能在多种场景下提供强有力的防御，同时保持良性任务上的性能。代码见 https://github.com/LeeQueue513/JRS-Rem。

    Detection Is Cheap, Routing Is Learned: Why Refusal-Based Alignment Evaluation Fails

    检测很容易，路由需要学习：基于拒绝的对齐评估为何失效

    Gregory N. Frank

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses probes, surgical ablations, and cross-model tests to show that alignment behavior depends on model-specific routing from detected concepts to output, including cases where routing geometry entangles knowledge and censorship. This directly advances mechanistic analysis of behavior and representation geometry; generalization tests and behavioral changes are incidental to the other directions.

    本文通过探针、精细消融和跨模型测试表明，对齐行为取决于从检测到的概念到输出的模型特定路由，其中也包括路由几何结构将知识与审查机制纠缠在一起的情况。这直接推进了对行为和表征几何的机制分析；泛化测试和行为变化与其他方向的关联则是附带的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Current alignment evaluation mostly measures whether models encode dangerous concepts and whether they refuse harmful requests. Both miss the layer where alignment often operates: routing from concept detection to behavioral policy. We study political censorship in Chinese-origin language models as a natural experiment, using probes, surgical ablations, and behavioral tests across nine open-weight models from five labs. Three findings follow. First, probe accuracy alone is non-diagnostic: political probes, null controls, and permutation baselines can all reach 100%, so held-out category generalization is the informative test. Second, surgical ablation reveals lab-specific routing. Removing the political-sensitivity direction eliminates censorship and restores accurate factual output in most models tested, while one model confabulates because its architecture entangles factual knowledge with the censorship mechanism. Cross-model transfer fails, indicating that routing geometry is model- and lab-specific. Third, refusal is no longer the dominant censorship mechanism. Within one model family, hard refusal falls to zero while narrative steering rises to the maximum, making censorship invisible to refusal-only benchmarks. These results support a three-stage descriptive framework: detect, route, generate. Models often retain the relevant knowledge; alignment changes how that knowledge is expressed. Evaluations that audit only detection or refusal therefore miss the routing mechanism that most directly determines behavior.

    中文

    当前的对齐评估主要衡量模型是否编码了危险概念，以及是否会拒绝有害请求。这两者都忽略了对齐通常发挥作用的层面：从概念检测到行为策略的路由。我们将中国来源语言模型中的政治审查作为自然实验，使用探针、精细消融和行为测试，研究来自五家实验室的九个开放权重模型。我们得到三项发现。第一，仅看探针准确率无法得出诊断结论：政治探针、空值对照和置换基线都可能达到 100%，因此留出类别上的泛化才是有信息价值的测试。第二，精细消融揭示了因实验室而异的路由机制。移除政治敏感性方向，会在大多数受测模型中消除审查并恢复准确的事实输出；而有一个模型会产生编造内容，因为其架构将事实知识与审查机制纠缠在一起。跨模型迁移失败，表明路由几何结构因模型和实验室而异。第三，拒绝已不再是主要的审查机制。在同一模型系列中，明确拒绝降至零，而叙事引导升至最高水平，使得仅依赖拒绝的基准无法察觉审查。这些结果支持一个三阶段描述框架：检测、路由、生成。模型通常保留相关知识；对齐改变的是知识的表达方式。因此，只审查检测或拒绝的评估会漏掉最直接决定行为的路由机制。

    How Alignment Routes: Localizing, Scaling, and Controlling Policy Circuits in Language Models

    对齐如何进行路由：定位、扩展并控制语言模型中的策略电路

    Gregory N. Frank

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper causally localizes a sparse gate-and-amplifier circuit that routes detected policy content into refusal, using interventions and knockouts across several language models. This directly advances mechanistic interpretability; refusal behavior is an application, while the abstract does not make a substantive contribution to compositionality, reasoning, or model-system design.

    本文通过干预和敲除，在多个语言模型中因果定位了一个稀疏的门控—放大器电路，该电路将检测到的策略内容路由至拒绝行为。这直接推进机制可解释性；拒绝行为是其应用场景，而摘要并未对组合性、推理或模型系统设计作出实质贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Models can represent policy-relevant content yet respond differently. We study the policy-routing circuit that turns detection into refusal. Using political censorship and harmful-request refusal as test cases, four-method circuit analyses in Qwen3-8B, Phi-4-mini, and Gemma-2-2B reveal sparse gate-amplifier circuits at architecture-specific locations. An intermediate-layer gate initiates routing, while later, distributed amplifier heads strengthen a refusal-directed signal. The gate is hard to find with direct logit attribution (DLA): in Qwen3-8B, it contributes less than 1% of output DLA. We therefore combine DLA screening, directional intervention, activation interchange, and gate-to-amplifier knockout. Activation interchange identifies upstream trigger candidates, and knockout suppresses a majority of tested later-head contributions in all three models. The gate is an upstream trigger, not a self-contained refusal mechanism; later amplifiers strengthen the signal toward the output. Candidate-head screens in nine additional models from six labs, spanning 2B-72B parameters, nominate similarly localized routing candidates without establishing head-level homology. Policy routing is a sparse, causally structured interface between content detection and aligned behavior that output attribution alone can miss.

    中文

    模型可以表征与策略相关的内容，却给出不同回应。我们研究将检测结果转化为拒绝行为的策略路由电路。我们以政治审查和有害请求拒绝为测试案例，对 Qwen3-8B、Phi-4-mini 和 Gemma-2-2B 进行四种方法的电路分析，发现了位于架构特定位置的稀疏门控—放大器电路。中间层的门控启动路由，而更靠后的分布式放大器头会增强指向拒绝的信号。直接 logit 归因（DLA）很难找到这个门控：在 Qwen3-8B 中，它对输出 DLA 的贡献不到 1%。因此，我们结合 DLA 筛查、方向性干预、激活互换以及门控至放大器的敲除。激活互换可识别上游触发因素候选；在三个模型中，敲除都会抑制大多数受测的后续头部贡献。门控是上游触发器，并非一个自成一体的拒绝机制；后续放大器会增强指向输出的信号。对来自六家实验室的另外九个模型（参数量为 2B–72B）的候选头筛查，提名了位置相似的路由候选，但尚未确立头级同源性。策略路由是一种稀疏且具有因果结构的接口，连接内容检测与对齐行为，而仅凭输出归因可能会遗漏这一接口。

    The Shape of Wisdom: How Language Models Converge on an Answer

    智慧的形态：语言模型如何收敛到一个答案

    Shailesh Rana

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies answer-specific regions in model state, tracks when answers become readable, and uses causal state interventions to change outputs, directly advancing mechanistic analysis of knowledge representations. Factual question answering connects to reasoning, but the abstract focuses on answer retrieval rather than reasoning processes; cross-question centroid transfer does not establish a compositional contribution.

    本文识别了模型状态中与答案对应的特定区域，追踪答案何时变得可读，并通过因果状态干预改变输出，从而直接推动了对知识表征的机制分析。事实性问答与推理有关，但摘要关注的是答案检索，而非推理过程；跨问题的质心迁移并不能证明存在组合性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When a language model answers a factual question, where does its internal state go? We asked four open models (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma-2-9B and Llama-3.2-1B) 2,256 factual questions whose answers recur, such as the country a person is a citizen of. At every layer, we recorded the state from which the answer is produced. Questions that receive the same answer converge on a shared region of state space, which we summarise by its centre, the answer centroid. The answer becomes readable within a single layer. In every model, the share of questions whose state lies nearest its own answer's centroid jumps at one layer, between 47% and 71% of the way through the network. The centroids follow the answer the model gives rather than the question: the centroid of a country learned from questions about people's citizenship also identifies that country in questions about towns and films. The model also uses the centroids. After the jump, moving the state of a wrongly answered question to the right answer's centroid makes the model give the right answer in 83%-97% of cases late in the network, against 2%-4% for a random move of the same size. Before the jump, moves of the same size almost never work. Near misses, in which the model answers wrongly but picks the right option in multiple choice, can be seen from the onset layer, where the right answer's centroid is already among the nearest to the state. This signal is about as informative as the right answer's rank in the model's final output, and more informative than the model's confidence in its reply.

    中文

    当语言模型回答一个事实性问题时，它的内部状态会走向何处？我们向四个开放模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Gemma-2-9B 和 Llama-3.2-1B）提出了 2,256 个答案会反复出现的事实性问题，例如某人的公民身份所属国家。在每一层，我们都记录了生成答案所依据的状态。得到相同答案的问题会收敛到状态空间中的一个共享区域，我们用该区域的中心，即答案质心，来概括它。答案会在单独一层内变得可读。在每个模型中，状态最接近其自身答案质心的问题占比都会在某一层跃升；这一层位于网络深度的 47% 到 71% 之间。质心追随的是模型给出的答案，而非问题：从关于人们公民身份的问题中学到的某个国家的质心，也能在关于城镇和电影的问题中识别出该国家。模型也会利用这些质心。跃升之后，在网络后段，将一个回答错误的问题的状态移到正确答案的质心，会使模型在 83%-97% 的情况下给出正确答案；相比之下，同等幅度的随机移动只能在 2%-4% 的情况下奏效。在跃升之前，同等幅度的移动几乎从不起作用。从起始层起，就能观察到接近答对的情况：模型虽然回答错误，却在多项选择题中选中了正确选项，此时正确答案的质心已经是最接近该状态的质心之一。这种信号提供的信息量大致相当于正确答案在模型最终输出中的排名，并且比模型对其回答的置信度更有信息量。

    Beyond Episodic AI: Cognitive Field Networks for Biologically Inspired Persistent Cognition

    超越情节式 AI：受生物启发的持续认知认知场网络

    Byung Gyu Chae

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops a recurrent Transformer whose hidden field re-enters computation, and experimentally characterizes how input relevance and training horizon shape persistent internal states. This offers substantial insight into internal state dynamics and model memory systems, but does not directly investigate compositional generalization or reasoning capabilities.

    本文开发了一种隐藏场可重新进入计算过程的循环 Transformer，并通过实验刻画输入相关性和训练时长如何塑造持续的内部状态。这为内部状态动力学和模型记忆系统提供了实质性见解，但没有直接研究组合泛化或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Cognitive Field Theory describes cognition as memory-dressed collective dynamics, in which slow relaxation modes support a persistent cognitive field. By connecting non-Markovian memory dynamics to discrete recurrent state evolution through an extended state, we develop a Cognitive Field Network (CFN), a recurrent Transformer architecture with hidden-field re-entry, \( \Phi_{n+1} = F_\theta(X_{n+1},\Phi_n) \). Rather than prescribing an explicit memory operation, the CFN allows the full token-resolved hidden field to re-enter the next computational cycle. We find that learning organizes this pathway into a functional channel for persistent, content-dependent internal states, with temporal persistence systematically controlled by the recurrent training horizon. The learned dynamics generalize beyond this horizon: semantic continuation sustains the recurrent state without explicit answer replay, whereas unsupported states exhibit finite passive relaxation. Periodic re-exposure to relevant input renews the surviving field, producing an approximately stationary nonzero regime over extended recurrent trajectories. Unrelated-input and recurrence-off controls fail to reproduce this behavior, while near-paraphrased input produces weaker renewal, revealing the dependence of persistence on both field re-entry and input relevance. These findings connect memory-dressed field formation, input-driven reorganization, and recurrent state continuity within a unified dynamical framework. The CFN thus provides an experimentally controllable platform for studying persistent, history-dependent cognition without a separately prescribed memory system.

    中文

    认知场理论将认知描述为带记忆的集体动力学，其中缓慢弛豫模式支撑着持续的认知场。我们通过扩展状态将非马尔可夫记忆动力学与离散循环状态演化联系起来，开发了认知场网络（CFN），这是一种具有隐藏场重入机制的循环 Transformer 架构，\( \Phi_{n+1} = F_\theta(X_{n+1},\Phi_n) \)。CFN 不预先规定显式的记忆操作，而是允许完整的、按 token 分辨的隐藏场重新进入下一个计算周期。我们发现，学习会将这一通路组织成一种功能性通道，用于维持依赖内容的内部状态；其时间持续性受循环训练时长系统性地控制。学习到的动力学能够泛化到这一时长之外：语义上的延续无需显式重放答案即可维持循环状态，而缺乏支持的状态则表现出有限的被动弛豫。定期重新接触相关输入会使残留场得以更新，从而在延长的循环轨迹中形成近似稳态的非零状态。无关输入和关闭循环的对照组无法复现这种行为，而近似释义的输入所产生的更新较弱，这揭示了持续性同时取决于场的重入和输入的相关性。这些发现将带记忆的场形成、输入驱动的重组和循环状态连续性联系在统一的动力学框架中。因此，CFN 提供了一个可通过实验控制的平台，可用于研究持续的、依赖历史的认知，而无需单独预设记忆系统。

    Reasoning with Continuous Latent Diffusion

    使用连续潜在扩散进行推理

    Xiang Cheng

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CEDR develops continuous latent diffusion for mathematical reasoning and code generation, combining compact learned answer and prompt representations, asynchronous denoising, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Its focus on training and inference for reasoning directly fits that direction; hidden-layer representations alone do not establish a mechanistic interpretability contribution, while asynchronous computation is a secondary systems connection.

    CEDR 开发了用于数学推理和代码生成的连续潜在扩散方法，结合紧凑的学习型答案与提示表示、异步去噪，以及使用可验证奖励的强化学习。其重点是推理训练与推理过程，与该方向直接相关；仅凭隐藏层表示不足以说明其对机制可解释性作出了贡献，而异步计算只是次要的系统层面关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We introduce the Continuous Embedding Diffusion Reasoner (CEDR), a training and inference pipeline for continuous latent diffusion models that achieves strong performance on mathematical reasoning and code generation. We learn compact answer representations from three hidden layers of the autoregressive Qwen3-4B model. A staged curriculum first trains the ELF-based diffusion backbone with teacher prompt conditioning, then initializes a compact prompt encoder through imitation and jointly adapts both networks. This replaces the large teacher contextual prompt encoder at inference with a compact learned Transformer. The multilayer answer representation also enables asynchronous inference, with different components denoised under separate clocks. We further adapt DiffusionNFT to learned self-conditioning guidance, enabling reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards. Controlled ablations evaluate the effects of representation design, prompt training, and denoising schedules. CEDR outperforms recent continuous-diffusion baselines at comparable backbone scales, including before reinforcement learning. With a 638M-parameter denoising backbone and DMD2-style stochastic sampling, post-NFT CEDR-L achieves {pass@1, pass@8} accuracies of {68.97%, 80.82%} on GSM8K and {32.40%, 53.80%} on MATH500 at 64 denoising steps per sample, and {37.56%, 51.00%} on HumanEval+ and {26.96%, 39.92%} on MBPP+ at 128 steps per sample. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/chengxiang/CEDR and https://huggingface.co/xc91/CEDR, respectively.

    中文

    我们提出连续嵌入扩散推理器（CEDR），这是一套用于连续潜在扩散模型的训练与推理流程，在数学推理和代码生成方面表现出色。我们从自回归 Qwen3-4B 模型的三个隐藏层中学习紧凑的答案表示。分阶段课程首先在教师提示条件下训练基于 ELF 的扩散骨干网络，随后通过模仿初始化一个紧凑的提示编码器，并联合调整两个网络。这样，推理时就可以用紧凑的学习型 Transformer 替代大型教师上下文提示编码器。多层答案表示还支持异步推理，使不同组件能够按各自独立的时钟进行去噪。我们进一步将 DiffusionNFT 适配为学习型自条件引导，从而支持使用可验证奖励进行强化学习。受控消融实验评估了表示设计、提示训练和去噪调度的影响。在骨干网络规模相当时，CEDR 优于近期连续扩散基线，包括在强化学习之前。使用一个拥有 638M 参数的去噪骨干网络和 DMD2 风格的随机采样时，经过 NFT 的 CEDR-L 在每个样本进行 64 步去噪时，在 GSM8K 和 MATH500 上的 {pass@1, pass@8} 准确率分别为 {68.97%, 80.82%} 和 {32.40%, 53.80%}；在每个样本进行 128 步去噪时，在 HumanEval+ 和 MBPP+ 上分别达到 {37.56%, 51.00%} 和 {26.96%, 39.92%}。代码和模型权重分别可在 https://github.com/chengxiang/CEDR 和 https://huggingface.co/xc91/CEDR 获取。

    $S^3$: Spectral Null-Space Swap Makes Reasoning Models Efficient

    $S^3$：谱零空间交换使推理模型更高效

    Hongbo Ma, Sansheng Cao, Jiajun Fan, Bangji Yang, Ge Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies a null-space weight component associated with reasoning capacity and uses it to compose checkpoints for lower-token reasoning, supported by analysis of attention entropy. This strongly advances reasoning efficiency and offers mechanistic evidence about representations, while composition is a model-merging technique rather than compositional generalization and MoE is only an evaluated architecture.

    本文发现了一个与推理能力相关的零空间权重分量，并利用它组合检查点以降低推理所需 token 数，同时通过注意力熵分析提供支持。这显著提升了推理效率，并对表征提供了机制层面的证据；其中的组合是模型合并技术，而非组合泛化，MoE 也只是评估所用的架构。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLMs trained with Chain-of-thought excel in reasoning capability, but often come with excessive token cost. We find that the core of reasoning capacity lies in the Thinking model's weight component within the null space of a projection defined by the corresponding Non-thinking model's dominant singular directions, and removing the subspace component can largely improve reasoning efficiency without hurting the accuracy gained during thinking-mode post-training. Unlike existing efforts that mostly operate within the dominant subspace, we are the first to unveil the critical role of the null space and harness it for model optimization. Motivated by this finding, we propose Spectral Null-Space Swap ($S^3$), a training-free composition of paired Non-thinking and Thinking checkpoints. Our method keeps the Non-thinking model inside its own dominant subspace and takes the Thinking checkpoint outside it, improving reasoning efficiency while maintaining accuracy. We extensively evaluate $S^3$ on 2B-30B dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures spanning 28 evaluation environments across mathematical, multimodal, and audio reasoning domains. $S^3$ establishes new empirical Pareto Frontiers among training-free model composition strategies: across all settings, it reduces inference token overhead by an average of 27.4% compared to full Thinking models while simultaneously improving overall task accuracy by 1.0 percentage point (e.g., yielding +8.3% accuracy on HMMT25 alongside a 33.0% token speedup). We further use attention entropy for explanation and find that the retained component produces more concentrated attention, and we use a simplified analytical model about optimization to demonstrate why null-space can effectively reduce attention entropy, thereby improving the efficiency of reasoning.

    中文

    使用思维链训练的 LLM 擅长推理，但往往需要消耗过多 token。我们发现，推理能力的核心位于 Thinking 模型权重中、由对应 Non-thinking 模型的主导奇异方向所定义的投影的零空间分量；移除子空间分量可以大幅提高推理效率，同时不损害思维模式后训练所获得的准确率。不同于大多在主导子空间内操作的现有工作，我们首次揭示了零空间的关键作用，并将其用于模型优化。受此发现启发，我们提出谱零空间交换（$S^3$），这是一种无需训练、由成对的 Non-thinking 与 Thinking 检查点构成的组合方法。我们使 Non-thinking 模型保留在其自身的主导子空间内，同时将 Thinking 检查点置于该子空间之外，从而在维持准确率的同时提高推理效率。我们在 2B–30B 的稠密模型和混合专家（MoE）架构上对 $S^3$ 进行了广泛评估，覆盖数学、多模态和音频推理领域的 28 个评估环境。$S^3$在无需训练的模型组合策略中建立了新的经验帕累托前沿：在所有设置下，与完整 Thinking 模型相比，该方法平均减少 27.4% 的推理 token 开销，同时将总体任务准确率提高 1.0 个百分点（例如，在 HMMT25 上准确率提高 +8.3%，同时 token 加速 33.0%）。我们进一步使用注意力熵进行解释，发现保留下来的分量会产生更加集中的注意力；此外，我们还使用一个关于优化的简化解析模型，说明零空间为何能够有效降低注意力熵，进而提高推理效率。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a state-dependent risk schedule for GRPO in diffusion language models and reports improved mathematical reasoning accuracy, coverage, and trace diversity, with controls supporting the schedule’s contribution. Reasoning training is the core contribution; using reinforcement learning and dLLM backbones alone does not establish a systems contribution.

    该论文为扩散语言模型中的 GRPO 引入了依赖状态的风险调度，并报告数学推理准确率、覆盖率和轨迹多样性有所提升，且对照实验支持该调度的贡献。推理训练是其核心贡献；仅仅使用强化学习和 dLLM 骨干模型，并不能构成系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by denoising a sequence or successive blocks, allowing several tokens to be revealed in parallel. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) reuses terminal feedback across these decisions, even as their conditioning context changes. We propose stepwise risk-sensitive GRPO (StepRS-GRPO), which varies the risk coefficient of the group-advantage transformation across denoising states while retaining the underlying trainer. For binary rewards, we show that this transformation is exactly a prompt- and state-dependent rescaling of centered outcome advantages. A capability-based calibration suggests a coefficient scale, while endpoint and interpolation ablations guide schedule selection. Across multiple dLLM backbones and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, StepRS-GRPO improves both pass@1 accuracy and pass@k coverage over centered GRPO, while increasing answer diversity. In our ablation studies, mass-matched controls support the contributions of state allocation and schedule direction, and the gains persist after matching the root mean square (RMS) of the advantages to that of centered GRPO. Reasoning-trace diagnostics further show that the diversity gains from StepRS-GRPO extend beyond final-answer strings.

    中文

    扩散大语言模型（dLLM）通过对一个序列或连续多个块进行去噪来生成文本，因此可以并行揭示多个 token。带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）会在这些决策之间重复利用终端反馈，即使它们的条件上下文不断变化。我们提出逐步风险敏感 GRPO（StepRS-GRPO）：在保留底层训练器的同时，随去噪状态改变组优势变换的风险系数。对于二元奖励，我们证明，该变换恰好等价于对中心化结果优势进行依赖于提示词和状态的重缩放。基于能力的校准给出了系数尺度的建议，而端点和插值消融实验则为调度方案的选择提供依据。在多个 dLLM 骨干模型和数学推理基准上，与中心化 GRPO 相比，StepRS-GRPO 同时提升了 pass@1 准确率和 pass@k 覆盖率，并增加了答案多样性。在我们的消融研究中，质量匹配的对照实验支持状态分配和调度方向所发挥的作用；在将优势的均方根（RMS）与中心化 GRPO 匹配后，这些增益仍然存在。推理轨迹诊断进一步表明，StepRS-GRPO 带来的多样性增益并不局限于最终答案字符串。

    Many Steps into One: Reasoning Contraction and the Limits of Safe Memory Reuse for LLM Agents

    化多步为一步：LLM 智能体推理压缩与安全复用记忆的局限

    Jianghong Zhou, Hao Rong, Chen Lin, Daoan Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes when compressed memories can safely replace multi-step reasoning, proves limits for success counters, and proposes likelihood-ratio certification and change detection. This directly advances agent memory and reasoning reliability; composition is only implicit in contracting steps into memories, without a substantive compositional result.

    本文分析压缩记忆何时能够安全取代多步推理，证明了成功计数器的局限，并提出基于似然比的认证和变化检测方法。这直接提升了智能体记忆与推理的可靠性；组合性仅隐含在将多个步骤压缩为记忆的做法中，并无实质性的组合研究结果。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Thought templates, skill libraries, agent memories and caches turn many reasoning steps into one. We call this reasoning contraction. A contracted memory saves reasoning steps and errors until its facts change, then quietly answers wrong. Most systems trust memories by counting successes and failures. We prove that such counters are badly tuned change detectors: a symmetric counter notices a partial change only after a power of its false-alarm horizon, and an unclipped one may never notice it. On five LLMs answering multi-hop questions over edited facts, ExpeL- and ACE-style counters serve 7.0-13.5x more stale answers than certified memories given the same information, and on code tasks with an exact verifier 35-73x more. Safety also has a price. When facts change and each memory is judged only by its own verified outcomes, one number, the certification load, sets how much reasoning any safe memory can skip, and under Zipf demand it yields a scaling law. Our recipe weighs each memory's failures by its own likelihood ratio, certifies its utility against live reasoning, and restarts the certificate when facts change, with the likelihood-ratio detector as the safety net for unannounced changes; for large edits it also invalidates the memory.

    中文

    思维模板、技能库、智能体记忆和缓存会将多个推理步骤变成一步。我们称之为推理压缩。压缩后的记忆可以节省推理步骤并减少错误，直到其中的事实发生变化，此时它便会悄然给出错误答案。大多数系统通过统计成功和失败次数来信任记忆。我们证明，这类计数器的变化检测性能很差：对称计数器只有在虚警时间范围的某个幂次之后才能发现局部变化，而未截断的计数器可能永远也发现不了。在五个 LLM 上针对经过修改事实的多跳问题进行回答时，在信息量相同的条件下，ExpeL 和 ACE 风格的计数器给出的过时答案数量是经认证记忆的 7.0-13.5 倍；在带有精确验证器的代码任务上则是 35-73 倍。安全也有代价。当事实发生变化，且每条记忆只依据自身经过验证的结果来评判时，一个数值——认证负载——决定了任何安全记忆可以省去多少推理步骤；在 Zipf 需求分布下，它还会导出一条缩放定律。我们的方法根据每条记忆自身的似然比对其失败进行加权，使用实时推理来认证其效用，并在事实发生变化时重新启动认证；同时使用似然比检测器作为应对未报告变化的安全网；对于较大的编辑，则会使记忆失效。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Memory systems for persistent personal agents must move beyond isolated memories, maintaining both personal memory about whom they serve and procedural memory about how to act. Crucially, in harness-based personal assistance, procedures or skills are inherently user-conditioned: personal context determines which procedures apply, how they are instantiated, and when they should change. Existing benchmarks typically emphasize either personal or procedural memory, leaving their interaction underexplored. We introduce PraxisMemBench, a harness-based benchmark for persistent personal assistance across daily-life and work trajectories, where personal and procedural memory evolve together and later tasks depend on both. Experiments show that maintaining two memory types separately is insufficient, with completion dropping from single-type to interdependent dependencies (84.6% to 77.9%). More broadly, across existing methods, relation-related failures increase from early to late sessions as interaction history grows (59.8% to 72.9%), revealing a continual-maintenance challenge: writing correct memories is not enough if their evolving content and organization cannot be preserved for later retrieval. To address this, we propose PraxisMem, which uses privileged joint-state supervision to internalize the ability to maintain memory content and organization into the memory manager, with location-aware GRPO and dynamic residual-routed OPSD. PraxisMem reaches 40.78% overall Session Success Rate, compared with 20.60% for Claude Code's native memory. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/QMMMS/PraxisMemBench.

    中文

    持久型个人智能体的记忆系统必须超越彼此孤立的记忆，同时维护关于服务对象的个人记忆，以及关于如何行动的程序性记忆。关键在于，在基于工具框架的个人助理场景中，程序或技能本质上受用户条件制约：个人情境决定哪些程序适用、如何实例化，以及何时需要改变。现有基准通常侧重个人记忆或程序性记忆之一，对两者之间的相互作用探究不足。我们推出 PraxisMemBench，这是一个基于工具框架、涵盖日常生活和工作轨迹的持久型个人助理基准，其中个人记忆和程序性记忆会共同演进，后续任务依赖于二者。实验表明，分别维护两类记忆并不足够：从单一类型依赖转为相互依赖时，任务完成率从 84.6% 降至 77.9%。更广泛地看，在现有方法中，随着交互历史增长，从早期到后期会话的关系相关失败比例从 59.8% 上升至 72.9%，揭示出持续维护方面的挑战：如果记忆内容和组织方式不断变化，却无法为之后的检索保留下来，那么仅仅写入正确记忆并不够。为解决这一问题，我们提出 PraxisMem，它利用特权联合状态监督，将维护记忆内容与组织方式的能力内化到记忆管理器中，并采用位置感知的 GRPO 和动态残差路由 OPSD。PraxisMem 的总体会话成功率达到 40.78%，而 Claude Code 的原生记忆为 20.60%。代码公开于 https://github.com/QMMMS/PraxisMemBench。

    The paper establishes when supervised networks recover latent variables as interpretable representations, including conditions for linear, nonlinear, and axis-aligned codes, with validation across model activations. Its central contribution directly advances representation identifiability; links to composition are limited to sparse codes and dictionary learning rather than compositional generalization.

    本文确立了监督网络在何种条件下能够将潜变量恢复为可解释表征，包括线性、非线性和轴对齐编码的形成条件，并在多种模型激活上进行验证。其核心贡献直接推进了表征可辨识性研究；与组合的联系主要涉及稀疏编码和字典学习，而非组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Understanding when neural networks learn interpretable representations is central to mechanistic interpretability. We study this through identifiability: when can supervised learning recover the true latent variables underlying the data? We introduce two data generating processes distinguished by their causal direction where either labels cause latents (generative) or latents cause labels (discriminative). When the representation has at least as many dimensions as the latent space, we prove that the optimal encoders are linear in the latents. Conversely, when dimensions are insufficient, identifiability generically fails and encoders become nonlinear. We then show that additional constraints yield recovery of individual latent variables, not just linear mixtures. In the generative setting, non-negative activations and energy efficiency force each neuron to encode exactly one latent, providing a precise account of selective grandmother cell-like responses. In the discriminative setting, when latents are sparse and the true measurement matrix satisfies the spark condition, the learned encoder inherits compressed sensing structure, enabling sparse dictionary learning to perfectly recover individual latents. This constitutes, to our knowledge, the first identifiability result for undercomplete nonlinear independent component analysis. Our framework unifies nonlinear ICA, compressed sensing, and neural network interpretability, delineating exactly when representations transition from nonlinear distortions to linear representations and, under additional constraints or steps, to clean, axis-aligned codes. Theoretical predictions are validated on synthetic benchmarks and on activations drawn from vision models, large language models, and macaque inferotemporal cortex.

    中文

    理解神经网络何时会学习到可解释表征，是机制可解释性的核心问题。我们从可辨识性的角度研究这一问题：监督学习何时能够恢复数据背后的真实潜变量？我们提出两种数据生成过程，其区别在于因果方向：一种是标签导致潜变量（生成式），另一种是潜变量导致标签（判别式）。当表征的维度至少与潜变量空间相同时，我们证明，最优编码器关于潜变量是线性的。相反，当维度不足时，可辨识性通常会失效，编码器也会变成非线性。随后我们表明，额外约束能够帮助恢复单个潜变量，而不只是它们的线性混合。在生成式设置中，非负激活和能量效率会迫使每个神经元恰好编码一个潜变量，从而为选择性的祖母细胞式响应提供了精确解释。在判别式设置中，当潜变量稀疏且真实测量矩阵满足 spark 条件时，学得的编码器会继承压缩感知结构，使稀疏字典学习能够完美恢复各个潜变量。据我们所知，这是关于欠完备非线性独立成分分析的首个可辨识性结果。我们的框架统一了非线性 ICA、压缩感知和神经网络可解释性，精确界定了表征何时会从非线性失真转变为线性表征，以及何时能在额外约束或步骤下进一步形成整洁、轴对齐的编码。我们在合成基准，以及从视觉模型、大型语言模型和猕猴颞下皮层中提取的激活上验证了理论预测。

Its evidence for reusable structure and binding supports compositional generalization, while no systems contribution is described.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    It has long been proposed that animals construct cognitive maps to support flexible behavior in novel environments. We tested whether large language models form similar representations using relational reasoning tasks and causal "mosaic experiments" that manipulate internal activations in open-weight language models. Models beyond the ten-billion-parameter scale successfully inferred unstated relationships between entities and generalized to synthetic entity names. Across model and task families, models generated abstract representations of relational structure and combined them additively with representations of entity identity, binding entities to roles within that structure. Models stored observed relationships as pairwise links that they composed retrospectively when queried, rather than prospectively positioning each entity in a global coordinate system. Binding was mediated by a sparse, distributed set of key--value pairs; by perturbing these pairs, we implanted "false memories" that altered model behavior in predictable ways. Overall, our findings reveal an internal organization analogous to a cognitive map that explains how language models reason with limited information.

    MemT-1.0 introduces an architecture and training pipeline that make memory part of model computation, with storage scaling, retrieval, and agent-task results as central contributions.     MemT-1.0 提出一种架构和训练流程，将记忆纳入模型计算，并将存储扩展、检索和智能体任务结果作为核心贡献。这直接推动了模型记忆系统的发展，但摘要关于内部知识机制或推理方面的证据有限，除任务成功率提升之外未提供更多信息。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. Following a deliberate backbone preparation, we develop a two-stage training pipeline consisting of continued pre-training and post-training, supported by 34B tokens of training data and efficient training and inference infrastructure. We release a model family comprising MemT-1.0-Nano and MemT-1.0-Flash, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of memory and general capabilities. The results show that they outperform the parametric memory baselines on average and remain competitive with retrieval-augmented methods, while largely preserving general capabilities. At a history length of 128K tokens, MemT-1.0-Nano achieves approximately $1.86\times$ end-to-end inference speedup and a $66\times$ reduction in persistent storage relative to full context KV cache. By internalizing retrieved procedural experience, MemT-1.0 improves task success on agentic tasks, providing a practical step toward memory-native evolution.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    本文测量有序层状态轨迹并对其进行干预以控制推理行为，直接推进了对内部机制的分析。研究聚焦于推理动态，因此与推理研究相关；候选项竞争只是研究中的附带内容，且本文未提出模型或智能体系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Mechanistic studies of large language models localize function in parameters, attention heads or neurons, but those parts do not specify how one inference unfolds. We treat the ordered layer-state trajectory as the empirical process and test whether layer order defines a measurable computation. Across representative Qwen, Llama and Gemma checkpoints, realized order produced paths 1.60--2.24 times as aligned with their endpoint chord as endpoint-preserving shuffles. The order effect transferred to a lexical task, but was stronger in three random initializations of the same Qwen architecture, identifying an architecture-compatible scaffold rather than a training-specific law. Direct hidden states provided stronger mechanism coordinates than vocabulary readbacks, and a task-defined coordinate made candidate competition computable. After additive interventions failed, local transition actuators selectively controlled internal trajectories across checkpoints. A confidence gate then drove 17 of 87 held-out Qwen closure trajectories across the full-vocabulary top-1 candidate boundary while leaving all 203 non-closure top-1 outputs unchanged. Safety-matched action reassignment performed similarly, locating the gain in selective gating and the bounded actuator family rather than fine-grained dose assignment. Layer order exposes an observable, computable and behaviourally consequential process of transformer inference without establishing a complete theory of LLM dynamics or control of answer correctness.

    对大型语言模型的机制研究会将功能定位到参数、注意力头或神经元中，但这些组成部分并不能说明一次推理是如何展开的。我们将有序的层状态轨迹视为经验过程，并检验层顺序是否定义了一种可测量的计算。在具有代表性的 Qwen、Llama 和 Gemma 检查点上，实际层顺序产生的路径与端点弦的对齐程度，是保持端点不变的打乱顺序所得路径的 1.60--2.24 倍。顺序效应迁移到了一个词汇任务上，但在同一 Qwen 架构的三个随机初始化中更强，这表明存在与架构兼容的支架，而非特定于训练的规律。直接隐藏状态比词表回读提供了更强的机制坐标，而由任务定义的坐标则使候选项竞争变得可计算。在加性干预失败后，局部转移执行器得以跨检查点选择性地控制内部轨迹。随后，一个置信度门控使留出的 Qwen 闭合轨迹中有 87 条里的 17 条跨越了完整词表的 top-1 候选边界，同时保持全部 203 个非闭合 top-1 输出不变。安全性匹配的动作重新分配取得了相似效果，这表明增益来自选择性门控和有界执行器族，而非精细的剂量分配。层顺序揭示了 Transformer 推理过程中一个可观测、可计算且会对行为产生实质影响的过程，但这并未建立关于 LLM 动态或答案正确性控制的完整理论。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We show that two-layer transformers trained to near-zero loss on a sorting task converge to one of two mechanistically distinct solution classes depending on their initialization. One solution class consists of solutions that do not use the second attention layer to sort, but also fail to length-generalize. The other, which uses both attention layers, length-generalizes perfectly, despite only being trained to sort sequences of a fixed length. By carefully choosing the weight initialization, we demonstrate that we can steer the model toward learning one solution or the other. We identify input types that are rare at the training length but increasingly common at longer sequence lengths as a source of this disparity in length-generalization, and find that layer-wise specialization of the second class of solutions allows them to handle these rare sequences more accurately. In the second class, we discover a mechanism by which the second layer attention can use the contextual information gathered by the first layer attention to reduce its search space. On the related task of finding the minimum of a sequence, we find a similar two solution-type phenomenon, but with the opposite generalization pattern, where a different form of layer-wise specialization causes the two-layer solution to length-generalize worse than the single-attention solution.

    本文提出一种用于 MoE 解码的软硬件系统，通过对互补的专家负载进行分组、以局部性为目标进行映射，并在线重映射来应对工作负载漂移。这直接推进了模型计算与系统性能；专家路由和负载互补性本身不足以证明组合泛化或可解释性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) have become a mainstream way to scale Large Language Models (LLMs), because each token activates only a small subset of experts, reducing inference cost. However, MoE decode remains highly memory-bound and exhibits strongly skewed, time-varying expert loads. 3D-stacked DRAM near-memory processing (NMP) provides the bandwidth that decode demands, yet its tiled organization makes load balancing expensive: expert parallelism (EP) preserves locality but suffers from hotspot-induced imbalance, while more distributed strategies weaken locality and increase NoC traffic. To address this locality-balance conflict, we observe that domain-specialized token routing creates offsetting expert-load fluctuations across decode steps, a property we call expert complementarity. Using this insight, we propose 3D-MoE, a hardware--software co-designed system for MoE decode on 3D-stacked NMP. 3D-MoE uses offline, one-time complementarity-guided grouping and locality-aware mapping to establish coarse-grained inter-group balance, handles residual intra-group hotspots through a lightweight Collaborative Memory-Network (CMN) that streams each hot expert's weight tiles once from its host DRAM channel to helper cores over a reconfigured local broadcast path, and uses cost-aware online remapping to remain robust to workload drift. Across MoE models, 3D-MoE achieves an average 4.63$\times$ MoE-layer speedup over EP and improves end-to-end throughput by 1.58$\times$--1.86$\times$ over the strongest NMP baselines, with 2.11\% additional logic-die area.

    中文

    混合专家（MoE）已成为扩展大语言模型（LLM）的主流方式，因为每个 token 只激活一小部分专家，从而降低推理成本。然而，MoE 解码仍严重受限于内存，并且专家负载随时间变化且高度偏斜。3D 堆叠 DRAM 近存处理（NMP）提供了解码所需的带宽，但其分块式组织使负载均衡成本高昂：专家并行（EP）保留了局部性，却会因热点而导致负载不均衡；更分布式的策略则会削弱局部性并增加 NoC 流量。 为解决局部性与均衡之间的冲突，我们观察到，领域专门化的 token 路由会使不同解码步骤之间的专家负载波动相互抵消；我们将这一性质称为专家互补性。基于这一发现，我们提出 3D-MoE，一种面向 3D 堆叠 NMP 上 MoE 解码的软硬件协同设计系统。3D-MoE 通过离线执行一次的互补性引导分组和感知局部性的映射，实现粗粒度的组间均衡；通过轻量级协同内存网络（CMN）处理组内剩余热点，该网络沿着重新配置的本地广播路径，将每个热点专家的权重块从其所属 DRAM 通道一次性传输到辅助核心；此外，系统还采用感知成本的在线重映射，以应对工作负载漂移。在多个 MoE 模型上，与 EP 相比，3D-MoE 的 MoE 层平均加速比为 4.63$\times$；与最强 NMP 基线相比，端到端吞吐量提高 1.58$\times$--1.86$\times$，逻辑裸片面积额外增加 2.11\%。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    Inference-time harnesses, i.e., external procedures that call a model many times and keep state across calls, can substantially improve model capabilities. In this paper, we investigate the benefits of using such harnesses and the extent to which these benefits can be internalized through training. More precisely, we conceptualize a harness $\mathcal{A}$ as an arbitrary wrapper around a base model $M$ and attempt to distill a student model from the harness's traces. Empirically we find that, even with simple scaffolds and small models, the inference-time harness significantly outperforms a distilled student. We then prove that such a gap is due to a fundamental representational limitation: inference-time harnesses can compute a closure of their per-call primitive that is $\NL$-complete even when the primitive is a trivial $\AC^0$ lookup, and that no fixed-depth forward pass can represent under the widely believed conjecture that $\NL\not\subseteq\TC^0$. Our theory suggests that expanding the representational capacity of the student relative to the task at hand, e.g., by enlarging the model, making the task easier, or lengthening its chain-of-thought, is necessary to close the gap, which we verify empirically. Finally, we scale to an agentic harness on competition math, where the same gap reappears. Overall, our results show that a harness confers on the base model a profound gain in representational power, one that training a same-class student on its traces cannot transfer back into the weights.

    推理时工具框架（即多次调用模型并在调用之间保持状态的外部流程）可以显著提升模型能力。本文研究使用此类工具框架的益处，以及这些益处在多大程度上能够通过训练内化。更具体地说，我们将工具框架概念化为围绕基础模型 $\mathcal{A}$ 的任意包装器，并尝试根据工具框架生成的轨迹蒸馏出一个学生模型。通过实证研究，我们发现，即使使用简单的脚手架和小型模型，推理时工具框架的表现也显著优于蒸馏后的学生模型。随后我们证明，这种差距源于一种根本的表征局限：推理时工具框架能够对其逐次调用的基本操作进行闭包计算，即使该基本操作只是一个简单的 $M$ 查找，其计算能力也达到 $\NL$ 完全；而在广泛认可的猜想 $\AC^0$ 成立的前提下，任何固定深度的前向传播都无法实现这一点。我们的理论表明，要弥合差距，必须相对于当前任务提升学生模型的表征能力，例如扩大模型规模、降低任务难度或延长其思维链；我们通过实证研究验证了这一点。最后，我们将实验扩展到用于竞赛数学的智能体工具框架，同样的差距再次出现。总的来说，我们的结果表明，工具框架赋予基础模型深远的表征能力提升，而在同类学生模型上使用其轨迹进行训练，无法将这种能力转移回模型权重中。任意包装器的概念可表示为 $\NL\not\subseteq\TC^0$ 对基础模型的包装；实验表明，即使基本操作是简单的查找，工具框架仍可能具有显著优势。

    用于 LLM 推理的稀疏 RL 松弛方法

    Jiabin Fan, Matthias Lindemann, Zita Marinho, Andr\'e FT Martins, Lili Mou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SpaRLax trains soft chain-of-thought reasoning by propagating gradients across steps and adaptively sparsifying token mixtures, with gains on reasoning benchmarks. Its discussion of superposition concerns soft-token computation rather than internal representation mechanisms, and it does not substantially address compositional generalization or model-system organization.

    SpaRLax 通过跨步骤传播梯度并自适应地稀疏化 token 混合，来训练软思维链推理，并在推理基准上取得提升。文中关于叠加的讨论涉及软 token 计算，而非内部表征机制；它也没有实质性地探讨组合泛化或模型系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent work has explored continuous representations in place of discrete tokens during Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, often referred to as soft CoT. This is motivated by the idea that a mixture of token embeddings can represent a superposition of multiple reasoning possibilities within a single step. However, it remains challenging to train large language models to realize this potential. Existing work has explored reinforcement learning (RL)-style training for soft CoT. However, these approaches treat soft tokens as actions in a Markov decision process rather than as differentiable intermediate computation steps. Thus, they do not propagate gradients across the soft tokens and miss out on the signal of how the choice of one soft token affects the next. In this paper, we propose a sparse relaxation method for RL (called SpaRLax), which leverages the differentiability of soft-CoT reasoning over time steps and makes training more stable and effective. We adopt an entmax sparsity method that adaptively determines the degree of softness, which truncates long-tail noise at confident steps while retaining multiple plausible candidates when uncertain. Across nine reasoning benchmarks, our method achieves the highest average performance compared with baseline methods. Further analyses validate the effective use of soft-token superposition in our approach, and also demonstrate the contribution of adaptive sparsity in our approach.

    近期研究探索在思维链（CoT）推理中用连续表征替代离散 token，这通常称为软 CoT。其动机是，token 嵌入的混合可以在单个步骤中表示多种推理可能性的叠加。然而，要训练大型语言模型实现这一潜力仍然很有挑战。已有研究探索了用于软 CoT 的强化学习（RL）式训练。然而，这些方法将软 token 视为马尔可夫决策过程中的动作，而不是可微的中间计算步骤。因此，它们不会跨软 token 传播梯度，也无法利用关于一个软 token 的选择如何影响下一个软 token 的信号。本文提出一种用于 RL 的稀疏松弛方法（称为 SpaRLax），利用软 CoT 推理跨时间步的可微性，使训练更稳定、更有效。我们采用 entmax 稀疏化方法，自适应地确定软化程度：在置信度高的步骤截断长尾噪声，在不确定时则保留多个合理候选项。在九个推理基准上，与基线方法相比，我们的方法取得了最高的平均表现。进一步分析验证了我们方法对软 token 叠加的有效运用，也展示了自适应稀疏性的贡献。

    Oveys Delafrooz Noroozi, Bhagyashree Puranik, Upamanyu Madhow

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper directly develops and evaluates activation shaping and a new SAE training method to improve feature selectivity, making a core contribution to mechanistic interpretability. Its use of learned dictionaries is not a contribution about compositional generalization, reasoning, or system organization.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) seek to decompose the dense activations of large language models (LLMs) into sparse, potentially interpretable features using a learned overcomplete dictionary. In this work, we ask whether it is possible to enhance the semantic selectivity of the learned dictionary atoms by linearly \emph{shaping} the dense activations prior to learning an SAE. We explore rank-reducing transformations based on the recently introduced J-space corresponding to the averaged Jacobian from the current layer to the LLM output, projecting activations onto the ``live'' subspace spanned by eigenmodes of the Jacobian with larger singular values (which we expect to be more semantically relevant). We also introduce a new approach for training SAEs in which (a)~an affine shaping transformation is learned along with the dictionary atoms, (b)~the atom selection mechanism is based on the TopK projections along the one-dimensional subspace spanned by the atoms, and (c)~reconstruction is carried out using the same atoms. We call this approach a Matched Filter SAE (MF-SAE) based on analogies with communication theory. The promise of shaping is demonstrated via evaluations against dense activations and state-of-the-art SAEs on benchmarks including SAEBench and SAE Probes.

    REM：编码智能体经验记忆中的存储、回忆与遗忘

    Xinyi Lisa Chen, Pedro Herrero-Vidal, Xiaohan Chen, Xiaojing Yu, Cris Liu, Bingqing Song, Bin Xu, Suleiman A. Khan, You-Lin Chen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    REM’s main contribution is an agent memory lifecycle that governs what to store, when to recall it, and when to forget it, with ablations and task results supporting these design choices. The coding benchmark involves reasoning and reusable experience, but the abstract does not claim advances in reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    REM 的主要贡献是一套智能体记忆生命周期管理机制，决定存储什么、何时回忆以及何时遗忘，并通过消融实验和任务结果支持这些设计选择。代码基准涉及推理和经验复用，但摘要并未声称其推进了推理机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents now autonomously complete long-horizon tasks, such as repository-level coding, through hundreds of think-act steps, yet the experience each run produces is rarely reused on the next. Prior memory systems concentrate on retrieval, finding the most relevant past trajectory. Retrieval cannot observe the running agent, so it cannot decide whether the agent needs an experience, at which point, or for how long. We introduce REM (Reusable Experience Memory), a framework that manages the memory lifecycle from inside the agent's think-act loop through three explicit decisions. What to store: each completed trajectory is consolidated into a phase-structured document, two orders of magnitude smaller than the trajectory. When to recall: the document is injected at the start of the task; the costlier implementation record is withheld until an in-loop gate detects the agent struggling. What to forget: the record is evicted after a single exposure. On repository-level bug fixing (SWE-ContextBench Lite), REM retrieves the related trajectory more accurately than every state-of-the-art memory system (68.7% vs. 55.6% match@1) and improves, in every replicate, end-task resolution (27.6% vs. 24.9%) at 17% lower cost. Injecting the same experience as a summary or raw trajectory, even when oracle-retrieved, does not. Ablating any of the three decisions reduces resolution. Altogether, these results demonstrate that the bottleneck in experience reuse is not retrieval fidelity but how experience is stored and governed across its lifecycle, opening a control-theoretic perspective on agent memory.

    中文

    如今，大语言模型（LLM）智能体能够通过数百个思考与行动步骤自主完成长时程任务，例如代码仓库级编程；然而，每次运行所产生的经验很少会在下一次运行中复用。以往的记忆系统主要关注检索，即寻找最相关的过往轨迹。检索无法观察正在运行的智能体，因此无法判断智能体是否需要某段经验、何时需要，或需要多久。我们提出 REM（可复用经验记忆），这是一个在智能体思考与行动循环内部管理记忆生命周期的框架，通过三个明确决策进行管理。存储什么：将每条已完成的轨迹整理为按阶段组织的文档，其大小比原轨迹小两个数量级。何时回忆：在任务开始时注入该文档；成本较高的实现记录则暂不提供，直到循环内的门控机制检测到智能体遇到困难。遗忘什么：记录在暴露一次后即被移除。在代码仓库级错误修复任务（SWE-ContextBench Lite）上，REM 检索相关轨迹的准确度高于所有最先进的记忆系统（68.7% 对比 55.6% match@1），并且在每次重复实验中都提高了最终任务解决率（27.6% 对比 24.9%），同时成本降低了 17%。即使通过 oracle 检索，将相同经验以摘要或原始轨迹的形式注入，也无法达到这一效果。移除这三个决策中的任何一个都会降低解决率。总体而言，这些结果表明，经验复用的瓶颈并非检索保真度，而是经验在整个生命周期中的存储与管理方式；这为智能体记忆提供了控制理论视角。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper directly studies errors in attribution patching for mechanistic interpretability and introduces Guided-AP to use a few exact measurements to correct unmeasured estimates. This is a core contribution to identifying which model components affect behavior; it does not substantively address the other directions.

    论文直接研究机制可解释性中的归因补丁误差，并提出 Guided-AP，利用少量精确测量来校正未经测量的估计。这是识别哪些模型组件会影响行为的一项核心贡献；论文并未实质性涉及其他方向。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Mechanistic interpretability asks which language model components matter for a behavior, and activation patching answers by changing one component's activation and measuring its effect, at a cost growing with components and prompts. Attribution patching estimates these effects from one gradient pass, but its estimates can be far off, and verifying each one restores the cost. Can the structure of these errors reduce this cost? We propose Guided-AP, which uses a few exact measurements to reveal attribution patching's errors and correct unmeasured estimates. On a single prompt, many components' errors share one sign, so a small exact sample yields one correction for the rest. Over many prompts of one task, components are misestimated similarly, so a few measured prompts show what to verify and how to correct each component's average effect. Our analysis shows that choosing what to verify needs error size, while correction also needs sign. On a single prompt, the correction lowers error by up to 26% across three behaviors at the compute of verifying the largest estimates and also on larger models. Over many prompts, learned corrections cut the error of average effects on factual completion by 75% to 79%, repaying their cost in long analyses.

    中文

    机制可解释性研究哪些语言模型组件会影响某种行为；激活补丁通过改变一个组件的激活并测量其影响来回答这一问题，但成本会随组件数和提示数增长。归因补丁通过一次梯度计算来估计这些影响，但估计可能严重偏离真实值；逐一验证每个估计又会使成本回升。能否利用这些误差的结构来降低成本？我们提出 Guided-AP，它用少量精确测量揭示归因补丁的误差，并校正未经测量的估计。对于单个提示，许多组件的误差具有相同符号，因此少量精确采样便可得出适用于其余组件的校正值。对于同一任务的多个提示，组件的误估方式相似，因此少量经过测量的提示便能揭示需要验证哪些结果，以及如何校正每个组件的平均影响。我们的分析表明，选择需要验证的对象需要误差大小信息，而校正还需要误差符号信息。对于单个提示，在计算量相当于验证最大估计值的情况下，这种校正能将三种行为的误差最多降低 26%，且这一效果也适用于更大的模型。对于多个提示，学习得到的校正能将事实补全中平均影响的误差降低 75% 至 79%，并在长时间分析中抵偿其成本。

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents are moving beyond reactive responses toward proactive assistance that anticipates user needs without explicit requests. However, existing proactive agents primarily address immediate needs, while many everyday situations involve delayed intentions that can only be acted on hours or days later. Humans handle such intentions through prospective memory, the ability to remember to act on an intention when the right moment arises. In this paper, we introduce ProMemAgent, the first proactive agent to incorporate prospective memory over everyday sensory contexts for long-horizon proactive assistance. ProMemAgent organizes past sensory perceptions (e.g., egocentric video and audio) into context-aware memory, generating prospective cues and linking earlier events with subsequent developments for future retrieval. Given the current context, it retrieves relevant past events and performs memory-augmented proactive reasoning to determine whether assistance is needed. We further introduce CPMBench, the first benchmark for evaluating long-horizon proactive assistance over sensory contexts, comprising 1,000 instances across eight everyday categories. Extensive experiments show that ProMemAgent achieves the best memory retrieval performance and consistently outperforms all baselines on long-horizon proactive assistance.

    文本转语音合成中的韵调引导

    Juan Pablo Vigneaux and Jennifer Cole

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses interchange interventions and steering vectors to locate and causally control how speech models represent intonational tunes, a direct mechanistic interpretability contribution. Its use of two-stage TTS systems is context; it does not substantively address composition, reasoning, or system design.

    本文使用互换干预和引导向量，定位并因果控制语音模型如何表征韵调，是对机制可解释性的直接贡献。文中使用两阶段 TTS 系统只是背景，并未实质探讨组合性、推理或系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Text-to-speech systems built on residual vector quantization often generate audio in two stages: a transformer backbone emits the first level of each frame's token stack, and a smaller depth model generates the rest autoregressively. We ask which components of such a model are responsible for prosodic intonation, more precisely for generating the English nuclear tune (for instance, the falling pitch melody that distinguishes an assertion from a question's rising melody), and whether interventions on those components can be used to control intonation. Prompt-based control mostly fails; only a final question mark is a reliable lever. Interchange interventions in CSM and S2 locate the tune: the backbone's hidden state carries it to the waveform through the depth model, and the first level of the stack carries little or none of it. Steering the backbone state with a difference-of-means vector computed on new material generated with a final period or question mark moves the tune, but the push toward an assertion degrades the voice. Steering vectors computed instead from the backbone states associated with human imitations of theoretically-specified tunes, whose text carries no punctuation, and applied inside the generation loop, move most recordings to the other condition in both systems (even when fitted without the speaker being steered), at a small cost in predicted naturalness. These imitation-derived vectors are aligned with the one obtained from the two punctuated conditions far beyond a shuffled-label null, so the backbone state of a punctuated prompt already represents intonation. The steered recordings broadly become falling or rising, according to the intent, but the edge tone moves more coherently than the pitch accent, and the target tune cannot be selected precisely beyond this broad tendency.

    更多记忆，更差的智能体：LLM 智能体中的错误再现与反持久化

    Ruhan Wang, Kishan Panaganti, Dongruo Zhou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies error reproduction in persistent agent memory and proposes Anti-Persistence, which reconstructs task guidance on demand and improves held-out success and call cost. The feedback loop involves repeated abstraction, but the contribution centers on memory and agent design rather than internal representations or compositional generalization.

    本文指出持久化智能体记忆中的错误再现问题，并提出反持久化：按需重建任务指导信息，从而提高留出集成功率并降低调用成本。其反馈循环涉及反复抽象，但贡献核心在于记忆和智能体设计，而非内部表征或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents can improve across tasks without updating model parameters by storing experience from their own executions in external memory and reusing it to guide later decisions. A central design question is whether to retain only observed trajectories and outcomes or also the rules, summaries, and skills inferred from them. Retaining these abstractions allows agents to reuse strategies without repeatedly deriving them from raw trajectories. However, errors in stored abstractions can propagate to subsequent decisions through retrieval and reuse. They can also shape execution trajectories, which then become the basis for new abstractions that reproduce the original errors. We term this feedback mechanism error reproduction: errors are regenerated through a cycle of abstraction, execution, and re-abstraction, extending their persistence beyond direct reuse of the original faulty knowledge. We propose Anti-Persistence, a memory design that accumulates trajectories and outcomes while reconstructing task-specific guidance on demand. An adaptive selector uses prior outcomes to decide whether and how to synthesize guidance, which is discarded after execution. This prevents its direct reuse as a stored object, although indirect feedback through retained trajectories remains possible. Across different benchmarks and backbones, Anti-Persistence achieves higher overall held-out success and the lowest average LLM-call cost among the evaluated memory designs. These results support separating experience accumulation from abstraction persistence in memorybased self-improvement.

    中文

    LLM 智能体可以在不更新模型参数的情况下提升跨任务表现：它们把自身执行过程中积累的经验存入外部记忆，并在之后的决策中再次调用这些经验。一个核心设计问题是，应该只保留观察到的轨迹和结果，还是也保留从中归纳出的规则、摘要和技能。保留这些抽象信息，可以让智能体复用策略，而不必反复从原始轨迹中推导策略。然而，存储的抽象信息中的错误可能通过检索和复用传播到后续决策中。这些错误还可能影响执行轨迹，而新的抽象又以这些轨迹为基础，从而再现原有错误。我们将这一反馈机制称为错误再现：错误在抽象、执行和再抽象的循环中重新生成，使其持续时间超出对原始错误知识的直接复用。我们提出反持久化（Anti-Persistence），这是一种记忆设计，它累积轨迹和结果，同时按需重建特定任务的指导信息。自适应选择器利用先前结果决定是否以及如何合成指导信息；执行结束后，这些信息即被丢弃。这样可以避免将指导信息作为存储对象直接复用，但保留的轨迹仍可能产生间接反馈。在不同基准和主干模型上，与所评估的其他记忆设计相比，反持久化取得了更高的总体留出集成功率和最低的平均 LLM 调用成本。这些结果支持在基于记忆的自我改进中，将经验积累与抽象信息持久化分开。

    Thamirawaran Sathiyalogeswaran, Navindu De Silva, Chamikara Siriwardane, W. K. Alwis, Jason Mars, Udaya Sampath K. Perera Miriya Thanthrige, Ranga Rodrigo

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LoRASpace uses shared low-rank subspaces and input-dependent routing to compose multiple LoRAs with lower inference cost, making efficient model composition and computation its main contributions. The measured overlap offers a limited connection to representation geometry, but the work studies LoRA factors rather than internal representations or mechanisms.

    LoRASpace 使用共享低秩子空间和依赖输入的路由，以更低的推理成本组合多个 LoRA，因此其主要贡献是高效模型组合和计算。测得的重叠度与表征几何只有有限关联；本文研究的是 LoRA 因子，而非内部表征或机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) attaches small low-rank matrices to a frozen backbone, and public repositories host many LoRAs per backbone, each for a different concept or task. Combining several LoRAs in one generation forces a trade-off. Merging their weights into one update needs a single forward pass, but LoRAs trained for different concepts interfere and quality drops. Running each LoRA in its own forward pass (composite) preserves quality, but inference time grows linearly with the number of active LoRAs. We study a property of LoRA pools overlooked by prior multi-LoRA work. In real LoRA pools, the stacked low-rank factors need far fewer directions than their summed ranks. Using singular value decomposition, we find the minimal subspace that keeps 99% of the factor energy. On three diffusion pools, only 46% to 57% of the summed LoRA ranks is needed, and the subspace grows sub-linearly with pool size. A 48-LoRA sub-pool of LoRA-Hub on FLAN-T5 tasks shows comparable overlap (62%), while the diversity-curated LoRA-Retriever benchmark sits near the no-overlap baseline (96%), so pool composition rather than modality predicts where compression is large. We build on this overlap with LoRASpace, a training-free method that computes the subspace once per pool and reuses it in two inference modes, a static mode at merge cost and a dynamic mode for input-dependent routing. On the diffusion pools, static LoRASpace matches composite quality at merge cost, and dynamic LoRASpace is more than 6x faster than composite with six active LoRAs on a 17-LoRA pool, mainly because it runs one backbone pass instead of six. In an ablation, static variants at the same rank match LoRASpace, so the quality gain does not depend on the pool-wide basis. On the near-orthogonal LoRA-Retriever benchmark, compression is small and gains come from coupling with external retrieval.

    中文

    低秩适配（LoRA）会在冻结的主干网络上附加小型低秩矩阵，公共仓库中则为每个主干网络托管了许多 LoRA，每个都针对不同概念或任务。在一次生成中组合多个 LoRA 会带来权衡。将它们的权重合并为一个更新只需一次前向传播，但针对不同概念训练的 LoRA 会相互干扰，导致质量下降。让每个 LoRA 分别进行一次前向传播（复合方式）可以保持质量，但推理时间会随启用的 LoRA 数量线性增长。我们研究了此前多 LoRA 工作忽视的一种 LoRA 池属性。在真实 LoRA 池中，堆叠的低秩因子所需的方向远少于其秩之和。我们使用奇异值分解找出能够保留 99% 因子能量的最小子空间。在三个扩散模型池中，所需维度仅为 LoRA 秩总和的 46% 至 57%，而且子空间随池大小呈次线性增长。使用 FLAN-T5 任务的 LoRA-Hub 子池（包含 48 个 LoRA）显示出相近的重叠度（62%）；而经多样性筛选的 LoRA-Retriever 基准接近无重叠基线（96%）。这说明，相比模态，池的组成更能预测压缩效果大小。基于这种重叠特性，我们构建了 LoRASpace：一种无需训练的方法，它为每个池计算一次子空间，并在两种推理模式中复用该子空间，一种静态模式的成本相当于合并，另一种动态模式则根据输入进行路由。在扩散模型池上，静态 LoRASpace 以合并的成本达到复合方式的质量；在包含 17 个 LoRA 的池中启用 6 个 LoRA 时，动态 LoRASpace 的速度比复合方式快 6 倍以上，主要因为它只需运行一次主干网络，而不是六次。在消融实验中，相同秩的静态变体与 LoRASpace 表现相当，因此质量提升并不依赖池级基底。在近似正交的 LoRA-Retriever 基准上，压缩效果较小，性能收益来自与外部检索的结合。

    Projected Distillation: On Learning to Solve Hard Problems from Close, Correct Targets

    投影蒸馏：从接近且正确的目标中学习解决难题

    Shripad V. Deshmukh, Christian Bock, Kangrui Ruan, Abhijeet Awasthi, Vijay Lingam, Rein Houthooft, Manish Prajapat

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Projected distillation directly advances training for hard multi-step problem solving, with a regret analysis and empirical results across several domains. Its tool-use experiments and contrast between targets are incidental to agent-system design and do not establish compositional generalization.

    投影蒸馏通过遗憾分析和多个领域的实证结果，直接推进了针对困难多步问题的训练。其工具使用实验以及目标之间的对比只是与智能体系统设计偶然相关，并未证明组合泛化能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy learning is central to post-training: training on a model's own generations limits distribution shift and helps preserve existing capabilities. On hard problems, however, on-policy RL provides no reward-based learning signal when all attempts fail. On-policy distillation provides next-token supervision from a teacher, but on hard problems, if a rollout goes wrong early, subsequent supervision is conditioned on prefixes that already contain the mistake. Correct behavior can instead come from a gold or teacher solution, but such off-policy targets can differ substantially from the model's generations and, as we show, may erode existing capabilities. We therefore treat on-policyness as a continuum and propose projected distillation, which minimally edits the student's failed attempts into correct targets. The method uses contrastive updates to favor corrections over failed attempts and refreshes these corrections as the student evolves, enabling near-on-policy learning even when all student attempts fail. Theoretically, we prove that the student's learning regret grows with the edit size: it scales linearly with the horizon under minimal correction, as in DAgger, and quadratically under full-answer replacement, as in behavior cloning. Empirically, across two students (Qwen3-8B and OLMo-2-7B) and five domains spanning math, code, science, and tool use, projected distillation gives the highest area under the specialization-retention frontier (best on 8 of 9 cells against GRPO and OPD, and 7 of 9 against SPOT and SODA). Our ablations highlight the importance of online corrections, the contrastive loss, and on-policyness: moving targets farther off-policy steadily worsens the specialization-retention trade-off, with retention falling from 0.916 to 0.744 when minimal corrections are replaced by student-agnostic gold solutions.

    中文

    策略内学习是后训练的核心：使用模型自身生成的内容进行训练可以限制分布偏移，并有助于保留已有能力。然而，对于难题，当所有尝试都失败时，策略内 RL 无法提供基于奖励的学习信号。策略内蒸馏提供来自教师的下一词元监督，但对于难题，如果一次轨迹展开较早出错，后续监督就会以已经包含该错误的前缀为条件。正确行为也可以来自标准答案或教师解答，但这类策略外目标可能与模型的生成内容存在显著差异，而且正如我们所展示的，它们可能削弱已有能力。因此，我们将策略内程度视为一个连续谱，并提出投影蒸馏，通过最小幅度编辑学生的失败尝试，将其转化为正确目标。该方法使用对比式更新来偏向修正结果而非失败尝试，并随着学生的演进不断刷新这些修正，从而即使学生的所有尝试都失败，也能实现近似策略内学习。理论上，我们证明学生的学习遗憾会随编辑幅度增大：在最小修正下，它像 DAgger 一样随时域线性增长；在完整答案替换下，它像行为克隆一样呈二次增长。实证方面，在两个学生模型（Qwen3-8B 和 OLMo-2-7B）以及涵盖数学、代码、科学和工具使用的五个领域中，投影蒸馏取得了最高的专业化—保留前沿曲线下面积（相较 GRPO 和 OPD，在 9 个单元中有 8 个最佳；相较 SPOT 和 SODA，在 9 个单元中有 7 个最佳）。消融实验凸显了在线修正、对比损失和策略内程度的重要性：目标越偏离策略内，专业化—保留权衡就越差；当最小修正被与学生无关的标准答案替代时，保留率从 0.916 降至 0.744。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AMOD makes agent organization a design object, with a method for assigning and revising responsibilities and testing their necessity. This directly advances agent-system organization and structured composition, but the abstract does not study internal model mechanisms or reasoning capabilities.

    AMOD 将智能体组织作为设计对象，提出分配和修订职责并检验其必要性的方法。这直接推进了智能体系统组织和结构化组合，但摘要没有研究模型内部机制或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agentic system design is increasingly shifting from hand-crafted prompts and workflows toward automated search over agentic programs and interaction structures, with multi-agent systems receiving growing attention. Yet a central question remains unresolved: when does an automatically generated multi-agent structure exhibit a functionally meaningful division of responsibility? We argue that automated multi-agent design should move beyond searching for effective architectures toward identifying which responsibilities are functionally necessary, how they should be allocated, and when they should change. To explore this, we propose Automated Multi-Agent Organization Design (AMOD), which treats organization itself as a first-class design object, explicitly modeling how agent teams are composed, what functional responsibilities the agents assume, how they coordinate, and how collective decisions are made. We formulate AMOD as an execution-driven design loop. For each task, an automated designer instantiates an organization by assigning functional responsibilities and coordination rules to a set of agents. After execution, task outcomes, intermediate artifacts, and interaction traces are examined to identify which responsibilities may be missing, duplicated, or ineffective, and the organization is revised accordingly. We also propose testing discovered responsibilities by removing them, replacing them with generic roles, or changing their assignment under matched resource budgets, with complementary evaluations. AMOD provides a principled foundation for evidence-based and adaptive multi-agent organization design.

    智能体系统设计正逐渐从手工编写提示和工作流转向对智能体程序及交互结构进行自动搜索，多智能体系统也日益受到关注。然而，一个核心问题仍未解决：自动生成的多智能体结构何时才体现出具有功能意义的责任分工？我们认为，自动化多智能体设计不应止步于搜索有效架构，还应确定哪些职责在功能上不可或缺、应如何分配，以及何时需要改变。为此，我们提出自动化多智能体组织设计（AMOD），将组织本身视为一等设计对象，显式建模智能体团队如何组成、智能体承担哪些功能职责、如何协调以及如何作出集体决策。我们将 AMOD 表述为一个由执行驱动的设计循环。对于每项任务，自动化设计者通过向一组智能体分配功能职责和协调规则来实例化一个组织。执行后，系统会检查任务结果、中间产物和交互轨迹，以识别哪些职责可能缺失、重复或无效，并据此修订组织。我们还提出在资源预算匹配的条件下，通过移除已发现的职责、将其替换为通用角色，或改变其分配方式来测试这些职责，并开展互补评估。AMOD 为基于证据且具备适应性的多智能体组织设计提供了一个有原则的基础。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies and mechanistically analyzes how diffusion language models represent and access factual knowledge, then uses that state for editing and retrieval.     本文识别并从机制层面分析扩散语言模型如何表示和访问事实知识，随后将这种状态用于编辑和检索。对释义和反向查询的覆盖与组合有关，但摘要没有将组合泛化作为实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Factual recall is a lookup: some representation inside the network serves as the key, and what that key is made of decides which queries can retrieve the fact, what an edit must cover, and what a retriever can read. We call it the factual access state. In autoregressive (AR) models the subject position enriches attributes largely independently of the relation, and relation-specific selection happens later, at the readout position. In masked diffusion language models (DLMs) we find the state is assembled differently, and much earlier: in the first attention layer the wording of the relation is routed into the position of whichever entity is visible and the early feed-forward layers look the fact up on this fused representation. The state therefore varies with the relation's surface form and with the query direction, so the queries about one fact occupy a region of state space rather than a point, and an operation on the fact succeeds only for queries that enter it. We treat the state as an interface to a DLM's factual knowledge, and put it to two uses. Writing to the state gives a knowledge editor: from one declarative statement, Multi-View Edit fits one shared value per direction across that region and installs it in the early-MLP block, preserving source-prompt reliability while substantially improving paraphrase and reverse question answering, where AR editors gain near zero. Reading it suggests a complementary use: the state at each entity position can serve as a relation-specific retrieval vector with no training, returning both pieces of evidence for two-entity queries on which pooled, prompted and lexical retrievers almost never return both.

    中文

    事实回忆是一种查找过程：网络内部的某种表征充当键，而这个键由什么构成，决定了哪些查询能够检索到该事实、编辑必须覆盖哪些内容，以及检索器能够读取什么。我们将其称为事实访问状态。在自回归（AR）模型中，主体位置在很大程度上独立于关系来丰富属性，基于关系的特定选择则发生在之后的读出位置。在掩码扩散语言模型（DLM）中，我们发现状态的组装方式不同，而且发生得早得多：在第一个注意力层中，关系的措辞会被路由到当前可见实体所在的位置，早期前馈层则基于这一融合表征查找事实。因此，状态会随关系的表层形式和查询方向而变化；关于同一事实的查询因而占据状态空间中的一个区域，而非一个点，并且只有进入该区域的查询才能成功对该事实执行操作。我们将该状态视为 DLM 事实知识的接口，并将其用于两个方面。向状态写入即可进行知识编辑：给定一个陈述句，Multi-View Edit 会为该区域内的每个方向拟合一个共享值，并将其写入早期 MLP 模块；它在保持源提示可靠性的同时，显著改善了释义和反向问答，而 AR 编辑器在这方面几乎毫无收益。读取该状态则启发了另一种互补用途：每个实体位置上的状态都可以充当特定于关系的检索向量，无需训练；对于双实体查询，它能返回两条证据，而池化、提示式和词汇检索器几乎从不同时返回这两条证据。

    记忆即代码将长期记忆组织为可执行抽象，并通过声明式程序检索，从而提升智能体的记忆准确性并减少词元消耗。其模块化组合为组合式记忆提供了可迁移的见解，而核心贡献直接推进了持久记忆系统；推理是其支持的下游收益，而非主要研究重点。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In long-term memory systems, memories are constructed from interaction histories and retrieved in response to queries, enhancing the reasoning ability of LLM agents. In complex scenarios, facts are scattered across sessions and their relationships evolve over time, making it difficult for existing memory systems to compose them to adapt to diverse queries. Motivated by the modularity and composability of code, we propose Memory as Code (MaC), a unified memory framework that jointly designs memory construction and retrieval through a shared code abstraction. MaC couples codified construction, which establishes executable memory abstractions, with declarative retrieval, which translates queries into structured retrieval programs. Specifically, codified construction builds a three-layer executable memory structure that progresses from an atomic function layer, through a relational layer, to a modular composition layer. Declarative retrieval recasts retrieval from relevance-based fact selection into declarative query processing over memory. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show relative gains of up to 15.91% in overall LLM-judge accuracy over the strongest baseline in each setting, while substantially reducing token consumption, highlighting the effectiveness of memory as code for long-horizon memory tasks.

    The paper analyzes how fine-tuning objectives shape layer-wise representations and identifies an InfoWindow mechanism that supports transferable layer removal. Its representation geometry and training dynamics make MechInterp central; layer pruning offers a secondary efficiency contribution to Systems, while hallucination detection alone provides only an incidental link to reasoning and none to composition.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Under matched conditions, classifier-head fine-tuning (\textsc{cls}) paradigm consistently outperforms the LLM-as-Judge sequence-to-sequence (\textsc{s2s}) on binary hallucination detection. We trace this gap to the representations induced by the two objectives. Static analysis shows that \textsc{cls} learns a task-specific discriminative direction, pushing hidden states into a clear two-cluster geometry with stronger class separation and linearly decodable label information. By contrast, \textsc{s2s} relies on the pretrained language-modeling head to make decisions. This minimizes the pressure to reorganize representations, leaving the hidden states much closer to the pretrained backbone. Our analysis also reveals that the \textsc{cls} signal saturates before the final layer, after which upper layers form a plateau of statistically interchangeable and largely redundant representations. However, endpoint redundancy alone does not show whether these layers are dispensable during training. Further training-dynamics analysis reveals 1) a lower pretrained substrate, 2) a narrow upper-middle \textbf{InfoWindow} where task information emerges, and 3) a later-synchronizing upper plateau that mirrors this signal. This mechanism motivates us to remove layers above the InfoWindow. Truncating 31\% of the network leaves accuracy unchanged within seed noise on Qwen3-4B and 8B and cuts latency by $1.4\times$. The same depth fraction, fixed before any analysis of the target models, transfers to Llama-3.2-3B and Mistral-7B-v0.3, and the layer structure behind it reappears there and on QNLI and SST-2. We hope this helps guide efficient task-specific LLM design.
