    The paper directly studies how task information is represented and read out, measuring feature sparsity and cross-model feature correspondence and testing how tuning, learning, and pruning affect readability. Its task and learning results do not address composition, reasoning mechanisms, or system organization.

    本文直接研究任务信息如何表征并被读出，测量特征稀疏性和跨模型特征对应关系，并测试微调、学习和剪枝如何影响可读性。其任务与学习结果没有涉及组合、推理机制或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Dense linear probes assess task readability from language model (LM) representations, but do not directly reveal how many features suffice for prediction. We measure readout sparsity with \(k^*\), the smallest feature count found by a fixed search protocol that recovers 95% of dense-probe AUROC above chance. We evaluate 19 LMs from five labs on 14 core tasks. Ten base models give the nine reliably readable tasks similar feature counts and nearly the same order. This agreement extends to the selected features themselves, which on three tasks show cross-model response correspondence beyond class-mean differences and a label-correlation-matched null. Instruction-tuned deployment selectively reduces \(k^*\), with both weights and input format contributing. In controlled synthetic experiments across 20 models, successfully learned targets admit single-feature readouts, whereas readable controls require tens of features. Reference-model \(k^*\) is associated with label requirements across eight students, following an empirical scaling of \(N^*\propto(k^*)^{0.65}\). After continual learning, saved heads can fail while linear readability remains high, and recovery requires fewer labels than initial task learning under the tested procedures. Pruning reduces linear readability, with wider pre-pruning readouts generally associated with larger losses. These findings distinguish task readability from readout sparsity and establish their complementary value for predicting learning requirements and diagnosing LM changes.

    中文

    ENGLISH

Motivated by neurolinguistic studies of their neural dissociation in human brains, in this study, we investigate the overlap of their circuits in large language models (LLMs). Specifically, we examine the overlap and causal effects between the circuits extracted for linguistic and arithmetic tasks, using controlled materials and circuit discovery methods from the mechanistic interpretability field. Our experiments with five LLMs show that circuit similarity is mostly explained by task domains (linguistic vs. arithmetic), rather than by their input and output vocabularies or by the syntactic similarities between natural-language sentences and arithmetic expressions.     TrajEvolve: Trajectory Evolution for Reinforcement Learning with Hindsight Credit Assignment

    TrajEvolve：结合事后信用分配的强化学习轨迹演化

    Yi Wen, Hao Chen, Wanyu Wang, Maolin Wang, Pengyue Jia, Derong Xu, Huize Tan, Yingyi Zhang, Wenlin Zhang, Weihong Luo, Xiku Du, Xiangyu Zhao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TrajEvolve improves long-horizon LLM reinforcement learning by refining historical trajectories and assigning counterfactual step-level credit to identify redundant steps. This directly advances reasoning training and problem solving; its use of high-quality step compositions is relevant to compositional generalization, but the abstract does not establish that as a main contribution.

    TrajEvolve 通过改进历史轨迹并分配反事实的步骤级信用，识别冗余步骤，从而提升长时程 LLM 强化学习。这项工作直接推动了推理训练与问题求解；其对高质量步骤组合的利用与组合泛化相关，但摘要并未表明组合泛化是其主要贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The Reinforcement Learning (RL) paradigm has achieved remarkable success in enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, when applied to long-horizon tasks, it faces severe challenges: i) Due to the high task complexity, the model struggles to sample enough successful trajectories, resulting in slow convergence. ii) Relying solely on sparse final rewards causes all steps to be updated indiscriminately, encouraging redundant step generation. When both the quantity and quality of successful trajectories become difficult to guarantee, the performance is severely constrained. This dilemma stems from the limitations: existing RL paradigms rely entirely on the reasoning capability of base models, lacking the ability to actively optimize trajectories. To address the above issues, we propose a novel trajectory evolution paradigm with hindsight credit assignment, termed TrajEvolve. TrajEvolve not only relies on the trajectory inferred by the model but also generates ``evolutionary trajectories'' by refining low-quality steps in historical trajectories, thereby exposing the policy to high-quality compositions that lie within the base model's support but are rarely sampled within practical training budgets. Furthermore, TrajEvolve reformulates step-level continuous credit assignment as a binary classification task, whether each step is necessary for task completion. This simplification not only reduces the learning difficulty but also enables step labels to be obtained through counterfactual verification, achieving precise identification of redundant steps. Extensive experiments on two datasets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method.

    中文

    强化学习（RL）范式在增强大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力方面取得了显著成功。然而，将其应用于长时程任务时，会面临严峻挑战：i）由于任务复杂度高，模型难以采样到足够多的成功轨迹，导致收敛缓慢。ii）仅依赖稀疏的最终奖励，会导致所有步骤都被不加区分地更新，从而鼓励生成冗余步骤。当成功轨迹的数量和质量都难以保证时，性能会受到严重限制。这一困境源于现有 RL 范式的局限：它们完全依赖基础模型的推理能力，缺乏主动优化轨迹的能力。为解决上述问题，我们提出一种带有事后信用分配的新型轨迹演化范式，称为 TrajEvolve。TrajEvolve 不仅依赖模型推断出的轨迹，还通过改进历史轨迹中的低质量步骤来生成“演化轨迹”，从而使策略接触到处于基础模型支持范围内、但在实际训练预算下很少被采样到的高质量步骤组合。此外，TrajEvolve 将步骤级连续信用分配重新表述为一个二元分类任务，即判断每个步骤对于完成任务是否必要。这种简化不仅降低了学习难度，还能通过反事实验证获得步骤标签，从而精确识别冗余步骤。在两个数据集上的大量实验表明，所提方法优于现有方法。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI agents keep long-term memory, much of which comes from web pages and tool results. Agent harnesses, the software that runs the model, do not record who may act on this memory, so an instruction hidden in a fetched page can be treated as the user's own instruction. We propose ClawMMU, a protection layer that labels every piece of memory with its owner, scope, origins, and authority. ClawMMU checks these labels whenever content enters the model's context, is written to storage, returns from storage, or drives a tool call. Its central rule is that information may rise in authority, but authority never lifts itself. Because the checks depend on where content came from, not on what it says, memory attacks become classical protection faults that the harness stops even when the model is fooled.

    本文将智能体协作形式化为分块优化，并证明了收敛保证，同时在路径规划和查询规划任务上进行了实验。其核心贡献在于推进多智能体协调与任务执行；优化和问题求解方面的联系居于次要地位，且本文没有研究模型内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Teams of large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly applied to complex tasks, but their collaboration protocols are mostly designed empirically, without convergence guarantees. We formalize collaborative problem solving as block optimization: each agent improves one part of a shared solution, guided by its local objective plus a correction for how its changes affect the other parts. A coordinator checks every proposal against the global objective and merges proposals that do not interfere with each other. We prove linear convergence up to an error floor that vanishes when the corrections are exact. Interfering proposals can also be merged once their combination has been checked; the rate then depends on how well the proposals actually combine, not on worst-case interactions. With GPT-OSS-120B agents on robot routing, a three-agent team finds collision-free plans in every run, better than those of a single agent that controls all robots. On a larger routing task, a six-agent team completes its search about twice as fast as the single agent (in median). Merging the best checked combination of proposals, rather than only proposals that do not interfere, cuts the team's search time by about 30%. With constants measured on the runs, our convergence bound holds in every round and follows the observed progress. We also test the theory on query planning in SQLite and on a synthetic task.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体团队日益广泛地应用于复杂任务，但其协作协议大多凭经验设计，缺乏收敛保证。我们将协作式问题求解形式化为分块优化：每个智能体改进共享解的一部分，其依据是自身的局部目标，以及一项用于校正其改动对其他部分影响的修正项。协调器根据全局目标检查每项提议，并合并彼此不冲突的提议。我们证明，算法线性收敛至一个误差下限；当修正项精确时，该下限会消失。经过组合检查后，彼此冲突的提议也可以合并；此时收敛速度取决于提议实际组合得有多好，而非最坏情况下的相互作用。在机器人路径规划任务中，使用 GPT-OSS-120B 智能体时，三智能体团队每次运行都能找到无碰撞方案，优于控制所有机器人的单个智能体。在规模更大的路径规划任务中，六智能体团队完成搜索的速度约为单智能体的两倍（按中位数计）。与仅合并互不冲突的提议相比，合并经过检查的最佳提议组合可将团队搜索时间缩短约 30%。使用运行中测得的常数时，我们的收敛界在每一轮均成立，并与观测到的进展相符。我们还在 SQLite 的查询规划任务和一个合成任务上检验了该理论。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Self-Credit introduces a reinforcement learning method that turns sparse outcomes into denser credit for critical actions in long-horizon agent tasks, directly advancing reasoning training and credit assignment. Agent training is relevant to systems, but the abstract gives no systems architecture contribution; comparing actions across rollouts is incidental to compositional generalization, and no internal mechanisms are analyzed.

    Self-Credit 提出一种强化学习方法，将稀疏结果转化为对长时程智能体任务中关键动作的稠密信用，直接推进了推理训练和信用分配。智能体训练与系统领域相关，但摘要未给出系统架构方面的贡献；跨采样轨迹比较动作与组合泛化只有偶然关联，也没有分析内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents are commonly trained with RLVR, but the sparse nature of typical RLVR rewards makes credit assignment challenging, especially for long-horizon tasks. We propose Self-Credit, an end-to-end agentic RL method that creates dense supervision signals from sparse outcome rewards using self-generated credit assignment via intra-group rescaling. Self-Credit builds on group-based RL with three components. First, during its rollouts, the policy model generates summaries with citations to earlier turns containing critical evidence, which serve as self-generated credit. Second, we refine this model-generated credit with intra-group rescaling, which compares cited actions across successful and failed rollouts for the same prompt. This approach uses group-level agreement and disagreement to remove undeserved credit and further emphasize credit assigned to critical actions. Third, advantage reweighting uses the rescaled credit weights to update the advantages of the cited turns. On BrowseComp-Plus, Self-Credit improves over the base models by 37.0 and 36.2 points on Qwen3 8B and 32B respectively, and outperforms the strongest agentic RL baselines by 8.5 and 5.6 points, respectively. Self-Credit also improves over the strongest baselines by 4.9 points on GAIA and 4.7 points on xBench-DeepSearch. Analyses show that self-generated credit provides useful signals for selecting critical actions, and that intra-group rescaling, especially on failed rollouts, is important across model scales.

    LLM 智能体通常使用 RLVR 训练，但典型 RLVR 奖励的稀疏性使信用分配颇具挑战，尤其是在长时程任务中。我们提出 Self-Credit，这是一种端到端的智能体 RL 方法，通过组内重缩放进行自生成信用分配，从稀疏的结果奖励中创建稠密监督信号。Self-Credit 建立在基于组的 RL 之上，包含三个组件。首先，在采样轨迹期间，策略模型会生成带有引文的摘要，引用包含关键证据的先前轮次，并将这些摘要作为自生成的信用。其次，我们通过组内重缩放来改进模型生成的信用；该方法会针对同一提示，比较成功和失败采样轨迹中被引用的动作。此方法利用组级别的一致与分歧来去除不应得的信用，并进一步强调分配给关键动作的信用。第三，优势重加权利用重缩放后的信用权重，更新被引用轮次的优势。在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，相比基线模型，Self-Credit 在 Qwen3 8B 和 32B 上分别提升 37.0 和 36.2 分，并分别超过最强的智能体 RL 基线 8.5 和 5.6 分。Self-Credit 在 GAIA 和 xBench-DeepSearch 上也分别比最强基线提升 4.9 和 4.7 分。分析表明，自生成信用为选择关键动作提供了有用信号；在不同模型规模下，组内重缩放（尤其是针对失败采样轨迹的重缩放）至关重要。

    Sahil Joshi, Prithvi Dixit, Aryan Katiyar, Agniva Chowdhury, Joseph E. Gonzalez, Anshumali Shrivastava, Aditya Desai, Kumar Krishna Agrawal

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SSA’s central contribution is a score-guided sparse-attention algorithm that recovers residual attention mass and improves long-context inference efficiency, a direct advance in sparse computation. AIME results are an evaluation context; the abstract does not claim a reasoning mechanism or capability contribution.

    SSA 的核心贡献是一种分数引导的稀疏注意力算法，它能够恢复残余注意力质量并提高长上下文推理效率，是稀疏计算领域的一项直接进展。AIME 结果属于评测场景；摘要并未声称其在推理机制或能力方面有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Model inference over long contexts is increasingly bottlenecked by the cost of attending to a growing Key-Value (KV) cache. Sparse attention reduces this cost by accessing only a fraction of the cache, but existing methods face a trade-off between deterministic retrieval, which captures high-scoring tokens but discards residual attention mass, and sampling, which improves coverage at the cost of higher variance. Hybrid methods combine top-$k$ retrieval with uniform sampling, yet still exhibit a substantial gap from dense attention at aggressive sparsity. We introduce \emph{Stratified Sparse Attention (SSA)}, a unified framework combining deterministic retrieval with score-guided sampling. SSA deterministically attends to high-scoring tokens while sampling the residual using proxy attention scores and correcting for their inclusion probabilities, thereby recovering attention mass beyond the retrieval set. SSA encompasses top-$k$, top-$p$, and hybrid top-$k$+sampling as special cases. Across RULER, LongBench, LOFT, and AIME, and five models ranging from 3B to 27B parameters, SSA consistently improves over the baselines at matched sparsity. On RULER-HARD with Ministral-3-8B, SSA improves accuracy over the strongest practical baseline from 81.8\% to 84.2\% at 32K and from 63.8\% to 69.3\% at 128K under $50\times$ attention sparsity, recovering 94\% and 85\% of dense-attention performance, respectively. With optimized CUDA kernels, SSA achieves up to $2.96\times$ decode speedup over FlashInfer at 1M context, demonstrating that its accuracy gains translate into practical long-context inference acceleration. We open-source our code at https://github.com/skylight-org/SSA-Paper-Code.

    中文

    长上下文上的大型语言模型推理越来越受制于对不断增长的键值（KV）缓存进行注意力计算的成本。稀疏注意力只访问缓存的一部分，从而降低这一成本，但现有方法面临一种权衡：确定性检索能够捕获高分词元，却会丢弃残余注意力质量；采样则能提高覆盖率，但代价是更高的方差。混合方法将 top-$k$检索与均匀采样结合起来，但在激进稀疏设置下，与稠密注意力之间仍存在显著差距。我们提出\emph{分层稀疏注意力（SSA）}，这是一个将确定性检索与分数引导采样结合起来的统一框架。SSA 对高分词元进行确定性注意力计算，同时使用代理注意力分数对残余部分采样，并按其纳入概率进行校正，从而恢复检索集合之外的注意力质量。SSA 将 top-$k$、top-$p$以及混合 top-$k$+采样作为特例涵盖在内。在 RULER、LongBench、LOFT 和 AIME 上，以及参数量从 3B 到 27B 的五个模型中，在相同稀疏度下，SSA 始终优于基线方法。在使用 Ministral-3-8B 的 RULER-HARD 上，在$50\times$注意力稀疏度下，SSA 将准确率从最强实用基线的 81.8\% 提高到 32K 时的 84.2\%，并从 63.8\% 提高到 128K 时的 69.3\%；分别恢复了稠密注意力性能的 94\% 和 85\%。借助优化后的 CUDA 内核，在 1M 上下文长度下，SSA 相较 FlashInfer 实现最高$2.96\times$的解码加速，表明其准确率提升可以转化为实用的长上下文推理加速。我们在 https://github.com/skylight-org/SSA-Paper-Code 开源代码。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper tests whether latent reasoning values are present and causally used, proposing minimal-pair probes and controls for separating computed values from copied or mixed inputs. This directly advances interpretability of internal representations and reasoning mechanisms; the arithmetic task alone does not establish a composition-generalization contribution.

    本文检验潜在推理值是否存在并在因果上被使用，提出最小对照探测以及用于区分计算值与输入复制或混合的控制方法。这直接推动了对内部表征和推理机制的可解释性研究；仅凭算术任务本身，无法证明其对组合泛化有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Probing studies of latent reasoning often read a model's state where the answer begins and take a failed probe as evidence that a value is absent. We test this with a digit copied from the question, in the looped model Ouro-1.4B and the standard transformer Qwen2.5-1.5B. Comparing prompts that differ only in that digit shows it is present at the last prompt token, in a code shared across questions (readout about 0.9). A probe that sees one prompt at a time, the usual setting, barely reads it: 0.36 in Ouro and 0.19 in Qwen even after 5,249 training questions. The digit's change is small rather than crowded: random noise lands on equally busy directions, while a random word in its place moves the state far more and is readable. Since every varied token leaves a trace, a successful probe is ambiguous too. We give a protocol, including a synthetic null for generic mixing, for testing computed values against copies and mixtures of the inputs. In pre-registered studies of two-step problems it finds a small signal for the unwritten intermediate a+b just before Ouro writes the answer's last digit, and its sign follows the operation, though mixing alone produces much of that sign-following part. Holding that value at another problem's from the first loop on does not move the written digit toward the other problem's, while the same patch of the answer does: the value is readable but not used.

    中文

    潜在推理的探测研究往往在答案开始的位置读取模型状态，并将探测失败视为某个值不存在的证据。我们用一个从问题中复制出来的数字，在循环模型 Ouro-1.4B 和标准 Transformer Qwen2.5-1.5B 上检验这一做法。比较仅在该数字上不同的提示词后发现，该数字存在于最后一个提示词词元处，并以一种在不同问题间共享的编码表示（读出值约为 0.9）。一次只查看一个提示词的探测器——这是通常的设置——几乎读不出它：即使经过 5,249 个训练问题，Ouro 上的读出值也只有 0.36，Qwen 上只有 0.19。该数字造成的变化幅度很小，而非被淹没在拥挤的方向中：随机噪声会落在同样繁忙的方向上，而用随机词替换该数字会让状态变化大得多，并且可以读出。由于每个变化的词元都会留下痕迹，成功的探测同样存在歧义。我们给出一种协议，其中包括用于检测一般混合效应的合成零假设，以检验计算所得的值是否只是输入的复制或混合。在预注册的两步问题研究中，该协议在 Ouro 即将写出答案最后一位之前，发现了未写出的中间值 a+b 的微弱信号；信号的符号随运算变化，尽管仅靠混合效应就能产生其中大部分随符号变化的部分。从另一道题目的第一个循环开始，将该值固定下来，并不会让写出的数字朝另一道题目的结果移动；而对答案本身进行同样的干预却会：这个值可以读出，却没有被使用。

    Rodrigo Casado Noguerales, Dimitri von R\"utte, Bernhard Sch\"olkopf, Thomas Hofmann, Aran Raoufi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces candidate-set discrete diffusion and shows that its uncertainty representation improves iterative solving on logic and planning benchmarks, directly advancing reasoning mechanisms.     本文提出候选集离散扩散，并证明其不确定性表示能提升逻辑和规划基准上的迭代求解表现，直接推动了推理机制的发展。候选 token 和去噪本身并不能证明本文对内部特征分析、组合泛化或模型与智能体系统作出了贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Discrete diffusion models iteratively denoise a noisy sequence of categorical data such as text, enabling any-order generation with self-correction and in-filling capabilities. This makes them promising candidates for reasoning, planning, and constrained-generation tasks like coding and math. Yet masked and uniform diffusion erase a token's identity in a single corruption event, so their noisy states cannot explicitly represent partially resolved uncertainty in which several alternatives remain plausible. We close this gap with Binary Discrete Diffusion, a family of continuous-time discrete-diffusion processes whose noisy state is a set of candidate tokens per position, represented as a binary membership vector. Binary diffusion changes candidate sets through additions and removals, allowing information to be lost and recovered gradually while the diffusion state itself represents partial uncertainty. On Sudoku-Extreme, Boxoban, and graph coloring, the symmetric formulation of binary diffusion consistently outperforms strong, well-tuned masked and uniform baselines under matched architectures and controlled training, sampling, and tuning budgets, with its largest gains on the hardest instances, while remaining competitive on language modeling (Text8, TinyStories, OpenWebText). These results support candidate sets as an effective intermediate representation for iterative reasoning and show that the corruption kernel can materially change the computation learned by the reverse model.

    中文

    离散扩散模型通过迭代去噪来处理文本等类别数据构成的噪声序列，从而支持任意顺序生成，并具备自我修正和填充能力。这使其成为推理、规划以及编码和数学等受约束生成任务的有力候选方案。然而，掩码扩散和均匀扩散会在一次噪声扰动中抹去 token 的身份，因此其噪声状态无法显式表示尚未完全消解的不确定性，即仍有多个备选项看似合理的情况。我们通过二元离散扩散弥补这一缺口：这是一类连续时间离散扩散过程，其噪声状态是每个位置上的候选 token 集合，并以二元成员向量表示。二元扩散通过添加和移除候选项来改变候选集，使信息能够逐步丢失和恢复，同时让扩散状态本身表示部分不确定性。在 Sudoku-Extreme、Boxoban 和图着色任务上，在架构匹配且训练、采样和调优预算受控的条件下，二元扩散的对称形式始终优于强且经过充分调优的掩码扩散和均匀扩散基线；它在最难的实例上收益最大，同时在语言建模任务（Text8、TinyStories、OpenWebText）上也保持竞争力。这些结果表明，候选集是迭代推理的一种有效中间表示，也说明噪声扰动核能够实质性地改变反向模型学到的计算方式。

    Hangyu Zhou, Constantine Dovrolis, Stephen Mussmann

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes jointly learned sparse connectivity and weights to exploit hidden compositional computation, with controlled evidence of improved sample efficiency and connectivity aligned to target structure. This directly advances compositional learning; the representation analysis is limited evidence about learned structure, while world-model prediction alone does not establish reasoning or agent-systems contributions.

    本文提出联合学习稀疏连接方式和权重，以利用隐藏的组合计算，并通过受控实验表明其样本效率有所提升，且连接方式与目标结构相吻合。这直接推动了组合学习的发展；对表示的分析只是有关所学结构的有限证据，而世界模型预测本身并不能证明本文对推理或智能体系统作出了贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Statistical learning in high dimensions suffers from the curse of dimensionality. Fortunately, many functions of practical interest are compositionally sparse, meaning they admit a composition of local functions, each depending on only a few variables, allowing sample complexity to depend on local arity rather than ambient dimension. Yet realizing this benefit requires exploiting hidden compositional structure, which theory does not establish for practical gradient-based training. We study this gap with CSFRBench, a controlled benchmark that hides the target's compositional computation during training but retains it for diagnosis, and find that dense networks and sparsity-based baselines leave much of that benefit unrealized. Inspired by the spatial organization of biological neural circuits, we introduce Learned Wiring (LeWi): each neuron has a learned low-dimensional embedding, only nearby neurons connect, and embeddings and weights are trained jointly. LeWi improves sample efficiency on targets with hierarchical structure, intermediate reuse, or independent modules. Across 32 additional targets generated by independently sampled computation graphs, LeWi is the most sample-efficient method not given the target graph, with 27% lower mean learning-curve area than dense networks. Dense networks perform better on targets with a single high-arity function. LeWi's representations and connectivity align with the target computation. On 17 world-model prediction tasks spanning control, navigation, and manipulation, LeWi beats the dense baseline on 16 and wins 99/119 baseline comparisons. These results show that jointly learning connectivity and weights can exploit computational structure to improve sample efficiency.

    高维统计学习受到维数灾难的影响。幸运的是，许多具有实际意义的函数具有组合稀疏性，也就是说，它们可以分解为若干局部函数的组合，每个局部函数只依赖少数变量，因此样本复杂度可以取决于局部元数，而非环境维度。然而，要实现这一优势，就必须利用隐藏的组合结构，而现有理论并未证明实际的基于梯度的训练能够做到这一点。我们使用 CSFRBench 研究这一差距：这是一个受控基准，训练时会隐藏目标的组合计算过程，但保留该信息以供诊断。我们发现，稠密网络和基于稀疏性的基线都未能充分实现这一优势。受生物神经回路空间组织方式的启发，我们提出 Learned Wiring (LeWi)：每个神经元都有一个可学习的低维嵌入，只有彼此邻近的神经元才相连，且嵌入和权重联合训练。在具有层次结构、中间结果复用或独立模块的目标上，LeWi 提高了样本效率。在另外 32 个由独立采样的计算图生成的目标上，对于未获知目标图的方法而言，LeWi 的样本效率最高，其平均学习曲线下面积比稠密网络低 27%。对于只有一个高元数函数的目标，稠密网络表现更好。LeWi 的表示和连接方式与目标计算相吻合。在涵盖控制、导航和操作的 17 项世界模型预测任务上，LeWi 在其中 16 项胜过稠密基线，并在 119 次基线比较中胜出 99 次。这些结果表明，联合学习连接方式和权重能够利用计算结构来提高样本效率。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces direct KV-cache control operations and a serving engine that manages stateful reuse, eviction, and restoration for agents. This is a core contribution to model and agent systems; benchmark gains and cache-policy improvement do not establish substantive work on reasoning or compositional generalization.

    本文提出直接控制 KV 缓存的操作，以及一个为智能体管理有状态缓存复用、淘汰和恢复的服务引擎。这是对模型和智能体系统的核心贡献；基准测试的提升和缓存策略的改进并不能证明本文对推理或组合泛化作出了实质贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM's maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth. Prior work uses context engineering to reduce cache size by trimming or summarizing history. However, modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates subsequent cached states and triggers costly re-prefilling of retained context. Task accuracy can also suffer when too little context is retained to limit re-prefill costs. We propose cache engineering as a new scheme. It allows agents to directly control their active KV cache without modifying the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context. Specifically, agents can proactively use drop to exclude selected cache from future attention and repos to adjust retained keys' position encodings. We formalize these cache operations and identify history dependence as a serving challenge: identical token sequences can yield different cache states under different cache operation sequences, making prefix matching insufficient for correct cache reuse. Thus, we co-design the AKV serving engine. It provides a stateless interface compatible with existing serving APIs, while internally managing stateful cache reuse, eviction, and restoration. Experiments show that a tool-response rolling-drop cache policy improves average benchmark scores by 1.7 points and reduces average cost by 27.7%, compared with conventional threshold-triggered summarization. With AKV, it achieves up to 1.2x the output throughput and a 1.5x speedup in P95 request latency. Recursive self-improvement of cache policies further reduces cost by 7.1% over expert design. Our code is at https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV.

    大型语言模型 (LLM) 智能体能够处理日益复杂的任务，并沿着包含观测和动作的长轨迹运行。随着这些轨迹增长，键值 (KV) 缓存的 I/O 和存储会成为主要开销。轨迹还可能超过 LLM 的最大上下文长度，因此需要控制活动缓存的增长。以往工作通过裁剪或总结历史记录进行上下文工程，以减小缓存大小。然而，修改轨迹前缀会使后续缓存状态失效，并触发对保留上下文进行代价高昂的重新预填充。若为限制重新预填充的开销而保留过少上下文，任务准确率也可能下降。我们提出一种新方案：缓存工程。它让智能体能够直接控制其活动 KV 缓存，而不修改轨迹，也不必重新预填充保留的上下文。具体而言，智能体可以主动使用 drop，将选定的缓存排除在后续注意力计算之外；也可以使用 repos，调整保留键的位置编码。我们对这些缓存操作进行形式化，并指出历史依赖性是服务系统面临的一项挑战：相同的 token 序列在不同缓存操作序列下可能产生不同的缓存状态，因此仅靠前缀匹配不足以正确复用缓存。因此，我们共同设计了 AKV 服务引擎。它提供与现有服务 API 兼容的无状态接口，同时在内部管理有状态的缓存复用、淘汰和恢复。实验表明，与传统的阈值触发式摘要相比，工具响应滚动丢弃缓存策略使基准平均分提高 1.7 分，并将平均成本降低 27.7%。结合 AKV，该策略最高可实现 1.2 倍的输出吞吐量，并使 P95 请求延迟加速 1.5 倍。对缓存策略进行递归自我改进，可进一步将成本降低 7.1%，优于专家设计。我们的代码位于 https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV。

    Computer-use agents are limited by the interfaces humans give them. An agent may type a spreadsheet cell by cell when a single line of code would do, or print all two thousand lines of a file through a shell to find one function. Both the interfaces and the knowledge of when to use each are built by hand, which cannot keep pace with new applications, workflows, and models. We argue that interface design should itself be an agent capability. We introduce Agent S4, an autonomous computer-use scientist that builds Evolving Agent Interfaces from task experience. A meta-agent examines task agents' trajectories on synthetic training tasks, without success labels, and constructs and revises interfaces and usage knowledge in a repository. Population-based evolution then selects which repositories to develop further by their performance on validation tasks the meta-agent never sees, favoring changes that generalize beyond the seen tasks. On OSWorld V2, Agent S4, with Qwen3.8-27B and the evolved repository of interfaces, sets a new state of the art in open-source computer-use agents, reaching 21.3% binary score, 3.8 times the same model with fixed interfaces. This is above both GPT-5.5 (13.0%) and Claude Opus 4.8 (20.6%), at about 4.3% and 1.5% of their respective costs. On ScienceBoard, the evolved interfaces improve the success rate from 41.4% to 58.6% with the same model. These results suggest that useful interfaces can be evolved from experience, making autonomous interface design a source of improvement complementary to advances in models and harnesses. We open-source our code at https://github.com/simular-ai/agent-s.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    UniWALM trains video, action, and language together in a shared backbone, using generated textual memory in subsequent steps and a correction objective for action recovery; results support gains in compositional manipulation and memory-dependent behavior. Unified modality composition and the language-as-memory agent design are central contributions, while the shared representation offers no direct interpretability analysis.

    UniWALM 在共享骨干网络中联合训练视频、动作和语言，在后续步骤中使用生成的文本记忆，并通过校正目标训练模型从动作偏差中恢复；实验结果支持其在组合式操作和依赖记忆的行为方面有所提升。统一的模态组合方式和语言即记忆的智能体设计是核心贡献，而共享表征本身未提供直接的可解释性分析。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Motivated by the human ability to integrate experience across language, perception, and action, we introduce UniWALM, a unified world-action-language model that learns video, action, and language in a single shared representation, where each modality is both a conditioning signal and a supervision target. We ask: can jointly generating language enrich this shared representation, improving manipulation and supporting memory-dependent behavior? Unlike prior approaches that attach a reasoning or vision-language model to a video-action backbone and run them as distinct stages, UniWALM unifies all three modalities inside a single mixture-of-transformers backbone whose per-modality diffusion heads co-denoise synchronously, decoding subtask and textual memory in the same pass as action with no separate planning stage; the generated language is re-consumed on the next step, closing a language-as-memory loop without an external planner or memory bank. To keep the action stream reliable under this richer objective, we further introduce Flow Matching with Correction (FMC), a training objective that teaches recovery from perturbed action trajectories at no inference-time cost. UniWALM consistently improves over same-backbone baselines (e.g., FastWAM) on compositional pick-and-place (MolmoSpaces) and across the memory-dependent subset of RMBench, where it reaches 34.5% without any pretrained language or reasoning model and exceeds Mem-0's keyframe-equipped setup (28.5%) using only a single anchor frame. On a real-world Find-the-Item task, generating textual memory lifts success from 11.1% to 61.1%, while state-of-the-art VLAs stay at or below chance (<=33.3%).

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Combinatorial optimization problems near algorithmic phase transitions represent a fundamental challenge for both classical algorithms and machine learning approaches. Among them, graph coloring is a prototypical constraint satisfaction problem characterized by phase transitions that fragment the solution space into distinct clusters, making the search for valid solutions challenging. Here we introduce a physics-inspired neural framework that learns to solve large-scale graph coloring instances by combining graph neural networks with statistical-mechanics principles. Our approach integrates a planting-based supervised signal, symmetry-breaking regularization, and iterative noise-annealed neural dynamics to navigate complex solution landscapes. When the number of iterations scales quadratically with graph size, the learned solver successfully tackles increasingly challenging instances, even in regimes where finding valid solutions becomes particularly difficult, demonstrating its ability to extract meaningful information from the graph structure. The model generalizes from small training graphs to instances up to 20 times larger, demonstrating that neural architectures can learn scalable algorithmic strategies that remain effective in hard connectivity regions. These results establish a general framework for learning neural solvers that operate near fundamental phase boundaries in combinatorial optimization and inference.

    接近算法相变的组合优化问题，对经典算法和机器学习方法都构成了根本性挑战。其中，图着色是一种典型的约束满足问题，其相变会将解空间分割成不同的簇，使有效解的搜索变得困难。本文提出一种受物理学启发的神经框架，将图神经网络与统计力学原理相结合，以学习求解大规模图着色实例。我们的方法融合了基于植入解的监督信号、对称性破缺正则化，以及迭代式噪声退火神经动力学，以探索复杂的解空间景观。当迭代次数随图规模呈二次增长时，训练得到的求解器能够成功处理难度不断增加的实例，即使在寻找有效解尤为困难的区域也不例外；这表明它能够从图结构中提取有意义的信息。模型能够从小规模训练图泛化到大出 20 倍的实例，表明神经架构可以学习可扩展的算法策略，并在连通性困难的区域保持有效。这些结果为学习在组合优化和推断的根本性相变边界附近运行的神经求解器建立了一个通用框架。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The public often attributes human-like qualities to large language models (LLMs), assuming that they "know" certain things. In reality, LLMs encode information retained during training as internal probabilistic knowledge. This study examines existing methods for probing the veracity of that knowledge and identifies three flawed underlying assumptions. To address these flaws, we introduce sAwMIL (Sparse-Aware Multiple-Instance Learning), a multiclass probing framework that combines multiple-instance learning with conformal prediction. sAwMIL leverages LLMs' internal representations to classify statements as true, false, or neither. We evaluate sAwMIL across 16 open-source LLMs, including default and chat-based variants, using three new curated datasets. Our results show that (1) common probing methods fail to provide a reliable and transferable veracity direction and, in some settings, perform worse than zero-shot prompting; (2) truth and falsehood are not encoded symmetrically; and (3) LLMs encode a third type of signal that is distinct from both true and false.

    AI planning provides agents the ability to act autonomously towards achieving a goal in a given environment. Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have introduced the prospect of using unstructured input for planning, making LLMs in planning an active area of research, especially for supporting autonomous agents. However, LLMs remain unreliable as long-horizon planners, since some of the plans they produce contain mistaken or hallucinated actions; executing such plans could lead to unexpected and harmful outcomes. Existing benchmarks for LLMs in planning primarily rely on binary evaluation metrics, providing limited insight into the quality of plans that do not achieve the goal, and how far those are from becoming valid. In this paper, we frame the evaluation of LLMs in planning as a natural language processing (NLP) task, as LLMs are themselves NLP models. We propose a pipeline comprising three NLP-based steps that assess plan quality from complementary perspectives, followed by a symbolic planning step to achieve a valid plan, to provide a finer-grained understanding of the quality of invalid plans. In our experiments, we find no clear evidence of logical derivation or state-tracking during LLM plan generation -- on average, for all non-empty plans, only 3.55 actions per plan are executable, despite symbolically-generated optimal plans having an average length of 9.47 actions, which suggests that LLMs are still far from the reliability of symbolic planners. Our suite of metrics is further used to investigate patterns in LLM plan generation over time, and can provide a useful metric for assessing the quality of individual invalid plans.

    中文

    AI 规划赋予智能体在给定环境中自主行动以实现目标的能力。大型语言模型（LLM）的近期进展带来了使用非结构化输入进行规划的可能性，使 LLM 规划成为一个活跃的研究领域，尤其是对自主智能体的支持。然而，LLM 作为长时程规划器仍不可靠，因为它们生成的某些计划包含错误或幻觉动作；执行这些计划可能导致意外且有害的后果。现有的 LLM 规划基准主要依赖二元评估指标，因此对于未能实现目标的计划质量，以及这些计划距离有效计划还有多远，所能提供的见解有限。本文将 LLM 规划评估构建为一项自然语言处理（NLP）任务，因为 LLM 本身就是 NLP 模型。我们提出一个由三个基于 NLP 的步骤组成的流水线，从互补的角度评估计划质量，随后再通过符号规划步骤生成有效计划，以便更细致地理解无效计划的质量。在实验中，我们没有发现 LLM 生成计划时存在逻辑推导或状态跟踪的明确证据——对所有非空计划而言，平均每个计划只有 3.55 个动作可执行，而符号生成的最优计划平均长度为 9.47 个动作；这表明 LLM 距离符号规划器的可靠性仍相去甚远。我们还使用这套指标研究 LLM 计划生成随时间变化的模式，并证明它可用于评估单个无效计划的质量。

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Models (LLMs) tend to generate a long reasoning chain when solving complex tasks. However, as the reasoning chain extends, critical intermediate steps and the original prompt will be buried in the context, receiving insufficient attention and leading to errors. In this work, we present ATAR, a novel reasoning method that leverages the inherent reasoning structure to steer LLM attention. Our experiments show that ATAR outperforms SOTA methods across six benchmarks, achieving up to 15.39% absolute improvement. Furthermore, with ATAR, "non-reasoning" models achieve comparable or even better performance compared to reasoning models of the same size in most benchmarks. Finally, our ablation studies show that the attention alignment component contributes significantly, and that these improvements are persist under different attentionsteering backends.

    Modeling opinion change through social interactions is important for understanding polarization, misinformation, and societal conflict. Recent work simulates opinion dynamics with role-playing LLM agents (RPLAs), but multi-agent simulations often display unnatural group behavior (e.g., premature convergence) and lack empirical benchmarks for assessing alignment with real human group interactions. We introduce DEBATE, a benchmark for evaluating the authenticity of opinion dynamics in multi-agent RPLA simulations. Across group-generalization tests with unseen participant groups and topic-generalization tests with unseen discussion topics, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct improves stance prediction of individuals and convergence prediction at the group level, though discrepancies in opinion change and belief updating remain.     Edge AI must adapt to new classes and shifting data within a tight power budget, but online continual learning (learning from each sample before the next arrives) is where conventional processors are least efficient: each small update pays a full dispatch at full power. We present CLP-SNN, a spiking architecture that recasts the Continually Learning Prototypes (CLP) algorithm as event-driven neural dynamics: a self-normalizing local rule replaces CLP's global renormalization, prototype allocation becomes novelty-triggered neurogenesis, and correctness-modulated plasticity becomes reward-gated per-neuron metaplasticity. Deployed on Intel Loihi 2 as the first online continual learner on that chip, rehearsal-free CLP-SNN matches Replay and SLDA on OpenLORIS at 1-shot; at 25-shot, it stays within 0.8 percentage points of Replay and 6.2 points below covariance-based SLDA.     Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models often exceed a single accelerator's memory capacity. Offloading experts to host memory creates a severe PCIe I/O bottleneck because data-dependent routing keeps transfers on the critical path. We present Specter, an inference system that uses quantization to combine speculative decoding with expert offloading. Its lightweight quantized draft model runs efficiently on device while preserving high-fidelity expert activation patterns. This provides accurate multi-step lookahead over future expert usage, allowing the runtime to organize expert movement and execution ahead of verification and improve both communication and execution efficiency. Under single-request inference, Specter achieves an average 1.50x (up to 1.88x) speedup in time per output token (TPOT) over the state-of-the-art system.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) enables models to learn new classes continually while preserving past knowledge. Recently, vision-language models like CLIP offer transferable features via multimodal pre-training, making them well-suited for CIL. However, real-world visual and linguistic concepts are inherently hierarchical: a textual concept like "dog" subsumes fine-grained categories such as "Labrador" and "Golden Retriever," and each category is associated with corresponding images. Nevertheless, existing CLIP-based CIL methods fail to explicitly capture this inherent hierarchy, leading to feature drift of fine-grained classes during incremental updates and ultimately to catastrophic forgetting. To address this challenge, we propose HASTEN (Hierarchical Semantic Tree Anchoring), a hierarchy-aware framework that uses semantic structure to stabilize CLIP-based CIL. Rather than treating classes as isolated labels, HASTEN leverages external hierarchical knowledge as structured supervision to organize visual and textual features in hyperbolic space, helping maintain parent--child relations as new tasks arrive and mitigating feature drift. Since the shared hyperbolic mapper is updated across tasks, we further stabilize it by constraining its updates to a null space induced by prior-task features, reducing interference with previous mappings while retaining adaptability to new classes. Extensive experiments on nine benchmarks show that HASTEN consistently outperforms existing methods while reducing feature drift and catastrophic forgetting. Code is available at: https://github.com/LAMDA-CL/NeurIPS2026-HASTEN.

    ENGLISH

    Unequal representation of demographic groups in training data poses challenges to model generalisation across populations. Standard practice assumes that balancing subgroup representation always optimises performance. However, recent empirical results contradict this assumption: in some cases, imbalanced data distributions actually improve subgroup performance, and in others, subgroup performance is unaffected by the absence of an entire subgroup during training. We propose the latent separation hypothesis, which states that a fine-tuned model's dependence on subgroup representation is determined by the degree of separation between subgroups in the latent space of the pre-trained model. We formalise this hypothesis, provide theoretical analysis, validate it empirically across four vision and language datasets, and present preliminary evidence of a causal role through regularisation experiments. Finally, we show how quantitative analysis of latent subgroup separation can inform practical data collection and balancing decisions when fine-tuning foundation models.

One-shot methods such as SparseGPT sit in between and apply efficient but approximate weight updates. To close this gap, we introduce OPTIMA, a practical one-shot post-training pruning method that balances accuracy and scalability. OPTIMA casts layer-wise weight reconstruction after mask selection as independent, column-wise quadratic programs (QPs) that share one Hessian per weight matrix. Solving these QPs yields, at solver convergence, the per-column minimizer of the layer-wise reconstruction objective under the shared Hessian, and the shared Hessian makes the QPs easy to batch on accelerators. We implement an accelerator-friendly QP solver that accumulates one Hessian per weight matrix and solves many small QPs in parallel with a convergence certificate per column, enabling one-shot post-training pruning at scale on a single accelerator without fine-tuning. OPTIMA integrates with existing mask selectors and improves average zero-shot accuracy in 40 of 49 (model, mask selector, sparsity) settings across the LLaMA and Gemma families, with mean gains of +0.61, +0.56, and +1.01 points at 50% unstructured, 2:4, and 60% unstructured sparsity, and up to +3.97 points at 60% sparsity, while matching ADMM-based exact reconstruction on its own masks. On an NVIDIA H100, OPTIMA prunes an 8B-parameter transformer end-to-end in 40 hours and 60 GB of peak GPU memory. This shows that principled column-wise QP reconstruction is a practical alternative to heuristic weight updates in one-shot post-training pruning.

    中文

    训练后剪枝可以降低大型语言模型的推理成本，但它面临一项权衡：将权重置零的简单启发式方法速度快，却会降低准确率；有原则的联合优化方法能够恢复准确率，但在现代规模下计算上不可行。SparseGPT 等单次方法介于两者之间，采用高效但近似的权重更新。为弥合这一差距，我们提出 OPTIMA，这是一种兼顾准确率与可扩展性的实用单次训练后剪枝方法。OPTIMA 将选定掩码后的逐层权重重构，表述为彼此独立、按列划分的二次规划（QP）；每个权重矩阵共用一个 Hessian。求解这些 QP 后，在求解器收敛时可得到共享 Hessian 下逐层重构目标的逐列极小值；而共享 Hessian 也使这些 QP 易于在加速器上批量处理。我们实现了一种适合加速器的 QP 求解器：它为每个权重矩阵累积一个 Hessian，并行求解许多小型 QP，同时为每列提供收敛证书，从而能够在单个加速器上大规模执行单次训练后剪枝，无需微调。OPTIMA 可与现有掩码选择器集成，在 LLaMA 和 Gemma 系列中 49 种（模型、掩码选择器、稀疏度）设置中的 40 种提高了平均零样本准确率；在 50% 非结构化、2:4 和 60% 非结构化稀疏度下，平均分别提升 +0.61、+0.56 和 +1.01 个点，在 60% 稀疏度下最高提升 +3.97 个点，同时在自身掩码上达到与基于 ADMM 的精确重构相当的效果。在 NVIDIA H100 上，OPTIMA 可在 40 小时内完成一个 8B 参数 Transformer 的端到端剪枝，峰值 GPU 内存为 60 GB。这表明，有原则的逐列 QP 重构是单次训练后剪枝中启发式权重更新的一种实用替代方案。

    The paper proposes an ask-or-answer VQA agent, a clarification dataset, and reinforcement learning rewards for generating useful questions, reporting system-level improvements.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Real-world visual question answering (VQA) may be context-dependent: an image-question pair could be under-specified, such that the correct answer depends on external information that is not observable in the image. In such cases, directly answering can lead to confident but incorrect predictions. We propose Clarify-or-Answer (CoA), an ask-or-answer agent that separately models the decision to ask or answer, and what to ask if needed. CoA first determines whether clarification is necessary; if so, it generates one or more clarification questions to iteratively enrich the context until ambiguity is resolved. To validate this framework, we introduce CONTEXTCLARIFY, a dataset of ambiguous VQA questions along with a contrast set of non-ambiguous questions. We further introduce GRPO-CR(Clarification Reasoning), a reinforcement learning approach that optimizes clarification question generation with multiple reward signals encouraging well-formed, focused, non-trivial questions that resolve ambiguity. Across three VLMs and three datasets, CoA achieves consistent improvements at both the module and system levels, with a single clarification turn providing substantial gains and recursive multi-turn execution offering modest additional improvements in select settings.

    Expected Return Causes Outcome-Level Mode Collapse in Reinforcement Learning and How to Fix It with Inverse Probability Scaling

    期望回报导致强化学习中的结果级模式坍塌及其逆概率缩放解决方法

    Abhijeet Sinha, Sundari Elango, Dianbo Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes why expected-return RL collapses diverse outcomes and proposes inverse probability scaling, with theory and experiments on reasoning and molecular generation. Its main contribution advances training for problem-solving and reasoning tasks; multimodal outcomes and a GRPO implementation are incidental to composition and system design.

    本文分析了期望回报 RL 导致多样化结果坍塌的原因，并提出逆概率缩放，通过理论分析以及推理和分子生成任务上的实验进行验证。其主要贡献推动了问题求解和推理任务的训练；多模态结果和 GRPO 实现与组合能力和系统设计的关系较为间接。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Many reinforcement learning (RL) problems admit multiple terminal solutions of comparable quality, where the goal is not to identify a single optimum but to represent a diverse set of high-quality outcomes. Nevertheless, policies trained by standard expected return maximization routinely collapse onto a small subset of outcomes, a phenomenon commonly attributed to insufficient exploration or weak regularization. We show that this explanation is incomplete: outcome level mode collapse is a structural consequence of the expected-return objective itself. Under idealized learning dynamics, the log-probability ratio between any two outcomes evolves linearly in their reward difference, implying exponential ratio divergence and inevitable collapse independent of the exploration strategy, entropy regularization, or optimization algorithm. We identify the source of this pathology as the probability multiplier inside the expectation and propose a minimal correction: inverse probability scaling, which removes outcome-frequency amplification from the learning signal, fundamentally changes the learning dynamics, and provably yields reward-proportional terminal distributions, preventing collapse in multimodal settings. We instantiate this principle in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) as a drop-in modification, IPS-GRPO, requiring no auxiliary models or architectural changes. Across different reasoning and molecular generation tasks, IPS-GRPO consistently reduces outcome-level mode collapse while matching or exceeding baseline performance, suggesting that correcting the objective rather than adding exploration heuristics is key to reliable multimodal policy optimization.

    中文

    许多强化学习（RL）问题存在多个质量相近的终止解，其目标不是找出唯一最优解，而是表示一组多样化的高质量结果。尽管如此，采用标准期望回报最大化训练的策略仍经常坍塌到少数结果上；这一现象通常被归因于探索不足或正则化较弱。我们表明，这种解释并不完整：结果级模式坍塌是期望回报目标本身在结构上导致的后果。在理想化的学习动力学下，任意两个结果之间的对数概率比会随它们的奖励差线性变化，这意味着概率比呈指数级分化，并且无论采用何种探索策略、熵正则化或优化算法，最终都会发生坍塌。我们指出，这种问题的根源是期望内部的概率乘数，并提出一种最小修正：逆概率缩放。它消除了学习信号中的结果频率放大效应，从根本上改变学习动力学，并且可证明会产生与奖励成比例的终止分布，从而防止多模态情形下的坍塌。我们将这一原则作为一种可直接替换的修改方案应用于群组相对策略优化（GRPO），得到 IPS-GRPO，无需辅助模型或架构改动。在不同的推理和分子生成任务上，IPS-GRPO 持续减少结果级模式坍塌，同时达到或超过基线性能。这表明，要实现可靠的多模态策略优化，关键在于修正目标，而不是添加探索启发式方法。

    Marthe Ballon, Brecht F. Verbeken, Vincent Ginis, Andres Algaba

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper probes how answer accuracy and commitment change as reasoning traces unfold, showing that relevant trace content drives gains and that stronger models can recover from some incorrect partial traces. This provides substantial insight into reasoning behavior, but does not directly examine internal mechanisms; deployment monitoring is an application of the probing method.

    本文探测推理轨迹展开过程中答案准确率和确定性的变化，表明相关轨迹内容会带来提升，而且较强模型能够从某些错误的部分轨迹中恢复。这为理解推理行为提供了重要洞见，但没有直接考察内部机制；部署监控只是探测方法的一种应用。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) increasingly solve difficult problems by producing "reasoning traces" before emitting a final response. However, it remains unclear how accuracy and decision commitment evolve along a reasoning trajectory, and whether intermediate trace segments provide answer-relevant information beyond generic length or stylistic effects. Here, we propose a protocol to systematically probe the trajectories of reasoning traces in LLMs by 1) generating a model's reasoning trace, 2) truncating it at fixed token-percentiles, and 3) injecting each partial trace back into the model (or a different model) to measure the induced distribution over answer choices via next-token probabilities. We apply this protocol to the open-source Qwen3-4B/-8B/-14B and gpt-oss-20b/-120b models across the multiple-choice GPQA Diamond and MMLU-Pro benchmarks. We find that accuracy and decision commitment consistently increase as the percentage of provided reasoning tokens grows. These gains are primarily driven by relevant content in the model generation rather than context length or generic "reasoning style" effects. Stronger models often backtrack successfully from incorrect partial traces, but immediate answers often remain anchored in the weaker model's incorrect response. More broadly, we show that trajectory probing provides diagnostics for efficient and safer deployment of reasoning models as the measurements can inform practical trace-handling and monitoring policies that improve reliability without assuming intermediate tokens are inherently faithful explanations.

    大型语言模型（LLM）越来越常通过先生成“推理轨迹”再输出最终回答来解决难题。然而，准确率和决策确定性如何沿推理轨迹演变，以及轨迹中的中间片段是否提供了超越一般长度或风格效应的答案相关信息，仍不清楚。本文提出一种系统探测 LLM 推理轨迹的流程：1）生成模型的推理轨迹；2）在固定的 token 百分位处截断轨迹；3）将每个部分轨迹重新输入模型（或另一个模型），通过下一 token 概率测量其诱发的答案选项分布。我们在多选题基准 GPQA Diamond 和 MMLU-Pro 上，将该流程应用于开源模型 Qwen3-4B/-8B/-14B 和 gpt-oss-20b/-120b。我们发现，随着提供的推理 token 比例增加，准确率和决策确定性始终提高。这些提升主要由模型生成内容中的相关信息驱动，而非上下文长度或一般性的“推理风格”效应。较强模型往往能从错误的部分轨迹中成功回溯，但即时回答常仍受较弱模型错误回答的影响。更广泛地说，我们表明，轨迹探测可为高效且更安全地部署推理模型提供诊断信息，因为这些测量能够指导实用的轨迹处理与监控策略，在不假设中间 token 天然就是忠实解释的前提下提高可靠性。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When a text description is extended with an additional detail, image-text similarity should drop if that detail is wrong. We show that CLIP-style dual encoders often violate this intuition: appending a plausible but incorrect object or relation to an otherwise correct description can increase the similarity score. We call such cases half-truths. On COCO, CLIP prefers the correct shorter description only 40.6% of the time, and performance drops to 32.9% when the added detail is a relation. We trace this vulnerability to weak supervision on caption parts: contrastive training aligns full sentences but does not explicitly enforce that individual entities and relations are grounded. We propose CS-CLIP (Component-Supervised CLIP), which decomposes captions into entity and relation units, constructs a minimally edited foil for each unit, and fine-tunes the model to score the correct unit above its foil while preserving standard dual-encoder inference. CS-CLIP raises half-truth accuracy to 69.3% and improves average performance on established compositional benchmarks by 5.7 points, suggesting that reducing half-truth errors aligns with broader gains in compositional understanding. Code is publicly available at: https://github.com/kargibora/CS-CLIP

    Coordinating multiple autonomous agents to explore and serve spatially heterogeneous demand requires jointly learning unknown spatial patterns and planning trajectories that maximize task performance. Pure model-based approaches provide structured uncertainty estimates but lack adaptive policy learning, while deep reinforcement learning often suffers from poor sample efficiency when spatial priors are absent. This paper presents a hybrid belief-reinforcement learning (HBRL) framework to address this gap. In the first phase, agents construct spatial beliefs using a Log-Gaussian Cox Process (LGCP) and execute information-driven trajectories guided by a Pathwise Mutual Information (PathMI) planner with multi-step lookahead. In the second phase, trajectory control is transferred to a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) agent, warm-started through dual-channel knowledge transfer: i) belief state transfer supplies spatial uncertainty, and ii) replay buffer seeding provides demonstration trajectories generated during LGCP exploration. A variance-normalized overlap penalty enables coordinated coverage through shared belief state, permitting cooperative sensing in high-uncertainty regions while discouraging redundant coverage in well-explored areas. The framework is instantiated in two scenarios: multi-Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) wireless service provisioning, and mobility-on-demand sensing over measured New York City taxi demand. In the wireless scenario it achieves 10.8% higher cumulative reward and takes 38% fewer episodes to reach the reward level of the baselines, with ablation studies confirming that dual-channel transfer outperforms either channel alone; the taxi scenario yields consistent gains with all algorithmic components unchanged.

    协调多个自主智能体，以探索空间异质的需求并为其提供服务，需要同时学习未知空间模式并规划能够最大化任务表现的轨迹。纯模型驱动方法能提供结构化的不确定性估计，但缺乏自适应策略学习；而在缺少空间先验时，深度强化学习往往样本效率较低。本文提出混合信念强化学习（HBRL）框架来弥补这一差距。第一阶段中，智能体利用对数高斯 Cox 过程（LGCP）构建空间信念，并执行由路径互信息（PathMI）规划器引导、采用多步前瞻的信息驱动轨迹。第二阶段中，轨迹控制转交给软演员—评论家（SAC）智能体，并通过双通道知识迁移进行热启动：i）信念状态迁移提供空间不确定性；ii）回放缓冲区初始化提供在 LGCP 探索期间生成的示范轨迹。方差归一化重叠惩罚通过共享信念状态实现协同覆盖，允许在高不确定性区域开展合作感知，同时抑制在已充分探索区域的冗余覆盖。该框架应用于两个场景：多无人机（UAV）无线服务供给，以及基于实测纽约市出租车需求的按需出行感知。在无线场景中，它的累积奖励比基线高 10.8%，并且达到基线奖励水平所需的回合数减少 38%；消融研究证实，双通道迁移优于单独使用任一通道。出租车场景也取得了稳定提升，且所有算法组件均保持不变。

    Tao Hu, Da-Wei Zhou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DRAPE generates instance-specific cross-modal prompts and uses gradient projection and task-free routing to reduce forgetting during continual multimodal instruction tuning. This substantially advances adaptive module use in a model system; prompt conditioning involves composition, but the abstract does not establish a main contribution to compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    DRAPE 生成实例特定的跨模态提示，并使用梯度投影和无任务标签路由来减少多模态持续指令微调中的遗忘。这显著推进了模型系统中自适应模块的使用；提示条件化涉及组合，但摘要并未证明其主要贡献在于组合泛化或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance through instruction tuning, yet real-world deployment often requires continual capability expansion across sequential tasks. In such scenarios, Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) aims to acquire new capabilities while limiting catastrophic forgetting. Existing methods mainly follow a module-composition paradigm: they maintain task-level prompts or LoRA experts and dynamically route or aggregate a subset of them at inference. However, samples within the same task can still differ substantially in visual scenes, question intents, and reasoning demands. This motivates instance-level adaptation to individual query-image pairs rather than only selecting or combining task-level modules. To this end, we propose DRAPE (Dynamic Cross-Modal Prompt Generation), a prompt-learning framework that synthesizes continuous instance-specific soft prompts for MCIT. Instead of selecting prompts from a fixed pool, DRAPE derives prompt queries from the textual instruction and cross-attends to visual patch features, producing prompts conditioned on query-image pairs that are prepended to the frozen LLM. To mitigate forgetting during sequential updates, DRAPE applies null-space gradient projection to the shared projector and uses CLIP-based prototype routing for task-label-free generator selection at inference. Extensive experiments on MCIT benchmarks show that DRAPE achieves state-of-the-art performance among representative prompt-based and LoRA-based continual-learning baselines. Code is available at: https://github.com/LAMDA-CL/NeurIPS2026-Drape.

    多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）通过指令微调取得了出色的性能，但在现实世界中部署时，往往需要在一系列连续任务中持续扩展能力。在这类场景中，多模态持续指令微调（MCIT）旨在获取新能力，同时限制灾难性遗忘。现有方法主要遵循模块组合范式：它们维护任务级提示或 LoRA 专家，并在推理时动态路由或聚合其中一部分。然而，同一任务中的样本在视觉场景、问题意图和推理需求方面仍可能存在显著差异。这促使我们针对单个查询-图像对进行实例级适配，而非只选择或组合任务级模块。为此，我们提出 DRAPE（动态跨模态提示生成），这是一种提示学习框架，可为 MCIT 合成连续的实例特定软提示。DRAPE 不从固定提示池中选择提示，而是根据文本指令生成提示查询，并对视觉图像块特征进行交叉注意，从而生成以查询-图像对为条件、并置于冻结 LLM 输入前的提示。为减轻连续更新过程中的遗忘，DRAPE 对共享投影器应用零空间梯度投影，并在推理时使用基于 CLIP 原型的路由，在无需任务标签的情况下选择生成器。在 MCIT 基准上的大量实验表明，与具有代表性的基于提示和基于 LoRA 的持续学习基线相比，DRAPE 达到了最先进的性能。代码见：https://github.com/LAMDA-CL/NeurIPS2026-Drape。

    COSMOS: Model-Agnostic Personalized Federated Learning with Clustered Server Models and Pseudo-Label-Only Communication

    COSMOS：采用簇化服务器模型和仅伪标签通信的模型无关个性化联邦学习

    Ben Rachmut, Luise Ge, Ning Zhang, William Yeoh, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    COSMOS clusters heterogeneous clients by predictions, trains server-side cluster models, and distills them using pseudo-label communication, with theoretical risk-contraction analysis. Its main contribution is a federated learning system; clustering and distillation alone do not establish a substantive connection to representation mechanisms, compositional generalization, or reasoning.

    COSMOS 根据预测对异构客户端进行聚类，在服务器端训练簇模型，并通过伪标签通信进行蒸馏，同时提供了风险收缩的理论分析。其主要贡献是一个联邦学习系统；仅有聚类和蒸馏并不足以证明其与表征机制、组合泛化或推理存在实质联系。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Federated learning (FL) in heterogeneous environments remains challenging because client models often differ in both architecture and data distribution. While recent approaches attempt to address this challenge through client clustering and knowledge distillation, simultaneously handling architectural and statistical heterogeneity remains difficult. We introduce COSMOS, a model-agnostic framework that enables server-side personalization using only pseudo-label communication. Clients train local models and predict on the public data; the server clusters clients by prediction similarity, trains a cluster-specific model for each group using its own compute, and distills the resulting models back to clients. We provide the first theoretical analysis showing that distillation from the learned cluster models can yield exponential personalization risk contraction, going beyond the convergence-to-stationarity guarantees typically provided in model-agnostic FL. Experiments across benchmarks demonstrate that COSMOS consistently outperforms all model-agnostic FL baselines while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art personalized FL methods. More broadly, our results highlight personalized server-side learning with pseudo-labels as a promising paradigm for scalable and model-agnostic federated learning in highly heterogeneous environments.

    中文

    异构环境中的联邦学习（FL）仍面临挑战，因为客户端模型在架构和数据分布上往往都不相同。近期方法尝试通过客户端聚类和知识蒸馏来应对这一挑战，但同时处理架构异构性和统计异构性仍然困难。我们提出 COSMOS，这是一种模型无关框架，仅通过伪标签通信即可实现服务器端个性化。客户端训练本地模型并在公共数据上进行预测；服务器根据预测相似性对客户端聚类，利用自身算力为每个组训练一个专属模型，再将得到的模型蒸馏回客户端。我们首次提供理论分析，表明从训练得到的簇模型进行蒸馏能够使个性化风险呈指数收缩，超越模型无关 FL 通常提供的收敛到平稳点保证。跨基准实验表明，COSMOS 持续优于所有模型无关 FL 基线，同时与最先进的个性化 FL 方法相比也保持竞争力。更广泛地说，我们的结果表明，采用伪标签的个性化服务器端学习，是在高度异构环境中实现可扩展、模型无关联邦学习的一种有前景的范式。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ASH's central contribution is a self-improvement loop that uses trajectory-trained inverse dynamics, video-derived supervision, and retained memories to sustain long-horizon game progress. This substantially advances agent learning and planning systems; multi-step planning is central, while the abstract gives no substantive account of internal representations or compositional generalization.

    ASH 的核心贡献是一个自我改进循环，它利用基于轨迹训练的逆动力学、从视频中提取的监督信号以及保留的记忆，来维持长时域游戏进展。这实质性推进了智能体学习与规划系统；多步规划是核心内容，但摘要并未对内部表征或组合泛化作实质说明。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon visuomotor tasks remain a fundamental challenge in AI, as current methods rely on hand-engineered rewards or action-labeled demonstrations, neither of which scales. We introduce ASH, an agentic system that learns a long-horizon policy from unlabeled, noisy internet video, without reward shaping or expert annotation. ASH follows a self-improvement loop; when it gets stuck, ASH learns an Inverse Dynamics Model (IDM) from its own trajectories, and uses its IDM to extract supervision from relevant internet video. ASH uses unsupervised learning to identify key moments from large-scale internet video and retains them as long-term memory - allowing it to tackle long-horizon problems. We evaluate ASH on two complementary environments demanding multi-hour planning: Pokemon Emerald, a turn-based RPG, and The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap, a real-time action-adventure game. In both games, behavioral cloning, retrieval-augmented and zero-shot foundation-model baselines plateau, while ASH sustains progression across our 8-hour evaluation. ASH reaches an average of 11.2/12 milestones in Pokemon Emerald and 9.9/12 in Legend of Zelda, while the strongest baseline gets stuck in both environments at an average of 9.3/12 and 7.8/12 milestones, respectively. We demonstrate that self-improving agents are a scalable recipe for learning in long-horizon worlds.

    Jie Jiang, Xing Sun, Ruotian Chen, Jianan Su, Kaixin Shen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PPOW optimizes speculative draft windows with reinforcement learning and adaptive windowing, improving inference speed and acceptance length. The window-level objective has a limited connection to composition, but the abstract does not study compositional generalization or model internals.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a lightweight draft model propose speculative windows of candidate tokens for parallel verification by a larger target model. In practice, speculative efficiency is often bottlenecked by hard-to-draft positions, where an early mismatch truncates the accepted prefix and invalidates the rest of the speculative window. Most learning-based drafters are still optimized with token-level supervised objectives, even though speculative utility is inherently window-level and prefix-sensitive. We propose PPOW (Performance-Driven Policy Optimization with Adaptive Windowing), a reinforcement learning framework that shifts drafter optimization from token-level imitation to window-level optimization. PPOW combines a Cost-Aware Speedup Reward, a Distribution-Based Proximity Reward, and Adaptive Divergence-Aware Windowing, which prioritizes informative windows with high confidence-weighted draft-target divergence. PPOW achieves average acceptance lengths of 6.29-6.52 and speedups of 3.39-4.36$\times$ across multiple model families and benchmarks under a unified decoding protocol. These results show that performance-driven window-level optimization is a practical approach to improving speculative decoding efficiency.

    Jingwei Sun and Jianing Zhu and Jiangchao Yao and Tongliang Liu and Bo Han

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TriMem combines dialogue segments, atomic facts, and synthesized profiles, with prompt optimization to improve lifelong agent memory and reasoning over dialogue history. This is a substantial memory-system contribution, but the abstract does not study model internals or compositional generalization; reasoning is a supported use of the memory rather than the paper’s main focus.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    To enable reliable long-term interaction, LLM agents require a memory system that can faithfully store, efficiently retrieve, and deeply reason over accumulated dialogue history. Most existing methods adopt an extracted fact based paradigm: handcrafted static prompts compress raw dialogues into atomic facts, which are then stored, matched, and injected into downstream reasoning. Nevertheless, such fact-centric designs inevitably discard fine-grained details in original dialogues and fail to support deep reasoning over scattered isolated facts. Moreover, static prompts cannot maintain consistent extraction granularity across diverse dialogue styles. To address these limitations, we propose TriMem, which maintains three coexisting representation granularities, including raw dialogue segments anchored by source identifiers for storage fidelity, extracted atomic facts for efficient memory retrieval, synthesized profiles that aggregate dispersed facts into holistic semantic understanding for deep reasoning. We further adopt TextGrad-based prompt optimization, which iteratively refines extraction and profiling prompts via response quality feedback, achieving lifelong evolution without any parameter updating. Extensive experiments on LoCoMo and PerLTQA across multiple LLM backbones demonstrate that TriMem consistently outperforms strong memory baselines. The code is available at https://TMLR-TriMem.github.io .

    为实现可靠的长期交互，LLM 智能体需要一种记忆系统，能够忠实存储、高效检索，并对累积的对话历史进行深入推理。大多数现有方法采用基于事实提取的范式：手工设计的静态提示将原始对话压缩为原子事实，随后存储、匹配并注入下游推理。然而，这种以事实为中心的设计不可避免地会丢失原始对话中的细粒度信息，也无法支持对分散、孤立事实进行深入推理。此外，静态提示无法在不同对话风格下维持一致的提取粒度。为解决这些局限，我们提出 TriMem，它同时维护三种表征粒度：以来源标识符为锚点的原始对话片段，用于忠实存储；提取出的原子事实，用于高效检索记忆；以及合成的用户画像，它将分散的事实汇总为整体语义理解，以支持深入推理。我们还采用基于 TextGrad 的提示优化，通过响应质量反馈迭代改进提取和画像生成提示，从而无需更新任何参数即可实现终身演进。在 LoCoMo 和 PerLTQA 上，针对多个 LLM 主干模型开展的大量实验表明，TriMem 持续优于强记忆基线。代码见：https://TMLR-TriMem.github.io 。

    Chao Xu, Maohua Li, Qirui Li, Yixuan Xu, Yanke Zhou, Yunhe Li, Cuifeng Shen, Hanlin Tang, Kan Liu, Tao Lan, Lin Qu, Shao-Qun Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes cross-layer information flow in diffusion transformers and introduces timestep-adaptive routing over prior sublayer outputs, with evidence of faster training. This gives substantial insight into model information routing, but the abstract does not establish feature or circuit explanations; the gains concern architecture rather than composition or reasoning.

    本文分析扩散 Transformer 中的跨层信息流，并提出对先前子层输出进行随时间步自适应路由的方法，且提供了加速训练的证据。这为模型信息路由提供了重要见解，但摘要并未建立特征或电路层面的解释；相关收益涉及架构，而非组合或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a de facto backbone of modern visual generation, and nearly every major axis of their design -- tokenization, attention, conditioning, objectives, and latent autoencoders -- has been extensively revisited. The residual stream that governs how information accumulates across layers, however, has been directly inherited from the original Transformer. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical analysis of cross-layer information flow in DiTs, jointly along depth and denoising timestep, and identify three concrete symptoms of traditional residual addition, namely monotonic forward magnitude inflation, sharp backward gradient decay, and pronounced block-wise redundancy. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose Diffusion-Adaptive Routing (DAR), a drop-in residual replacement that performs learnable, timestep-adaptive, and non-incremental aggregation over the history of sublayer outputs. Moreover, the proposed DAR is compatible with many modern Transformer enhancement methods, such as REPA. On ImageNet $256\times256$, DAR improves SiT-XL/2 by $2.11$ FID ($7.56$ vs. $9.67$) and matches the baseline's converged quality with $8.75\times$ fewer training iterations. Stacked on top of REPA, it yields a $2\times$ training acceleration in the early stage, suggesting cross-layer information routing as an underexplored design axis in diffusion modeling, one that operates orthogonally to existing representation-alignment objectives. Beyond pretraining, DAR can also be applied during the fine-tuning stage of large-scale T2I models and preserves high-frequency details during Distribution Matching Distillation. We present Psy-Chronicle, an event-driven framework that grounds multi-session counseling synthesis in a student's semester timeline: each simulated student receives a profile and a semester-long temporal stress event graph, and counseling sessions are generated along this timeline with memory carried across them. Applied to campus counseling, it yields CPCD, an open Chinese dataset of 100 students and 1{,}248 sessions spanning a full semester. The dialogues follow their timelines: dependencies between events carry across sessions, and references to earlier sessions rarely introduce content absent from the trajectory. A model fine-tuned on CPCD connects each week's events to earlier ones more often than a model trained on the same data without the dependencies between events, while matching it when the client's situation does not change.

We argue that a key reason for this gap is self-anchored drift: responses produced under partial information introduce unsupported assumptions, and those assumptions later distort the final answer.     Aligned language models often exhibit a recognizable AI-like style, yet its connection to post-training and internal representations remains poorly understood. In this work, we study whether post-training introduces or amplifies AI-like stylistic regularities and whether these regularities have a localized internal signature. To this end, we compare human text, base-model generations, and aligned-model generations under matched human-source prefixes. Aligned generations show lower human-corpus affinity and higher AI-detection rates than base generations, suggesting that post-training shifts generated text away from human-corpus style and toward detector-visible AI-like text. We then introduce PASTA (Post-training Alignment Signature Targeted Ablation), a training-free method that estimates a post-training alignment signature from aligned-base residual contrasts and ablates the corresponding direction during decoding. Across 11 aligned models and 6 AI detectors, PASTA lowers the detection rate for most aligned models; this effect transfers well across detectors and is not reproduced by random directions. We prove that the VFE of the augmented model can be rewritten as the VFE of the predictive model plus explicit entropy-correction terms, making the EFE contribution transparent. We then show that proper EFE-based planning requires combining these epistemic corrections with a planning correction that turns marginal inference into policy optimization, yielding a full variational characterization of EFE-based planning. This clarifies which corrections are needed for cross-entropy planning and for full EFE-based planning. The same entropy-corrected formulation leads to a detailed message-passing scheme for EFE-based planning together with simpler ablations. Experiments on three grid-world environments show that full EFE-based planning outperforms ablations that omit either the planning correction or the epistemic corrections.

    Recent post-training methods, particularly Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), have significantly enhanced the reasoning ability of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). However, the sparse nature of verifiable rewards provides little token-level supervision for failed rollouts, often leading to inefficient exploration in complex multimodal reasoning tasks. Although policy distillation can offer dense guidance, external teacher based methods introduce substantial computational overhead, while answer conditioned tuning methods may expose answer-level information and induce shortcut-like generation behavior. To address these limitations, we propose PTD-PO, a Privileged Tutoring Distillation Policy Optimization framework for RLVR that provides dense guidance without exposing the answer to the student policy. Specifically, PTD-PO constructs structured privileged hints from spatial attention guidance and intermediate textual reasoning steps, and uses them through in-context learning to produce step-wise token-distribution supervision. The student is still optimized under the original answer-free context, and its failed rollouts are aligned with the hint-augmented reference model at the token-distribution level. To further stabilize distillation under the distribution shift between guided and unguided contexts, we introduce a Top-K Jensen-Shannon divergence objective that focuses alignment on informative token probabilities while reducing memory overhead. Experiments on LVLMs ranging from 2B to 8B parameters show that PTD-PO consistently outperforms RLVR and distillation baselines, mitigates entropy collapse, and improves complex multimodal reasoning performance.

    近期的后训练方法，尤其是可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR），显著增强了大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的推理能力。然而，可验证奖励的稀疏性几乎无法为失败的 rollout 提供 token 级监督，因此复杂多模态推理任务中的探索往往效率低下。策略蒸馏可以提供密集指导，但基于外部教师的方法会带来巨大的计算开销，而以答案为条件的调优方法可能泄露答案级信息，并诱发类似走捷径的生成行为。为解决这些局限，我们提出 PTD-PO，这是一种用于 RLVR 的特权式辅导蒸馏策略优化框架，可在不向学生策略泄露答案的情况下提供密集指导。具体而言，PTD-PO 根据空间注意力指导和中间文本推理步骤构造结构化的特权提示，并通过上下文学习利用这些提示生成逐步的 token 分布监督。学生仍在原始的不含答案上下文中进行优化，其失败的 rollout 则在 token 分布层面与加入提示的参考模型对齐。为进一步稳定引导上下文与非引导上下文之间分布偏移下的蒸馏，我们引入 Top-K Jensen-Shannon 散度目标，使对齐聚焦于有信息量的 token 概率，同时降低内存开销。对参数规模从 2B 到 8B 的 LVLM 所做实验表明，PTD-PO 持续优于 RLVR 和蒸馏基线，缓解了熵坍塌，并提升了复杂多模态推理性能。

    Service-Induced Congestion in Memory-Constrained LLM Serving

    内存受限 LLM 服务中的服务诱发拥塞

    Ruicheng Ao, Jing Dong, Gan Luo, and David Simchi-Levi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper models memory growth, admission, and eviction in LLM serving, deriving stability results and scheduling principles for throughput. Workload heterogeneity has a limited connection to composition, but the contribution is about serving-system dynamics rather than compositional capability.

    本文对 LLM 服务中的内存增长、请求接纳和逐出进行建模，并推导出稳定性结果和吞吐量调度原则。工作负载异质性与组合性有有限联系，但本文的贡献针对服务系统动态，而非组合能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In large language model (LLM) serving, each request accumulates persistent graphics processing unit (GPU) memory during service as its key-value cache grows with every generated token. Under high concurrency, aggregate memory usage therefore increases endogenously over time: the service process itself creates future capacity pressure. When memory capacity is exceeded, systems evict active requests, discarding cached state and restarting them later, which wastes computation and reduces throughput. We develop a discrete-time dynamical model of memory-constrained LLM inference that captures admission, memory growth, and eviction under continuous batching. In the saturated-input regime, the system admits both eviction-free fixed points and limit cycles with evictions. For homogeneous workloads, we show that the eviction-free equilibrium is unstable and that, except for a Lebesgue-measure-zero exact-capture set, the system converges to a unique worst-case limit cycle that is asymptotically stable outside this exceptional set, with throughput losses as large as 50%. For heterogeneous workloads, we prove a stability criterion in the two-class common-input setting and explain how the survival-polynomial mechanism generalizes to multiple classes and heterogeneous-input lengths. Under an input-dominated scaling regime, coprime decoding lengths stabilize the eviction-free equilibrium, while non-coprime lengths create synchronized modes that drive instability. These results characterize when workload heterogeneity desynchronizes completions and helps stabilize memory-constrained serving. More broadly, we identify service-induced congestion as a structural instability mechanism and derive scheduling design principles for sustaining high throughput.

    中文

    在大型语言模型（LLM）服务中，每个请求在服务期间都会占用持续增长的图形处理器（GPU）内存，因为其键值缓存会随生成的每个 token 增长。因此，在高并发下，内存总用量会随时间内生增长：服务过程本身造成了未来的容量压力。当内存容量超限时，系统会逐出正在处理的请求，丢弃缓存状态并在稍后重启这些请求，从而浪费计算并降低吞吐量。我们建立了一个内存受限 LLM 推理的离散时间动力学模型，刻画连续批处理下的请求接纳、内存增长和逐出。在输入饱和区间内，系统既存在无逐出的不动点，也存在伴随逐出的极限环。对于同质工作负载，我们证明无逐出均衡是不稳定的；除去一个勒贝格测度为零的精确捕获集合外，系统会收敛到唯一的最坏情况极限环，并且在该例外集合之外渐近稳定，吞吐量损失最高可达 50%。对于异质工作负载，我们在两类共享输入的情形下证明了稳定性判据，并解释生存多项式机制如何推广到多类和异质输入长度。在输入主导的缩放区间内，互素的解码长度会稳定无逐出均衡，而非互素长度则会产生导致不稳定的同步模式。这些结果刻画了工作负载异质性何时会使完成时间去同步化并帮助稳定服务。更广泛地说，我们指出服务诱发拥塞是一种结构性不稳定机制，并推导出维持高吞吐量的调度设计原则。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Generalizing manipulation policies across robot embodiments remains difficult because standard policies tie the interactions needed for a task to the actions of a particular robot. We study zero-shot cross-embodiment manipulation, where a policy trained on source embodiments must be deployed on a structurally different target embodiment without additional task demonstrations. We introduce Kinematic Interaction Transfer across Embodiments (KITE), which decouples manipulation into embodiment-agnostic interaction prediction and embodiment-specific kinematic decoding, connected through a learned representation of interaction intent based on contact patterns. An interaction policy is trained to predict the intent using demonstration data only collected on a source robot, and shared across morphologically different target robots. A kinematic decoder realizes these intents by learning from synthetic data generated from each embodiment's kinematic model. Through such decoupling, KITE can robustly transfer learned skills to a new embodiment given only its kinematic model, without recollecting any task-specific demonstration data. We evaluate KITE on four manipulation tasks in simulation and the real world spanning transfer between parallel grippers, dexterous hands, and composite embodiments. KITE successfully achieves zero-shot transfer to structurally different target embodiments, and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. Project website: https://kite-manip.github.io/.

    由于标准策略将任务所需的交互与特定机器人的动作绑定在一起，因此让操作策略泛化到不同机器人具身仍然很困难。我们研究零样本跨具身操作：在源具身上训练的策略，无需额外任务演示即可部署到结构不同的目标具身上。我们提出跨具身运动学交互迁移（KITE），将操作解耦为与具身无关的交互预测和特定于具身的运动学解码，并通过一种基于接触模式的交互意图学习表征将二者连接起来。交互策略仅使用在源机器人上收集的演示数据进行训练，以预测意图，并在形态不同的目标机器人之间共享。运动学解码器通过学习根据各具身运动学模型生成的合成数据来实现这些意图。通过这种解耦，KITE 只需获得新具身的运动学模型，就能稳健地将已学技能迁移到该具身，无需重新收集任何特定任务的演示数据。我们在仿真和现实世界中评估了 KITE，涵盖四项操作任务，以及平行夹爪、灵巧手和复合具身之间的迁移。KITE 成功实现了向结构不同的目标具身进行零样本迁移，并持续优于最先进的基线。项目网站：https://kite-manip.github.io/。

Probing Whisper's decoder representations, without a ground-truth reference, yields the strongest performance, revealing that hallucination traits are encoded across intermediate decoding layers.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) are typically pretrained on short sequences and then extended to work on longer sequences with additional training. However, such LLMs still struggle to further generalize to very long sequences. We propose Randomized YaRN, a training method that improves length generalization by combining YaRN-based positional extrapolation with randomized positional encoding and a length curriculum. During training on short context data, tokens are assigned YaRN positional encodings sampled from a larger position range, exposing the model to out-of-distribution positional representations even on short-context inputs. We evaluate Randomized YaRN on three challenging long-context reasoning benchmarks, BABILong, Multi-Round Coreference Resolution (MRCR), and LongBench v2. When training on data with short context, Randomized YaRN consistently improves reasoning performance on context lengths from 16K to 128K and outperforms standard fine-tuning, with the largest gains appearing at far out-of-distribution lengths.
