    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    NestedVLA’s main contribution is a hypernetwork-based method for consolidating separately trained VLA skills, storing task updates independently and generating task-specific action-expert updates without original training data. This directly advances skill composition and policy-system design; the abstract reports transfer and performance results but no analysis of internal representations or reasoning mechanisms.

    NestedVLA 的主要贡献是一种基于超网络的方法，用于整合分别训练的 VLA 技能：各任务更新分别存储，并在没有原始训练数据的情况下生成任务专属的动作专家更新。这直接推进了技能组合与策略系统设计；摘要报告了迁移和性能结果，但没有分析内部表征或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-language-action (VLA) models can learn a wide range of robotic skills, but combining separately trained skills remains challenging. The original training data may be unavailable for joint retraining, while directly merging model weights can cause interference. We propose NestedVLA, which consolidates independently fine-tuned VLA policies without access to their original training data. Instead of merging all updates into one checkpoint, a hypernetwork embedded in the VLA generates action-expert weight updates for a selected task. Each task's compressed vision-language model update is stored separately, and both updates are added to a frozen base VLA to instantiate the corresponding policy. We evaluate NestedVLA by consolidating three policies fine-tuned with reinforcement learning on MetaWorld, ManiSkill, and CALVIN. It achieves 66.7% average success, improving on the strongest model-merging baseline by 41.1 percentage points. It performs within 1 percentage point of per-task fine-tuning on ManiSkill and substantially narrows the gap on CALVIN. In this three-policy setting, total storage is 1.5x that of a single full checkpoint. Code is available at https://github.com/WanyuGroup/NeurIPS2026-NestedVLA.

    视觉—语言—动作（VLA）模型能够学习多种机器人技能，但组合分别训练的技能仍然很有挑战。联合重新训练时可能无法获得原始训练数据，而直接合并模型权重又可能造成干扰。我们提出 NestedVLA，它可以在无法访问原始训练数据的情况下整合经过独立微调的 VLA 策略。它不将所有更新合并到一个检查点中，而是通过嵌入 VLA 的超网络，为选定任务生成动作专家的权重更新。每个任务的压缩视觉语言模型更新都单独存储，并将两类更新加到冻结的基础 VLA 上，以实例化相应策略。我们通过整合三个使用 MetaWorld、ManiSkill 和 CALVIN 上的强化学习进行微调的策略来评估 NestedVLA。其平均成功率达到 66.7%，比最强的模型合并基线高 41.1 个百分点。在 ManiSkill 上，其表现与逐任务微调相差不到 1 个百分点，并且在 CALVIN 上大幅缩小了差距。在这一包含三个策略的设置中，总存储量为单个完整检查点的 1.5 倍。代码见 https://github.com/WanyuGroup/NeurIPS2026-NestedVLA。

    DiscoveryRSI: Recursively Learning to Discover Valuable Hypotheses

    DiscoveryRSI：递归学习发现有价值的假设

    Jianyuan Zhong, Chenwei Wu, Zhaochen Yu, Xixian Jiang, Xuewei Li, Hao Xiao, Xilin Dai, Junyang Wang, Jiaru Zou, Zhiqing Cui, Boyuan Zheng, Jing Xiong, Zhen Zhang, Qiang Gao, Michael Morley, Luis Nakayama, Qiang Xu, Liyue Shen, Tao Gui, Leo Anthony Celi, Zhenfei Yin, Yingcheng Wu, Ling Yang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DiscoveryRSI develops a multi-agent research workflow that recursively improves hypothesis generation, investigation strategies, and evaluation, with reported gains in scientific hypothesis quality. This advances agent organization and task execution, while reasoning is relevant through hypothesis development but remains part of a broader research-agent contribution; no internal model mechanisms or compositional generalization are described.

    DiscoveryRSI 构建了一套多智能体研究工作流，能够递归改进假设生成、调查策略和评估，并报告了科学假设质量的提升。这项工作推动了智能体组织和任务执行；推理能力与假设发展相关，但仍是更广泛的研究智能体工作的组成部分；文中没有描述模型内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Scientific discovery requires developing worthwhile hypotheses into practical investigations, yet learning from this evolving research process remains challenging. We introduce an operational definition of valuable and testable research hypotheses: evidence-grounded claims about consequential uncertainties, coupled with feasible investigations, explicit decision criteria, and alternative explanations. Our DiscoveryRSI framework develops hypothesis trees through multi-agent evolutionary search, compiles selected investigations into executable Harbor tasks, and recursively learns through three mechanisms: hypothesis credit optimization attributes scientific assessments to documented research contributions; harness replay identifies productive strategies and recurring failures to refine research workflows; and rediscovery applies accepted improvements to new investigations, generating further experience for subsequent learning. We also introduce DFM-Bench, which provides comprehensive assessment of hypothesis quality and cumulative research progress at the levels of hypotheses, revisions, development paths and research runs. Across four life-science domains, automated evaluation shows that hypothesis quality rises from 4.86 for the base model to 5.39 after two rounds of self-improvement, with the large gains in falsifiability and data resolvability. We further validate hypothesis quality through expert review, comparing our DiscoveryRSI-27B with other research agents. Preliminary human assessments show that DiscoveryRSI-27B scores higher than GPT-6 Luna on hypothesis importance and whether claims are plausible and evidence-bounded. DiscoveryRSI-27B achieved a 6.3% rate of hypothesis correspondence with research published after the model cutoff, largely outperform GPT-6 with 2.5% and Claude Opus 5 with 2.3%, while delivering greater human-rated improvement along research paths.

    中文

    科学发现需要将有价值的假设发展为切实可行的研究，但从这一不断演进的研究过程中学习仍然颇具挑战。我们对有价值且可检验的研究假设给出操作性定义：以证据为依据、针对重要不确定性的主张，并配有可行的调查、明确的判定标准和替代解释。我们的 DiscoveryRSI 框架通过多智能体进化搜索构建假设树，将选定的调查编译为可执行的 Harbor 任务，并通过三种机制递归学习：假设信用优化将科学评估归因于有记录的研究贡献；执行框架回放识别有效策略和反复出现的失败，以改进研究工作流；重新发现则将已接受的改进应用于新的调查，为后续学习生成更多经验。我们还推出 DFM-Bench，在假设、修订、发展路径和研究运行等层面全面评估假设质量和累计研究进展。在四个生命科学领域中，自动评估显示，经过两轮自我改进后，假设质量从基础模型的 4.86 提升至 5.39，其中可证伪性和数据可解析性提升显著。我们还通过专家评审验证假设质量，并将 DiscoveryRSI-27B 与其他研究智能体进行比较。初步人工评估显示，DiscoveryRSI-27B 在假设重要性，以及主张是否合理且受证据约束方面的得分高于 GPT-6 Luna。DiscoveryRSI-27B 与模型截点之后发表的研究相对应的假设比例达到 6.3%，大幅超过 GPT-6 的 2.5% 和 Claude Opus 5 的 2.3%，同时在研究路径上的人评改进幅度更大。

    How Data Scales in Agentic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies

    智能体强化学习中的数据如何扩展：规律与合成策略

    Bowei He, Yankai Chen, Xiaokun Zhang, Changjiang Han, Ye Yuan, Chong Li, Xue Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper measures how task, environment, and trajectory diversity affect agentic RL scaling, then derives and validates a budget allocation recipe. This advances agent training and data allocation, but provides no explicit insight into internal reasoning mechanisms; the task structure alone gives only an incidental connection to compositional generalization.

    本文测量了任务、环境和轨迹多样性对智能体 RL 扩展的影响，进而推导并验证了预算分配方案。这推动了智能体训练和数据分配，但没有明确揭示内部推理机制；任务结构本身与组合泛化只有偶然的关联。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Pretraining scaling laws treat training data as a one-dimensional quantity: a token count. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) inherits this scalar abstraction, but modern synthesis pipelines now generate \textit{tasks}, \textit{environments}, and \textit{trajectories} independently and at very different costs, turning data into a structured design space. This raises a question pretraining never had to answer: given a synthesis budget, \textit{which axis} should be scaled? We address this question end-to-end with three tightly coupled contributions. First, we decompose agentic data into three cardinality axes (task, environment, trajectory), plus a reward-density control variable, and fit per-axis scaling relations on different large language models (LLMs) across math+code, SWE, web, and UI/tool application domains. Across all model sizes, model families, domains, and RL algorithms (PPO and GRPO) we measured, the scaling exponents order as environment $>$ task $>$ trajectory. When environment diversity is decomposed into world and environment-structure diversity, its advantage is mainly driven by the former, while the latter is just comparable to the task diversity. Second, we use the fitted laws as a common ruler to price synthesis methods, capturing each method's efficiency as a per-axis discount factor and identifying critical synthetic-to-real ratios at which collapse begins; these ratios differ by an order of magnitude across axes. Third, we cast budget allocation as a constrained optimization under our laws and discounts, deriving a Chinchilla-style compute-optimal recipe and validating it at held-out scale. The empirical results demonstrate that following the recipe yields up to $1.7\times$ compute efficiency over the dominant ``scale-the-trajectories'' practice.

    中文

    预训练的缩放定律将训练数据视为一维数量：词元数。智能体强化学习（RL）沿用了这种标量抽象，但现代合成流程如今能以彼此独立且成本差异很大的方式生成\textit{任务}、\textit{环境}和\textit{轨迹}，使数据成为一个结构化设计空间。这引出了一个预训练从未需要回答的问题：给定合成预算，应该扩展\textit{哪个维度}？我们通过三个紧密关联的贡献端到端地回答这一问题。首先，我们将智能体数据分解为三个基数维度（任务、环境、轨迹），以及一个奖励密度控制变量，并在数学与代码、SWE、网页和 UI/工具应用领域的不同大型语言模型（LLM）上拟合各维度的缩放关系。在我们测量的所有模型规模、模型家族、领域和 RL 算法（PPO 和 GRPO）中，缩放指数排序为：环境 $>$ 任务 $>$ 轨迹。当将环境多样性进一步分解为世界多样性和环境结构多样性时，其优势主要由前者驱动，而后者仅与任务多样性相当。其次，我们将拟合出的规律作为统一标尺来衡量合成方法的成本，将每种方法的效率表示为各维度的折扣因子，并识别合成数据与真实数据的关键比例——超过这些比例就会开始出现性能崩溃；不同维度的这些比例相差一个数量级。第三，我们在上述规律和折扣因子约束下，将预算分配建模为约束优化问题，推导出类似 Chinchilla 的计算最优方案，并在留出的规模上验证该方案。实验结果表明，遵循该方案相较于主流的“扩展轨迹规模”做法，计算效率最高可提升 $1.7\times$。

    Eric Zhang, Terry Jingchen Zhang, Chijioke Ugwuanyi, Jerick Shi, Bernhard Sch\"olkopf, Zhijing Jin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AM-Bench contributes a theory-grounded taxonomy and benchmark for agentic misalignment, finding that harmful behavior can occur without explicit situational awareness or explanation. It provides substantial evaluation insight into agent behavior (Systems 4), with a limited connection to reasoning evaluation (3); it does not study internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    AM-Bench 提供了基于理论的智能体错位分类体系与基准，并发现有害行为可能在缺乏明确情境意识或解释的情况下发生。它对智能体行为评估（Systems 4）提供了实质性见解，与推理评估有有限关联（3）；它没有研究内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As LLM-based agents are deployed with increasing autonomy in real-world environments, a critical failure mode emerges: agentic misalignment, where agents choose harmful actions over failure. However, existing safety benchmarks primarily evaluate whether agents comply with explicitly harmful instructions, leaving the conditions that cause agents to choose harmful actions poorly understood. To address this limitation, we propose AM-Bench, a unified taxonomy and 35 scenario evaluation benchmark spanning seven industries for agentic misalignment grounded in the fraud triangle, a well-established criminological framework explaining goal-directed misconduct. We adapt this framework to agentic environments and construct our evaluation suite and detection systems along three dimensions: perceived threat, perceived opportunity, and reasoning. We operationalize each dimension into structured subcategories rooted in prior theory: five threat categories derived from the instrumental convergence thesis, seven opportunity categories drawn from the Emergent Strategic Reasoning Risks (ESRR) taxonomy, and a novel four-question binary reasoning framework synthesized from prior literature. Our evaluation of 10 frontier models reveals a 62-percentage-point gap in misalignment across scenarios, with Gemini 3 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro exhibiting the highest levels of agentic misalignment while Claude Sonnet 4.6 displays near-zero rates across all conditions. Our reasoning framework further reveals that models may exhibit harmful behaviours without explicit situational awareness or explanation, complicating both mitigation and detection. AM-Bench scenarios and code are available at https://github.com/AI4Collaboration/Agentic-Misalignment-Bench

    中文

    随着基于 LLM 的智能体在真实环境中以越来越高的自主性部署，一种关键失效模式随之出现：智能体错位，即智能体选择有害行为而非选择失败。然而，现有安全基准主要评估智能体是否遵循明确有害的指令，对导致智能体选择有害行为的情境了解不足。为解决这一局限，我们提出 AM-Bench：一个统一的分类体系和包含 35 个场景、覆盖七个行业的智能体错位评估基准，其理论基础是欺诈三角这一成熟的犯罪学框架，该框架用于解释有目标导向的不当行为。我们将这一框架改编至智能体环境，并围绕三个维度构建评估套件和检测系统：感知到的威胁、感知到的机会以及推理。我们将每个维度具体化为源自既有理论的结构化子类别：五种威胁类别源自工具性趋同论题，七种机会类别取自新兴战略推理风险（ESRR）分类体系，以及一个从既有文献综合得出的新型四问二元推理框架。对 10 个前沿模型的评估发现，不同场景之间的错位程度相差 62 个百分点；Gemini 3 Flash 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro 表现出最高程度的智能体错位，而 Claude Sonnet 4.6 在所有条件下的错位率都接近于零。我们的推理框架还揭示，模型可能在缺乏明确情境意识或解释的情况下表现出有害行为，这使缓解和检测都更加复杂。AM-Bench 场景和代码见 https://github.com/AI4Collaboration/Agentic-Misalignment-Bench

    Junsu Kim, Naeun Kim, Dongyoon Han, Seungryul Baek

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    HumanSkill-4D combines semantic and motion memories with composable operators for language-based avatar segmentation and motion selection. Operator composition supports reusable motion conditions, a substantive compositional contribution; traceability and query-based selection offer more limited reasoning and system insights, while internal model mechanisms are not studied.

    HumanSkill-4D 将语义记忆和动作记忆与可组合算子相结合，用于基于语言的化身分割和动作选择。算子组合支持可复用的动作条件，构成实质性的组合贡献；可追溯性和基于查询的选择带来的推理及系统见解较为有限，且未研究模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We introduce avatar referring segmentation, which selects regions of animatable Gaussian avatars from language queries. A query can also specify a pose or motion to select matching intervals. This lets users interact with avatars for local editing and motion inspection. However, making these selections with existing language Gaussian splatting methods poses two challenges: adjacent parts and garments are hard to separate and may be referred to indirectly (region ambiguity), while fine-grained motions can look alike in RGB (motion ambiguity). We address these challenges with HumanSkill-4D, a training-free framework that shares a multimodal large language model (MLLM) and geometric operators across avatars. For each avatar, a semantic memory links body-part and garment categories to persistent Gaussian regions and appearance descriptions. The MLLM uses category names and descriptions to select categories by appearance, relation, or function. To find matching intervals, it composes operators into programs that check query conditions on driving joint trajectories stored in a motion memory. These category choices and operator outputs make selections traceable, while composing or adding operators supports new motion conditions. To evaluate this task, we introduce three human-annotated benchmarks and show that HumanSkill-4D outperforms the baselines in part segmentation and 3D and 4D referring segmentation, with compact memories and only minutes of setup per avatar.

    中文

    我们提出了化身指代分割任务，即根据语言查询从可动画高斯化身中选取区域。查询还可以指定姿势或动作，以选出匹配的时间区间。这使用户能够与化身交互，进行局部编辑和动作检查。然而，使用现有的语言高斯泼溅方法进行这些选择面临两项挑战：相邻部位和服装难以区分，而且可能通过间接方式指代（区域歧义）；细粒度动作在 RGB 中看起来也可能相似（动作歧义）。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 HumanSkill-4D，这是一个无需训练的框架，可在多个化身之间共享一个多模态大语言模型（MLLM）和几何算子。对于每个化身，语义记忆将身体部位和服装类别与持久化的高斯区域及外观描述关联起来。MLLM 使用类别名称和描述，根据外观、关系或功能选择类别。为了找到匹配的时间区间，它将算子组合成程序，用于检查存储在动作记忆中的驱动关节轨迹是否满足查询条件。这些类别选择和算子输出使选择过程可追溯，而组合或添加算子则支持新的动作条件。为评估这一任务，我们引入了三个由人工标注的基准，并表明 HumanSkill-4D 在部件分割以及 3D 和 4D 指代分割方面优于基线，同时只需紧凑的记忆，并且每个化身的设置仅需几分钟。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    HABIT-Bench evaluates whether agent memory systems infer habits from weak evidence over long histories and apply them appropriately, exposing persistent capability limits.     HABIT-Bench 评估智能体记忆系统能否从长期历史中的弱证据推断习惯并恰当地应用这些习惯，揭示了持续存在的能力局限。这推动了智能体记忆评估的发展，其中推理是被测量的能力；受控习惯图属于评估结构，而非对组合学习的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In long-term interactions with large language model (LLM) agents, users reveal habits through their choices and actions. These habits capture implicit user information that agents must infer across conversations. However, individual observations may provide only partial evidence about a habit or when it applies. Retaining past interactions alone does not ensure that agents can infer habits and apply them appropriately. We introduce HABIT-Bench to evaluate how well agent memory systems infer habits from weak evidence and apply them to later requests. We construct synthetic user histories from task-oriented dialogue data and controlled habit graphs. The histories span hundreds of sessions across food, finance, software, and travel. Four-choice tasks assess agents' ability to infer user habits and apply them appropriately. They include temporary exceptions, changes in habits, and suggestions that users have not accepted. Sampled tasks undergo independent human review. We evaluate eight memory methods with Qwen3-235B-A22B and GLM-5.3-Flash. The best-performing memory method achieves 33.61\% macro accuracy across the four domains. Performance remains limited even when annotated evidence is supplied directly. These results expose a persistent gap between access to past interactions and the ability to infer and appropriately use user habits.

    在与大语言模型（LLM）智能体的长期交互中，用户会通过选择和行动透露习惯。这些习惯包含智能体必须跨对话推断的隐性用户信息。然而，单条观察可能只为某种习惯或其适用时机提供部分证据。仅保留过去的交互并不能确保智能体能够推断习惯并恰当地应用它们。我们提出 HABIT-Bench，用于评估智能体记忆系统从弱证据中推断习惯并将其应用于后续请求的能力。我们根据面向任务的对话数据和受控习惯图构造合成用户历史记录。这些历史记录涵盖食品、金融、软件和旅行领域的数百个会话。四选一任务用于评估智能体推断用户习惯并恰当应用这些习惯的能力。任务中包括临时例外、习惯变化以及用户尚未接受的建议。抽样任务经过独立人工审查。我们使用 Qwen3-235B-A22B 和 GLM-5.3-Flash 评估了八种记忆方法。表现最好的记忆方法在四个领域的宏平均准确率为 33.61\%。即使直接提供标注证据，表现仍然有限。这些结果揭示了一个持续存在的差距：能够访问过去的交互，并不意味着能够推断用户习惯并恰当地使用它们。

The framework tracks position trajectories, group dispersion, and information expressed in public messages. Two case studies examine staffing decisions based on distributed facts and decisions requiring agents to reconcile duplicate information and a cancelled contract. Results from 1,872 completed runs associate sharing explanations with more accurate group decisions, while the second task reveals persistent disagreement despite accurate aggregate answers.     TamedFlow：面向教师辅助扩散采样的轨迹感知蒸馏

    Shuaiqi Cheng, Jiahao Zhang, Boyuan Gu, Yuxi Chen, Haiying Xu, Zexin Lu, Huiyu Zhou, Xuming Hu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TamedFlow trains and routes diffusion sampling drafts to reduce inference computation while preserving quality, a substantial contribution to model computation and inference systems. Feature alignment is used for distillation, not to explain internal representations.

    TamedFlow 训练并路由扩散采样草稿，以减少推理计算，同时保持生成质量，对模型计算和推理系统作出了实质性贡献。特征对齐用于蒸馏，并非用于解释内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) deliver high-fidelity image and video generation, but inference requires many sequential model evaluations. Two acceleration strategies are increasingly important: model compression makes each evaluation cheaper, while adaptive inference avoids selected teacher computation through reuse, forecasting, or speculative execution. Their combination, however, is brittle: directly applying the evaluated adaptive methods to a compressed student can degrade quality, an observed failure mode we call the \textbf{Combination Gap}. We link this gap to a mismatch between pointwise distillation and short-horizon execution: a student trained at teacher states need not remain reliable when its own predictions are chained. We propose \textbf{TamedFlow}, which trains a compressed DiT for this deployed role through cross-architecture feature alignment, a near-identity Velocity Alignment Head, and randomized rollout supervision. At inference, a lightweight Learnable Trajectory Estimator routes completed drafts: accepted drafts bypass the teacher, while rejected drafts roll back and receive one teacher rescue step. Distilling DiT-XL/2 into DiT-B/2, TamedFlow reaches FID $2.58$ at $2.25\times$ measured speedup over DDIM-50 on ImageNet $256\times256$. Ablations support trajectory supervision, and routing controls favor LTE over random decisions at nearly matched latency. Evaluations on ImageNet $512\times512$, MS-COCO, and Latte/FaceForensics extend the empirical scope.

    中文

    扩散 Transformer（DiT）能够生成高保真图像和视频，但推理需要进行许多次序贯模型评估。两种加速策略正变得愈发重要：模型压缩降低每次评估的成本，而自适应推理则通过复用、预测或推测执行，避免部分教师模型计算。然而，两者结合起来并不稳定：将经过评估的自适应方法直接应用于压缩学生模型可能会降低质量，我们将这一观察到的失效模式称为 \textbf{组合差距}。我们将这一差距归因于逐点蒸馏与短期执行之间的不匹配：在教师模型状态上训练的学生模型，在连续串接自身预测时未必仍然可靠。我们提出 \textbf{TamedFlow}，通过跨架构特征对齐、近恒等的 Velocity Alignment Head，以及随机化 rollout 监督，针对这种部署角色训练压缩 DiT。推理时，一个轻量级的 Learnable Trajectory Estimator 对已完成的草稿进行路由：接受的草稿会绕过教师模型，而被拒绝的草稿则回滚并接受一步教师模型救援。将 DiT-XL/2 蒸馏为 DiT-B/2 后，TamedFlow 达到 FID $2.58$，相对于 DDIM-50 在 ImageNet $2.25\times$上的测得加速比为 $256\times256$。消融实验支持轨迹监督；在延迟几乎相同的情况下，路由对照实验表明 LTE 优于随机决策。在 ImageNet $512\times512$、MS-COCO 和 Latte/FaceForensics 上的评估进一步扩展了实证范围。

    Truncate or Not? A Scaling Study of Looped Transformers with Truncated Backpropagation

    截断还是不截断？带截断反向传播的循环 Transformer 规模化研究

    Xuyuan Xiong, Siyu Chen, Zihan Shao, Yue Su, Weiyang Jin, Ping Luo, Zhuoran Yang, Xihui Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study measures how shared-layer looping and truncated backpropagation affect compute-efficient transformer training, and proposes a scaling law for choosing loop settings. This advances model computation design, but the abstract does not focus on reasoning behavior or internal representations.

    本研究测量共享层循环和截断反向传播对计算高效 Transformer 训练的影响，并提出一条用于选择循环设置的缩放定律。这推动了模型计算设计的发展，但摘要并未聚焦于推理行为或内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Looped transformers reuse a shared block of layers to increase computational depth without increasing the number of trainable parameters. They are trained with backpropagation through time (BPTT). To save training compute, BPTT is often truncated to the last few loops, but truncation yields biased gradients that may weaken the benefit of looping. In this work, we study the value of truncation in looped transformer training in a systematic way: we jointly vary model size, training tokens, and forward and backward loop counts across nearly 600 training runs and fit a unified scaling law that captures the effects of looping and truncation through effective parameters. Despite the training-compute savings of truncation, our fitted law favors full BPTT when forward and backward loop counts are jointly optimized. In matched-compute runs, full BPTT through fewer loops consistently outperforms truncated settings of the same compute. The law further shows that at fixed model size, the compute-optimal loop count and training-token budget both grow with compute. When model size is also free, the law identifies two fully trained loops as the best looped setting. Experimentally, this setting achieves lower validation loss than the compute-optimal non-looped model with about 27% fewer non-embedding parameters and only 8% more training compute.

    中文

    循环 Transformer 复用共享层块，以增加计算深度而不增加可训练参数的数量。它们使用时间反向传播（BPTT）进行训练。为了节省训练计算，BPTT 通常会截断，只保留最后几次循环，但截断会产生有偏梯度，可能削弱循环结构的益处。在这项工作中，我们系统地研究截断在循环 Transformer 训练中的作用：在近 600 次训练运行中，我们联合改变模型规模、训练 token 数以及前向和反向循环次数，并拟合一条统一的缩放定律，通过有效参数刻画循环和截断的影响。尽管截断可以节省训练计算，我们拟合的定律在联合优化前向和反向循环次数时仍倾向于完整 BPTT。在计算量匹配的运行中，通过较少循环执行完整 BPTT，始终优于计算量相同的截断设置。该定律还表明，在模型规模固定时，计算最优循环次数和训练 token 预算都会随计算量增加而增长。当模型规模也可调整时，该定律指出完整训练两次循环是最佳循环设置。在实验中，这一设置的验证损失低于计算最优的非循环模型，非嵌入参数约少 27%，训练计算量仅多 8%。

    VibeTraining-Bench: Data-Trainer-Harness Co-Design for Iterative System Improvement

    VibeTraining-Bench：面向迭代系统改进的数据、训练器与执行框架协同设计

    Ruotian Peng, Yuanyi Ren, Shuaiqi Liu, Xin Guo, Fang Zhu, Yangyi Huang, Yue Wu, Zheng Wang, Yandong Wen, Zhihang Fu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    VibeTraining-Bench evaluates agents that iteratively co-design training data, trainers, and inference harnesses, making agent-system improvement its main contribution. Mathematical reasoning is one benchmark task, so its connection to reasoning capabilities is partial rather than central.

    VibeTraining-Bench 评估能够迭代协同设计训练数据、训练器和推理执行框架的智能体，因此其主要贡献在于改进智能体系统。数学推理只是基准中的一项任务，因此它与推理能力的联系并非核心。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires agents to diagnose system bottlenecks and coordinate improvements across training and inference. We refer to the agents' capability to jointly optimize training data, the trainer, and the inference harness as cross-component co-design. We introduce VibeTraining-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating this capability across tasks spanning terminal operation, software engineering, multi-turn tool use, and mathematical reasoning. Within each task, research agents start from an identical initial agent system under a fixed resource budget. Guided by validation feedback, they iteratively refine data, trainers, and inference harnesses, then select and submit a final agent system for evaluation on the test set. To prevent reward hacking, we enforce three safeguards: test data isolation, separate research and grading containers, and network restrictions for research agents. Our evaluation results show that frontier research agents substantially improve target agent systems. For example, on SWE-bench Verified, GPT-6-Astra raises the target agent system's performance from 32.9% to 53.7%, comparable to the human-developed instruct model's 55.4%. However, there is still room to improve their ability to co-design and iteratively refine data, trainer, and harness to achieve cumulative performance gains. We hope that VibeTraining-Bench will serve as a unified platform for advancing RSI, deepening our understanding of cross-component optimization for agent systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/D2I-ai/VibeTraining-Bench.

    中文

    Rethinking LLM Fine-Tuning via Weight Space Reparameterization: Preserving Safety during Downstream Adaptation

    通过权重空间重参数化重新思考 LLM 微调：在下游适配期间保留安全性

    Min-Seong Kim, Jongbok Won, Jeesup Park, Yonghee Choi, Dong-Jun Han

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    WSR-Tune reparameterizes model weights to concentrate safety information in selected directions, then freezes those directions during fine-tuning; this offers a substantive, transferable contribution to representation geometry and information localization. The separation of safety and task information has only an incidental connection to composition, and the fine-tuning method does not study reasoning or system organization.

    WSR-Tune 对模型权重进行重参数化，使安全信息集中于选定方向，并在微调期间冻结这些方向；这为表征几何和信息定位作出了实质且可迁移的贡献。安全信息与任务信息的分离仅与组合性存在附带联系，而该微调方法并未研究推理或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on downstream tasks often weakens their previously aligned safety behavior, creating an inherent trade-off between task adaptation and safety preservation. Existing approaches attempt to mitigate this issue by identifying safety-relevant neurons, layers, or update directions in the original parameter space. However, safety-related information is often distributed across many directions in this space, causing downstream updates to overwrite parameters that encode safety behavior. We propose WSR-Tune, a Weight Space Reparameterization-based fine-tuning framework that preserves safety during downstream adaptation. Our approach constructs a safety-conditioned basis and reparameterizes the weight matrices such that safety-relevant information becomes concentrated in a small subset of directions. We then identify safety-critical directions and freeze them in the reparameterized space, while updating the remaining complementary directions for downstream adaptation. By explicitly structuring the parameter space to disentangle safety and task information, our method reduces interference between objectives and enables simultaneous preservation of safety and improvement in downstream performance. Experimental results show that our method achieves a more favorable trade-off between downstream performance and safety retention, demonstrating its effectiveness for reliable LLM fine-tuning.

    中文

    在下游任务上微调大语言模型（LLM）往往会削弱其先前对齐的安全行为，造成任务适配与安全保留之间的内在权衡。现有方法试图通过在原始参数空间中识别与安全相关的神经元、层或更新方向来缓解这一问题。然而，与安全相关的信息通常分散在该空间的许多方向上，导致下游更新覆盖编码安全行为的参数。我们提出 WSR-Tune，这是一种基于权重空间重参数化的微调框架，可在下游适配期间保留安全性。我们的方法构造一个安全条件化基底，并对权重矩阵进行重参数化，使与安全相关的信息集中到少数几个方向上。随后，我们识别安全关键方向，并在重参数化空间中将其冻结，同时更新剩余的互补方向以适配下游任务。通过明确构造参数空间以解耦安全信息和任务信息，我们的方法降低了目标之间的干扰，并实现了安全性的同步保留与下游性能提升。实验结果表明，我们的方法在下游性能和安全保留之间实现了更有利的权衡，证明其适用于可靠的 LLM 微调。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    HarnessPro contributes an iterative, multi-agent method for evolving agent harnesses and selecting among performance-cost trade-offs, a substantial advance in agent organization and execution. Its benchmark performance and use of generated tests do not establish a substantive contribution to model mechanisms, compositional generalization, or reasoning.

    HarnessPro 提出一种迭代式多智能体方法，用于改进智能体执行框架，并在性能与成本权衡之间进行选择，显著推动了智能体组织与执行的发展。其基准表现和生成测试的使用，并未构成对模型机制、组合泛化或推理的实质性贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs. We introduce HarnessPro, a label-free method for evolving harnesses to improve task performance while reducing execution cost. In this setting, candidate harnesses are evaluated using LLM-generated tests without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests. Specialized agents diagnose execution trajectories, plan updates with different performance-cost priorities, and implement them as candidate harnesses. Rather than returning a single harness, HarnessPro uses normalized weighted squared-distance selection to provide cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) harnesses for different deployment budgets. Selected harnesses enter the next iteration, where execution feedback guides further updates. Our experiments cover Terminal-Bench 2, SWE-Bench Pro, and ProgramBench, using GPT-5.5 with Codex and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Across these benchmarks using GPT-5.5 with Codex, the heavy mode of HarnessPro achieves an average pass-rate gain of 2.0 percentage points and an average per-task cost reduction of 26.1% relative to RHO. This advantage also holds when using GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Code is available at https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro

    WeAct: Dynamic Weight Switching as Agent Actions

    WeAct：将动态权重切换作为智能体动作

    Rui Shi, Xunjian Yin, Jiacheng Sang, Zichuan Liu, Shuyan Zhou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    WeAct makes capability-specific adapter selection an agent action, enabling modular capability composition and continual adaptation while reducing forgetting. This is a substantial agent architecture contribution, with composition a meaningful but secondary element; parameter switching alone does not establish mechanistic insight or improved reasoning.

    WeAct 将针对特定能力的适配器选择设为智能体动作，从而在减少遗忘的同时实现模块化能力组合和持续适配。这是对智能体架构的实质性贡献，其中能力组合具有重要意义，但属于次要方面；仅有参数切换并不能证明获得了机制层面的洞见或推理能力的提升。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon agents must learn heterogeneous capabilities from interleaved trajectories. Updating shared parameters to learn new capabilities can degrade previously acquired ones, resulting in catastrophic forgetting. As a trajectory unfolds, different stages may require different capabilities, yet conventional joint training and static adapter merging maintain a fixed parameter configuration throughout execution. We introduce WeAct (Weight-level Internal Actions), which trains independent capability-specific LoRA adapters over a frozen backbone and adds adapter selection to the agent's action space. These internal actions use the model's native tool-calling interface for on-demand capability composition in a shared context. Across eight deep-research benchmarks, Qwen3-32B with WeAct improves average accuracy by 6.2% relative to full fine-tuning counterparts despite using less compute, and by 27.5% relative to the strongest static LoRA-merging method. WeAct also supports modular continual adaptation, by adding a new code computation adapter to expand the agent's capabilities and updating the existing writing adapter to improve report quality. Both updates leave the backbone and other adapters unchanged, supporting modular continual adaptation in agents.

    长时程智能体必须从交错轨迹中学习异质能力。更新共享参数以学习新能力可能会损害此前获得的能力，导致灾难性遗忘。随着轨迹展开，不同阶段可能需要不同能力，但传统的联合训练和静态适配器合并会在整个执行过程中维持固定的参数配置。我们提出 WeAct（权重级内部动作），它在冻结的骨干网络上训练相互独立、针对特定能力的 LoRA 适配器，并将适配器选择加入智能体的动作空间。这些内部动作利用模型原生的工具调用接口，在共享上下文中按需组合能力。在八个深度研究基准上，尽管计算量更少，采用 WeAct 的 Qwen3-32B 相较于对应的全量微调模型，平均准确率提高了 6.2%；相较于最强的静态 LoRA 合并方法，则提高了 27.5%。WeAct 还支持模块化持续适配：通过添加新的代码计算适配器来扩展智能体能力，并更新现有的写作适配器以提升报告质量。这两项更新都不改变骨干网络和其他适配器，从而支持智能体的模块化持续适配。

    LatticeMind: A Validation-Gated Agentic Framework for Density Functional Theory Workflows

    LatticeMind：一种带验证门控的密度泛函理论工作流智能体框架

    Nathaniel M. Vegh, Yu Zhu, Rapha\"el J. Prentki, F\'elix Beaudoin, Shuaishuai Yuan, Hong Guo

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LatticeMind contributes workflow contracts, deterministic pre-execution validation, and bounded repair for agentic scientific-computing workflows, with ablations and transfer across solvers supporting their reliability role. The workflows involve dependent stages and task execution, but the abstract offers little insight into compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms themselves.

    LatticeMind 为智能体科学计算工作流引入了工作流契约、确定性的执行前验证和有界修复；消融实验以及跨求解器迁移结果支持了这些机制对可靠性的作用。相关工作流包含相互依赖的阶段和任务执行，但摘要对于组合泛化或推理机制本身的阐述较少。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    First-principles calculations are rarely single solver calls: they are multistage workflows in which structures, settings, and saved densities must pass correctly between dependent stages. Language models can write a valid single input, but reliability collapses once stages are chained: a dropped dependency, wrong file handoff, or hallucinated keyword can invalidate results even when the solver runs, and such errors surface only after costly execution. We introduce LatticeMind, a validation-gated agentic framework that converts natural-language requests into executable, checkable density functional theory (DFT) projects. A workflow contract specifies required stages, files, and dependencies; deterministic validators inspect the project before any solver launch; failed checks trigger bounded repair; and reports remain traceable to project files. On a 44-case RESCU benchmark spanning total-energy, density-of-states, band-structure, magnetic, phonon workflows, three non-flagship LLM backends reproduced every reference value; 119 of 132 runs passed on the first validated plan and the rest after one repair cycle. Ablations identify the workflow contract and pre-execution validation as the principal reliability mechanisms; a conventional trial-and-repair baseline reaches 71% at twice the token cost per success. The same architecture reproduces every reference value on a 19-case VASP benchmark, demonstrating transfer across solvers. Beyond these task families, LatticeMind generated and validated the 23 inputs of a multistage study of Rh-induced electronic responses at a Rh$_6$/In$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N photocatalyst interface. These results establish workflow contracts, deterministic validation, bounded repair, and traceable records as a practical foundation for reliable AI-assisted scientific computing, where preventable errors are caught before execution and the solver is never the first validator.

    中文

    第一性原理计算很少只是调用一次求解器：它们是多阶段工作流，其中结构、设置和已保存的密度必须在相互依赖的阶段之间正确传递。语言模型可以编写有效的单个输入文件，但一旦串联多个阶段，可靠性就会骤降：遗漏依赖关系、文件交接错误或臆造关键词，都可能使结果失效，即使求解器能够运行；而此类错误只有在耗费大量资源执行后才会暴露。我们提出 LatticeMind，这是一种带验证门控的智能体框架，可将自然语言请求转换为可执行、可检查的密度泛函理论（DFT）项目。工作流契约规定必需的阶段、文件和依赖关系；确定性验证器会在启动任何求解器之前检查项目；检查失败时会触发有界修复；报告则始终可追溯至项目文件。在涵盖总能量、态密度、能带结构、磁性和声子工作流的 44 个案例 RESCU 基准测试中，三个非旗舰 LLM 后端均复现了所有参考值；132 次运行中有 119 次在首个经验证的计划下通过，其余运行则在一个修复周期后通过。消融实验表明，工作流契约和执行前验证是主要的可靠性保障机制；传统的试错修复基线达到 71% 的成功率，但每次成功的 token 成本是其两倍。同一架构在 19 个案例的 VASP 基准测试中也复现了所有参考值，表明该方法可迁移至不同求解器。除了这些任务类别之外，LatticeMind 还生成并验证了 23 个输入文件，用于研究 Rh 在 Rh$_6$/In$_x$Ga$_{1-x}$N 光催化剂界面引起的电子响应。这些结果表明，工作流契约、确定性验证、有界修复和可追溯记录，为可靠的 AI 辅助科学计算奠定了实用基础：在执行前捕获可避免的错误，并且求解器绝不会成为第一个验证者。

    Hengqi Liu, Ziyuan Liu, Yang Qin, Wanting Zhou, Zichuan Wang, Jiachen Liang, Xu Chu, Shaowei Chen, Zhaokai Luo, Mu Chuan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    本文合成可验证的多步金融任务，并用这些任务进行 SFT 和 RL，以提升智能体的长时程执行、证据整合和工具使用能力。推理和智能体系统是实质性贡献；任务组合属于附带内容，摘要也未研究模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from conversational assistants into Cowork Agents capable of autonomous planning, tool use, and complex task execution. Financial analysis requires these agents to integrate cross-document evidence and perform multistep numerical reasoning, but expert task authoring is costly, while direct LLM synthesis struggles to produce challenging tasks with reliable answers. We introduce Navalia, a framework for Cowork Agents that combines verifiable task synthesis with long-horizon post-training. Using corporate financial reports as its data source, Navalia semantically selects supporting evidence from complete fact sets and constructs executable computation chains to generate analytical tasks with traceable evidence and actual data dependencies between steps. We further use independent LLM review and programmatic checks to verify evidence consistency and answer correctness. The verified tasks are then used for trajectory collection, cold-start supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL) to improve long-horizon task execution. Navalia, initialized from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, achieves consistent gains over the base model across all five benchmarks: OfficeQA Pro, FinSearchComp, Finance Agent Benchmark, APEX-Agents-AA, and Workspace-Bench-Lite. These results demonstrate that Navalia improves evidence integration, tool use, and long-horizon task execution capabilities and generalizes to broader Cowork settings, including general office tasks.

    AtomSD 从成功轨迹中学习可复用的程序单元，并利用它们训练智能体策略，同时采用任务奖励优化并报告了性能提升。这直接推进了组合与智能体学习；摘要没有提供模型内部机制的证据，因此其与机制可解释性的关联较弱。

    Large language models (LLMs) possess broad factual knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, but solving complex tasks also requires procedural knowledge about how to act. Existing approaches often represent procedural knowledge through trajectories or bundled skills, limiting flexible reuse across interaction histories. This paper introduces Procedural Atoms, fine-grained and independently applicable units that represent Intent, When, Do, and Avoid guidance. Building on this representation, we propose AtomSD, an Atom-guided Self-Distillation framework in which the learner continually extracts Procedural Atoms from its own successful trajectories and distills them into the evolving policy through Atom-conditioned supervision and task-reward optimization. Comprehensive experiments show that AtomSD consistently outperforms strong reward-based and distillation methods, exceeding the state-of-the-art baseline by up to 9.31 points in average performance.     Hardik Ruparel, Raj Kumar Pandey, Pramod Kumar

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    GRaSP formulates geo-distributed retrieval selection and derives an efficient greedy algorithm, with experiments measuring latency, cost, and answer quality. This is a substantial systems contribution; question answering is an evaluation context, not a study of reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    GRaSP 对地理分布式检索选择问题进行了形式化，并推导出高效的贪心算法；实验测量了延迟、成本和答案质量。这是实质性的系统贡献；问答只是评估场景，并非对推理机制或组合泛化的研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is increasingly served across geo-distributed cloud and edge infrastructures, where wide-area latency, cross-region egress cost, and data-residency rules compete with retrieval quality. Conventional pipelines rank by semantic similarity alone and ignore where content lives, inflating tail latency and cost. We formalize the Geo-RAG Selection Problem (GRaSP), a drop-in re-scoring layer that decays relevance by latency and adds an optional cost penalty under a cardinality budget and per-region caps, with no retraining. We first settle its complexity: the base formulation is a linear objective over a partition matroid, solved optimally by an O(N log N) greedy algorithm, rather than NP-hard as a knapsack framing suggests, with hardness entering only under an additive egress budget. On a five-node CloudLab testbed emulating a four-region WAN over the Natural Questions corpus (2.68M passages), GRaSP's benefit is placement-dependent: under uniform placement it cuts fetch latency at negligible quality cost; under topical (residency-like) placement it traces a recall-latency Pareto frontier that dominates relevance-only, nearest-k, and a latency-budgeted baseline. At a moderate latency setting, GRaSP lowers P90 fetch latency by 41% while retaining 78% of relevance-only's recall, with sub-millisecond selection overhead, stable to 200 queries/s. Findings generalize across four public BEIR benchmarks. In end-to-end question answering, GRaSP reduces context-fetch latency by 43% while remaining within 0.062 absolute EM of relevance-only retrieval.

    中文

    检索增强生成（RAG）越来越多地部署在地理分布式云和边缘基础设施上，其中广域网延迟、跨区域出口成本和数据驻留规则都与检索质量相互制约。传统流水线只按语义相似度排序，忽略内容所在位置，从而推高尾延迟和成本。我们形式化定义了 Geo-RAG 选择问题（GRaSP）：一种可直接接入的重新评分层，在基数预算和各区域上限约束下，根据延迟衰减相关性，并可选地加入成本惩罚，且无需重新训练。我们首先厘清其复杂度：基础形式是在分区拟阵上的线性目标，可通过 O(N log N) 贪心算法求得最优解；与背包问题的表述所暗示的情况不同，它并非 NP-hard，只有加入加性出口预算时才会出现困难性。在一个由五节点 CloudLab 测试平台构成、用于模拟四区域 WAN 的环境中，使用 Natural Questions 语料库（268 万个段落）进行实验，GRaSP 的收益取决于内容放置方式：均匀放置时，它能以可忽略的质量代价降低获取延迟；采用主题式（类似驻留限制的）放置时，它形成的召回率—延迟帕累托前沿优于仅按相关性排序、最近邻 k 项和延迟预算基线。在中等延迟设置下，GRaSP 将 P90 获取延迟降低 41%，同时保留仅按相关性检索所得召回率的 78%；其选择开销低于一毫秒，在每秒 200 个查询时仍保持稳定。实验结果可推广到四个公开 BEIR 基准。在端到端问答中，GRaSP 将上下文获取延迟降低 43%，同时与仅按相关性检索相比，绝对 EM 差距不超过 0.062。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces compiler-guided repair of failed Lean tactics and measures its effect on theorem-proving success, a substantial algorithmic contribution to problem solving. Its use of a repair model and compiler feedback does not investigate model internals, compositional generalization, or model-system architecture, so those connections remain low.

    本文提出对失败 Lean 策略进行编译器引导修复，并测量其对定理证明成功率的影响，是对问题求解的实质性算法贡献。使用修复模型和编译器反馈并不意味着研究模型内部、组合泛化或模型系统架构，因此这些方面的关联仍较弱。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Automated theorem provers often rely on sampling language models, but proof assistants like Lean reject each failed step with a precise error message --- information that pure sampling discards. To overcome this, we introduce a bounded, online step-level repair module. Our search samples $K$ candidate tactics at each step and repairs a failed tactic at most $R$ times. Instead of discarding failed tactics, we feed the compiler's error message to a pretrained repair model to fix individual rejected steps in place. This approach improves the solve rate over a sampling-only baseline across all tested candidate budgets ($K \in \{1,3,5,8\}$), achieving up to a $32\%$ relative gain and solving $82$ additional theorems on a $1{,}990$-theorem subset of the LeanDojo benchmark. Repair is not free: it trades extra runtime for reachable proofs. But the trade is predictable: repair pays most when sampling is constrained; its return is front-loaded, with the first repair attempt capturing $84\text{--}96\%$ of the total gain; and the gain comes almost entirely from shallow tactic-execution failures rather than structural errors such as type mismatches. This targeted repair successfully replicates on a second benchmark (Lean Workbook), nearly doubling the solve rate with zero regressions.

    中文

    自动定理证明器通常依赖对语言模型进行采样，但 Lean 这类证明助手会针对每个失败步骤给出精确的错误消息——纯采样会丢弃这些信息。为此，我们引入一种有界的在线逐步修复模块。我们的搜索在每一步采样 $K$ 个候选策略，并对失败的策略最多修复 $R$ 次。我们不再丢弃失败的策略，而是将编译器的错误消息提供给预训练修复模型，以便就地修复单个被拒绝的步骤。与仅采样基线相比，这种方法在所有测试的候选预算（$K \in \{1,3,5,8\}$）下都提高了解题率，最高取得 $32\%$ 的相对增益，并在 LeanDojo 基准的一个包含 $82$ 条定理的子集中额外解决了 $1{,}990$ 条定理。修复并非没有代价：它以增加运行时间换取可达成的证明。但这种权衡是可预测的：采样受限时修复最有价值；其收益主要集中在前期，首次修复尝试就获得了总增益的 $84\text{--}96\%$；而增益几乎完全来自较浅层的策略执行失败，而非类型不匹配等结构性错误。这种有针对性的修复在第二个基准（Lean Workbook）上也成功复现，使解题率几乎翻倍，且没有任何回退。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes a multimodal, process-aware benchmark and empirical findings about mathematical reasoning quality and multi-agent collaboration, strongly advancing reasoning evaluation.     本文提出多模态、过程感知的基准，并给出有关数学推理质量和多智能体协作的实证发现，显著推进了推理评估。多智能体组织是评估设置的一部分，但主要贡献是基准，而非新的智能体系统机制；仅有模态多样性不足以证明组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Mathematical reasoning is a fundamental capability for educational applications of Large Language Models (LLMs), where reliable problem solving requires not only correct answers but also coherent and verifiable reasoning processes. Multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown growing potential in this domain by leveraging collaboration and verification among multiple LLM agents. However, existing evaluations primarily focus on the correctness of final answers in text-only settings, offering limited insight into multimodal reasoning capabilities, the reliability of intermediate reasoning steps, and robustness against reasoning errors. To address these limitations, we introduce MAMath-Bench, a process-aware benchmark designed to evaluate the multimodal mathematical reasoning capabilities of MASs. MAMath-Bench comprises 1,003 problems spanning 11 mathematical categories, multiple difficulty levels, and several modalities, including text, images, and audio. It features fine-grained milestone annotations to evaluate systems across three dimensions: problem-solving correctness, reasoning-process reliability, and robustness to adversarial reasoning-chain perturbations. Our evaluation yields three key findings. First, multi-agent collaboration does not consistently improve final-answer accuracy over strong single LLMs. Second, collaboration can substantially enhance the coverage of intermediate reasoning, but such gains may come at the cost of increased reasoning redundancy. Third, current systems remain vulnerable to adversarial reasoning errors, particularly those involving subtle structural perturbations. The dataset is available at https://github.com/mira-ai-lab/AgentMath.

    数学推理是大型语言模型（LLM）教育应用的一项基础能力；可靠地解决问题不仅需要答案正确，还需要推理过程连贯且可验证。多智能体系统（MAS）通过多个 LLM 智能体之间的协作与验证，在这一领域展现出越来越大的潜力。然而，现有评估主要关注纯文本场景下最终答案是否正确，对多模态推理能力、中间推理步骤的可靠性以及对推理错误的稳健性所提供的洞见有限。为解决这些局限，我们推出 MAMath-Bench，这是一个过程感知基准，旨在评估 MAS 的多模态数学推理能力。MAMath-Bench 包含 1,003 道题，涵盖 11 个数学类别、多个难度等级以及文本、图像和音频等多种模态。它提供细粒度的里程碑标注，从三个维度评估系统：问题求解正确性、推理过程可靠性，以及对推理链对抗性扰动的稳健性。我们的评估得出三项主要发现。第一，多智能体协作并不能始终提高最终答案的准确率，使其超过强大的单个 LLM。第二，协作能够显著提高中间推理的覆盖度，但这种提升可能以推理冗余增加为代价。第三，当前系统仍容易受到对抗性推理错误的影响，尤其是涉及细微结构扰动的错误。数据集可通过 https://github.com/mira-ai-lab/AgentMath 获取。

    Long-horizon language agents require compact memories that retain interaction evidence while preserving competing hypotheses about unobserved states. Although effective, many belief-state methods encode memory in discrete natural language, where repeated compression can omit evidence or prematurely discard plausible alternatives. We introduce LAMB, a recurrent framework for latent multi-hypothesis beliefs. A Common--Delta factorization combines a shared Common state for interaction evidence with weighted Delta components for competing hypotheses. Relative evidence from action-outcome predictions guides recurrent hypothesis updates without generating textual memory. A context-conditioned readout exposes hypotheses separately to the policy through a fixed-token belief prefix in the default configuration. The belief modules and policy are jointly trained using action imitation and auxiliary state, outcome, and observation-discrimination objectives. Across ALFWorld, BabyAI, ScienceWorld, and Crafter, LAMB matches or outperforms PABU, improving ALFWorld SR@30 and ScienceWorld success by 6.0 and 22.0 percentage points, respectively, and Crafter achievement progress by 26.37 points.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Continuum-LM reuses pretrained transformations for continuous-depth computation, with solver settings controlling computation and experiments showing gains on scientific tasks. This is a substantial model-computation design contribution, but the abstract provides no direct evidence about internal representations, compositionality, or reasoning mechanisms; task accuracy alone does not establish those.

    Continuum-LM 复用预训练变换来执行连续深度计算，并通过求解器设置控制计算量；实验显示该方法在科学任务上取得性能提升。这是一项重要的模型计算设计贡献，但摘要没有提供关于内部表征、组合性或推理机制的直接证据；任务准确率本身不足以证明这些方面。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Scientific foundation models increasingly operate on continuous phenomena, yet still use discrete residual computation. We ask whether pretrained residual transformations can support additional latent computation without expanding the backbone. To test this possibility, we introduce Continuum-LM, which reuses these transformations as dynamical operators in a continuous-depth language model. Its hidden states evolve through an ordinary differential equation evaluated by higher-order numerical integration, with solver order and step size controlling computation. Across eight scientific tasks, Continuum-LM trains stably and improves mean exact-match accuracy by 7.77 and 10.96 percentage points over discrete counterparts at the 0.6B and 1.7B scales, respectively. At 0.6B, it also outperforms an Ouro-style recurrent control under matched parameter and residual-function evaluation budgets. Together, these results support extensible computational depth through parameter reuse, identifying continuous hidden-state evolution as a practical design dimension for scientific language models beyond parameter scaling.

    中文

    科学基础模型越来越多地处理连续现象，但仍采用离散残差计算。我们探究预训练残差变换能否在不扩展骨干网络的情况下支持额外的潜在计算。为检验这一可能性，我们提出 Continuum-LM，它在连续深度语言模型中将这些变换作为动力算子重复使用。其隐藏状态通过常微分方程演化，并采用高阶数值积分求解，求解器阶数和步长控制计算量。在八项科学任务中，Continuum-LM 训练稳定；在 0.6B 和 1.7B 规模下，与离散对应模型相比，其平均精确匹配准确率分别提高 7.77 和 10.96 个百分点。在 0.6B 规模下，在参数量和残差函数评估预算相同的条件下，它也优于 Ouro 式循环对照模型。总的来说，这些结果支持通过参数复用扩展计算深度，并表明连续隐藏状态演化是科学语言模型在参数扩展之外的一种实用设计维度。

    Do LLMs Really Lack Difference Awareness? Uncovering Heuristic Substitution in Group-Differentiating Fairness

    LLM 真的缺乏差异意识吗？揭示群体差异公平判断中的启发式替代

    Jingshen Zhang, Bo Wang, Yanlin Fu, Yuewen Dang, Dongming Zhao, Zifei Yu, and Yuexian Hou

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes a two-stage fairness reasoning framework and supports its heuristic-substitution account with neuron-level probing that identifies representational structure and activation bias. This provides substantial evidence about a reasoning failure mode and mechanistic insight, while the stage decomposition alone does not establish broader compositional generalization and the work does not focus on model or agent systems.

    本文提出两阶段公平推理框架，并通过神经元级探测识别出表征结构和激活偏差，为启发式替代解释提供支持。这为一种推理失败模式和相关机制提供了重要证据；不过，分阶段分解本身并不能证明更广泛的组合泛化，而且该研究并不聚焦于模型或智能体系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In this paper, we investigate the issue of difference awareness in LLMs, defined as a model's ability to recognize and acknowledge meaningful differences between social groups in fairness decision-making. Previous studies have consistently shown that models perform poorly on such tasks, a finding commonly attributed to a lack of difference awareness. We propose an alternative account, which we term Fairness Heuristic Substitution: difference awareness is not necessarily absent, but the complex demand of simultaneously identifying relevant group differences and determining their implications for fairness decisions may lead models to substitute the simpler, more accessible equal-treatment heuristic, i.e., formal equality. Based on this hypothesis, we introduce TDD, a Two-stage Distinguish-Decide framework that explicitly decomposes fairness reasoning into first distinguishing contextually relevant group differences and then making the corresponding decision, thereby discouraging reliance on formal-equality shortcuts. (i) Across four benchmarks and ten models ranging from billions to trillions of parameters, TDD significantly outperforms one-stage baselines, even one strengthened through simulated test-set leakage. (ii) Combining TDD with neuron-level contrastive probing provides mechanistic evidence consistent with the Fairness Heuristic Substitution hypothesis by revealing two signatures of the formal-equality: a compact, locally coordinated representational structure and a pronounced activation bias under default reasoning. (iii) TDD's stage-wise decomposition uncovers overlooked failure modes in fairness reasoning, including heuristic displacement and misaligned stage dynamics.

    中文

    本文探讨 LLM 中的差异意识问题，将其定义为模型在公平决策中识别并承认社会群体间有意义差异的能力。以往研究一再表明，模型在此类任务上的表现不佳，这通常被归因于缺乏差异意识。我们提出另一种解释，并将其称为“公平启发式替代”：差异意识未必不存在，但同时识别相关群体差异并确定这些差异对公平决策的影响这一复杂要求，可能会促使模型转而采用更简单、更易调用的平等待遇启发式，即形式平等。基于这一假设，我们提出 TDD（两阶段“区分—决策”）框架，将公平推理明确分解为先区分与情境相关的群体差异，再据此作出相应决策，从而避免依赖形式平等的捷径。（i）在四个基准和十个参数规模从数十亿到数万亿不等的模型上，TDD 显著优于单阶段基线，甚至优于一种通过模拟测试集泄漏加以强化的基线。（ii）将 TDD 与神经元级对比探测相结合，通过揭示形式平等的两个特征，为“公平启发式替代”假设提供了相符的机制证据：紧凑且局部协调的表征结构，以及默认推理时显著的激活偏差。（iii）TDD 的分阶段分解揭示了公平推理中被忽视的失败模式，包括启发式替代和阶段动态失调。

    Langchen Liu, Junlin Luo, Min Zhu, Zhuoran Yang, Lu Lu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FoundPDE learns to map trajectories to reusable symbolic PDEs and demonstrates recovery of unseen composite equations, making compositional generalization a substantial contribution. Its interpretability concerns the discovered scientific laws rather than the model’s internal representations; broader scientific discovery and transformer use are incidental to the other directions.

    FoundPDE 学会将轨迹映射为可复用的符号 PDE，并展示了对未见过的复合方程的恢复能力，因此组合泛化是其重要贡献。其可解释性针对的是发现出的科学定律，而非模型的内部表征；更广义的科学发现和 transformer 的使用只是与其他方向相关的附带内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Discovering governing partial differential equations (PDEs) from observed data is a central inverse problem in computational science and engineering: the goal is not only to predict trajectories, but to identify interpretable symbolic laws that can be analyzed and reused. Existing PDE discovery methods often depend on hand-designed libraries, accurate numerical derivatives, or per-equation symbolic search, making them fragile under sparse observations, noisy data, broad equation families, and unseen symbolic compositions. Here, we introduce FoundPDE, a pretrained data-to-symbol foundation model for PDE discovery. FoundPDE maps discretized spatio-temporal trajectories to symbolic equations with a transformer, uses Fourier and first-order spatial-derivative augmentation to expose complementary trajectory information, refines numerical coefficients, and supports downstream extension with improved generalization through few-shot fine-tuning and hierarchical discovery. On a clean in-domain benchmark spanning 20 PDE families, our model reaches 97.50% type recognition. Under coefficient shifts beyond the training support, type recognition remains 90.53%; under multiplicative Gaussian noise on the model input, it is 94.43% at a 2% noise level but falls to 52.09% at 10%. For unseen composite equations, few-shot fine-tuning reaches over 90% exact recovery on four held-out families, and we further develop a hierarchical discovery algorithm that recovers two-term composites without fine-tuning FoundPDE. By amortizing symbolic discovery across equation families, FoundPDE shifts PDE discovery from per-dataset search toward a reusable pretrained model that extends to new physics with limited additional data, a step toward foundation models that uncover interpretable governing laws directly from scientific data.

    中文

    从观测数据中发现控制系统演化的偏微分方程（PDE），是计算科学与工程中的核心逆问题：目标不仅是预测轨迹，还要识别可供分析和复用的可解释符号定律。现有 PDE 发现方法往往依赖人工设计的候选库、精确数值导数或针对每个方程进行符号搜索，因此面对稀疏观测、噪声数据、广泛的方程族和未见过的符号组合时容易失效。在此，我们提出 FoundPDE，一种用于 PDE 发现的预训练数据到符号基础模型。FoundPDE 使用 transformer 将离散化的时空轨迹映射为符号方程，利用傅里叶变换和一阶空间导数增强来提供互补的轨迹信息，优化数值系数，并支持通过少样本微调和分层发现进行下游扩展，以提升泛化能力。在涵盖 20 个 PDE 方程族的干净域内基准上，我们的模型达到 97.50% 的类型识别率。当系数偏移超出训练数据范围时，类型识别率仍为 90.53%；对模型输入施加乘性高斯噪声时，噪声水平为 2% 时识别率为 94.43%，而在 10% 时降至 52.09%。对于未见过的复合方程，少样本微调在四个留出方程族上实现了超过 90% 的精确恢复率；我们还进一步开发了一种分层发现算法，无需微调 FoundPDE 即可恢复由两项组成的复合方程。FoundPDE 将符号发现的成本分摊到多个方程族上，使 PDE 发现从针对每个数据集的搜索转向可复用的预训练模型；该模型只需有限的额外数据即可扩展到新的物理问题。这是迈向直接从科学数据中发现可解释控制定律的基础模型的一步。

    The paper separates structural planning difficulty from sensitivity to predicate semantics and evaluates heuristics, LLM planning, and hybrid routing, substantially advancing understanding of planning capability.     本文区分结构性规划难度与对谓词语义的敏感性，并评估启发式方法、LLM 规划和混合路由，显著推进了对规划能力的理解。谓词重命名探测了模型行为，但没有分析内部机制或表征；路由是经过评估的应用，而非主要的系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models (LLMs) struggle with classical planning, but benchmarks rarely distinguish structural difficulty from the difficulty of interpreting symbolic vocabulary. We examine seven STRIPS domains with BFS-optimal plan lengths. For predicting structural difficulty without solving an instance, the zero-training delete-relaxation heuristic $h_{\mathrm{add}}$ outperforms learned alternatives on held-out domains (mean Spearman $|\rho|=0.931$), including ridge regression ($0.707$), object count ($0.657$), and the episodic retrieval architecture ARC ($0.400$). ARC also fails to outperform a linear model using the same features. To isolate semantic effects, we progressively rename predicates while preserving states, transitions, and optimal plans. Valid LLM planning success drops from $67.5\%$ to $40.0\%$ between $0\%$ and $100\%$ renaming, while refusals remain at $0\%$. An LLM supplied with ARC's conditioning information predicts difficulty in context better than trained ARC (mean $|\rho|=0.826$). Hybrid routing between an LLM and a symbolic planner depends more on calibration to the target LLM's outcomes than on the structural score selected. Thus, established symbolic heuristics already estimate structural difficulty well; improving hybrid planning requires modeling LLM behavior sensitive to predicate semantics rather than developing more structural predictors.

    中文

    大语言模型（LLM）难以应对经典规划，但基准测试很少区分结构难度与理解符号词汇的难度。我们考察了七个 STRIPS 域，并使用 BFS 最优计划长度。对于无需求解实例即可预测结构难度这一任务，零训练删除松弛启发式 $h_{\mathrm{add}}$在留出域上的表现优于学习得到的替代方法（平均 Spearman $|\rho|=0.931$），包括岭回归（$0.707$）、对象数量（$0.657$）和情景检索架构 ARC（$0.400$）。ARC 的表现也未能优于使用相同特征的线性模型。为分离语义因素的影响，我们逐步重命名谓词，同时保持状态、转移和最优计划不变。在重命名从 $67.5\%$到 $40.0\%$的过程中，有效的 LLM 规划成功率从 $0\%$降至 $100\%$，而拒答率保持在 $0\%$。向 LLM 提供 ARC 的条件信息后，它在上下文中预测难度的表现优于经过训练的 ARC（平均 $|\rho|=0.826$）。LLM 与符号规划器之间的混合路由，其效果更取决于针对目标 LLM 结果的校准，而非所选的结构评分。因此，已有的符号启发式已经能够很好地估计结构难度；改进混合规划需要对受谓词语义影响的 LLM 行为建模，而不是开发更多结构预测器。

    Latent Projection for Latent Planning

    用于潜在规划的潜在投影

    Yoo Sung Jang, Michael Ryoo

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper derives how latent dynamics encode direction-specific uncertainty and uses that structure to modify planning costs, with gains demonstrated across environments. This is a substantive algorithmic contribution to latent-space planning and model-based agents, but it does not analyze learned representations mechanistically or address compositional generalization.

    本文推导出潜在动力学如何编码各方向上的不确定性，并利用这一结构修改规划代价，且在多个环境中展示了性能提升。这是对潜在空间规划和基于模型的智能体的一项实质性算法贡献，但没有对学习到的表征进行机制分析，也没有涉及组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Latent world models let an agent plan in latent space. The planner searches for an action sequence that minimizes a cost, and that cost is often the $\ell_2$ distance between the predicted terminal latent and the goal latent. The latent, however, is partly noise: the regularizer that prevents collapse during world model training promotes variance in the directions carrying no signal. We show that the same regularizer also supplies the structure to prune that noise in the latent. SIGReg drives the latent marginal to a standard Gaussian at every step, and assuming further that the latent sequence is a Gauss-Markov process, the transition is linear with its covariance pinned by the map itself, $z' \mid z \sim \mathcal{N}(Az,\, I - AA^\top)$. Fitting the state dynamics $A$ therefore yields the covariance at no additional cost, and in its eigenbasis each latent direction carries its own uncertainty. Furthermore, constraining $A$ to be a normal matrix fixes that basis across timesteps, so one eigenbasis measures the uncertainty over an arbitrary number of steps and serves as a stable basis to compute the planning cost on. We then restrict the $\ell_2$ cost to the $k$-dimensional subspace the state dynamics carry forward with the least uncertainty. The correction is post hoc: the encoder, the predictor, the rollout, and the planner are all left untouched, and only a single constrained matrix, $A$, is fit. We evaluate across six environments and show large gains on the 2D navigation tasks, TwoRoom and PointMaze, raising success rate over the plain $\ell_2$ cost by up to $+54.7$ points under a harder planning setting. Code is available at https://github.com/yjang43/lp2.

    中文

    潜在世界模型使智能体能够在潜在空间中规划。规划器搜索能使代价最小化的动作序列，而该代价通常是预测终端潜在状态与目标潜在状态之间的 $\ell_2$距离。然而，潜在状态中有一部分是噪声：世界模型训练中用于防止坍塌的正则化器，会促使不携带信号的方向产生方差。我们表明，同一正则化器也提供了用于剔除潜在状态中噪声的结构。SIGReg 会在每个时间步将潜在边缘分布推向标准高斯分布；若进一步假设潜在序列是高斯—马尔可夫过程，则转移是线性的，且其协方差由映射本身确定，$z' \mid z \sim \mathcal{N}(Az,\, I - AA^\top)$。因此，拟合状态动力学 $A$即可无额外代价地得到协方差；在其特征基下，每个潜在方向都具有自身的不确定性。此外，将 $A$约束为正规矩阵可使该基在各时间步保持不变，因此同一个特征基可以衡量任意步数下的不确定性，并作为计算规划代价的稳定基底。随后，我们将 $\ell_2$代价限制在状态动力学以最低不确定性向前传递的 $k$维子空间内。这种修正是事后进行的：编码器、预测器、展开过程和规划器都保持不变，只拟合一个受约束的矩阵 $A$。我们在六个环境中进行评估，并显示该方法在二维导航任务 TwoRoom 和 PointMaze 上取得显著提升；在更难的规划设置下，相比直接使用 $\ell_2$代价，成功率最多提高 $+54.7$个百分点。代码见 https://github.com/yjang43/lp2。

    SPEM：面向 LLM 智能体高效技能使用的结构感知程序记忆

    Ran Zhou, Zehui Kong, Fanyu Lin, Jiaheng Liu, Zhen Zhang, Yuxiang Ren

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SPEM’s main contribution is a procedural memory that retrieves skills and reuses execution-derived skill compositions, advancing reusable composition and agent memory design. Its task-solving benchmarks provide only incidental evidence about reasoning capability, and the abstract makes no claim about interpreting model internals.

    SPEM 的主要贡献是一种程序记忆，它能检索技能并复用从执行中得到的技能组合，从而推进可复用组合和智能体记忆设计。其任务求解基准只能间接说明推理能力，摘要也没有声称会解释模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM-based agents increasingly rely on reusable skills. However, scaling skill libraries makes efficient and accurate skill use difficult. Full skill loading incurs high token and runtime overhead. In contrast, flat semantic retrieval treats skills as independent text entries, ignoring dependencies, execution order, state transitions, and data flow constraints. We propose SPEM, a lightweight structure-aware procedural memory framework for efficient skill use in LLM-based agents. SPEM maintains Atomic Skill Memory for individual skills and Skill-DAG Memory for reusable compositions derived from successful executions. For a new task, SPEM reuses high-confidence Skill-DAG templates when available. Otherwise, it retrieves atomic skills and invokes Skill-GNN for state- and structure-aware skill selection. Successful executions are written back as new Skill-DAGs, allowing procedural memory to accumulate over time. Experiments on ALFWorld and SkillsBench show that SPEM achieves the best overall effectiveness--efficiency trade-off, reaching 87.1% ALFWorld success and 38.38% SkillsBench reward while reducing token and runtime costs against strong baselines.

    Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains a language model by sampling responses, scoring them with an automatic verifier, and updating the policy from the resulting rewards. The policy therefore receives direct learning signals only from trajectories that appear in its rollouts. Yet repeated sampling from the same policy can concentrate on similar reasoning paths, leaving useful alternatives unexplored under a fixed rollout budget. By clustering activation differences between correct and incorrect responses to the same problem, ASE builds a structured bank of latent exploration vectors. Different vectors are then applied to subsequent rollouts to explore alternative reasoning paths. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base trained on DAPO-Math-17k, ASE improves average Mean@8 across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks over GRPO by 4.87 and 1.87 percentage points, respectively, under the same rollout budget.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM)-based agents have recently demonstrated outstanding performance in single-turn tasks, yet they continue to struggle with long-horizon tasks, particularly in environments without prior training. A key limitation of single LLMs is their difficulty in processing long contexts, which stems from weaknesses in continuous decision-making and reasoning capabilities. Although existing multi-agent systems (MAS) equipped with long-term memory bases can partially address this gap, they mostly rely on knowledge reuse or summarization, an approach that is often constrained by directly retrieval without any adaptation for the current task, while the retrieved memory may contain much history noises waiting to be preprocessed. In contrast, MAS characterized by task-specific guidance often lack long-term memory specifically designed for the guidance. To address these challenges, we propose M-Plan, a closed-loop MAS framework that integrates long-term and short-term memory. By combining global-local and past-current guidance, M-Plan enhances agents' performance on multi-turn tasks while maintaining a plug-and-play design. During task execution, agents receive task-specific milestones and insights, and are provided with local hints only when confusion arises, which form global-local guidance together. These guidance generation and utilization construct the short-term memory as well. After task completion, relevant information about the current task is optimized or reorganized before being sent to the long-term memory storage for future retrieval. The designments mentioned above build a comprehensive framework different from other individual long-term or short-term memory works. Extensive experiments on multi-turn tasks including ALFWorld, Webshop, and PDDL across diverse models demonstrate that M-Plan outperforms multiple baseline methods in both accuracy and efficiency.

    Recent Omni LLMs (OLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in joint audio-visual reasoning, yet cross-modal hallucinations remain a major challenge.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PORA learns when an agent should spend limited reasoning budget by comparing short and long reasoning outcomes, then allocates computation across task steps. This substantially advances reasoning capability and adaptive agent computation, while composition and internal mechanisms are not addressed.

    PORA 通过比较简短与深入推理的结果，学习智能体何时应当花费有限的推理预算，并据此在各任务步骤间分配计算资源。这显著推进了推理能力和自适应智能体计算；本文没有涉及组合能力或内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents perform tasks over multiple steps and revise their actions based on feedback. As the total reasoning budget is often limited and must support future steps, the agent must choose between short and long reasoning before each action. Longer reasoning may improve the final task outcome by preventing later errors, but it also uses budget capacity that may be needed for future decisions. This creates two challenges: estimating the downstream value of long reasoning and deciding when that value is worth using the remaining budget. We propose Paired Outcome-guided Reasoning Allocation (PORA), which learns this decision by comparing short and long reasoning from the same interaction state. During training, \method{} completes the task twice from each selected state, once with a short reasoning allowance and once with a long allowance, and compares their final quality and total processing to estimate when longer reasoning is valuable. During inference, a controller weighs this estimate against learned prices on remaining-budget pressure and chooses either short or long reasoning without running both alternatives. We evaluate PORA across application, memory, code, retail, and mathematics tasks, achieving strong results across all settings. On BFCL memory, it exceeds the strongest existing method by 17.4--32.9 percentage points. Within the same agent, it matches or exceeds always using long reasoning on code and mathematics with 50.6% fewer actor tokens and 31.2% fewer model requests, respectively.

    中文

    LLM 智能体通过多个步骤执行任务，并根据反馈调整动作。由于总推理预算通常有限，且必须留给后续步骤使用，智能体必须在每次动作之前选择进行简短还是深入的推理。更深入的推理可能通过避免后续错误改善最终任务结果，但也会消耗可能用于未来决策的预算。这带来了两个挑战：估计深入推理的下游价值，以及判断该价值是否值得消耗剩余预算。我们提出配对结果引导的推理分配方法（Paired Outcome-guided Reasoning Allocation，PORA），通过比较同一交互状态下的简短推理和深入推理来学习这一决策。在训练期间，\method{} 从每个选定状态出发完成两次任务，一次允许简短推理，一次允许深入推理，并比较最终质量和总处理量，以估计何时深入推理有价值。在推理期间，控制器将这一估计与学习得到的剩余预算压力代价权衡，并选择简短或深入推理，而不会同时运行两种方案。我们在涵盖应用、记忆、代码、零售和数学的任务上评估 PORA，结果显示其在所有设置中均表现出色。在 BFCL memory 上，它比最强的现有方法高出 17.4–32.9 个百分点。在同一智能体中，与始终使用深入推理相比，PORA 在代码和数学任务上的表现持平或更好，同时分别减少 50.6% 的执行智能体 token 数和 31.2% 的模型请求数。

Existing approaches based on Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) improve performance by splitting the task into intermediate steps, but do not quantify how each modality contributes to reaching the final answer. We argue that quantifying the effect that each modality has on the answering process improves process traceability and final performance. Thus, we propose Entropy-Driven Multimodal Answering (EDMA), which uses logical entropy to formalise multimodal QA as an iterative process of entropy reduction and to quantify the contribution of each modality in distinguishing correct from incorrect candidate answers. This enables the construction of quantifiable answering trajectories, where each step is associated with a measurable entropy reduction. EDMA introduces (i) modality-conditioned partitioning to estimate unimodal entropy reduction, (ii) entropy-driven multimodal fusion to capture complementary information across modalities, and (iii) entropy-based selection of the answering trajectory that minimises the most logical entropy. Evaluated across standard MMQA benchmarks, EDMA outperforms competitive prompting baselines, with average gains of 12.8 F1 and 4.6 LLM-J points over Planning Prompting and 18.6 F1 and 8.3 LLM-J points over Chain-of-Thought. Moreover, EDMA outperforms self-consistency baselines and is competitive with the multi-agent system baseline. Moreover, we show that higher entropy correlates with more false positives and, through controlled trajectory selection, demonstrate that logical entropy serves as an effective, monotonic selector for correct reasoning paths, validating entropy level as a reliable proxy for performance.

    中文

    多模态问答（MMQA）依赖于整合异构数据源、有选择地利用相关模态并忽略干扰信息。基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的现有方法通过将任务拆解为中间步骤来提升表现，但并未量化各模态对得出最终答案的贡献。我们认为，量化各模态对回答过程的影响，有助于提高过程可追溯性和最终表现。因此，我们提出熵驱动的多模态问答（EDMA），它使用逻辑熵将多模态 QA 形式化为熵逐步降低的迭代过程，并量化各模态在区分正确与错误候选答案方面的贡献。这使得我们能够构建可量化的回答轨迹，其中每一步都对应可测量的熵减。EDMA 引入了：（i）模态条件化划分，用于估计单模态熵减；（ii）熵驱动的多模态融合，用于捕捉模态间的互补信息；（iii）基于熵的回答轨迹选择，以尽可能降低逻辑熵。在标准 MMQA 基准上的评估表明，EDMA 优于有竞争力的提示基线：相较于 Planning Prompting，平均提高 12.8 个 F1 点和 4.6 个 LLM-J 点；相较于 Chain-of-Thought，平均提高 18.6 个 F1 点和 8.3 个 LLM-J 点。此外，EDMA 优于自一致性基线，其表现也与多智能体系统基线相当。此外，我们还表明，较高熵与更多假阳性相关；通过受控的轨迹选择，我们证明逻辑熵是有效的单调选择器，可用于挑选正确推理路径，从而验证熵水平是可靠的表现代理指标。

    Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models reduce computation through sparse expert activation, but deployment still requires storing a large number of expert parameters. We study post-training expert pruning using task-domain calibration data as a subset-selection problem: given a pretrained MoE layer, select a fixed number of experts that best reconstruct its original output. Exact subset search is combinatorial and becomes intractable for modern MoE models with many experts per layer. We develop OptEP, a scalable continuous relaxation that directly optimizes differentiable expert-selection variables, followed by a lightweight reconstruction-based update of the retained expert weights. Across multiple MoE architectures and tasks spanning mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approach improves over the strongest existing expert-pruning baselines, with absolute accuracy gains of up to 15.05% on Qwen3-30B-A3B, 14.55% on Qwen3-235B-A22B, 11.06% on GLM-4.5-Air, and 16.20% on Mixtral-8x7B.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper finds that composing tasks reduces per-task reasoning tokens and increases errors, then uses task fragility to reduce token use while preserving accuracy. This directly advances understanding of compositional generalization and reasoning allocation; the budgeting result is relevant to computational allocation, but does not establish a broader systems mechanism.

    论文发现，组合任务会减少分配给每项任务的推理 token，并增加错误；随后利用任务脆弱性，在保持准确率的同时减少 token 用量。这直接推进了对组合泛化和推理分配的理解；预算分配结果与计算资源分配相关，但未确立更广泛的系统机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Modern language models are increasingly asked to handle several tasks within a single prompt. Doing so requires solving each task correctly while integrating the resulting answers into a coherent response. In this paper, we identify a fundamental limitation in this process, where models make substantially more errors when tasks are composed, even when they can solve every constituent task reliably in isolation. This degradation cannot be fully explained by the accumulation of independent errors. Across both open-weight models and the frontier model Claude Opus 5, our findings instead point to an implicit thinking budget underlying this effect. In particular, under composition, models use substantially fewer tokens per task than in isolation, even when the full sequence remains well within the context window. Tasks that require longer solution traces in isolation are consequently more $\textit{fragile}$ under composition, i.e., models make more errors on prompts containing these tasks. In isolation, non-fragile tasks receive more reasoning than they need and waste compute. However, by grouping tasks according to their fragility, the implicit budgeting can be manipulated to reduce token usage by $43$\% across a range of math and linguistic tasks while also preserving accuracy.

    中文

    现代语言模型越来越常被要求在单个提示中处理多个任务。这样做需要正确解决每个任务，同时将所得答案整合为连贯的回复。本文指出这一过程存在一项根本局限：即使模型能够可靠地单独解决每个组成任务，在任务组合时也会出现多得多的错误。这种性能下降无法完全用独立错误的累积来解释。我们在开放权重模型和前沿模型 Claude Opus 5 上的发现表明，这种效应背后存在隐式思考预算。具体而言，在任务组合时，即使整个序列仍远未达到上下文窗口上限，模型分配给每项任务的 token 也显著少于单独处理时。单独处理时需要较长解题轨迹的任务，在组合情形下因而更 $\textit{fragile}$脆弱，也就是说，包含这些任务的提示会让模型犯下更多错误。单独处理时，非脆弱任务得到的推理超过所需，造成计算浪费。然而，按任务脆弱性对任务分组，可以操控隐式预算分配，使数学和语言任务中的 token 用量减少 $43$\%，同时保持准确率。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly operate across culturally diverse settings, yet existing evaluations largely measure cultural behavior at the output level. We introduce CultureLens, a reference-grounded benchmark and mechanistic study of how LLMs use cultural information. CultureLens contains 9,261 scenarios across 75 countries and systematically varies country, value, true-norm, and contradictory-norm evidence. Across Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-3-12B, and Qwen-3.5-27B, stating a contradictory norm lowers aligned answers by 32-47 percentage points, even when the model answers correctly from the country alone. Mechanistically, models default to Anglophone norms when no country is given. The failure under a contradictory norm is not one of missing knowledge, as blocking the norm inside the model restores the correct answer in most cases. Models accept a stated norm according to how it is presented and not whether it is true, which leaves them most exposed to errors in retrieved content. Supervised fine-tuning with contradictory-norm examples raises aligned answers under a contradictory norm to 85-93%, including on unseen countries, at a small cost under a true norm.

    大语言模型（LLM）日益应用于文化多样的环境，但现有评估大多只衡量输出层面的文化行为。我们推出 CultureLens，这是一项基于参照的基准和机制研究，旨在探究 LLM 如何使用文化信息。CultureLens 包含来自 75 个国家的 9,261 个场景，并系统地改变国家、价值观、真实规范和矛盾规范等证据。在 Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-3-12B 和 Qwen-3.5-27B 上，即使模型仅凭国家信息就能正确作答，给出矛盾规范仍会使符合文化的答案减少 32–47 个百分点。从机制角度看，当未给出国家信息时，模型默认采用英语文化圈的规范。矛盾规范导致的失误并非源于知识缺失，因为阻断模型内部的该规范后，在大多数情况下都能恢复正确答案。模型是否接受给出的规范，取决于规范的呈现方式，而非其是否真实；这使模型最容易受到检索内容错误的影响。使用矛盾规范样例进行监督微调后，在矛盾规范条件下符合文化的答案比例升至 85–93%，并且对未见过的国家也有效，而在真实规范条件下仅付出很小的代价。

    LSA-PAST：用于组合式增量学习的层特定适配与原型传输

    Kyle Stein, Andrew Arash Mahyari, Guillermo Francia III, Eman El-Sheikh, Jiangpeng He

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The method targets incremental learning of state-object compositions, using specialized adapters and transported prototypes to reduce representation drift across tasks. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to compositional learning, while the representation changes are not analyzed mechanistically and the work does not center on reasoning or general model-system design.

    该方法针对状态—物体组合的增量学习，使用专门化适配器和传输后的原型来减少跨任务的表征漂移。这是对组合学习的重要算法贡献，但没有从机制层面分析表征变化，且工作重点并非推理或通用模型系统设计。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) enables models to recognize new classes over time while retaining prior knowledge, but many real-world problems are compositional, where visual concepts arise from combinations of primitives such as states (i.e., red, shiny) and objects (i.e., shoe, car). Standard CIL methods treat each composition as an independent class, ignoring shared primitives and providing no mechanism to stabilize their representations as new compositions arrive. This causes parameter updates to entangle primitives and induce drift that degrades performance on earlier compositions. Compositional Incremental Learning (composition-IL) formalizes this setting by introducing new state-object compositions across tasks. In this paper, we propose Layer-Specific Adaptation with Prototype-Anchored Adapter-Space Transport (LSA-PAST), a parameter-efficient method tailored to composition-IL. LSA integrates Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) into a frozen ViT with depth-specialized adapters for states, objects, and compositions. PAST then maps past, anchored prototypes into the current adapter space through a rehearsal-free affine transform fit on current-task data, enabling old prototypes to remain compatible with new adapters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LSA-PAST achieves state-of-the-art (SOA) accuracy-forgetting trade-off performance for composition-IL.

    中文

    类增量学习（CIL）使模型能够随时间识别新类别，同时保留先前知识，但许多现实问题具有组合性，其中视觉概念由状态（即红色、闪亮）和物体（即鞋、汽车）等基元组合而成。标准 CIL 方法将每种组合视为一个独立类别，忽略共享基元，也没有机制在新组合出现时稳定其表征。这会导致参数更新将基元纠缠在一起并引发漂移，从而降低模型在较早组合上的性能。组合式增量学习（composition-IL）通过在不同任务中引入新的状态—物体组合，对这一设置进行形式化。本文提出层特定适配与原型锚定的适配器空间传输（LSA-PAST），这是一种专为 composition-IL 设计的参数高效方法。LSA 将低秩适配（LoRA）集成到冻结的 ViT 中，并为状态、物体和组合配备按深度专门化的适配器。随后，PAST 通过在当前任务数据上拟合的、无需重放的仿射变换，将过去的锚定原型映射到当前适配器空间，使旧原型仍能与新适配器兼容。大量实验表明，LSA-PAST 在 composition-IL 上实现了最先进（SOA）的准确率—遗忘权衡表现。
