    AutoRedClaw：面向 Claw 式智能体的自动化红队测试

    Hao Li, Tongyan Hu, Weidi Luo, Shanghao Shi, Xiaogeng Liu, Aiden Suh, Yulong Cao, Ning Zhang, William Yeoh, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik, Chaowei Xiao

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AutoRedClaw contributes an automated attack-generation and evaluation framework for persistent agents, including exploration over risk areas and a benchmark. Its agent and memory context is relevant to Systems, but the focus is security evaluation rather than agent architecture or memory mechanisms; composition and reasoning are incidental.

    AutoRedClaw 提出一种面向持久化智能体的自动攻击生成与评估框架，包含对风险领域的探索和一个基准。其智能体和记忆背景与系统方向相关，但重点是安全评估，而非智能体架构或记忆机制；组合和推理只是附带涉及。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agent systems are shifting from task-scoped tool-use agents to persistent, personalized assistants such as OpenClaw. These claw-style agents maintain configuration files (e.g., AGENTS.md), long-term memory, and reusable skills. Once poisoned, this persistent state is repeatedly reloaded into the agent's context, creating persistent threats across tasks and sessions. Existing security evaluation systems struggle to evaluate these complex claw-style systems since they rely heavily on manually constructed test cases and environments, which limits their scale and coverage; in addition, these manually designed cases quickly become outdated as agents evolve, and their evaluation settings leave a gap with how claw-style agents are deployed in practice. To address this, we introduce AutoRedClaw, an automated red-teaming framework that generates end-to-end attacks together with the environments needed to execute them. AutoRedClaw combines a strict quality-checking protocol with execution-based validation to ensure the correctness, realism, and effectiveness of generated samples, and adopts task-driven environment construction to keep costs low. To achieve broad coverage, it organizes generation along risk categories, attack strategies, attack stages, and attack surfaces, and uses experience-guided exploration to steer generation toward under-explored regions. AutoRedClaw achieves an effective attack rate above 30% at less than $0.10 per successful sample. From its outputs, we construct RedClaw-Bench, a 330-case benchmark that yields substantially higher attack success rates (ASRs) than AgentDojo, AgentDyn, and DTap. Across seven harnesses and four frontier models, most agent systems exceed 50% ASR, showing that our red-teaming pipeline provides a strong evaluation signal even for the most advanced agent systems. Our code and benchmark are released at https://github.com/SaFo-Lab/AutoRedClaw.

    中文

    智能体系统正从针对特定任务的工具使用型智能体，转向 OpenClaw 等持久化、个性化的助手。这类 claw 式智能体会维护配置文件（例如 AGENTS.md）、长期记忆和可复用技能。一旦这些持久状态遭到投毒，就会在每次重新加载到智能体上下文时反复生效，从而在多个任务和会话中造成持续威胁。现有安全评估系统难以评估这类复杂的 claw 式系统，因为它们严重依赖人工构建的测试用例和环境，限制了规模和覆盖范围；此外，随着智能体不断演进，这些人工设计的用例很快就会过时，其评估设置也与 claw 式智能体的实际部署方式存在差距。为解决这一问题，我们推出 AutoRedClaw，这是一个自动化红队测试框架，可生成端到端攻击以及执行攻击所需的环境。AutoRedClaw 将严格的质量检查流程与基于执行的验证相结合，以确保生成样本的正确性、真实性和有效性，并采用任务驱动的环境构建方式来降低成本。为实现广泛覆盖，它沿着风险类别、攻击策略、攻击阶段和攻击面组织生成过程，并使用经验引导的探索，将生成方向引向探索不足的区域。AutoRedClaw 的有效攻击率超过 30%，每个成功样本的成本低于 $0.10。基于其输出，我们构建了包含 330 个案例的基准 RedClaw-Bench，其攻击成功率（ASR）显著高于 AgentDojo、AgentDyn 和 DTap。在七种测试框架和四个前沿模型上，大多数智能体系统的 ASR 超过 50%，表明我们的红队测试流程即使针对最先进的智能体系统，也能提供强有力的评估信号。我们的代码和基准已发布于 https://github.com/SaFo-Lab/AutoRedClaw。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper evaluates the reliability and downstream value of LLM-generated reasoning graphs, finding that graph errors impair uncertainty estimation while gold graphs enable answer separation and node-level diagnosis. This is a substantial evaluation of reasoning structures, but it does not explain internal model mechanisms or study compositional generalization.

    本文评估 LLM 生成的推理图的可靠性及其下游价值，发现图错误会损害不确定性估计，而金标准图能够区分答案并支持节点级诊断。这是对推理结构的重要评估，但没有解释模型内部机制，也没有研究组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reasoning structures (e.g., chains and graphs) are increasingly used for probabilistic inference, factuality verification, and uncertainty estimation, but their structural reliability is rarely evaluated directly. We test whether this reliability holds through a proposed two-stage diagnostic evaluation in open-ended multi-hop QA. Stage 1 tests different capabilities required to construct reasoning graphs, showing that graph reliability varies with topology, prompt design, and model family. Stage 2 uses uncertainty estimation as a downstream test case. Generated-edge experiments show that graph-based computation is sensitive to upstream graph errors, with performance dropping relative to the gold-graph setting. Gold-graph experiments further show that graph structure provides little benefit when used only as prompt context, but improves the separation of correct from incorrect answers by confidence score and enables node-level diagnostics.

    The paper compares pattern and vulnerability information in code-model representations, finding vulnerability is more accessible as a relational ranking signal than as a linearly separable label.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models can detect vulnerable code, yet the form of vulnerability encoding in their representations remains unclear. We analyze 8 code models spanning 6.7B-15B parameters on C programs using three datasets (DELTASECOMMITS, SVEN, and PRECISE-BUGS), comparing two diagnostic tasks on the same representations: identifying what patterns the code instantiates, and determining whether it is vulnerable. Models encode the first with high fidelity. Under the studied paired C-code datasets and linear-probing setup, vulnerability information is more accessible as a paired relational signal-whether code A is riskier than code B-than as a globally separable categorical label. This structural difference has implications for classification: the model reliably ranks which code is riskier but standard classifiers on isolated samples achieve limited accuracy because vulnerable and secure samples form overlapping distributions in representation space.

    VPFlow: Value-Predictive Planning with Imperfect World Models for Offline Goal Reaching

    VPFlow：利用不完美世界模型进行离线目标到达的价值预测规划

    Yunzhe Hu, Dong Xu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    VPFlow’s main contribution is planning with world models trained to predict goal-reaching value, showing that accurate state prediction is unnecessary for offline goal reaching. This provides substantial insight into planning and test-time computation (Reasoning 4); its learned representations are value-oriented but the abstract does not investigate internal mechanisms or representation geometry (MechInterp 3), and system design is secondary (Systems 3).

    VPFlow 的主要贡献是使用经过目标到达价值预测训练的世界模型进行规划，并表明离线目标到达不需要准确的状态预测。这对规划和测试时计算（Reasoning 4）提供了重要洞见；其学习到的表征以价值为导向，但摘要没有研究内部机制或表征几何（MechInterp 3），系统设计则居于次要地位（Systems 3）。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning enables skill acquisition by reaching any goal from any state without dense rewards. Model-based methods allow for planning by scaling test-time compute to solve complex tasks. Combining both holds appealing promise for pre-training on suboptimal demonstrations and zero-shot adaptation via goal specification and planning. Yet existing methods assume effective planning requires accurate next-state prediction in pixel or latent space. In this work, we show that value prediction is more useful for planning, whereas accurate state prediction is often unnecessary. Our key insight is that offline goal reaching naturally admits a closed-form Monte Carlo return, enabling value regression to replace temporal-difference bootstrapping. We use this return as the sole supervision for latent world models: imagined latents are trained to predict goal-reaching value rather than match future states, implicitly preventing representation collapse. These planning-oriented representations let imperfect world models imagine on the level sets of value field beyond dataset transitions. We then present VPFlow, a value-predictive planner that pairs the world models with a one-step flow policy and plans in its noise space via evolutionary search. It enables policy improvement with imagined generalized advantage and reduces out-of-distribution queries common in action-space planning. On 30 state and pixel OGBench datasets, VPFlow surpasses model-free baselines by at least 30.3 and 10.1 percentage points in success rate, respectively, and outperforms latent planners LeWorldModel, PLDM, and TD-MPC2. It achieves this despite a latent prediction error orders of magnitude larger than with state prediction, while minimizing this error lowers success rate. This demonstrates that value-predictive representations, not exact state prediction, are what offline planning requires.

    中文

    离线目标条件强化学习无需密集奖励，就能通过从任意状态到达任意目标来习得技能。基于模型的方法允许通过增加测试时计算来规划，从而解决复杂任务。二者结合前景可观：可利用次优示范进行预训练，并通过目标指定和规划实现零样本适应。然而，现有方法假设有效规划需要在像素或潜在空间中准确预测下一状态。本文表明，价值预测对规划更有用，而准确的状态预测往往并非必要。我们的关键洞见是，离线目标到达任务天然具有闭式蒙特卡洛回报，因此可以用价值回归取代时序差分自举。我们将这一回报作为潜在世界模型的唯一监督：训练模型预测想象潜变量的目标到达价值，而非匹配未来状态，从而隐式地防止表征坍塌。这些面向规划的表征使不完美的世界模型能够在数据集转移之外，沿价值场的等值面进行想象。随后，我们提出 VPFlow，这是一种价值预测规划器，将世界模型与单步流策略配对，并通过进化搜索在该策略的噪声空间中规划。它利用想象的广义优势来改进策略，并减少动作空间规划中常见的分布外查询。在 30 个状态和像素 OGBench 数据集上，VPFlow 的成功率分别至少超过无模型基线 30.3 和 10.1 个百分点，并优于潜在规划器 LeWorldModel、PLDM 和 TD-MPC2。尽管其潜在预测误差比状态预测高出几个数量级，它仍取得了这些结果；而将该误差最小化反而会降低成功率。这表明离线规划所需的是价值预测表征，而非精确的状态预测。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TEX’s main contribution is a multi-agent test-time scaling framework that uses cross-execution feedback to refine tests and patches for long-horizon software tasks. This strongly advances agent coordination and task execution (Systems 4); the feedback supports problem solving (Reasoning 3), while composition is incidental to combining agents and their outputs (CompGen 2), with no model-mechanism analysis (MechInterp 1).

    TEX 的主要贡献是一个多智能体测试时扩展框架，它利用交叉执行反馈来改进长时程软件任务的测试和补丁。这显著推进了智能体协作与任务执行（Systems 4）；反馈有助于问题求解（Reasoning 3），而组合仅附带涉及智能体及其输出的结合（CompGen 2），没有模型机制分析（MechInterp 1）。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Test-case generation is critical but remains challenging for language models. Existing test-time scaling methods either isolate candidates or aggregate traces, which do not scale to long-horizon tasks. We present TEX, a collaborative test-time scaling framework based on execution-driven cross-validation. TEX parallelizes agents to generate tests and patches, cross-executing each test against every patch to form a $K \times K$ feedback matrix. Agents use their matrix slices for refinement, enabling objective validation without verbose trace sharing. On SWT-Bench Verified, TEX achieves 86.4%, establishing a new state-of-the-art and improving +9.0% over single-agent baselines. Moreover, even random selection from TEX outputs (84.4%) surpasses the previous SOTA (84.0%), showing collaborative execution feedback improves solution quality, not just best-case samples. Our results highlight execution-grounded feedback as an effective scaling mechanism for long-horizon agentic tasks.

    中文

    测试用例生成至关重要，但对语言模型而言仍然很有挑战。现有测试时扩展方法要么孤立地处理候选项，要么聚合轨迹，这些方法无法扩展到长时程任务。我们提出 TEX，这是一种基于执行驱动交叉验证的协作式测试时扩展框架。TEX 并行安排多个智能体生成测试和补丁，并将每个测试与每个补丁交叉执行，形成一个$K \times K$反馈矩阵。智能体利用矩阵中对应的切片进行改进，无需冗长地共享轨迹即可实现客观验证。在 SWT-Bench Verified 上，TEX 达到 86.4%，创下新的最先进水平，比单智能体基线提升 +9.0%。此外，即使从 TEX 输出中随机选择，结果（84.4%）也超过了先前的 SOTA（84.0%），表明协作式执行反馈提升的是解的质量，而不只是最佳样本。我们的结果凸显了以执行为依据的反馈是长时程智能体任务的一种有效扩展机制。

    Junwei Yao, Yongxi Zhou, Zike Yang, Zhijun Wang, Jianan Liu, Yanxian Chen, Wenbo Ye

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper evaluates whether context-compaction methods preserve evidence for later questions and tool calls, finding that rankings depend on task and evidence retention. This is a substantial empirical contribution about agent memory and context management, while its question answering and tool-use settings alone provide only incidental links to reasoning and composition.

    本文评估上下文压缩方法能否为后续问题和工具调用保留证据，发现方法排名取决于任务和证据保留情况。这是关于智能体记忆与上下文管理的重要实证贡献；其问答和工具使用场景与推理和组合的联系仅属附带。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language-model agents compact their context for the question at hand, but the compacted context must also serve questions that come later. We evaluate compaction on these later questions, using four corpora that annotate the evidence of several questions per text and recorded agent trajectories, and compare every method with random deletion at the same budget. On MultiRC, keeping the sentences that gpt-6-luna (through the OpenAI Decisions API) judges necessary for the current question raises its accuracy on that question by 11.4 points at 25% of the tokens. On the later questions, however, no method that selects sentences for the current question does detectably better than deleting sentences at random. Deleting words instead of sentences does better: LLMLingua-2, which ignores the question, beats random sentence deletion at the same token count by 12.5 points on the later MultiRC questions. It keeps about twice random deletion's share of the evidence's content words, and at equal content-word retention its gain shrinks to 7.3 points (exploratory). On FEVER, label accuracy can overstate what the kept text supports: the gain of sentence selection is no longer detected when answers are scored against the kept evidence, and the 21.0-point gain of LLMLingua-2 is not shown to rest on the kept text. The ranking also depends on the setting: on Evidence Inference sentence selection beats LLMLingua-2 at a nominal 25% budget, and on $\tau$-bench trajectories, whose later tool calls need exact identifiers, it beats random deletion while LLMLingua-2 shows no detected gain. Scores on the question a compaction was made for do not reliably show how it serves later ones.

    中文

    语言模型智能体会针对当前问题压缩上下文，但压缩后的上下文还必须能服务后续问题。我们使用四个语料库评估压缩对这些后续问题的效果，这些语料库标注了每段文本中多个问题所需的证据，并记录了智能体轨迹；同时在相同预算下将每种方法与随机删除进行比较。在 MultiRC 上，保留 gpt-6-luna（通过 OpenAI Decisions API）判定为当前问题所必需的句子，在 token 占比为 25% 时，可使模型在该问题上的准确率提高 11.4 个百分点。然而，对于后续问题，选择当前问题相关句子的方法没有一种表现出可检测的优势，超过随机删除句子。删除词语而非句子效果更好：忽略问题的 LLMLingua-2，在相同 token 数下处理 MultiRC 后续问题时，比随机删除句子高 12.5 个百分点。它保留的证据内容词占比约为随机删除的两倍；在内容词保留量相同的情况下，其提升缩小到 7.3 个百分点（探索性结果）。在 FEVER 上，标签准确率可能会夸大保留文本所能支持的结论：当依据保留证据对答案评分时，句子选择的提升不再可检测；也没有证据表明 LLMLingua-2 的 21.0 个百分点提升基于保留文本。方法排名也取决于设置：在 Evidence Inference 上，名义预算为 25% 时，句子选择优于 LLMLingua-2；而在$\tau$基准的轨迹中，后续工具调用需要精确标识符，句子选择优于随机删除，LLMLingua-2 则未显示出可检测的提升。针对进行压缩时所面对的问题取得的分数，不能可靠地反映压缩结果对后续问题的帮助程度。

    Physics-Inspired Optimizers beyond the Edge of Stability: Period-Two Orbits and Delayed Instability

    超越稳定性边界的物理启发优化器：周期二轨道与延迟失稳

    Alexander Itin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops stability theory for momentum-based optimizers beyond the edge of stability and tests predictions in controlled networks, directly advancing understanding of training dynamics relevant to capability development. Its optimizer analysis is algorithmic, but does not address model internals, composition, or model and agent system organization.

    本文建立了动量优化器在稳定性边界之外的稳定性理论，并在受控网络中检验预测，直接推进了对与能力发展相关的训练动力学的理解。其优化器分析属于算法研究，但没有涉及模型内部机制、组合性或模型与智能体系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Gradient descent with momentum can be viewed as a particle moving with friction in the loss landscape. In deep learning the learning rate is usually large, so training is a discrete dynamical system: in many full-batch experiments the sharpness grows to the optimizer's stability limit, the edge of stability (EoS), and training continues there. Physics-inspired optimizers change this motion; Velocity-Regularized Adam (VRAdam), for example, shrinks the step at high speed. We study kinetic maps, in which the step is the gradient of a kinetic energy of the momentum, and ask what they do beyond the EoS. (i) In a reduced model, a kinetic map creates a symmetric period-two orbit beyond the edge, strictly linearly stable if and only if the map's elasticity (the log-log slope of step length versus momentum) lies between 0 and 1; on it, training sits at an effective edge of stability. VRAdam's damper fails above twice the critical learning rate, where its kinetic energy is not convex; the Legendre dual of VRAdam's own Lagrangian is convex and passes at every learning rate. (ii) Because the sharpness rises gradually, the loss of stability is delayed, as in Neishtadt's theory of slowly swept bifurcations. In a network with a controlled sweep, the dynamics match this theory without fitted parameters, including the memory of where the sweep started and its erasure by noise. (iii) With momentum, reaching the oscillation also requires elasticity at large momentum: maps that bound the step have competing period-four and chaotic attractors already at beta1 = 0.9, while the cubic-Legendre map reached the oscillation from every sampled start up to beta1 = 0.99. Experiments on an exact quadratic problem, a full-batch MLP and ResNet-32 support the theory; on ResNet-18, much of the apparent benefit of the maps is reproduced by matching the effective learning rate.

    中文

    带动量的梯度下降可以看作一个在损失景观中受摩擦作用运动的粒子。在深度学习中，学习率通常较大，因此训练是一个离散动力系统：在许多全批量实验中，尖锐度会增长到优化器的稳定性极限，即稳定性边界（EoS），而训练会在此处继续进行。受物理启发的优化器会改变这种运动；例如，速度正则化 Adam（VRAdam）会在速度较高时缩小步长。我们研究动能映射，其中步长是动量动能的梯度，并考察它们在 EoS 之外的表现。(i) 在一个约化模型中，动能映射会在稳定性边界之外形成对称的周期二轨道；当且仅当映射的弹性（步长相对于动量的双对数斜率）介于 0 和 1 之间时，该轨道才严格线性稳定；在该轨道上，训练处于一个有效的稳定性边界。VRAdam 的阻尼器在超过临界学习率两倍后会失效，此时其动能不再是凸函数；而 VRAdam 自身拉格朗日量的 Legendre 对偶是凸函数，且在所有学习率下都能通过检验。(ii) 由于尖锐度逐渐上升，失稳会延迟发生，这与 Neishtadt 的缓慢扫过分岔理论一致。在具有受控扫过过程的网络中，动力学与该理论相符，无需拟合参数，包括对扫过起点的记忆及其被噪声抹除的现象。(iii) 有动量时，要达到振荡还需要在大动量下具有弹性：当 beta1 = 0.9 时，限制步长的映射已经存在相互竞争的周期四和混沌吸引子；而 cubic-Legendre 映射从所有采样的起点出发，直到 beta1 = 0.99 都能达到振荡。在精确二次问题、全批量 MLP 和 ResNet-32 上的实验支持了该理论；在 ResNet-18 上，通过匹配有效学习率即可复现映射的大部分表观优势。

    ENGLISH

    Vision-language models (VLMs) can infer sensitive information such as geolocation from subtle visual cues, creating privacy risks when responses disclose more detail than the visual context warrants. We study visual-contextual privacy in geolocation disclosure, where a VLM should reveal location information only at the granularity appropriate to the visual context depicted in the image. We first show that this contextually appropriate granularity is recoverable from pre-generation hidden states, even when generated responses are misaligned, with disclosure levels exhibiting an ordered structure along a common hidden-state direction. Motivated by this, we propose an inference-time route-and-steer framework: an ordinal granularity router maps visual-contextual privacy representations to a disclosure route, and a disclosure-level-conditioned steering module applies route-specific hidden-state interventions during decoding. Across four VLM backbones, our method improves visual-context-aware disclosure alignment, better balances over- and under-disclosure, and incurs only modest changes on general capability benchmarks. It further transfers to another dataset with a distinct data distribution and privacy-risk taxonomy.

    Yuqing Yang, Yurong Liu, Deqing Fu, Manav Garg, Sravan Babu Bodapati, Fatma Ozcan, Alon Y. Halevy, Jiani Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TEAL evolves reusable tools and usage skills from agent trajectories and data, improving analytics under step budgets; this substantially advances agent tool systems. Reuse across tasks has a compositional aspect, but the abstract does not establish systematic composition or generalization, and the application results alone do not show a reasoning-mechanism contribution.

    TEAL 根据智能体执行轨迹和数据演化可复用工具及其使用技能，并提升了步数预算下的分析表现；这对智能体工具系统作出了实质性推进。跨任务复用具有组合性的一面，但摘要并未证明系统化的组合或泛化，单凭应用结果也无法表明其对推理机制有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Coding agents can answer analytical questions over a data lake by discovering, cleaning, and joining the relevant data. However, they discard this work after each question and redo it from scratch for the next one. Tool evolution, which automatically builds and refines reusable tools across tasks, is a natural fit for this repetition. Since a ground-truth label for a data-lake question requires an expert to solve it first, we consider the unsupervised setting. We propose TEAL (Tool Evolution for Analytics over data Lakes), which evolves a library of tools and usage skills for a given Worker agent without labels. Two agents propose tools from complementary evidence, an Explorer from the data lake itself and a Critic from Worker trajectories. A proposed change is kept only if the Worker adopts the tool on a rerun without extra steps and any changed answer is supported by trajectory evidence. We also introduce TEAL-Q, which generates synthetic questions for tool evolution when real ones are unavailable. We evaluate on KramaBench and LakeQA with four Worker LLMs under step budgets, which cap the number of steps the Worker may take per question. With a tight budget of 10 or 15 steps, TEAL improves every Worker on both benchmarks, lifting Sonnet-5 at 15 steps by 9.3 points on KramaBench and 21.7 points on LakeQA. A tighter budget also yields better feedback for evolution. For example, Sonnet-5's LakeQA library evolved at 20 steps and deployed unchanged at 30 steps scores 68.3, above both the baseline (59.6) and a library evolved directly at 30 steps (64.2). Additionally, a library evolved on synthetic questions performs comparably to one evolved on real questions. These results show that useful tools can be evolved without labels, and hopefully inspire future work on what to evolve and how to obtain feedback in unsupervised agent evolution.

    编码智能体可以通过发现、清理和连接相关数据，回答数据湖上的分析问题。然而，它们会在每个问题之后丢弃这项工作，并在下一个问题上从头重做。工具演化能够跨任务自动构建并改进可复用工具，很适合应对这种重复。由于数据湖问题的真实标签需要专家先行求解，我们研究无监督设置。我们提出 TEAL（面向数据湖分析的工具演化），它能在没有标签的情况下，为给定的 Worker 智能体演化工具和使用技能库。两个智能体依据互补证据提出工具：Explorer 从数据湖本身获取证据，Critic 则从 Worker 的执行轨迹中获取证据。只有在重新运行时 Worker 无需额外步骤便采用了该工具，且任何答案变化都有执行轨迹证据支持，才会保留提议的改动。我们还提出 TEAL-Q，在没有真实问题时生成用于工具演化的合成问题。我们在 KramaBench 和 LakeQA 上使用四种 Worker LLM 进行评估，并设置步数预算，即限制 Worker 针对每个问题可执行的步骤数。在 10 步或 15 步的严格预算下，TEAL 在两个基准上都提升了每一种 Worker 的表现；在 15 步时，Sonnet-5 在 KramaBench 上提升了 9.3 分，在 LakeQA 上提升了 21.7 分。更严格的预算也会为演化提供更好的反馈。例如，Sonnet-5 的 LakeQA 工具库在 20 步预算下演化，并在 30 步预算下原样部署，得分为 68.3，高于基线（59.6），也高于直接在 30 步预算下演化的工具库（64.2）。此外，基于合成问题演化出的工具库，表现与基于真实问题演化出的工具库相当。这些结果表明，无需标签也能演化出有用工具，并有望启发未来研究无监督智能体演化中应演化什么以及如何获取反馈。

    建模真实研究轨迹：研究构思的图视角

    Ruochen Li, Zhiyu Chen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The Research Progress Graph represents idea development as states linked by evidence-backed reasoning, and the paper uses it to motivate trajectory-based agent design, evaluation, and training. It substantially addresses reasoning processes and research-agent organization, while its compositional connection is limited to structuring transitions rather than advancing composition itself.

    研究进展图将想法的发展表示为由证据支持的推理连接起来的状态；论文据此提出了基于轨迹的智能体设计、评估和训练思路。它实质性地涉及推理过程和研究智能体组织方式；与组合性的联系则局限于对转换进行结构化，并未推进组合本身。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The research idea in a published paper is rarely the project's initial idea. Between the two lies a closed-loop process in which researchers run experiments, derive insights, identify challenges, explore the literature, and revise the idea, with each step motivated by evidence and reasoning they can articulate. We call the path one idea takes through this process, with the evidence and reasoning behind each step, its authentic research trajectory. Although it underlies every scientific contribution, it is rarely recorded. Existing LLM-based research agents generate an idea once, refine it against reviews, literature, or their own experimental results, or search over candidate ideas and experiments. In all of them the text of the idea evolves, while the evidence and reasoning that connected one version to the next are discarded. We propose the Research Progress Graph (RPG), a representation of authentic and complete research trajectories. An RPG records the evolution of an idea as typed research states connected by cognitive transitions, each annotated with a temporal index and the reasoning behind it, which makes this evolution an explicit object of study. We ground the representation in authentic trajectories whose steps their authors justify in annotations and papers. Comparing the representations of thirty-five research agents with the RPG, we find that each is an incomplete RPG; none keeps the state that changed, the evidence that changed it, and the reasoning connecting them as one evolving record. Modeling ideation with the RPG changes how research agents should be designed, evaluated, and trained. Agents predict the next research state instead of a complete idea, ideas are evaluated as trajectories instead of final texts, and authentic trajectories serve as training data. These directions shift research agents from generating static ideas to modeling how ideas evolve.

    中文

    已发表论文中的研究想法很少是项目最初的想法。在两者之间，存在一个闭环过程：研究者进行实验、推导见解、识别挑战、探索文献并修订想法，每一步都有他们能够阐明的证据和推理作为依据。我们将一个想法经历这一过程的路径，以及每一步背后的证据和推理，称为该想法的真实研究轨迹。尽管真实研究轨迹是每项科学贡献的基础，却很少被记录。现有基于 LLM 的研究智能体会生成一次想法，再依据评审意见、文献或自身实验结果对其加以改进，或者搜索候选想法和实验。在所有这些方法中，想法的文本会不断演变，但连接前后版本的证据和推理却被丢弃。我们提出研究进展图（RPG），用以表征真实且完整的研究轨迹。RPG 将想法的演变记录为由认知转换连接的、有类型的研究状态；每个状态都标注时间索引及其背后的推理，从而使这种演变成为一个明确的研究对象。我们以真实轨迹为表征依据，其中每一步均由作者在注释和论文中给出理由。将 35 种研究智能体的表征与 RPG 进行比较后，我们发现每种表征都是不完整的 RPG；没有一种能将发生变化的状态、促使其变化的证据以及连接两者的推理，保留为一份持续演变的记录。用 RPG 建模研究构思，会改变研究智能体的设计、评估和训练方式。智能体预测下一个研究状态，而不是完整的想法；想法以轨迹而非最终文本为单位进行评估；真实轨迹则作为训练数据。这些方向将研究智能体从生成静态想法，转向建模想法如何演变。

    预测闭包：对 JEPA 特征选择的集合层面刻画

    Mosh Levy, Aly Lidayan, Yoav Goldberg

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper characterizes how feature relationships shape JEPA representation selection and tests interventions that indirectly strengthen related features, providing substantial insight into learned representations. Feature-set interactions connect to composition, but the contribution focuses on predictive representation formation rather than compositional generalization; reasoning and systems are not central.

    论文刻画了特征间关系如何影响 JEPA 的表征选择，并检验了能够间接增强相关特征的干预措施，从而为理解学习到的表征提供了实质性见解。特征集合之间的相互作用与组合有关，但论文的贡献侧重于预测性表征的形成，而非组合泛化；推理和系统并非其核心。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA), an encoder and a predictor are trained together to produce a representation that minimizes the error in predicting the representation of the next observation. Because the representations of both the current and the next observation are learned, it is unclear which features they will include. Earlier characterizations describe the features JEPA selects in terms of their individual predictability, raising the concern that unpredictable features, like a traffic light, will not be encoded into the representation. However, the prediction error is also affected by the relationships between features, e.g., the light's color helps predict whether the traffic will stop. We propose the predictive closure characterization, which accounts for these relationships. Based on a reformulation of the JEPA training objective, we show that selection depends on properties of feature sets. This view agrees with earlier works when features evolve independently, but makes new predictions when they do not, for instance that a feature like the traffic light can still be retained. We test this characterization in controlled experiments, which show that unpredictable features can become better represented when they help predict other features, and that changing one feature's predictive relationships can affect how well others are represented. We also demonstrate implications for steering feature selection: targeting one feature with an auxiliary objective, or supplying it to the predictor as side information, can strengthen the representation of another feature whose future values it helps predict, so steering can be indirect.

    中文

    在联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）中，编码器和预测器共同训练，生成一种能够尽量减小对下一次观测表征进行预测时误差的表征。由于当前观测和下一次观测的表征都是学习得到的，因此无法确定它们会包含哪些特征。先前的刻画依据特征各自的可预测性来描述 JEPA 所选择的特征，因此引发了这样的担忧：交通信号灯这类不可预测的特征不会被编码进表征中。然而，预测误差还会受到特征间关系的影响；例如，信号灯的颜色有助于预测交通是否会停止。我们提出预测闭包这一刻画方式，以纳入这些关系。基于对 JEPA 训练目标的重新表述，我们表明，特征选择取决于特征集合的性质。当特征独立演变时，这一观点与早期研究一致；当它们并非独立演变时，则会给出新的预测，例如交通信号灯这样的特征仍可能被保留。我们通过受控实验检验这一刻画，结果显示，当不可预测的特征有助于预测其他特征时，它们可以得到更好的表征；改变一个特征的预测关系，也会影响其他特征的表征效果。我们还展示了这种刻画对引导特征选择的启示：通过辅助目标针对某个特征，或将其作为旁信息提供给预测器，可以增强另一个特征的表征，而该另一个特征的未来取值可由前者帮助预测，因此引导作用可以是间接的。

    Shreyas Kulkarni, Uttam Gurram, Madhav Kanda, Krishna Teja Chitty Venkata, Shichu Chen, Kartik Balasubramaniam, Supriyo Chakraborty, Sambit Sahu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DStill distills multi-step refinement trajectories into one-pass speculative drafts, improving decoding speed and acceptance length. Reasoning benchmarks are an evaluation context, while the contribution is chiefly an inference algorithm rather than a reasoning mechanism.

    DStill 将多步细化轨迹蒸馏为单次处理的推测草稿，提升了解码速度和接受长度。推理基准只是评估场景，而其贡献主要是一种推理算法，并非推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Block-diffusion speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel. However, one-step drafting in discrete diffusion is limited by token factorization error: each token is predicted from the same masked block, without conditioning on the tokens selected at other positions in that step. This can produce inconsistent drafts and reduce acceptance length. Iterative refinement mitigates this limitation by conditioning later predictions on previously committed tokens, though additional passes increase drafting cost. To address this trade-off between draft fidelity and inference latency, we introduce DStill, a two-stage framework that distills a target-conditioned drafter's own multi-step refinement into one-step drafting. We first train the drafter to complete partially revealed blocks, then use its refinement trajectories to train a student to predict the final completion in one pass. Using a curriculum that gradually transitions from partial to fully masked inputs, we successfully transfer the multi-step refinement capabilities into one step. Across reasoning, math, code benchmarks on three model families DStill improves acceptance length by up to 28% and speedup by up to 25% over one-step DFlash, achieving up to 6.45x speedup over auto-regressive decoding.

    块扩散推测解码通过并行草拟多个 token 来加速大语言模型推理。然而，离散扩散中的单步草拟受到 token 因子化误差的限制：每个 token 都根据同一个掩码块进行预测，且在该步骤中不以其他位置所选的 token 为条件。这可能导致草拟结果不一致并缩短接受长度。迭代细化通过让后续预测以先前已确定的 token 为条件来缓解这一限制，但额外的轮次会增加草拟成本。为解决草拟保真度与推理延迟之间的权衡，我们提出 DStill，这是一个两阶段框架，可将目标条件化草拟器自身的多步细化过程蒸馏为单步草拟。我们首先训练草拟器补全部分揭示的块，然后利用其细化轨迹训练学生模型，使其在一次处理中预测最终补全结果。通过逐步从部分掩码输入过渡到完全掩码输入的课程学习，我们成功将多步细化能力迁移到单步中。在三种模型系列的推理、数学和代码基准上，与单步 DFlash 相比，DStill 将接受长度最多提高 28%，加速比最多提高 25%；与自回归解码相比，最高可实现 6.45 倍加速。

    稠密联想记忆的样本高效学习

    Andrew Lucas, Dmitry Krotov

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analytically studies how associative memories learn code-generating constraints and latent representations from few examples, with a thresholding rule that improves sample efficiency. Its structured rule learning supports compositional generalization, but it is a toy model and does not directly study interpretability of modern models or reasoning capability.

    论文以解析方式研究联想记忆如何从少量样本中学会生成码字的约束和潜在表征，并提出能提高样本效率的阈值化规则。其结构化规则学习有助于组合泛化，但它是玩具模型，并未直接研究现代模型的可解释性或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    We analytically study the evolution of the energy function of Dense Associative Memories (DenseAMs) as they train on randomly sampled codewords of random expander low-density parity-check codes (a.k.a. solutions of random XORSAT problems). We identify two distinct regimes and a transition between them, reminiscent of grokking in neural networks. A regime of small training set size is where the model memorizes a few training examples but cannot discover the underlying rules of the entire codeword dictionary generative process. The opposite regime, corresponding to a larger training set size, is where the model has uncovered the sparse constraints that generated the entire data set after seeing only polynomially many patterns. We also design a novel class of DenseAMs with a thresholding learning rule, and show that any amount of thresholding enables the model to perform simplified sparse Hamiltonian learning, which exponentially reduces the number of training examples needed to learn the true underlying data set. In this regime, the model learns how to discover $\exp[\mathrm{O}(n)]$ solutions from only $\mathrm{O}(\log n)$ training samples, which is asymptotically optimal for any learning algorithm. When training on codewords of certain random codes, the model can even learn the underlying code when a small O(1) fraction of bits are latent variables. These latent variables are not shown to the model during learning, but will be discovered by sparsifying observed higher-order correlations. For certain random codes, we show that a simple and conservative algorithm learns a minimal latent representation for the data set. This provides a transparent, physics-motivated, and analytically tractable toy model for how deep latent representations emerge in an associative memory training.

    我们以解析方式研究稠密联想记忆（DenseAMs）的能量函数在使用随机采样的码字进行训练时如何演变；这些码字来自随机扩展低密度奇偶校验码（也称为随机 XORSAT 问题的解）。我们识别出两个不同的区域及其间的转变，这让人联想到神经网络中的 grokking。训练集规模较小时，模型会记住少数训练样本，却无法发现整个码字字典生成过程的底层规则。相反，在训练集规模较大的区域中，模型只需观察多项式数量的模式，就能发现生成整个数据集的稀疏约束。我们还设计了一类采用阈值化学习规则的新型 DenseAM，并证明任何程度的阈值化都能使模型执行简化的稀疏哈密顿量学习，从而以指数级减少学习真实底层数据集所需的训练样本数量。在这一地区，模型学会仅用 $\exp[\mathrm{O}(n)]$ 个训练样本发现 $\mathrm{O}(\log n)$ 个解；对于任何学习算法而言，这在渐近意义上都是最优的。在使用某些随机码的码字进行训练时，即使少量、为 O(1) 比例的比特是潜变量，模型也能学会底层编码。这些潜变量在学习过程中不会展示给模型，但可通过对观测到的高阶相关性进行稀疏化而被发现。对于某些随机码，我们证明，一种简单且保守的算法能够学会该数据集的最小潜在表征。这为理解深层潜在表征如何在联想记忆训练中涌现，提供了一个透明、受物理学启发且便于解析的玩具模型。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

The abstract leaves semantic interpretability and causal faithfulness untested, and does not study composition or reasoning.

    NR-SAE 检验 MoE 路由能否为稀疏字典提供指引；与专家对齐的自编码器优于对照组，因此为理解学习到的表征和稀疏计算提供了实质见解。摘要指出语义可解释性和因果忠实性尚未经过检验，且没有研究组合性或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models already make a sparse choice for every token: which experts should process it. We ask whether a sparse dictionary should reuse that choice. NR-SAE gives each routed expert a small dictionary and opens only those the frozen router selects. At block 15 of Gemma 4 26B-A4B, after ten million C4 training tokens and across three seeds, the expert-aligned autoencoder explains 0.518 of the variance in router-weighted expert outputs on a fixed evaluation capture. A rank-addressed control with the same parameters but sixteen times as many candidates reaches 0.481, a candidate-matched control 0.458, and an architecture-matched control with randomized expert identity 0.387. A transcoder variant also leads all three controls: 0.432, against 0.347, 0.371, and 0.118. Part of this advantage is architectural: each expert writes into a subspace of at most a quarter of the model width, so naming the expert names the subspace. How much it explains, we have not measured. At this layer and budget, the router already knows something a dictionary would otherwise have to learn. Our implementation did not train faster, and semantic interpretability, downstream loss, and causal faithfulness remain untested.

    RiseHarness iteratively improves terminal-agent reliability by analyzing trajectories and runtime traces, adapting harness mechanisms, and evaluating changes across tasks. This makes agent-system design a substantial contribution, while trace analysis and task success do not establish insight into model internals, compositional generalization, or reasoning mechanisms.

    RiseHarness 通过分析轨迹和运行时跟踪信息、调整执行框架机制并跨任务评估改动，迭代提升终端智能体的可靠性。因此，智能体系统设计是其主要贡献；跟踪信息分析和任务成功表现并未揭示模型内部、组合泛化或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon terminal agents may solve a task in one run yet fail across repeated runs. Stochastic errors can propagate through actions and context, creating a gap between capability and reliable execution. We present RiseHarness, a framework for iteratively improving agent harnesses with model weights fixed. It focuses on flipping tasks with both successful and failed runs under the same configuration, using successful runs as references for failure analysis. RiseHarness combines agent trajectories with internal harness traces from a runtime monitor to examine how model actions interact with command execution, feedback, context management, and completion decisions. A Harness Handbook links this evidence to harness behaviors and source code, helping identify recurring problems in mechanisms shared across tasks. RiseHarness then searches other harness frameworks for relevant implementations and adapts them as design references to the current model and execution protocol. Candidate changes undergo behavioral checks and repeated task evaluation; versions with measured gains seed the next iteration. This loop integrates suitable mechanisms from different frameworks into a single harness and uses new execution evidence to guide further changes. We evaluate task success and reliability across models, ablate harness execution evidence and external research, and test transfer to unseen benchmarks with the same model. RiseHarness treats a specific model as the unit of harness adaptation, studying how changes to shared interaction mechanisms can make existing capabilities more reliable across tasks.

    Samkit Jain, Sai Kishan Pampana, Shlok Agarwal

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MLIPS shares candidate KV searches across attention layers while preserving each layer’s scoring, with measured serving speedups and energy savings. It advances sparse computation and inference serving, while recurring KV positions motivate an exploratory working-set characterization rather than a direct study of internal representations.

    MLIPS 在保留各注意力层自身评分机制的同时，共享层间候选 KV 搜索，并实测了服务速度提升和能耗降低。它推进了稀疏计算和推理服务；重复出现的 KV 位置促成了对工作集结构的探索性刻画，但这并非对内部表征的直接研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sparse attention limits the keys used by each query, but finding those keys can still require a full-prefix scan at every layer. We introduce \textbf{MLIPS (Multi-Layer Indexer Pool Sharing)}, a training-free method that shares candidate search while retaining each consumer's own scoring and selection. A producer publishes a top-$M$ pool larger than the attention budget $K$; subsequent layers select their own top-$K$ from that pool. Measurements across three sparse-attention model families show substantially higher coverage from broad pools than overlap between final selections. We implement layerwise sharing, persistent decode reuse, and a coarse producer in vLLM for DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Across four long-context suites, three consumer layers per producer give $1.14$--$1.40\times$ speedups and $14.8$--$27.4\%$ lower GPU energy, with observed accuracy changes of $-1.49$ to $+0.29$ percentage points in single runs. More extensive sharing exposes task-dependent quality losses. Sampled prefill traces also reveal recurring selected KV positions across query groups and layers. We characterize this shared working-set structure and use it to motivate Top-$G$, an exploratory bounded pool construction for prefill. Its deployment, task accuracy, and serving benefits remain open.

    Solving reasoning tasks supported on graphs typically requires providing a Language Reasoning Model (LRM) with a serialized description of the graph. This approach results in the input length growing with the number of edges, which limits the size of the problems that can be solved. Furthermore, even when graphs fit in context, performance sharply decays as the graphs grow. We propose to address this by augmenting LRMs with scalable and permutation equivariant graph positional encodings that modulate attention logits. An additional post-fusion-style module incorporates structural information into hidden states. We compute these positional encodings using a GNN followed by a Graph Transformer. This eliminates the need for serialized adjacencies, reducing the context burden to $O(N)$. We jointly fine-tune the positional encoder and the LRM LoRA adapters using optimal solutions generated by graph-theoretic solvers, resulting in a computationally efficient method. Trained on small graphs, the model exhibits improved size-generalization across graph-theoretic tasks on graphs with up to 1,000 nodes, and produces fewer tokens than a conventional LRM. Additionally, we observe that our model remains robust to node relabelings. Evaluations on graph-theoretic benchmarks also show that performance on small graphs is preserved.

When the controller uses selected internal features, poor performance alone cannot distinguish missing information from limitations of its decision rules or training. We study decision sufficiency: whether the best controller using a representation can match the minimum average loss attainable with full state information, under the same strategies and evaluation criteria. For interfaces with finitely many outputs, we compute the optimal loss exactly and separate the three sources of excess loss. Pairwise checks can miss information loss: states with the same controller input may share an optimal strategy in every pair but not across the whole group. We bound the number of states needed to reveal a conflict and characterize the fewest outputs an unrestricted interface needs to avoid all conflicts. We audit selected features from sparse autoencoders, which encode model activations using relatively few active features, in Qwen2.5, SmolLM2, and Phi.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper defines and measures verifier strength and recoverability to decide which agent self-improvements can run unattended, a substantial contribution to agent-system design. Its references to execution traces and benchmark tasks do not provide substantive interpretability or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文定义并测量验证器强度和可恢复性，以判断哪些智能体自我改进可以在无人值守的情况下运行，这是对智能体系统设计的一项重要贡献。文中提及执行轨迹和基准任务，但没有提供实质性的可解释性或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agent platforms are starting to improve their own agents: they read a deployed agent's execution traces, derive a change, have an automated verifier approve it, and release it with no human author. How much of this loop can safely run without a human? We propose two quantities a platform can measure. Verifier strength $\sigma$ is how well the available verifier -- often an LLM judge -- agrees with a trusted reference verifier; it limits how much a step can improve the agent. Recoverability is how cheaply a bad change can be undone: whether undoing it needs a new verifier approval, and how much of the old behavior a rollback restores. A step should run unattended only if both are adequate. On our platform this rule allows prompt, tool and skill edits to run unattended and keeps weight updates under human sign-off. Our main contribution is these two definitions and how to measure them. We built a platform that applies the rule and tested it in two ways: on the platform's own approval gate, and in controlled experiments on the $\tau^2$-bench agent benchmark. On verifier strength, the platform's LLM judge sometimes gave the same score no matter what it was shown (9 of 37 settings) and reported no error, so a verifier can look healthy while approving anything; its strength must be measured, and two simple tests catch the failure. On recoverability, restoring a saved copy brought the agent back to its original behavior, but a regenerated undo did not, so only changes whose old version is kept can be reversed without a human; and while a change was deployed, it altered the outcome of 17 percent of tasks beyond normal run-to-run variation, which no undo repairs. Together these support the rule: a change can run unattended only when its old version is kept and its verifier's strength has been measured.

    The paper proposes a state-bound runtime assurance architecture that invalidates stale execution allowances and rechecks actions at dispatch, with a scripted replay illustrating its behavior. This substantially concerns agent execution and control, while reasoning is incidental to policy adjudication and the abstract offers no insight into internal model mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Language-model agents increasingly participate in operational workflows where approvals, binds, and payments create commitments. An approval valid when issued may no longer authorize execution after relevant facts, evidence, policy, or authority change. We call this the evaluation--execution gap. We specify a state-bound runtime assurance layer that separates probabilistic measurement from deterministic adjudication, binds an execution allowance to the decision-relevant basis of an approval, invalidates that allowance after relevant logged changes, and rechecks admissibility at dispatch. This distinguishes the continued validity of a prior approval from a current-state policy check. We describe eight failure modes, an assurance model, a reference architecture, and prospective interventions with retrospective remediation. In a scripted 42-case replay, the state-bound configuration identifies 15 later-invalidated approvals that a deliberately non-re-evaluating point-in-time comparator does not revisit; it holds 14 affected actions before dispatch and compensates one landed effect. These results illustrate behavior under the stipulated policies and event orders, not superiority over dispatch-time enforcement designs or production effectiveness. Under explicit interception, ingestion, dependency, and serialization assumptions, the model establishes dispatch-time validity within the registered execution surface.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

Its connection to model systems is incidental, and the abstract does not address composition or reasoning.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Mitigating catastrophic risks from large language models requires excising hazardous operational capabilities, such as cyberwarfare exploitation and pathogen enhancement, without degrading benign scientific utility. In these dual-use domains, legitimate defensive science and malicious attacks share vocabulary, syntax, and internal model representations, causing standard unlearning methods to induce severe collateral damage (concept bleeding). In this work, we present Orthogonal Boundary Unlearning (OBU), a mathematically grounded framework designed to eliminate collateral damage on benign dual-use capabilities. OBU extracts a domain-matched capability subspace from paired calibration queries via singular value decomposition on empirical activation covariances, and restricts parameter updates strictly to the orthogonal null space. This guarantees that benign representations experience zero parameter perturbation along the spanned calibration subspace. We present two complementary realizations of OBU: Projected LoRA, which applies the orthogonal constraint during iterative gradient-based fine-tuning, and Closed-Form Weight Surgery, which directly edits model weights in a single analytical step without training. Across four modern open-weight foundation models (Gemma-3-4B, Qwen3.5-4B, SmolLM3-3B, and Granite-4.2-3B), OBU achieves strong dual-use concept separation, substantially mitigates in-context priming attacks, and demonstrates durable resistance against adversarial relearning without degrading benign domain competence.

Stage 1 structures single-clip representations via masked self-distillation and contrastive regularization. Stage 2 introduces bidirectional alignment: for a synthetic mixture, MiCLA suppresses the component aligned with one constituent and aligns the residual with the other, using projective residualization on patch tokens and sample-adaptive soft residualization on the global class token.     Self-evolving agents aim to improve from their own experience rather than remain fixed after deployment, but naturally collected trajectories often lack ground-truth solutions or verifier-derived rewards. For each on-policy trajectory, the same underlying model acts as both student and teacher: the teacher re-scores the student's realized actions while conditioning on cross-task precedents and lessons, together with turn-level reflection and future hindsight from the completed trajectory. The resulting teacher distribution is distilled back into the policy through on-policy self-distillation. Across rounds, the experience bank grows and the retrospective context is refreshed, allowing the model, its data, and its supervision to co-evolve. We formulate cross-visibility-gap identity persistence as historical-node recovery through a remembered target--carrier binding. We introduce CVG-SGM, a perception-frontend-compatible transfer--maintain--read memory. Geometry-weighted cross-node interaction transfers target-specific evidence into carrier states, a shared per-node GRU maintains this information during transport, and a two-time readout combines stored carrier--identity compatibility with current detection--carrier geometry to recover the historical identity. In the controlled one-identity-per-carrier setting, CVG-SGM achieves 1.000 re-link accuracy, compared with 0.570 for both no-memory and parameter-count-matched no-write controls. It also generalizes to scene-disjoint, unseen longer visibility gaps. On real RGB-D/SAM2 feature-level episodes, it correctly re-links 36/36 held-out detections, compared with 28/36 for the strongest fixed carrier--identity control. Counterfactual carrier-memory swaps redirect predictions according to the swapped bindings, supporting the role of stored relational information in identity recovery.     Code agents increasingly work on evolving real repositories, and memory systems aim to help them reuse earlier experience. However, such experience is diverse and evolving, so it remains unclear how memory systems organize it and thereby affect code agents. Existing benchmarks cannot answer this reliably because they lack either temporally valid histories or control over prior-task relevance. In this paper, we present MemDev-Bench to evaluate how memory systems affect code agents over diverse repository histories. It pairs each task with relevance-annotated earlier tasks from the same repository to build histories with controlled relevance. We also build an automated pipeline that reliably makes these earlier tasks executable and verifiable, producing 4,869 historical tasks for 555 base tasks. Based on MemDev-Bench, our systematic evaluation of memory systems across diverse development scenarios yields three main findings. (1) Memory mainly improves fine-grained localization and editing, increasing functional correctness. (2) Memory also causes failures on otherwise solvable tasks even with related history, and unrelated history tends to increase such failures. These failures mainly stem from agents reusing memory without reassessing its applicability. (3) Compared with using memory systems, directly providing agents with raw historical trajectories substantially reduces their steps. Further analysis suggests that agents save these steps by reusing process information that compressed memories tend to omit. These results suggest that future memory systems should preserve process information and reassess memory applicability against current task context.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AnchorRM reconstructs event-specific node memories from fixed batch anchors and causal histories, enabling parallel temporal graph updates with substantially faster training.     AnchorRM 根据固定批次锚点和因果历史重建特定事件的节点记忆，从而支持并行时序图更新并大幅加快训练。其主要贡献是可迁移的记忆与计算设计，服务于模型系统；并行状态重建与组合性的联系仅属附带。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Memory-based temporal graph neural networks (TGN) rely on recurrent node memories to capture evolving interaction histories. However, temporal mini-batching introduces a trade-off between computational efficiency and temporal fidelity: when a node appears multiple times within the same batch, later interactions are evaluated using stale pre-batch memory because the intermediate memory updates have not yet been committed. This problem becomes more severe as temporal batch size increases. To overcome this challenge, we propose AnchorRM, an anchor-based residual memory mechanism that reconstructs event-specific intra-batch node states without executing sequential recurrent updates. AnchorRM treats the last committed node memory at the beginning of each batch as a pre-batch fixed anchor and uses causally preceding same-batch interactions to infer the missing state evolution relative to that anchor. The learned residual then calibrates the anchor to reconstruct an event-specific node memory for each interaction. Because each event-specific residual is predicted directly from the fixed anchor and its causal history, reconstructed states do not depend on previously reconstructed states and can therefore be computed in parallel within the batch while preserving temporal causality. Experiments across four temporal graph datasets and three memory-based backbones demonstrate that AnchorRM achieves an average 6.16x training speedup (up to 10.05x) and 28.67x batch scaling (up to 40x). These results demonstrate that AnchorRM substantially improves the scalability and training efficiency of memory-based temporal graph learning while maintaining competitive predictive performance.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper develops and analyzes a practical POMDP algorithm combining particle filtering, online dynamics learning, and approximate planning, with regret bounds that characterize its errors.     本文开发并分析了一种实用的 POMDP 算法，将粒子滤波、在线动力学学习和近似规划结合起来，并通过遗憾界刻画其误差。这为规划和决策提供了重要见解，而算法系统设计是次要贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Model-based reinforcement learning in partially observable environments requires inferring hidden states, learning latent dynamics, and planning under the resulting belief. Practical algorithms often solve one aspect of the above pipeline while relying on approximations for the others that are often poorly understood, while existing POMDP theory typically analyzes computationally inefficient theoretical algorithms far from modern deep RL practice. To fill this gap, we propose a practical end-to-end algorithm that approximately solves the hidden state filtering problem via sequential Monte Carlo (SMC), updates a latent dynamics model online, and performs approximate online planning for $d$ steps before bootstrapping leaves with a state-value critic (a QMDP approximation). We analyze each approximation and prove an end-to-end regret bound decomposing the error into model estimation error, particle filter error, Monte Carlo rollout error, and a structural bias term induced by the QMDP approximation controllable by the planning depth that we further analyze in various special cases. The resulting guarantee makes explicit how statistical sample size, particle budget, rollout budget, and planning depth affect performance. We instantiate our algorithm in an MPC-based deep RL framework, demonstrating its practicality on a variety of environments. On a POMDP that satisfies our assumptions, each term of the bound decays at its predicted rate. Our results provide a practical and theoretically grounded route for bridging theory and practice within online decision-making in POMDPs.

Our method utilizes iterative orthogonal decomposition to identify complementary directions that capture distinct facets of deceptive intent. We therefore introduce a domain-adaptive gating mechanism that dynamically composes the extracted directions through few-shot adaptation at test time.     Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper contributes a benchmark and transactional memory architecture for full-duplex speech agents, with event-level memory operations and evaluation of persistent state.     本文提出一个基准和事务性记忆架构，用于全双工语音代理，其中包含事件级记忆操作和持久状态评估。其主要贡献是代理记忆组织；仅有语音应用场景并未对可解释性、组合或推理洞见作出实质贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Full-duplex speech agents must update persistent memory while listening and speaking, yet it remains unclear which events should be stored, revised, or excluded. Existing benchmarks isolate interaction timing from memory outcomes, obscuring the state transitions behind a correct answer. We introduce DuplexLedger, a bilingual benchmark of 1,094 persistent sessions aligning four full-duplex scenarios with event-level Write/Update/Ignore/Retain supervision, explicit pre/post memory states, and 6,564 same-session questions and checks. Evaluating five full-duplex models reveals an interaction-memory gap: no system combines strong boundary control with coherent final-state memory, and the best final-state fact coverage is 2.01%. We propose ACT-Mem, an 8.92M-parameter sidecar comprising an event controller, a versioned transactional ledger, and a typed retriever coupled with a frozen MiniCPM-o 4.5 backbone. On 219 held-out sessions, ACT-Mem increases latest-value accuracy from 4.11% to 8.68% while reducing stale assertions and distractor adoption. It improves interaction boundaries but slows interruption stopping. These results motivate selective, auditable full-duplex memory rather than indiscriminate transcript retention. Code is available at https://github.com/lyx-researcher/DuplexLedger.

    全双工语音代理必须在聆听和说话的同时更新持久记忆，但哪些事件应当存储、修订或排除仍不明确。现有基准将交互时序与记忆结果分开，因而掩盖了正确答案背后的状态转换。我们推出 DuplexLedger，这是一个双语基准，包含 1,094 个持久会话，将四种全双工场景与事件级 Write/Update/Ignore/Retain 监督、明确的记忆前后状态，以及 6,564 个同一会话内的问题和检查相对应。对五种全双工模型的评估揭示了交互与记忆之间的差距：没有系统能兼具强边界控制和一致的最终状态记忆，最佳最终状态事实覆盖率也仅为 2.01%。我们提出 ACT-Mem，这是一个包含事件控制器、版本化事务账本和类型化检索器的 8.92M 参数侧挂模块，并与冻结的 MiniCPM-o 4.5 主干模型耦合。在 219 个留出会话上，ACT-Mem 将最新值准确率从 4.11% 提高到 8.68%，同时减少过时断言和干扰项采纳。它改善了交互边界控制，但使停止应对打断的速度变慢。这些结果表明，全双工记忆应当具备选择性和可审计性，而不是不加区分地保留转录内容。代码见 https://github.com/lyx-researcher/DuplexLedger。

    TeCoP introduces a decoding algorithm that pipelines tentative predictions as context to reduce computation while preserving accuracy, a substantial contribution to computational allocation in model systems. Its math and coding evaluations are incidental, and the abstract does not claim new reasoning mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    TeCoP 提出一种解码算法，将暂定预测作为上下文进行流水线处理，以减少计算量并保持准确率，这是对模型系统中计算资源分配的实质性贡献。数学和代码评测只是辅助验证，摘要并未声称提出新的推理机制或组合泛化方法。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) predict multiple token positions per forward pass, yet block-wise decoders serialize generation and repeatedly recompute stable predictions. We attribute this inefficiency to coupling a prediction's readiness for irreversible commitment with its utility as context. We introduce Tentative Context Pipelining (TeCoP), a training-free decoder that decouples these roles through staggered block-parallel pipelining and draft-and-verify. TeCoP reuses stable but uncommitted predictions as provisional cross-block context, with commitment governed by confidence and stability checks. Across four LLaDA and Dream dLLMs on GSM8K, Minerva MATH, and MBPP, TeCoP reduces number of forward evaluations by up to 87% and achieves up to 7.50-fold throughput without KV caching and 11.77-fold with caching over the uncached original decoder. It outperforms Fast-dLLM and DSB in throughput across all 12 model-benchmark settings, with and without caching, while keeping average cached accuracy within one percentage point of the original decoder.

    扩散大语言模型（dLLM）在每次前向传播中预测多个 token 位置，但分块解码器会串行生成，并反复重新计算稳定的预测。我们将这种低效归因于把预测能否不可逆地提交与其作为上下文的效用耦合在一起。我们提出免训练解码器“暂定上下文流水线”（TeCoP），通过交错的分块并行流水线和起草—验证机制将这两种作用解耦。TeCoP 将稳定但尚未提交的预测作为临时跨块上下文复用，并通过置信度和稳定性检查来决定是否提交。在 GSM8K、Minerva MATH 和 MBPP 上对四种 LLaDA 和 Dream dLLM 的评估中，与未缓存的原始解码器相比，TeCoP 将前向评估次数最多减少 87%；在无 KV 缓存时吞吐量最高提升 7.50 倍，在启用缓存时最高提升 11.77 倍。在所有 12 种模型—基准设置中，无论是否启用缓存，其吞吐量都优于 Fast-dLLM 和 DSB，同时启用缓存时的平均准确率与原始解码器相差不超过一个百分点。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ASCENDEVOLVE uses retrieved platform knowledge to seed, repair, and recombine candidates in evolutionary kernel generation, substantially advancing a knowledge-guided agent system. Candidate recombination and search offer partial connections to composition and reasoning, but the abstract does not establish broader compositional generalization or reasoning mechanisms.

    ASCENDEVOLVE 利用检索到的平台知识，为进化式内核生成中的候选方案提供启发、指导修复并约束重组，实质性地推进了知识引导的代理系统。候选方案重组和搜索与组合和推理存在部分关联，但摘要没有证明更广泛的组合泛化能力或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    LLM agents have become capable kernel engineers on mainstream GPU stacks, but they struggle on emerging accelerators such as Ascend NPUs, whose programming model is barely represented in pretraining data. Recent NPU agents address this gap largely through experience: they accumulate memory from their own generation and optimization trials and reuse it on later tasks. We argue that experience alone is not enough for kernel generation. An agent can only remember what it has tried, and it rarely tries a mechanism it does not know. As a result, such memory offers little help when a new operator calls for a different mechanism, and even familiar operators raise unseen situations as optimization proceeds. We present ASCENDEVOLVE, which grounds every step of an evolutionary kernel search in a large external knowledge base built from platform documentation, toolkit headers, and operator repositories. Because this corpus far exceeds any context window, ASCENDEVOLVE indexes it and routes each agent to a small, task-specific slice of evidence instead of the corpus itself. The retrieved knowledge seeds diverse implementation strategies, guides repair when a candidate fails, and constrains how strong candidates are recombined. On 53 Ascend C operators from CANN-Bench spanning four difficulty levels, ASCENDEVOLVE achieves an overall score of 71.39, improving over Reflexion and OpenEvolve by 11.6% and 17.2%.

    中文

    LLM 代理已成为主流 GPU 软件栈上能力出众的内核工程师，但面对 Ascend NPU 等新兴加速器时仍显乏力，因为其编程模型在预训练数据中的占比极低。近期的 NPU 代理主要通过经验来弥补这一差距：它们积累自身生成和优化试验的记忆，并在后续任务中复用。我们认为，仅凭经验不足以胜任内核生成。代理只能记住自己尝试过的内容，而且很少会尝试自己不了解的机制。因此，当新算子需要不同机制时，这类记忆帮助不大；即使是熟悉的算子，在优化过程中也会出现未见过的情形。我们提出 ASCENDEVOLVE，让进化式内核搜索的每一步都以一个大型外部知识库为依据。该知识库由平台文档、工具包头文件和算子仓库构建而成。由于该语料规模远超任何上下文窗口，ASCENDEVOLVE 会为其建立索引，并将每个代理路由到一小段与任务相关的证据，而非整个语料。检索到的知识用于启发多样的实现策略、在候选方案失败时指导修复，并约束优秀候选方案的重组。在涵盖四个难度等级的 CANN-Bench 53 个 Ascend C 算子上，ASCENDEVOLVE 的总分达到 71.39，较 Reflexion 和 OpenEvolve 分别提高 11.6% 和 17.2%。

    ENGLISH

    As model parameters scale up, sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approaches have become essential for model scaling. However, mainstream models currently adopt hierarchical architectures, where experts in different layers, although topologically independent, exhibit substantial similarity and redundancy in their stored content. Compared to the hierarchically arranged \textbf{Local Expert} in existing mainstream models, we hypothesize that inter-layer shared \textbf{Meta Expert} hold greater potential. To this end, we conduct a multi-dimensional empirical comparison between Local and Meta Experts, and find that models incorporating Meta Experts exhibit lower parameter redundancy, together with lower cross-entropy loss and higher downstream task accuracy. With the activated quantity and the expert granularity held fixed, \textbf{our model matches the performance of Vanilla MoE using only 70--80\% of the experts}, substantially improving the model's scaling potential. Beyond removing inter-layer redundancy among experts and improving information storage efficiency, our theoretical analysis further shows that, compared with Local Experts, Meta Experts provide hidden states with more flexible residual pathways, thereby improving information retrieval efficiency.

    随着模型参数规模扩大，稀疏激活的专家混合（MoE）方法已成为扩展模型规模的关键。然而，当前主流模型采用分层架构，不同层中的专家虽然在拓扑结构上彼此独立，其存储内容却存在大量相似和冗余。与现有主流模型中分层排列的\textbf{局部专家}相比，我们假设跨层共享的\textbf{元专家}具有更大潜力。为此，我们对局部专家和元专家进行了多维度实证比较，发现采用元专家的模型参数冗余更低，同时交叉熵损失更低，下游任务准确率更高。在激活数量和专家粒度保持不变的情况下，\textbf{我们的模型仅使用 Vanilla MoE 70--80\% 的专家数量便达到相同性能}，显著提升了模型的扩展潜力。除了消除专家间的跨层冗余并提高信息存储效率外，我们的理论分析还表明，与局部专家相比，元专家为隐藏状态提供了更灵活的残差路径，从而提高信息检索效率。

    Lize Shao, Zichen Xie, Zhizhen Chen, Zhe Zeng, Wenxi Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SDDC plans program decomposition and inter-unit contracts to support parallel code generation, substantially advancing structured composition and algorithmic problem solving. Faster parallel decoding is a systems benefit, but the abstract does not present a broader systems mechanism.

    SDDC 规划程序分解和单元间契约，以支持并行代码生成，实质性地推进了结构化组合和算法问题求解。更快的并行解码带来了系统层面的收益，但摘要没有提出更广泛的系统机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion language models (DLMs) are emerging as a promising paradigm for code generation, offering the potential for fast, parallel decoding. However, generating complex programs remains challenging, as their interdependent components must maintain consistent interfaces, data flows, and shared assumptions. Aggressive parallel decoding can compromise these dependencies and undermine program correctness, while conservative decoding sacrifices efficiency. To address this trade-off, we propose planning program decomposition before implementation to coordinate interdependent units during parallel generation. We introduce Self-Decomposing Diffusion for Code (SDDC), a novel framework that decomposes complex programs and implements their units in parallel, entirely through diffusion. SDDC first generates a contract specifying the program's decomposition and inter-unit dependencies, then uses it to guide coordinated parallel implementation. Across five benchmarks and two 7B diffusion backbones, SDDC substantially improves the accuracy--latency trade-off, raising pass@1 by up to 31.1 percentage points while decoding 7.5--13.7$\times$ faster than the base models, and outperforming a fine-tuning baseline by up to 23.5 points with lower latency.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Empathetic interaction involves two distinguishable capacities: representing another person's emotional state (cognitive empathy) and generating an appropriate response to that state (affective empathy). We apply this distinction to examine how emotion-related information is internally organized, selectively attended to, and carried through response generation in Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct across 10 emotion categories from the EmpatheticDialogues dataset. Layer-wise linear probing revealed a broad middle-layer region of peak emotion-category decodability, with the layer-11 L2 probe achieving 63.6% held-out accuracy against a 10% chance level and a 54.6% TF-IDF lexical baseline. During response generation, emotion-related user tokens received 1.89 times as much attention per token as other utterance tokens, concentrated across layers 10-15. Target-emotion alignment then decreased from a mean cosine similarity of 0.239 for input representations to 0.125 for generated responses, with positive drift in 77% of examples and the largest shifts for angry and furious. Emotion-category representation, attention allocation, and response-level alignment therefore emerge as distinguishable components of model processing that can be analyzed through a functional cognitive-affective empathy framework. These findings provide a foundation for monitoring emotion representations during generation and leveraging models' existing affective structure to support more naturally empathetic responses without relying on external prompting or explicit emotion conditioning.

    富有同理心的互动涉及两种可区分的能力：表征他人的情绪状态（认知同理心），以及针对该状态生成恰当回应（情感同理心）。我们将这一区分用于考察 Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 如何在 EmpatheticDialogues 数据集的 10 类情绪中，对情绪相关信息进行内部组织、选择性关注，并在回应生成过程中传递这些信息。逐层线性探测发现，情绪类别可解码性在一个较宽的中间层区域达到峰值；其中第 11 层的 L2 探测器在留出集上达到 63.6% 的准确率，高于 10% 的随机水平和 54.6% 的 TF-IDF 词汇基线。在回应生成期间，情绪相关的用户词元获得的单位词元注意力是其他话语词元的 1.89 倍，这种注意力集中在第 10 至第 15 层。随后，目标情绪对齐度从输入表征的平均余弦相似度 0.239 降至生成回应的 0.125；77% 的示例出现正向偏移，愤怒和暴怒类别的偏移最大。因此，情绪类别表征、注意力分配和回应层面的对齐度构成了模型处理过程中可区分的组成部分，可以通过功能性认知—情感同理心框架加以分析。这些发现为监测生成过程中的情绪表征奠定了基础，也为利用模型现有的情感结构来支持更自然、更富同理心的回应提供了依据，无需依赖外部提示或显式情绪条件设定。

    Local Allow, Global Deny: Why Per-Action Authorization Does Not Compose in LLM Agents

    局部允许，全局拒绝：为何逐操作授权无法在 LLM 智能体中组合

    Anmol Pandey, Aditya Jain, Liang Chen, Carsten Maple

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper formalizes compositional authorization failures and proves that per-action monitors cannot detect certain relational policy violations, then demonstrates synthesis and monitoring approaches. This strongly advances composition and agent-system safety; LLM judges are used to evaluate the failure, but the work does not study their reasoning mechanisms.

    本文形式化了组合授权失败，并证明逐操作监控器无法检测某些关系性策略违规，随后展示了合成和监控方法。这项工作有力推进了组合性和智能体系统安全；文中使用 LLM 评判器评估失败案例，但没有研究它们的推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Autonomous LLM agents act through tools under per-action authorization: a local guard screens each tool call in isolation. We show that local authorization does not compose into global authorization. A compositional authorization failure (CAF) is a locally authorized execution, or a pair of locally authorized executions, that violates a global policy spanning intent, purpose, provenance, consent, and delegation. We characterize CAFs along two axes, expressiveness (single-trace safety versus relational k-safety) and observability (a ladder of monitor profiles). Our central result is an impossibility: relational purpose violations form a 2-safety hyperproperty with no per-trace locus of blame, so a per-action monitor that never raises a false alarm detects none of them, independent of the underlying model or decision procedure; they become visible only under cross-execution monitoring, which none of the six guardrails we survey implements. We make this constructive with AL-SYNTH, a SAT/SMT synthesizer (using no language model) that emits minimal CAF witnesses, each checked against an exhaustive oracle. The empirical signature is sharp: across nine LLM judges the per-action view approves the synthesized witness almost without exception, blocking it at a rate comparable to a benign control, yet the same models flag it when shown the two executions together. Per-action authorization is therefore structurally insufficient for relational policy conjuncts not reducible to single-trace safety: to bound them, a monitor must compare executions or accept false alarms.

    中文

    自主 LLM 智能体通过工具执行操作，并采用逐操作授权：局部防护机制会独立审查每次工具调用。我们表明，局部授权无法组合成全局授权。组合授权失败（CAF）是指一次或一对在局部获准的执行违反了涵盖意图、目的、来源、同意和委派的全局策略。我们沿两条轴刻画 CAF：表达能力（单轨迹安全与关系式 k-safety）和可观测性（监控器配置档案的层级）。我们的核心结论是不可能性：关系性目的违规构成一种 2-safety 超性质，不存在可归咎于单条轨迹的依据，因此，永不产生误报的逐操作监控器无法检测到任何此类违规，无论底层模型或决策过程为何；只有通过跨执行监控才能发现这些违规，而我们调查的六种防护机制均未实现这种监控。我们使用 AL-SYNTH 将这一结果具体化：这是一种 SAT/SMT 合成器（不使用语言模型），可生成最小 CAF 见证，并逐一用穷举预言机进行验证。实证特征十分鲜明：在九个 LLM 评判器中，逐操作视角几乎总是批准合成的见证，其拦截率与良性对照相近；然而，当向同一批模型同时展示两次执行时，它们就会标记该见证。因此，对于无法化约为单轨迹安全的关系性策略合取项，逐操作授权在结构上不足以应对：若要约束这些违规，监控器必须比较不同执行，或接受误报。

    From Outcomes to Steps: Reliable Success-Aware Critic Learning for Long-Horizon Language Agents

    从结果到步骤：面向长时程语言智能体的可靠成功感知评论器学习

    Jiaxi Liu, Shixiong Kai, Zhentao Tang, Yang Li, Yuqi Cui, Mingxuan Yuan, Junchi Yan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    SCALE adds success-probability prediction and reliability-weighted credit assignment to actor-critic training for long-horizon language agents, with improved performance and critic stability across benchmarks. This strongly advances reasoning-related training, while its agent setting alone provides only partial Systems relevance and the abstract offers no interpretability or compositional-generalization contribution.

    SCALE 将成功概率预测和按可靠性加权的信用分配加入长时程语言智能体的演员—评论器训练，并在多个基准上提升了性能和评论器稳定性。这项工作有力推进了与推理相关的训练；其智能体应用场景本身只与系统领域部分相关，摘要也没有提出可解释性或组合泛化方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reinforcement learning for long-horizon language agents requires identifying whether intermediate actions make eventual task success more or less likely when supervision is available only at trajectory level. The main difficulty is that a critic with aggregate return-prediction accuracy may still fail to resolve the local value differences needed to assign credit to actions, especially under sparse feedback and function approximation. Conventional critics estimate future return, but policy improvement also depends on knowing whether each intermediate decision makes task success more or less likely. We introduce SCALE, an actor-critic framework that augments conventional return estimation with explicit prediction of eventual task success. At each interaction prefix, the critic predicts a return value and a Success Value, defined as the probability that the task will eventually be completed from that prefix. SCALE converts changes in Success Value into multi-step action credit through Success-GAE and modulates its contribution according to the estimated reliability of the predictor, while retaining the token-level PPO objective. Across five agent benchmarks and three model backbones, SCALE improves task performance over the compared RL baselines in most settings, with gains of up to 4.1 percentage points in success rate. Separate critic-learning analyses show that SCALE also improves critic estimation and training stability.

    中文

    当监督信号仅在轨迹层面提供时，长时程语言智能体的强化学习需要判断中间动作会让最终任务成功的可能性增加还是降低。主要难点在于，即使评论器在总体回报预测上准确，也仍可能无法分辨为动作分配信用所需的局部价值差异，尤其是在反馈稀疏且采用函数逼近时。传统评论器估计未来回报，但改进策略还取决于能否知道每个中间决策会让任务成功的可能性增加还是降低。我们提出 SCALE，这是一种演员—评论器框架，在传统回报估计之外，显式预测最终任务是否成功。在每个交互前缀处，评论器都会预测回报值和成功值；成功值定义为从该前缀开始最终完成任务的概率。SCALE 通过 Success-GAE 将成功值的变化转化为多步动作信用，并依据预测器的估计可靠性调节其贡献，同时保留词元级 PPO 目标。在五个智能体基准和三种模型骨干上，与所比较的 RL 基线相比，SCALE 在大多数设置中提升了任务表现，成功率最高提高 4.1 个百分点。对评论器学习的独立分析表明，SCALE 还提升了评论器估计能力和训练稳定性。

    Pan Wang, Yihao Hu, Guangyuan Dong, Yitong Lin, Hang Wang, Zimi Liu, Zhihao Wen, Jianshe Li, Jiang-Ming Yang, Wei Wu, Yongqi Tong

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces progress-aligned intermediate targets and state norm anchoring to make recurrent computation extrapolate to longer state-tracking sequences. This substantially advances iterative reasoning and adaptive use of recurrent depth, while compositional generalization is limited to length extrapolation rather than a broader account of reusable constituents.

    本文提出了进度对齐的中间目标和状态范数锚定，使递归计算能够外推到更长的状态跟踪序列。这显著推进了迭代推理和递归深度的自适应使用，但组合泛化仅限于长度外推，并未更广泛地阐释可复用组成部分。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Looped language models can run more iterations at test time, but additional iterations need not help them solve longer problems. For sequential state tracking, final-answer supervision does not specify how far each iteration should advance, and repeated updates can change the scale of the recurrent state. We introduce \textbf{Progress-Aligned Recurrence (PAR)}, which trains the prediction at iteration $k$ to match the state after the first $k$ operations and rescales recurrent states to their first-iteration norms. On swap-$S_5$, a Qwen2.5-0.5B model trained on at most 32 moves achieves 95.5\% mean full-state accuracy at 512 moves, or $16\times$ the training length, compared with 55.7\% reported for RLT and 0.8\% for explicit chain of thought on the same backbone. Controlled $S_5$ ablations show that removing norm anchoring reduces the extrapolation factor from $16\times$ to below $2.2\times$, and replacing progress-aligned targets with final-answer supervision reduces it to at most $8\times$. A learned completion readout selects when to answer without a supplied stopping depth. When intermediate labels are unavailable, prefix self-distillation induces the correspondence from shorter problem prefixes using only final answers. The gains apply across sequential state-tracking tasks, establishing the task structure required for depth extrapolation. These findings support training intermediate predictions and state scale together to make additional recurrent depth useful for longer problems.

    中文

    循环语言模型可以在测试时运行更多轮迭代，但增加迭代次数不一定能帮助它们解决更长的问题。对于序列状态跟踪，最终答案监督并未说明每轮迭代应推进多少，而重复更新可能改变递归状态的尺度。我们提出\textbf{进度对齐递归（PAR）}，训练第 $k$ 轮迭代的预测与前 $k$ 次操作后的状态相匹配，并将递归状态重新缩放至其第一轮迭代时的范数。在 swap-$S_5$ 上，一个最多使用 32 步训练的 Qwen2.5-0.5B 模型，在 512 步时的平均完整状态准确率达到 95.5\%，即训练长度的 $16\times$ 倍；相比之下，据报告，同一主干模型上的 RLT 为 55.7\%，显式思维链为 0.8\%。受控的 $S_5$ 消融实验表明，移除范数锚定会使外推倍数从 $16\times$ 降至低于 $2.2\times$；而将进度对齐目标替换为最终答案监督，则会使其降至至多 $8\times$。一种学习得到的完成度读出机制可在未提供停止深度的情况下选择何时作答。当无法获得中间标签时，前缀自蒸馏仅利用最终答案，从较短的问题前缀中诱导出这种对应关系。这些收益适用于各种序列状态跟踪任务，确立了深度外推所需的任务结构。这些发现支持同时训练中间预测和状态尺度，从而使额外的递归深度有助于解决更长的问题。

    Xu Hu, Haoming Li, Yuxiang Wang, Jinxin Yang, Kangshuo Li, Licheng Wang, Dingyi Kang, Jiayu Song, Tianhao Wang, Zhanhua Hu, Xu Yang, Qiannan Li, Bingzhe Li, Feng Chen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a benchmark and training trajectories for detecting and recovering from errors in long-horizon computer-use agents, with gains on recovery and task completion. Workflow composition is a substantive but supporting part of benchmark construction (CompGen 3); the main contribution advances agent robustness and execution (Systems 4), while it offers no internal-mechanism insight or direct study of reasoning.

    本文为长时程计算机使用智能体引入了用于错误检测和恢复的基准与训练轨迹，并在错误恢复和任务完成方面取得提升。工作流组合是基准构建中有实质意义但起辅助作用的部分（CompGen 3）；主要贡献在于推进智能体的稳健性和执行能力（Systems 4），而本文没有提供关于内部机制的见解，也没有直接研究推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As computer-use agents (CUAs) move to long-horizon workflows spanning multiple applications, undetected errors can silently corrupt persistent state and cause cascading failures in subsequent actions. Reliable error detection and recovery have become critical bottlenecks for building robust CUAs. However, existing benchmarks focus primarily on end-to-end task performance, providing limited insight into whether agents can detect and recover from errors during execution. The few benchmarks that evaluate recovery rely largely on manually injected errors, which may not reflect the types or horizons of failures induced by real agent policies. We introduce CUA-Recovery, a benchmark comprising test and training suites across multiple desktop applications. We construct it using ReRail, a framework for synthesizing long-horizon tasks and trajectories in a persistent desktop environment. ReRail composes MyPCBench tasks into new long-horizon workflows with executable ground truth, collects verifier-confirmed failures from multiple policies, and turns them into verified recovery trajectories. CUA-Recovery comprises a human-verified test suite of 2,250 erroneous states over 100 tasks and a training suite of 8.6K trajectories over 377 tasks. Evaluation on the test suite shows that agents struggle both to recognize inherited errors and to complete the task. Across six agents and six takeover depths, Error Awareness Rate (EAR) reaches at most 44.0% and Pass@3 at most 25.5%. After fine-tuning Qwen3.5-35B-A3B on the training suite, its average EAR rises from 19.9% to 35.2% on held-out recovery states, and its Rubric Score goes from 5.0% to 16.1%. It also gains 15.3 points on MyPCBench and 10.8 points on Odysseys for Pass@3, showing that the training trajectories help both with recovery and with completing tasks from a clean start. Our code is available at https://github.com/xu-hu-2002/CUA-Recovery.

    中文

    随着计算机使用智能体（CUA）开始执行跨多个应用程序的长时程工作流，未被发现的错误可能会悄然破坏持久状态，并导致后续操作接连失败。可靠的错误检测和恢复已成为构建稳健 CUA 的关键瓶颈。然而，现有基准主要关注端到端任务表现，难以揭示智能体能否在执行过程中检测并恢复错误。少数评估恢复能力的基准大多依赖人工注入的错误，这可能无法反映真实智能体策略引发的故障类型或持续时长。我们推出 CUA-Recovery，这是一个包含多个桌面应用程序测试套件和训练套件的基准。我们使用 ReRail 构建该基准；ReRail 是一个用于在持久化桌面环境中合成长时程任务和轨迹的框架。ReRail 将 MyPCBench 任务组合成带有可执行真实标注的新长时程工作流，从多个策略收集经验证器确认的失败，并将其转化为经过验证的恢复轨迹。CUA-Recovery 包含一个由人工验证的测试套件，其中有 100 个任务、2,250 个错误状态；以及一个训练套件，其中有 377 个任务、8.6K 条轨迹。测试套件的评估表明，智能体在识别继承而来的错误和完成任务这两方面都表现吃力。在六个智能体和六种接管深度下，错误感知率（EAR）最高为 44.0%，Pass@3 最高为 25.5%。在训练套件上对 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 微调后，它在留出的恢复状态上的平均 EAR 从 19.9% 升至 35.2%，Rubric Score 从 5.0% 升至 16.1%。在 MyPCBench 和 Odysseys 上，Pass@3 分别提高 15.3 和 10.8 个百分点，表明这些训练轨迹既有助于错误恢复，也有助于从干净状态开始完成任务。我们的代码见 https://github.com/xu-hu-2002/CUA-Recovery。
