    Does Multi-Agent Collaboration Pay When Agents Serve Users? Testing Agent Scaling in Dual-Control Settings

    当智能体服务用户时，多智能体协作是否值得？在双重控制设置中检验智能体扩展

    Ethan Yang, Xiangcheng Shi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper systematically tests when multi-agent collaboration helps in user-facing settings and finds that a centralized multi-agent system generally underperforms a single agent while spending more tokens. This is a substantial empirical contribution to agent organization; task success is measured, but the abstract does not investigate reasoning mechanisms or how reasoning capabilities develop.

    本文系统地检验了多智能体协作何时能在面向用户的场景中发挥作用，并发现集中式多智能体系统通常表现不如单智能体，同时消耗更多 token。这是对智能体组织方式的一项重要实证贡献；研究衡量了任务成功率，但摘要没有探究推理机制，也没有研究推理能力如何发展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent systems (MAS) built from language models are deployed on the premise that collaboration beats a single-agent system (SAS), yet when it pays is unclear. The most systematic study to date gives a capability-saturation rule: coordination helps while the SAS is weak and hurts once it is strong, with the crossing near 45% single-agent accuracy. That rule was derived on autonomous benchmarks, where no user takes part. We test it where agents now work: in conversation with a user under a written policy, on $\tau^2$-bench, the dual-control benchmark. On its airline, retail and telecom domains we compare the stock SAS with a centralized MAS built from the same model for six models from three families, over about 7,950 simulated conversations, with one completion-token ledger per episode per system. The study was pre-registered with a public change log; the MAS is reported as built, with one validity bar unmet (its planner never saw the tool schemas). Under a fixed simulated user no cell shows a MAS benefit: the MAS is worse in 12 of the 13 valid cells and tied in the thirteenth, and the fitted gain is negative across the observed capability range (weighted mean -28 points, 95% CI [-44, -12]). On the two cells where the rule predicts a benefit, the MAS loses by 13 and 22 points, and without a budget ceiling it at best draws level at 5.5 times the SAS's token spend. The one gain appears on the cell nearest 45%, under a second simulator. Whether the gain declines with capability is unresolved (slope -0.41, 95% CI [-1.51, +0.68]), because model-by-domain effects dominate. The MAS does not detectably reduce wrongful database writes; it converts other failures into budget exhaustion and inaction. For agents that serve people, the SAS is the default; a multi-agent design must show compute-matched evidence from the setting itself. We release all trajectories, ledgers, prompts and code.

    中文

    基于语言模型构建的多智能体系统（MAS）的部署前提是协作优于单智能体系统（SAS），然而协作何时能带来收益尚不清楚。迄今最系统的研究提出了一条能力饱和规则：当 SAS 较弱时，协调会有所帮助；一旦 SAS 足够强，协调便会带来损害，二者的交叉点约在单智能体准确率 45% 处。这条规则是在自主基准上得出的，那里没有用户参与。我们在智能体如今实际工作的场景中检验它：智能体依据书面政策与用户对话，在 $\tau^2$-bench（双重控制基准）上进行测试。在其航空、零售和电信领域中，我们对比了原版 SAS 与由相同模型构建的集中式 MAS，涵盖来自三个系列的六种模型、约 7,950 段模拟对话，并为每个系统的每个对话回合分别记录 completion token。该研究已预注册，并提供公开的变更日志；报告的 MAS 是按实际构建状态测试的，其中有一项有效性条件未满足（其规划器从未见过工具 schema）。在固定的模拟用户条件下，没有任何单元显示 MAS 有收益：在 13 个有效单元中，MAS 有 12 个表现更差，另一个持平；在观测到的能力范围内，拟合得到的增益为负（加权平均 -28 个百分点，95% CI [-44, -12]）。在规则预测 MAS 会有收益的两个单元中，MAS 分别低 13 和 22 个百分点；即使没有预算上限，它充其量也只能在 token 消耗达到 SAS 的 5.5 倍时打平。唯一的增益出现在最接近 45% 的单元中，且使用了第二种模拟器。增益是否随能力提升而下降仍未确定（斜率 -0.41，95% CI [-1.51, +0.68]），因为模型与领域之间的效应占主导。MAS 并未显著减少错误的数据库写入；它将其他失败转化为预算耗尽和不作为。对于服务于人们的智能体，SAS 应作为默认选择；多智能体设计必须提供来自实际应用场景且计算量匹配的证据。我们公开所有轨迹、账本、提示词和代码。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Sampling complete solutions gives large language models more chances to solve a problem, but each attempt starts again. For tasks with several subproblems, all required answers must be correct in the same attempt. Retaining intermediate results can avoid repeating correct work, but errors in those results may affect later attempts. We study when this reuse is reliable and how much computation it requires. For local retries that stop when no candidate passes within the retry budget, we give conditions for correct completion and bound the average number of attempts. We also show how checking cost and the chance of passing a check affect total computation. Experiments across eight reasoning models examine composite mathematics and arithmetic. Across four DeepSeek models, average success on the second subproblem is 36.2 percent without first-subproblem context, 57.2 percent with its answer, and 58.3 percent with its reasoning and answer. These scores measure second-subproblem coverage and include continuations made when selection fails. Arithmetic experiments show that similar first-attempt accuracies can lead to very different coverage after repeated attempts. Code is available at https://github.com/SempraETY/Intermediate-State-Reuse.

    中文

    对完整解答进行采样，能让大语言模型有更多机会解决问题，但每次尝试都要从头开始。对于包含多个子问题的任务，所有必需答案必须在同一次尝试中全部正确。保留中间结果可以避免重复已正确完成的工作，但这些结果中的错误可能会影响后续尝试。我们研究何时能够可靠地复用中间结果，以及需要多少计算量。对于局部重试（若在重试预算内没有候选答案通过，就停止），我们给出正确完成任务的条件，并对平均尝试次数进行界定。我们还展示检查成本和通过检查的概率会如何影响总计算量。我们在八个推理模型上开展实验，考察复合数学和算术任务。在四个 DeepSeek 模型上，第二个子问题的平均成功率，在不提供第一个子问题上下文时为 36.2%，提供其答案时为 57.2%，提供其推理过程和答案时为 58.3%。这些分数衡量第二个子问题的覆盖率，也包括选择失败时继续生成的结果。算术实验表明，即使首次尝试准确率相近，经过多次尝试后的覆盖率也可能大不相同。代码见 https://github.com/SempraETY/Intermediate-State-Reuse。

    Pengying Wu, Zhejia Wen, Kang Ding, Kangjie Zhou, Chunxuan Jiao, Wei Pan, Xiangli Nie, Chang Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CovNav contributes a calibrated, training-free policy that escalates ambiguous navigation queries from fast judgments to chain-of-thought reasoning, with experiments showing the efficiency and navigation trade-off. Its reasoning and adaptive agent-computation contributions are substantial; object-pair structure alone offers only an incidental connection to compositional generalization, and it does not study internal representations.

    CovNav 提出一种经过校准、无需训练的策略，将模糊的导航查询从快速判断升级为思维链推理，并通过实验展示了效率与导航表现之间的权衡。这项工作对推理和智能体计算自适应的贡献显著；单靠物体对结构只与组合泛化存在附带联系，且本文没有研究内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    In object goal navigation (ObjectNav), an embodied agent must find a target object (e.g., "find a bed") in a previously unseen environment, relying on spatial commonsense such as object co-occurrence. Large Language Models (LLMs) encode this commonsense, but deploying them on robots exposes a trade-off between reasoning quality and efficiency: cloud-based models incur latency and privacy risks, whereas small on-device LLMs are fast but prone to hallucinated spatial judgments. Hybrid reasoning LLMs offer both a fast non-thinking mode and a slow thinking mode, which raises a key question for embodied agents: when is slow thinking worth its cost? We propose CovNav, a training-free framework that answers this question with Conformal Prediction (CP), turning dual-process (System 1 / System 2) inference into an uncertainty-aware decision. Much like recent decision models such as Jev, CovNav casts each spatial query as a structured binary decision rather than free-form generation: a local LLM in fast mode judges whether the target is likely near an observed object, CP converts its token probabilities into a prediction set, and only ambiguous queries are escalated to slow chain-of-thought reasoning. The object-pair formulation keeps calibration tractable and supports open-set objects through off-the-shelf detectors. Experiments on Gibson and HM3D show that CovNav surpasses the strongest zero-shot baseline by 0.8 and 1.7 percentage points in success rate on HM3D v1 and v2, while invoking slow reasoning for only 12.4% of queries and retaining most of the gain of always-on thinking at a fraction of its latency. Real-robot experiments on a TurtleBot 4 further validate the approach. CovNav shows how calibrated uncertainty can decide when an embodied agent should think slowly, offering a principled form of adaptive test-time reasoning for LLM-based robots.

    中文

    在物体目标导航（ObjectNav）中，具身智能体必须在此前未见过的环境中找到目标物体（例如“找到一张床”），并依赖物体共现等空间常识。大语言模型（LLM）编码了这类常识，但将其部署到机器人上会暴露推理质量与效率之间的权衡：云端模型会带来延迟和隐私风险，而小型端侧 LLM 虽然速度快，却容易产生幻觉式空间判断。混合推理 LLM 同时提供快速的非思考模式和缓慢的思考模式，这引出了具身智能体面临的一个关键问题：何时值得付出代价进行慢速思考？我们提出 CovNav，这是一种无需训练的框架，利用保形预测（CP）回答这一问题，将双过程（System 1 / System 2）推理转化为考虑不确定性的决策。与 Jev 等近期决策模型类似，CovNav 将每个空间查询建模为结构化二元决策，而非自由形式生成：本地 LLM 在快速模式下判断目标是否可能靠近已观察到的物体，CP 将其词元概率转换为预测集合，只有模糊不清的查询才会升级为慢速思维链推理。物体对形式使校准易于处理，并可通过现成检测器支持开放集物体。在 Gibson 和 HM3D 上的实验表明，在 HM3D v1 和 v2 上，CovNav 的成功率比最强零样本基线分别高 0.8 和 1.7 个百分点；它仅对 12.4% 的查询调用慢速推理，同时以极低的延迟保留了常开思考的大部分收益。TurtleBot 4 上的真实机器人实验进一步验证了该方法。CovNav 展示了如何利用经过校准的不确定性来决定具身智能体何时应进行慢速思考，为基于 LLM 的机器人提供了一种有原则的测试时自适应推理方法。

    World2HOSI：用于长时程人类-物体-场景交互生成的多专家协作框架

    Jiushu Li, Haoran Wang, Yumeng Liu, Zhiyang Dou, Yuan Liu, Yuexin Ma, Cheng Lin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    World2HOSI contributes an orchestration harness that coordinates existing experts through shared persistent scene state, staged planning, and updates to the evolving world. This is a substantial model-system contribution with meaningful expert composition, but the abstract focuses on generating HOSI data rather than advancing reasoning mechanisms or internal interpretability.

    World2HOSI 提出了一种协作编排框架，通过共享的持久场景状态、分阶段规划以及对演变世界的更新来协调现有专家。这是一项有实质意义的模型系统贡献，涉及重要的专家组合，但摘要重点在于生成 HOSI 数据，而非推进推理机制或内部可解释性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon human-object-scene interaction (HOSI) is central to embodied AI, animation, and game development. Existing human-object interaction (HOI) and human-scene interaction (HSI) models excel in their respective domains, but none alone covers tasks requiring multiple interaction skills. Training unified HOSI models is hindered by scarce and costly data. We introduce World2HOSI, a multi-expert orchestration harness that generates continuous HOSI data from 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes and natural language instructions. Our key insight is that long-horizon HOSI hinges not on a stronger single model but on orchestration. Given a shared, structured scene state and an orchestration harness grounded in it, existing experts can jointly accomplish tasks beyond the reach of any of them alone. World2HOSI realizes this insight as a closed loop around a persistent scene state built from decoupled background and object assets. A harness plans action stages over this state, invokes experts via their native conditioning interfaces, and writes each action's effects back, so that every invocation is grounded in the evolving world. To reduce physical artifacts, bounded residual optimization and contact-driven physics simulation further ensure the physical plausibility of human motion and object manipulation, respectively, while preserving interaction intent. Experiments and a perceptual user study show that World2HOSI achieves the best task completion and interaction quality on the evaluated HOSI tasks, while generating more diverse data.

    中文

    长时程人类-物体-场景交互（HOSI）是具身 AI、动画和游戏开发的核心问题。现有的人类-物体交互（HOI）和人类-场景交互（HSI）模型各自在其领域表现出色，但没有任何单一模型能够涵盖需要多种交互技能的任务。统一 HOSI 模型的训练受限于数据稀缺且成本高昂。我们提出 World2HOSI，这是一个多专家协作编排框架，可根据 3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）场景和自然语言指令生成连续的 HOSI 数据。我们的关键洞见是，长时程 HOSI 的关键不在于更强的单一模型，而在于协作编排。给定共享的结构化场景状态以及以该状态为基础的编排框架，现有专家便能协同完成任何单个专家都无法独立完成的任务。World2HOSI 围绕由彼此解耦的背景和物体资产构建的持久场景状态，实现了这一洞见形成的闭环。框架基于该状态规划动作阶段，通过专家原生的条件接口调用专家，并将每个动作的效果写回状态，使每次调用都以不断演变的世界为依据。为减少物理伪影，有界残差优化和接触驱动的物理模拟分别进一步确保人体运动和物体操作在物理上的合理性，同时保留交互意图。实验和一项感知用户研究表明，在评估的 HOSI 任务中，World2HOSI 的任务完成度和交互质量最佳，同时生成的数据也更多样。

    RSI Control: Can AI Models Perform Covert Sabotage in the Self-Improvement Process?

    RSI Control：AI 模型能否在自我改进过程中实施隐蔽破坏？

    Kaiwen Zhou, Udari Madhushani Sehwag

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces and evaluates a testbed for covert sabotage by autonomous R&D agents during successor-model training, finding that attacks can evade transcript-based monitors and that reasoning access improves detection. Agent task execution and monitoring are a substantial systems contribution, while reasoning is studied as attack behavior; it does not explain internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文提出并评估了一个测试平台，用于研究自主研发智能体在训练后继模型期间实施隐蔽破坏的行为；研究发现，攻击可以躲过基于运行记录的监控，而访问推理过程能提升检测能力。智能体执行任务和监控构成了重要的系统贡献；推理在此作为攻击行为进行研究，但本文没有解释内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recursive self-improvement, in which frontier AI models work on training the next generation, is quickly becoming a reality. However, the safety of this process has received far less attention than it should. A misaligned model training its successor can shape what that successor knows, how it behaves, and what it wants, and the harm carries forward into the next generation. We study this risk through the lens of AI control. We introduce RSI Control Arena, a testbed in which a frontier model, acting as an autonomous R\&D agent, is given a benign main task from a stage of a successor model's training pipeline together with a covert side task to install a misaligned property in the successor. The testbed contains 16 side tasks in three classes, forming 22 task pairs with main tasks that span the pipeline from data curation to reinforcement learning. We evaluate six frontier models as agents against LLM monitors that read the transcript of the run and the agent's reasoning. We observe that every model completes a substantial share of the side tasks without degrading the main-task performance, including side tasks that make the successor itself a better saboteur. Under minimal instructions to stay covert, models already produce successful attacks that monitors fail to detect, and providing a short list of evasion tactics further reduces the detection rate. Monitors with access to agent's reasoning detects most attacks, but not all. Our results indicate that recursive self-improvement raises significant safety concerns, and that strong safety effort should be in place before models are trusted with greater responsibility of training their successors.

    中文

    递归自我改进正迅速成为现实：前沿 AI 模型开始参与训练下一代模型。然而，这一过程的安全性远未得到应有的关注。训练后继模型的失准模型可能塑造后继模型所知的内容、行为方式和欲求，而造成的伤害会延续到下一代。我们从 AI 控制的视角研究这一风险。我们推出 RSI Control Arena，这是一个测试平台：一个前沿模型作为自主研发（R&D）智能体，从后继模型训练流程的某个阶段接收一项良性的主要任务，同时还接收一项隐蔽的侧任务，要求它在后继模型中植入某种失准属性。该测试平台包含三个类别的 16 项侧任务，与主要任务组成 22 个任务对；这些主要任务涵盖从数据整理到强化学习的整个流程。我们评估了六个前沿模型作为智能体，对手则是能够读取运行记录和智能体推理过程的 LLM 监控器。我们观察到，每个模型都能完成相当一部分侧任务，同时不降低主要任务的表现，其中也包括使后继模型本身更善于实施破坏的侧任务。在只给出最低限度的隐蔽指令时，模型已经会实施监控器无法检测到的成功攻击；提供一份简短的规避策略清单后，检测率会进一步下降。能够访问智能体推理过程的监控器可以检测出大多数攻击，但并非全部。我们的结果表明，递归自我改进会带来重大安全隐患；在赋予模型更大责任、让其训练后继模型之前，应当做好有力的安全准备。

    AC/DC on a Budget - Alternating Sparse Phases

    低预算 AC/DC——交替稀疏阶段

    Rahul Nittala, Advait Gadhikar, Tom Jacobs, Rebekka Burkholz

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies gradient and sign-flipping dynamics behind sparse rewiring, then uses those findings to reduce the compute cost of sparsification while maintaining performance. This provides some mechanistic insight, and its main algorithmic contribution advances sparse computation; it does not address composition or reasoning.

    本文揭示了稀疏重连背后的梯度和符号翻转动态，并利用这些发现降低稀疏化的计算成本，同时维持性能。这提供了一些机制层面的洞见，其主要算法贡献则推进了稀疏计算；本文没有涉及组合或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    State-of-the-art neural network sparsification relies on alternating dense and sparse training phases. While computationally expensive, dense phases are critical for performance. Our empirical analysis reveals the mechanics behind this gain: upon reintroduction, previously masked parameters receive disproportionately large gradients that drive essential mask rewiring and parameter sign-flipping. Building on these insights, we optimize the performance-to-FLOPs Pareto frontier through three innovations: (1) zero-initializing masked parameters during dense phases to promote relevant sign flips, (2) shortening dense phases, and (3) replacing the dense phase entirely with a sparse rewiring phase that updates only the active mask and a small, high-gradient fraction of out-of-mask weights. Evaluated on CIFAR100 and ImageNet, our variant ARC (Alternating Rewiring Compression) matches baseline AC/DC performance at a fraction of the computational cost, establishing a superior performance-to-FLOPs frontier also compared to standard sparse-to-sparse algorithms. Experiments with GPT-2 on OpenWebText further show improvements in validation perplexity and average zero-shot performance

    中文

    最先进的神经网络稀疏化方法依赖于稠密和稀疏训练阶段交替进行。稠密阶段虽然计算成本高昂，却是性能的关键。我们的实证分析揭示了这种收益背后的机制：先前被屏蔽的参数重新引入时，会收到大得不成比例的梯度，从而驱动必要的掩码重连和参数符号翻转。基于这些发现，我们通过三项创新优化性能-FLOPs 帕累托前沿：（1）在稠密阶段将被屏蔽参数初始化为零，以促进相关的符号翻转；（2）缩短稠密阶段；（3）完全以稀疏重连阶段取代稠密阶段，该阶段只更新活动掩码以及少量梯度较大的掩码外权重。在 CIFAR100 和 ImageNet 上评估时，我们的变体 ARC（交替重连压缩）以一小部分计算成本达到基线 AC/DC 的性能；与标准的稀疏到稀疏算法相比，它也建立了更优的性能-FLOPs 前沿。在 OpenWebText 上使用 GPT-2 的实验进一步表明，验证集困惑度和零样本平均性能均有所提升

    Wenshuo Zhang, Yuquan Lin, Yushi Sun, Yishi Lin, Rui Sheng, Peng He, Han Gao, Wang Jikai, Yifeng Rong

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a benchmark for testing how tool-using agents recover from silent errors across multi-step workflows, identifying resilience bottlenecks and testing a state-checking intervention. Its central contribution concerns agent tool-use reliability and evaluation, while reasoning and composition are incidental to the task rather than mechanisms it studies.

    本文提出了一个基准，用于测试使用工具的智能体如何从多步工作流中的静默错误中恢复，并识别韧性瓶颈及测试状态检查干预措施。其核心贡献在于智能体工具使用的可靠性与评估；推理和组合只是任务中的附带因素，而非研究机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Tool-using LLM agents increasingly answer e-commerce queries through multi-step tool interactions. The expected output of a tool call can shift between agent development and execution, allowing a plausible but incorrect value to be returned without an explicit failure signal. These silent errors may propagate through subsequent decisions into final answers. To study agents' resilience across this end-to-end process, we formulate Silent-error Resilience Task, an interactive task that evaluates whether they complete the original query after a silent error corrupts an intermediate state. We introduce RITE, a benchmark built from human-authored industrial workflows and production-log-derived inputs. To enable controlled and reproducible evaluation, we use a semantic error taxonomy to inject errors into fixed workflow prefixes, freeze recorded tool behavior, and let agents continue freely. It contains 167 matched units across nine e-commerce workflows, yielding 501 silent-error, correct-value, and explicit-failure instances. Across 10 recent LLMs, silent errors roughly halve task success and are consistently harder than explicit failures. Recognition, use of an available verification path, and integration of the resulting evidence form successive bottlenecks. We also propose a light State Checker as an intervention to test whether resilience can be improved.

    中文

    使用工具的 LLM 智能体越来越多地通过多步工具交互来回答电商查询。从智能体开发到执行期间，工具调用预期返回的结果可能发生变化，导致系统返回看似合理但实际错误的值，且没有明确的失败信号。这些静默错误可能在后续决策中传播，最终影响答案。为研究智能体在这一端到端流程中的韧性，我们提出静默错误韧性任务，这是一项交互式任务，用于评估中间状态被静默错误破坏后，智能体能否完成原始查询。我们推出 RITE，这是一个基于人工编写的行业工作流和源自生产日志的输入构建的基准。为实现受控且可复现的评估，我们采用语义错误分类体系，在固定的工作流前缀中注入错误，冻结已记录的工具行为，并允许智能体自由继续执行。该基准涵盖九种电商工作流中的 167 个匹配单元，形成 501 个静默错误、正确值和显式失败实例。在对 10 个近期 LLM 的评估中，静默错误使任务成功率大约减半，而且始终比显式失败更难处理。识别错误、使用可用的验证途径以及整合由此得到的证据，构成了依次出现的瓶颈。我们还提出一种轻量级状态检查器，作为检验能否提升韧性的干预措施。

    GRADUS: Discovering and Recovering Agent Lessons from the Environment's Latent Syllabus

    GRADUS：从环境的潜在课程中发现并恢复智能体经验

    Qing Ping, Wei Yang, Panpan Xu, Johannes Kirmayr, Lukas Stappen, Junjie Tang, Jun Huan

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Gradus extracts guarded behavioral operators and composes them into progressively harder tasks, with feedback targeting missing outcome combinations; this is a substantial contribution to compositional learning and generalization. The work also improves agent training and environment interaction, but the abstract does not establish a central advance in reasoning mechanisms or agent-system design.

    Gradus 提取受条件约束的行为算子，并将它们组合成逐步变难的任务，同时利用反馈针对缺失的结果组合；这是对组合学习与泛化的一项重要贡献。该工作也改进了智能体训练和环境交互，但摘要并未证明其在推理机制或智能体系统设计方面有核心突破。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Training LLM agents for policy-constrained tool environments, such as an airline backend with booking, refund, and cancellation policies, requires tasks that exercise the environment's rules individually and in combination. Existing synthesis pipelines let a model propose tasks and retain only those it immediately solves, biasing training data toward easier behaviors. We introduce Gradus (Graded Rungs of Ascending Difficulty from an Underlying System), which decouples what a task should teach from the concrete task and solution used to teach it. Without seed tasks, Gradus treats a fixed environment as a latent syllabus, extracting guarded behavioral operators that capture how actions depend on current conditions and how their effects reshape subsequent decisions. It composes these operators into increasingly demanding tasks while using corpus-level feedback to target missing outcome combinations. Crucially, Gradus jointly calibrates tasks and solutions against the environment: execution feedback identifies which side to refine while preserving the intended behavioral requirements. Verification thus becomes a recovery signal rather than a terminal filter, coupling coverage-guided exploration with the preservation of difficult examples. From off-the-shelf backbones, the resulting curriculum lifts a 30B model from 59% to 89% on $\tau^2$-Bench and from 47% to 83% on CAR-Bench with an Opus 4.5 proposer, and to 76% and 62%, respectively, with an open-weight Qwen3-235B proposer. These results show the value of jointly controlling which behaviors are explored and which survive into verified training data.

    中文

    要在受策略约束的工具环境中训练 LLM 智能体（例如包含预订、退款和取消政策的航空公司后台系统），需要让任务分别以及组合起来考验环境规则。现有的合成流程让模型提出任务，并只保留它能立即解决的任务，导致训练数据偏向较容易的行为。我们提出 Gradus（源自底层系统、难度逐级上升的阶梯），将任务应当教授的内容与用于教学的具体任务和解法解耦。在没有种子任务的情况下，Gradus 将固定环境视为一套潜在课程，提取受条件约束的行为算子，刻画动作如何取决于当前条件，以及动作效果如何改变后续决策。它将这些算子组合成难度逐渐增加的任务，同时利用语料库层面的反馈，针对缺失的结果组合。关键在于，Gradus 根据环境共同校准任务和解法：执行反馈会指出哪一方需要改进，同时保留预期的行为要求。因此，验证成为恢复信号，而非最终筛选器；它将覆盖率引导的探索与保留难例结合起来。使用现成骨干模型时，生成的课程将一个 30B 模型在 $\tau^2$-Bench 上的成绩从 59% 提升到 89%；使用 Opus 4.5 提议器时，在 CAR-Bench 上的成绩从 47% 提升到 83%；使用开放权重的 Qwen3-235B 提议器时，两项成绩分别达到 76% 和 62%。这些结果表明，共同控制探索哪些行为以及哪些行为保留在经过验证的训练数据中，具有重要价值。

    Eric Mittag, Lukas Brechtel, Maximilian Stark, Hans D. Schotten

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The main contribution is an agentic workflow that ports, optimizes, and validates algorithms on baseband silicon under measured hardware constraints, including a detector tailored to those costs. Its agent and algorithm-search aspects are incidental to the systems contribution; the abstract does not study model reasoning or internal representations.

    主要贡献是一种智能体工作流：在实测硬件约束下移植、优化并验证基带芯片上的算法，其中包括一个针对这些成本定制的检测器。智能体和算法搜索是系统贡献中的组成部分；摘要没有研究模型推理或内部表征。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    6G will be designed faster than it can be built: AI-driven search already proposes physical-layer algorithms at machine speed, while carrying a single one onto embedded baseband silicon remains specialist work. That silicon imposes hard memory and numeric limits, but also exposes cost structures a GPU lacks, and a design flow that never runs on the target sees neither. We present an agentic workflow in which an LLM coding agent implements algorithms on a commercial baseband SoC, optimizes them down to agent-written vector assembly, and validates them on silicon. The agent is guided by a knowledge base of measured platform facts, checked at every step against evaluators it is instructed never to edit, and metered per phase. We showcase the workflow on an AI-discovered orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) detector portfolio on the open 6G4All platform. It yields twelve kernels that run cycle-exactly on silicon, their optimized versions at 18k-405k cycles (30-660 $\mu$s) per frame. It also yields a new detector shaped by the chip's measured costs that needs 13.9% fewer cycles than the port of the discovered detector while matching its error rate, with a measured edge our evaluation cannot statistically resolve, a structure that a hardware-blind search objective had no reason to find. What is not specific to OTFS is the workflow: an LLM agent exploring an implementation space under real hardware limits, with the cost of every choice measured rather than assumed.

    中文

    Certified Adaptive List Decoding for Error-Correcting Codes

    纠错码的认证式自适应列表译码

    Jaeho Hwang, Byung-Sun Won, Uiwon Hwang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper combines probability-beam search with code-derived bounds to find and certify maximum-likelihood decoding solutions, with strong empirical certification and error-rate results. This substantially advances algorithmic problem solving, while its tree search offers only a limited connection to composition and does not concern model internals or agent systems.

    本文将概率束搜索与由码推导的界结合起来，以寻找并认证最大似然译码解，并取得了出色的实证认证和错误率结果。这显著推进了算法问题求解；其树搜索与组合只有有限关联，也不涉及模型内部机制或智能体系统。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Maximum-likelihood (ML) decoding of linear block codes is NP-hard, so neural decoders are evaluated by how closely they approach it. We observe that proving a candidate optimal can be far easier than finding it, and build a decoder that does both. We cast decoding as a search over an absorbing-state discrete diffusion model, whose sequential commitment of coordinates turns generation into a tree, and run a probability beam search over it. A dual bound from a linear-programming relaxation and a distance-based test, both derived from the code, then certify per frame that the current candidate is the global ML solution; because both are theorems, certified frames incur no accuracy-computation trade-off. Across $15$ codes and five operating points we certify up to $99.9\%$ of frames, the two tests dividing the space as their derivations predict, one strong for sparse parity-check matrices and the other for codes with a large minimum distance. Certification also behaves as a per-frame reliability signal, with $96.7$-$100\%$ of all frame errors falling on uncertified frames. Against an exact ML reference at $5$ dB the decoder is within one standard deviation on three of the four codes where the reference is uncensored, and against four neural baselines it attains the best bit-error rate in $71$ of $75$ cells.

    中文

    线性分组码的最大似然（ML）译码是 NP-hard 问题，因此神经译码器的评估依据是其结果与最优解有多接近。我们观察到，证明某个候选解为最优，可能远比找到该解容易，并据此构建了一个兼顾两者的译码器。我们将译码表述为在吸收态离散扩散模型上的搜索，其中坐标的逐步确定将生成过程转化为一棵树，并在其上运行概率束搜索。随后，基于线性规划松弛得到的对偶界以及基于距离的检验（两者均由码本身推导而来），逐帧认证当前候选解为全局 ML 解；由于二者都是定理，经过认证的帧不存在准确率与计算量之间的权衡。在 $15$ 种码和五个工作点上，我们最多认证了 $99.9\%$ 的帧；两种检验按其推导所预示的方式划分适用范围，一种对稀疏校验矩阵表现出色，另一种适用于最小距离较大的码。认证也可作为逐帧可靠性信号：所有帧错误中有 $96.7$–$100\%$ 落在未认证帧上。在 $5$ dB 下与精确 ML 参考结果相比，对于参考结果未被截尾的四种码中的三种，该译码器的表现处于一个标准差以内；与四种神经基线相比，它在 $71$ 个单元中的 $75$ 个单元里取得了最佳比特错误率。

    Jiajun Zhu, Haobo Li, Zixin Chen, Huamin Qu, Wenshuo Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    LatBridge enables interface reuse and efficient latent communication when agent models are replaced, a substantial contribution to multi-agent system design. Its MATH and ALFWorld evaluations are application evidence; the abstract does not describe a reasoning mechanism or compositional generalization contribution.

    LatBridge 使智能体模型替换后能够复用接口并进行高效的潜在通信，这是对多智能体系统设计的一项重要贡献。其 MATH 和 ALFWorld 评估提供了应用层面的证据；摘要没有描述推理机制或组合泛化方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Multi-agent systems rely on communication to complete tasks, and latent communication passes continuous representations to reduce text generation and re-encoding. However, multi-agent systems must reconfigure agent models, whereas existing latent-communication methods are built for fixed model combinations, so their interfaces may fail after replacement. Our pilot study confirms this interface failure and identifies the requirement for interface reuse after model replacement. We present LatBridge, which connects agent models through a shared Bridge and separate interfaces under a shared latent-communication protocol. After agent model replacement, LatBridge reuses unchanged interfaces, selects matching low-rank interfaces, and combines them through the Bridge, training only missing ones with all models frozen. The Bridge processes source representations in the basic mode and constructs target input without autoregressive generation in the accelerated mode. Experiments support effective communication after model replacement, with mean basic-mode accuracies of 14.8% on MATH and 27.3% on ALFWorld next-action prediction across eight small-model configurations. Analyses examine the factors supporting task accuracy and communication efficiency.

    Ziqi Jin, Weiwen Xu, Jiaxi Li, Yujie Zhong, Qi She, Aixin Sun

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ProVe trains a large model to propose token blocks and verifies them to increase decoding throughput, advancing computational efficiency in language model inference. GSM8K is an evaluation benchmark, but the contribution concerns decoding speed rather than reasoning capability; no internal-mechanism or compositional insight is described.

    ProVe 训练一个大模型来提议词元块，并对其进行验证以提高解码吞吐量，从而提升语言模型推理的计算效率。GSM8K 是一个评估基准，但这项工作的贡献关注的是解码速度，而非推理能力；文中没有描述内部机制或组合性方面的洞见。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive (AR) language models by letting a small model draft tokens serially and a large model verify them in parallel. We reverse these roles. Starting from a standard AR checkpoint, we fine-tune the large model into a proposer that predicts a block of future tokens in a single forward pass, then use one additional forward pass to verify the proposed block. This gives ProVe, Proposer-Verifier decoding. The verifier can be a smaller AR model or the proposer itself; the latter gives ProVe-lossless, which reproduces the proposer's greedy AR decoding. Block proposals already provide substantial room for acceleration: with a block size of 16, the proposed block has an average AR-matching prefix of 6.6 tokens on GSM8K. Across six benchmarks with a 32B proposer, ProVe-lossless reaches 2.5x average AR throughput without training a separate draft head. With a small 3B verifier, ProVe reaches 2.7x average throughput at 2.6 accuracy points below AR on the six-task average, providing a controllable tradeoff between speed and accuracy.

    中文

    推测解码通过让小模型串行草拟词元、让大模型并行验证这些词元，加速自回归（AR）语言模型。我们反转这两者的角色。从一个标准 AR 检查点出发，我们微调大模型，使其成为提议者，在一次前向传播中预测一组未来词元，然后再用一次额外的前向传播验证所提议的词元块。这就是 ProVe，即提议者-验证者解码。验证者可以是一个更小的 AR 模型，也可以是提议者本身；后一种方式得到 ProVe-lossless，它能够复现提议者的贪心 AR 解码。词元块提议本身就有很大的加速空间：块大小为 16 时，在 GSM8K 上，所提议词元块与 AR 匹配的前缀平均为 6.6 个词元。在使用 32B 提议者的六个基准测试中，ProVe-lossless 的平均 AR 吞吐量达到 2.5 倍，且无需训练单独的草稿头。使用较小的 3B 验证者时，ProVe 的平均吞吐量达到 2.7 倍，在六项任务的平均准确率上比 AR 低 2.6 个百分点，从而在速度与准确率之间提供可控的权衡。

    Elicitation or Expansion? Demystifying Gains from Agent Harness Optimization

    启发还是扩展？揭示智能体 Harness 优化带来的收益

    Younghyun Kim, Wooseok Seo, Minseo Kim, Seunghyuk Oh, Minjae Lee, Donghoon Kim, Hyung Il Koo, Jaehyung Kim, Wonjun Kang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes whether agent harness optimization elicits existing capability or expands task coverage, comparing it with scaling and inference compute across difficulty. This gives substantive evidence on evaluation of agent systems, but it does not explain internal model mechanisms or compositional generalization; reasoning is relevant mainly through task capability measurement.

    本文分析智能体 harness 优化究竟是在启发已有能力，还是在扩展任务覆盖范围，并按照难度将其与模型扩展和推理计算量进行比较。这为智能体系统评估提供了实质性证据，但没有解释模型内部机制或组合泛化；其与推理的相关性主要体现在任务能力测量上。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent studies in harness optimization have shown substantial performance gains in language model agents without updating model weights. A well-designed harness more effectively leverages the underlying model's capabilities by shaping context, tool use, and execution workflows. However, na\"ive success rates alone do not fully characterize whether optimized harness yields more reliable success on tasks already within reach (elicitation) or a broader range of solvable tasks (expansion). This distinction is crucial for recursive self-improvement and evolutionary search, as expansion may provide a broader range of successful experiences to push the capability boundaries. Despite the growing significance, this distinction remains underexplored in harness optimization. We conduct a systematic analysis to study the effect of gains from harness optimization. Building on pass@k analyses in the reinforcement learning (RL) literature that compare models before and after RL training, we compare optimized harnesses with their pre-optimization counterparts. Specifically, we assess changes in reachable task coverage, compare harness optimization with model scaling and increased inference-time compute, and examine how gains vary with task difficulty. Across static prediction and dynamic tasks, we find that pass@1 advantages of harness over stronger interventions can reverse at larger attempt budgets and aggregate gains conceal shortfalls on hard tasks, underscoring the need for a fine-grained diagnosis.

    中文

    近期关于 harness 优化的研究表明，无需更新模型权重，语言模型智能体的性能也能大幅提升。设计良好的 harness 能通过调整上下文、工具使用和执行工作流，更有效地发挥底层模型的能力。然而，仅凭朴素的成功率，无法充分判断优化后的 harness 是让原本已能完成的任务更可靠地成功（启发），还是扩大了可解决任务的范围（扩展）。这一区分对于递归自我改进和进化搜索至关重要，因为扩展可能提供范围更广的成功经验，推动能力边界向外拓展。尽管这一问题日益重要，harness 优化中的这一区分仍未得到充分研究。我们开展系统分析，研究 harness 优化所带来收益的影响。借鉴强化学习（RL）文献中用于比较 RL 训练前后模型的 pass@k 分析，我们比较优化后的 harness 与其优化前的版本。具体而言，我们评估可达任务覆盖范围的变化，将 harness 优化与模型扩展及增加推理时计算量进行比较，并考察收益如何随任务难度而变化。在静态预测和动态任务中，我们发现，harness 相较于更强干预措施所具有的 pass@1 优势，可能会在尝试次数较多时逆转；而汇总收益会掩盖模型在困难任务上的不足。这凸显了进行细粒度诊断的必要性。

    Zhiyuan Liu, Sicheng Liu, Haiyu Wu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces a trainable quantum prior for generating diverse futures in JEPA world models, with parameter-efficient sampling and correlated latent actions. Its main contribution is a model-system design; multi-agent futures and alternative continuations are application capabilities, without a substantive focus on compositional or general reasoning mechanisms.

    本文为 JEPA 世界模型引入了一种可训练的量子先验，用于生成多样化未来，并具备参数高效的采样方式和相关潜在动作。其主要贡献是模型系统设计；多智能体未来和不同后续发展属于应用能力，本文并未实质性关注组合推理或一般推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A single observation can admit several plausible futures, making uncertainty an essential part of world modelling. However, quantum generative models remain underexplored for this task. We introduce Quantum-JEPA, a latent-action JEPA framework that learns distributions of future representations using a conditional quantum Born prior. Circuit measurements generate binary latent actions, which a shared predictor maps to alternative future representations. We train the quantum prior through the quality and diversity of these predictions using a sampled energy objective. Our model learns distinct continuations on constructed multimodal tasks and captures latent-action correlations that support coordinated multi-agent futures. On D3IL, a benchmark of diverse human demonstrations, our trained models generate multiple obstacle-crossing routes from a common starting point without observed motion. On the controlled tasks, our classical and quantum prior implementations improve prediction validity and distributional fidelity over the evaluated variational baselines. Our quantum priors combine competitive predictive quality with a parameter-efficient sampling structure: they avoid an exponentially sized categorical output layer while supporting correlated latent actions. We further validate finite-shot parameter-shift training, including training with readout noise. Unlike most prior work, which focuses on simulation, we also verify the feasibility of inference with trained priors on a real QPU. These results establish a trainable quantum component for JEPA future prediction and a basis for exploring quantum-enhanced world models at larger scales.

    Why Do LLMs Accept Generics? Explaining Acceptability using Psycholinguistic and Model-Derived Factors

    为什么 LLM 会接受类指称句？利用心理语言学和模型派生因素解释可接受性

    Mervat Abassy, Zhaoxin Feng, Tatsuki Kuribayashi, Kentaro Inui, Emmanuele Chersoni

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The study tests how psycholinguistic factors shape LLM judgments and reports that moving hidden states along factor directions changes those judgments, offering a mechanistic link between representations and behavior. It examines acceptability judgments rather than compositional generalization, reasoning processes, or system organization.

    这项研究检验心理语言学因素如何影响 LLM 的判断，并报告沿因素方向移动隐藏状态会改变这些判断，从而揭示表征与行为之间的机制联系。它研究的是可接受性判断，而非组合泛化、推理过程或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Psycholinguistic studies explore why humans accept some generic statements but reject others by showing that these judgments depend on more than how common a property is. People consider several other factors such as how well it sets the kind apart from others or whether it is characteristic of the kind. Inspired by the linguistic and cognitive literature, we explore to what extent factors from these studies explain how large language models (LLMs) judge generics. Our results with twelve models on a psycholinguistic dataset and on naturally occurring generics show that models weigh how common a property is against how well it distinguishes the kind, and combine the two much as people do, though less clearly. Like people, they favor characteristic properties, but unlike the accounts of human judgment, they ignore striking ones. What matters most to LLMs is whether a statement is factually true, and much of the influence of human factors reaches their ratings through that judgment.     ENGLISH

    Automated respiratory sound classification enables continuous, non-invasive respiratory assessment, yet long-term deployment remains challenging due to domain shifts from evolving recording devices and acquisition periods. When privacy and governance regulations prohibit replaying historical data, sequential learning easily overwrites previously acquired knowledge. Preserving dedicated domain experts prevents parameter interference, but selecting the correct expert at inference is difficult under overlapping acoustic distributions and absent domain labels. To resolve this dilemma, we propose APRIL, an exemplar-free domain-incremental framework for RSC. Built on a shared frozen BEATs backbone, APRIL sequentially inherits and isolates low-rank experts to enable new-domain adaptation without altering earlier models. A multi-level prototype router retrieves the top-two candidate experts and dynamically selects the final model by integrating domain-routing posteriors with classification confidence, adaptively weighted by matching ambiguity. We establish standardized device- and temporal-incremental benchmarks on the ICBHI and SPRSound datasets across forward and reversed domain orders. Evaluated over five random seeds, APRIL consistently achieves the highest final-session average Score among compared continual learning approaches, reaching 64.4% and 65.4% on ICBHI, and 83.1% and 82.2% on SPRSound under forward and reversed sequences, respectively. Crucially, average forgetting remains under 1.0% across all protocols, demonstrating robust domain adaptation and long-term knowledge retention without data replay. Overall, APRIL offers a reliable and privacy-preserving paradigm for deploying continuous respiratory sound classification across real-world healthcare settings.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recent advances in large (vision) language models have enabled computer-use agents that automate digital workflows via fine-grained keyboard and mouse operations. However, such agents remain fragile in long-horizon settings, where errors accumulate and executed actions leave unintended side effects, making the ability to recover from failures critical. Yet, existing remedies remain inadequate: environment resets are infeasible in proprietary settings, action replay is prohibitively expensive over long horizons, and API-based rollback is limited to web environments, leaving model-based recovery largely unexplored. To address this gap, we present ReTrace, a scalable evaluation framework for systematically studying recovery behavior in computer-use agents. We formalize Transition-Consistent Recovery: identical downstream actions from the recovered and target states must yield identical outcomes. We operationalize this criterion through goal-oriented action replay following controlled error injection. Using ReTrace, we present the first systematic study of autonomous, model-based recovery, revealing that (i) ideal recovery can unlock model's latent task completion capabilities, (ii) current computer-use agents fail to exploit their latent recovery capabilities, and (iii) accurate model-based recovery yields measurable end-to-end gains. Together, these findings establish recovery as a fundamental capability for building reliable computer-use agents. Our code and dataset is available at https://github.com/BangProx/ReTRACE.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Can humans and artificial intelligence cooperate such that their combination yields greater accuracy than either agent alone? This result, termed \emph{synergy} or \emph{complementarity}, is notoriously difficult to achieve, even when both agents possess significant independent accuracy. In this paper, we present a formal framework to model human-AI interaction through the lens of reliance patterns, which characterize the joint correctness structure of human and algorithmic decisions. We derive mathematically necessary and sufficient conditions for synergy, demonstrating that its emergence depends on the ability of either agent to identify and correct the errors of the other, what we call Human and Algorithmic Correction. Beyond its theoretical contribution, the proposed framework provides a foundation for the design and evaluation of knowledge-based decision support systems, where interaction policies must dynamically integrate heterogeneous sources of expertise. We demonstrate this through the analysis of seven clinical case studies. Our empirical results reveal a ``dominance trap,'' where a strong algorithmic advantage can paradoxically inhibit synergy by eroding human corrective intervention. We also show that synergy can persist even in the presence of cognitive biases, such as automation bias, provided there is functional de-correlation between human and AI errors. These results provide a formal foundation for key concepts in the human-AI systems literature and offer actionable insights for designing interaction-centric AI systems that foster complementarity.

    Dancing Diffusion: Learning Continuous Programs for Image Generation and Editing

    舞动扩散：学习用于图像生成与编辑的连续程序

    Cui Enhe, Jinyue Yang, Bojian Yin, Guoqi Li

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Dancing Diffusion turns timestep conditioning into a learned program of reusable, addressable operations, with shared-prefix execution and preservation of earlier content. This substantially advances compositional generation, while latent conditions alone do not reveal model mechanisms and the described trajectory control provides only limited systems or reasoning insight.

    Dancing Diffusion 将时间步条件化转化为由学习得到的、可重复使用且可寻址的操作程序，并通过共享前缀执行来保留先前内容。这显著推动了组合式生成；不过，潜在条件本身无法揭示模型机制，文中描述的轨迹控制对系统或推理的洞见也有限。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Diffusion models generate samples through a multi-step denoising trajectory, yet condition every step on the same instruction, so the trajectory cannot be addressed at the level of individual operations. We introduce Dancing Diffusion, which assigns each span of timesteps a dedicated continuous condition block and thereby turns conditioning into a latent program. A compiler maps text features into this program, and a fixed pretrained generator executes its blocks over successive sampling intervals. The trajectory can then dance, keeping its executed history while its continuation is redirected. A shared prefix is executed once and reused, and a later operation is rewritten while content fixed by earlier operations is preserved. The compiler is trained through the images it produces, with visual feedback on both the requested change and the retained content. On SANA, reusing an executed prefix preserves markedly more of the scene than regenerating from noise at a similar strength of edit, learned conditions preserve more background than native prompt switching from the same saved state, and the learned program improves generation quality over native SANA. Later branches weaken the edit, which leaves semantic control over individual operations limited. By converting a single-instruction trajectory into a program of addressable operations, Dancing Diffusion lays a foundation for structured intermediate computation in diffusion models.

    中文

    扩散模型通过多步去噪轨迹生成样本，但每一步都以同一条指令为条件，因此无法在单个操作的层面上对轨迹进行寻址。我们提出 Dancing Diffusion，为每个时间步区间分配一个专属的连续条件块，从而将条件化转化为潜在程序。编译器将文本特征映射到该程序中，固定的预训练生成器则在连续的采样区间内执行其中的各个块。随后，轨迹可以起舞：保留已执行的历史，同时改变后续轨迹的方向。共享前缀只执行一次并重复使用；后续操作可以改写，同时保留由先前操作确定的内容。编译器通过其生成的图像进行训练，并根据请求的变化和保留的内容获得视觉反馈。在 SANA 上，与以相近编辑强度从噪声重新生成相比，重复使用已执行的前缀能保留场景中显著更多的内容；与从同一保存状态进行原生提示词切换相比，学习得到的条件能保留更多背景；学习得到的程序也提升了相较于原生 SANA 的生成质量。后续分支会削弱编辑效果，因此对单个操作的语义控制仍然有限。Dancing Diffusion 将单指令轨迹转化为可寻址操作程序，为扩散模型中的结构化中间计算奠定了基础。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RANGER trains a graph-navigation policy using an LLM's semantic path evaluations as dense reinforcement-learning rewards, improving retrieval in a question-answering pipeline. This is a substantial agent and training-system contribution, with reasoning relevant mainly as task context and no clear evidence of compositional generalization or internal model mechanisms.

    RANGER 使用 LLM 对路径的语义评估作为密集强化学习奖励来训练图导航策略，从而改善问答流程中的检索效果。这是一项重要的智能体与训练系统贡献；推理主要是任务背景，且没有明确证据表明该方法实现了组合泛化或揭示了模型内部机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    The integration of Large Language Models and Reinforcement Learning offers a promising direction for complex sequential decision-making tasks, such as multi-hop question answering over knowledge graphs. While LLMs provide strong semantic understanding and reasoning capabilities, they often struggle with precise, multi-step navigation in structured environments. Conversely, RL agents excel at learning navigation policies but are hindered by the difficulty of designing semantically meaningful reward functions. This paper introduces a novel hybrid approach in which an LLM serves as a mentor to an RL agent during training by providing dense, semantically informed reward signals. The RL agent, built on a Transformer-based policy and trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization, learns to navigate a knowledge graph to retrieve relevant information. The LLM evaluates the semantic relevance of the agent's traversed paths, generating reward signals that align the agent's behavior with the information needs expressed in a query. We integrate this Retrieval Agent for Navigating Graphs with Semantic Evaluation Rewards (RANGER) into a complete question-answering pipeline and evaluate it on the open question answering datasets. Experimental results show that the proposed approach outperforms both a baseline retrieval-augmented system with classical graph search and one using an RL agent trained with heuristic rewards, achieving a significant increase in NLP metrics and LLM-as-a-Judge scores. Our findings demonstrate that deep integration of LLMs into the RL training loop yields more effective and semantically aligned retrieval policies for complex reasoning tasks.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）与强化学习（RL）的结合，为知识图谱上的多跳问答等复杂序贯决策任务提供了一个有前景的方向。LLM 具有强大的语义理解与推理能力，但往往难以在结构化环境中进行精确的多步导航。相反，RL 智能体擅长学习导航策略，却受限于难以设计语义上有意义的奖励函数。本文提出一种新颖的混合方法：在训练期间，LLM 作为导师，为 RL 智能体提供密集且包含语义信息的奖励信号。该 RL 智能体基于 Transformer 策略构建，并使用 Group Relative Policy Optimization 训练，能够在知识图谱中导航以检索相关信息。LLM 会评估智能体所经过路径的语义相关性，并生成奖励信号，使智能体的行为与查询表达的信息需求相一致。我们将这一利用语义评估奖励进行图导航的检索智能体（Retrieval Agent for Navigating Graphs with Semantic Evaluation Rewards，RANGER）整合进完整的问答流程，并在开放式问答数据集上进行评估。实验结果表明，所提方法优于采用经典图搜索的基线检索增强系统，也优于使用启发式奖励训练的 RL 智能体系统，在 NLP 指标和 LLM-as-a-Judge 评分上均取得显著提升。研究结果表明，将 LLM 深度整合进 RL 训练环路，能够为复杂推理任务带来更有效、语义对齐程度更高的检索策略。

    Auditing Where Concept Bottleneck Accuracy Comes From on CUB

    审查 CUB 上概念瓶颈模型的准确率来源

    Sascha Saralajew, Eleonora Poeta, Eliana Pastor, Ammar Shaker

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper audits whether concept scores in concept bottleneck models reflect visual evidence or leak class information, using localization, occlusion, and architecture ablations to identify where that information enters. This is a substantial, transferable contribution to model representations and interpretability; the benchmark’s bird-classification setting does not establish contributions to the other directions.

    本文审查概念瓶颈模型中的概念分数反映的是视觉证据还是泄漏了类别信息，并通过定位、遮挡和架构消融确定这些信息从何处进入模型。这项工作对模型表示与可解释性作出了重要且可迁移的贡献；其鸟类分类基准并未证明它对其他方向有所贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) promise predictions that humans can inspect and correct through concepts such as "curved beak". Yet on CUB-200-2011, their standard benchmark, progress is measured like that of ordinary classifiers: by task and concept accuracy. Neither reveals whether the label is predicted from the exposed concept scores, or whether a concept is supported by visual evidence of that concept rather than by co-occurring features such as cues to the species as a whole. We audit where the accuracy of CBMs and Concept Embedding Models (CEMs) on CUB comes from. The CUB annotations are too noisy to explain it: class-level training labels agree with per-image annotations on only ~82% of image--concept pairs, and classifiers trained on per-image annotations reach only ~37% species accuracy. Leakage probes show that CEM predictions cannot be reconstructed from their concept scores; the missing class information sits in internal embeddings. We identify four design axes through which class information can enter concept scores---receptive field, shared versus concept-specific representations, norm-dependent scoring, and task supervision. An ablation shows that most of it enters through non-local features: restricting a ResNet50 backbone to local BagNet patches lowers the accuracy recoverable from concept scores from 72% to 43%, close to what ground-truth annotations support, while joint training raises it again at the cost of concept accuracy. Localization and occlusion show that locality makes grounding measurable but does not guarantee it: under class-level labels, local concept scores use the head as a proxy for body, wing, and tail concepts, and CEM concept scores barely respond to occluding their supporting part. Task and concept accuracy should thus support, not drive, the evaluation of CBMs, and given the noisy annotations, CUB accuracy gaps should not be overinterpreted.

    中文

    概念瓶颈模型（CBM）承诺通过诸如“弯曲的喙”之类的概念提供可由人检查和纠正的预测。然而，在其标准基准 CUB-200-2011 上，模型进展的衡量方式与普通分类器相同：任务准确率和概念准确率。这两项指标都无法说明标签是否是根据公开的概念分数预测的，也无法说明某个概念是否得到该概念本身的视觉证据支持，而非由整个物种的线索等共现特征支持。我们审查了 CUB 上 CBM 和概念嵌入模型（CEM）的准确率来源。CUB 标注的噪声太大，无法解释这些准确率：类别级训练标签与逐图像标注在仅约 82% 的图像—概念对上相符，而使用逐图像标注训练的分类器，物种准确率仅约为 37%。泄漏探测表明，无法从 CEM 的概念分数重建其预测；缺失的类别信息存在于内部嵌入中。我们确定了类别信息可能进入概念分数的四个设计维度——感受野、共享表示与概念专属表示、依赖范数的评分，以及任务监督。消融实验表明，其中大部分信息来自非局部特征：将 ResNet50 骨干网络限制为局部 BagNet 图像块后，从概念分数中可恢复的准确率从 72% 降至 43%，接近真实标注所能支持的水平；而联合训练会再次提高这一准确率，但代价是概念准确率下降。定位和遮挡实验表明，局部性使概念落地情况可被测量，但并不能保证其成立：在类别级标签下，局部概念分数会把头部作为身体、翅膀和尾部概念的代理；遮挡其支持部位时，CEM 概念分数几乎没有响应。因此，任务准确率和概念准确率应当用于辅助评估 CBM，而不应主导评估；鉴于标注噪声较大，不应过度解读 CUB 上的准确率差距。

    Slot-JEPA: Object-Structured Prediction Interfaces for Latent World Models

    Slot-JEPA：面向潜在世界模型的对象结构化预测接口

    Peisong Wen, Qianqian Xu, Minye Lei, Siran Dai, Yang Liu, and Qingming Huang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    Slot-JEPA contributes reusable object-structured latent interfaces and transition memory for goal-conditioned planning, with results on visual transfer and planning. Its explicit slots are engineered representations rather than an investigation of learned mechanisms, so MechInterp remains low; reusable structure is relevant to composition, but composition is not the central contribution.

    Slot-JEPA 为目标条件规划提供了可复用的对象结构化潜在接口和转移记忆，并在视觉迁移和规划任务上展示了结果。其显式槽位属于工程化表示，并非对学习所得机制的研究，因此 Mechanistic Interpretability（机制可解释性）的贡献较低；可复用结构与组合有关，但组合并非其核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    As a prototypical latent world model, Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provide strong semantic representations. However, dense patch representations expose a redundant interface to downstream predictors, which must implicitly infer spatial organization and temporal correspondence, presenting three challenges. First, object information is distributed across patches, forcing each downstream predictor to redundantly recover object structure that could otherwise be reused across tasks before modeling interactions. Second, the lack of explicit entity correspondence across time makes historical transitions expensive, restricting the predictor's flexibility in utilizing context. Third, without explicit transport structure, existing JEPA models typically use pointwise l1/l2 distances, which are insensitive to spatial displacement when predicted and goal supports are largely disjoint. We propose the Slot-based Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (Slot-JEPA), which decomposes dense representations into stable semantic slots and time-varying spatial masks. Pretrained once and frozen downstream, this decomposition exposes a reusable object-structured interface. Building on it, our Transition Memory Predictor (TMP) stores visual transitions as compact masks and retrieves useful context using statistics of corresponding slots. Its two branches separate slot-specific dynamics from shared cross-slot dynamics. We further use Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT) to supervise mask prediction and evaluate candidate plans by transporting mass between aligned predicted and goal masks, providing a signal better aligned with spatial progress. Across seven visual-understanding benchmarks, the slot-reconstructed features remain transferable. Slot-JEPA also improves goal-conditioned planning across six planar environments and four robotic arm planning tasks on the REALM-JEPA benchmark.

    中文

    作为一种典型的潜在世界模型，联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）能够提供强大的语义表示。然而，密集图像块表示向下游预测器暴露了冗余接口，预测器必须隐式推断空间组织和时间对应关系，由此带来三项挑战。第一，对象信息分散在各个图像块中，迫使每个下游预测器重复恢复对象结构；而在对交互进行建模之前，这种结构本可跨任务复用。第二，缺少跨时间的显式实体对应关系，使历史转移的处理代价高昂，限制了预测器灵活利用上下文的能力。第三，由于缺乏显式传输结构，现有 JEPA 模型通常使用逐点 l1/l2 距离；当预测掩码和目标掩码大部分不相交时，这类距离对空间位移不敏感。我们提出基于槽位的联合嵌入预测架构（Slot-JEPA），将密集表示分解为稳定的语义槽位和随时间变化的空间掩码。该分解只需预训练一次，并在下游任务中冻结，由此提供可复用的对象结构化接口。在此基础上，我们的转移记忆预测器（TMP）将视觉转移存储为紧凑掩码，并利用对应槽位的统计量检索有用上下文。它的两个分支分别处理槽位特定动态和跨槽位共享动态。我们还使用非平衡最优传输（UOT）监督掩码预测，并通过在对齐的预测掩码与目标掩码之间传输质量来评估候选规划，从而提供与空间进展更一致的信号。在七个视觉理解基准上，槽位重建特征保持了可迁移性。Slot-JEPA 还在 REALM-JEPA 基准上的六种平面环境和四项机械臂规划任务中提升了目标条件规划性能。

    Jarek Liesen, Matthew T. Jackson, Benjamin Ellis, Shimon Whiteson, Jakob N. Foerster

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MoDDiT learns token-level routing to allocate computation dynamically across content and denoising steps, reducing generation costs; the learned allocation is also interpretable. This advances conditional computation in model systems, while interpretability is a secondary property and the abstract gives no evidence of internal representation or reasoning mechanisms.

    MoDDiT 学习令牌级路由，根据内容和去噪步骤动态分配计算量，从而降低生成成本；学习得到的分配方式也具有可解释性。这项工作推动了模型系统中的条件计算；不过，可解释性是次要属性，摘要也没有提供模型内部表示或推理机制的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Real-time video generation, interactive world models, and on-device image synthesis are almost a reality. Diffusion Transformers (DiT) achieve excellent sample quality, shifting the bottleneck to the throughput of the models themselves. Natural images are inherently sparse, as large portions of an image are often background, contribute little to the scene content, and are easy to denoise. DiTs fail to exploit this sparsity, as they process image tokens statically and uniformly. We propose MoDDiT, a simple architecture modification that learns to route tokens through both MLP and self-attention operations. By routing tokens through both blocks independently, MoDDiT allows for dynamic compute allocation in MLPs that varies across tokens, images, and denoising timesteps. Using MoDDiT to train image generation models from scratch significantly reduces computational costs of training and inference, processing as few as 12.5% of the tokens. By increasing sparsity and model depth, MoDDiT reduces costs and improves generation performance over unrouted baselines. The learned allocation is interpretable, revealing how computation varies with visual content and noise level. We also use MoDDiT to train video generation models, where allocation correlates with motion, and to distill a dense bidirectional video model into a sparse autoregressive student.

    中文

    实时视频生成、交互式世界模型和设备端图像合成几乎已成为现实。扩散 Transformer（DiT）能够生成高质量样本，因此瓶颈转向了模型本身的吞吐量。自然图像本质上具有稀疏性：图像中的大部分区域通常是背景，对场景内容贡献很小，而且易于去噪。DiT 未能利用这种稀疏性，因为它们以静态且均匀的方式处理图像令牌。我们提出 MoDDiT，这是一种简单的架构改动，能够学习将令牌路由到 MLP 和自注意力操作中。通过分别将令牌路由到这两个模块，MoDDiT 能够在 MLP 中动态分配计算量，且计算量随令牌、图像和去噪时间步而变化。使用 MoDDiT 从头训练图像生成模型，可显著降低训练和推理的计算成本，令牌处理量最低可降至 12.5%。通过提高稀疏度和模型深度，MoDDiT 在降低成本的同时，提升了相较于未进行路由的基线模型的生成性能。学习得到的分配方式具有可解释性，揭示了计算量如何随视觉内容和噪声水平变化。我们还使用 MoDDiT 训练视频生成模型，此时计算分配与运动相关；此外，我们将一个密集的双向视频模型蒸馏为一个稀疏的自回归学生模型。

    面向临时接管期间 UAS 导航的中断感知循环强化学习

    Christopher Conrad, Deepak Panda, Weisi Guo, Antonios Tsourdos

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The work studies how interruptions alter recurrent hidden-state information and introduces architectures that preserve task-relevant context for safer handback, a substantial contribution to resilient agent design. Hidden-state decodability is a limited mechanistic analysis; navigation and policy optimization do not provide a central reasoning contribution.

    本文研究中断如何改变循环隐藏状态中的信息，并提出保留任务相关上下文、以实现更安全控制权交还的架构，为韧性智能体设计作出了重要贡献。对隐藏状态可解码性的分析在机制层面有限；导航和策略优化并未带来核心的推理贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Safe autonomous navigation of UASs requires tactical deconfliction to address conflicts that strategic coordination cannot prevent. This task is challenging under partial observability, when sensor or traffic data are missing, delayed, or degraded. Geometry-based methods can offer separation assurances but face limitations in dense encounters. Recurrent reinforcement learning has therefore been proposed to learn navigation policies that integrate observation-action histories to optimise long-term safety-efficiency trade-offs. However, operational safeguards may require a remote pilot, onboard detect-and-avoid system, or runtime assurance mechanism to temporarily override the learned policy. A research gap remains in understanding how these interruptions affect recurrent policies when the agent regains authority. Benchmark evidence shows that interruptions make task variables less decodable from the recurrent hidden state and increase post-interruption collision risk. The findings suggest that altered recurrent context prolongs post-handback degradation through an action-observation feedback loop, in which changed actions alter the flight path and subsequent recurrent updates. To address this vulnerability, we propose three interruption-aware architectures that condition recurrent processing on interruption context through separate feature streams, dedicated interruption memory, or gated environmental features. Across simulations, all three architectures preserve more decodable task information than a standard recurrent policy. Moreover, the strongest architecture reduces post-interruption collisions by 74% and interruption-induced mission failures by 69% relative to the recurrent baseline, without degrading interruption-free performance. These results show that safe interruption does not guarantee safe handback, and support interruption-aware recurrent design for resilient UAS autonomy.

    中文

    UAS 的安全自主导航需要通过战术级冲突消解，处理战略协调无法避免的冲突。在部分可观测条件下，这项任务尤其具有挑战性，因为传感器或交通数据可能缺失、延迟或质量下降。基于几何的方法能够提供间隔保障，但在密集遭遇情况下存在局限。因此，人们提出了循环强化学习，通过整合观测—动作历史来学习导航策略，以优化长期安全性与效率之间的权衡。然而，运行保障措施可能要求远程飞行员、机载探测与避让系统或运行时保障机制暂时接管已学习的策略。关于智能体重新获得控制权时，这类中断如何影响循环策略，仍存在研究空白。基准实验的证据表明，中断会降低从循环隐藏状态中解码任务变量的能力，并增加中断后的碰撞风险。研究结果表明，循环上下文发生变化后，动作—观测反馈环路会延长控制权交还后的性能退化：动作变化会改变飞行路径，进而影响后续的循环状态更新。为解决这一脆弱性，我们提出三种中断感知架构，通过独立特征流、专用中断记忆或门控环境特征，使循环处理过程以中断上下文为条件。在各项模拟中，这三种架构保留的可解码任务信息都多于标准循环策略。此外，与循环基线相比，性能最强的架构将中断后碰撞减少了 74%，将中断引发的任务失败减少了 69%，同时不降低无中断时的性能。这些结果表明，安全中断并不保证安全交还，并支持采用中断感知循环设计来实现更具韧性的 UAS 自主能力。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    DirectWAM distills iterative video and action experts into single-step predictors, training futures according to downstream action accuracy and reducing control latency. This advances robot-control computation, while future representations and action prediction are used for application performance without a central interpretability, compositionality, or reasoning contribution.

    DirectWAM 将迭代式视频专家和动作专家蒸馏为单步预测器，并根据下游动作准确率训练未来预测，从而降低控制延迟。这推进了机器人控制计算的发展；不过，未来表征和动作预测在此用于提升应用性能，并未对可解释性、组合性或推理作出核心贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Cascade world-action models (WAMs) use predicted visual futures to condition robot actions, but inherit costly iterative inference from diffusion-pretrained experts. We ask what a single-step predicted future must preserve to support accurate single-step action prediction. In the evaluated WAM, resampling video noise has little effect on downstream actions, yet naively truncating both streams to one step substantially reduces task success. Video-space supervision only partially closes this gap, and a local sensitivity analysis shows that vision prediction errors have highly unequal consequences for action accuracy. These findings motivate DirectWAM, which converts pretrained video and action experts into single-step predictors without stochastic sampling through action-sufficient distillation, while retaining the explicit future-to-action cascade. After learning a one-step action model, we train the future predictor by decoding actions from its own predicted futures and backpropagating demonstration action error through the expert, with an optional future-latent reconstruction loss. The resulting objective evaluates the student-generated future through its downstream control consequences rather than relying on representation matching alone. DirectWAM achieves 97.1% average success across four LIBERO suites and 85.4% on RoboTwin 2.0, outperforming Flash-WAM at the same one-evaluation-per-stream budget. This advantage has also extended to three real-world tasks that we designed. Compared with the full iterative teacher, it reduces inference latency by $28.0\times$.

    中文

    级联世界-动作模型（WAM）利用预测的视觉未来来条件化机器人动作，但也继承了由扩散预训练专家带来的高成本迭代推理。我们探究单步预测的未来必须保留哪些信息，才能支持准确的单步动作预测。在所评估的 WAM 中，重新采样视频噪声对下游动作影响很小，但直接将两条流都截断为一步会大幅降低任务成功率。视频空间监督只能部分弥合这一差距，局部敏感性分析则显示，视觉预测误差对动作准确率的影响极不均等。这些发现促使我们提出 DirectWAM：通过动作充分蒸馏，将预训练的视频专家和动作专家转化为单步预测器，无需随机采样，同时保留显式的未来到动作级联。在学习单步动作模型之后，我们通过从其自身预测的未来中解码动作来训练未来预测器，并将演示动作误差经由专家反向传播，同时可选地加入未来潜变量重建损失。由此得到的目标函数依据学生模型生成的未来对下游控制造成的影响来评估该未来，而不只是依赖表征匹配。DirectWAM 在四个 LIBERO 套件上的平均成功率达到 97.1%，在 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到 85.4%，在每条流仅评估一次的预算下优于 Flash-WAM。这一优势也已扩展到我们设计的三个真实世界任务。与完整的迭代教师模型相比，它降低了推理延迟，降幅为 $28.0\times$.

    面向 LLM 时序知识图谱推理的时序证据—参数协同对齐

    Jiapu Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    TEPCA combines temporally coherent evidence retrieval with timestamp-conditioned LoRA to improve LLM reasoning over temporal knowledge graphs, supported by benchmark results. DG-LoRA’s changing adaptation subspace offers limited insight into model representations, while path pruning uses structure without advancing compositional generalization; the main contribution is a reasoning method, with parameter adaptation as a secondary systems contribution.

    TEPCA 将时间上连贯的证据检索与时间戳条件化 LoRA 相结合，提升 LLM 在时序知识图谱上的推理能力，并以基准测试结果为支撑。DG-LoRA 的适配子空间变化对模型表示提供的洞见有限；路径剪枝虽然利用结构，却未推动组合泛化。其主要贡献是一种推理方法，参数适配则是次要的系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large Language Models (LLMs) often struggle with temporally grounded reasoning because their static parametric memory is misaligned with the dynamic evolution of real-world knowledge. Although RAG and Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) provide practical ways to enhance LLMs, they remain insufficient for temporal reasoning. Existing retrieval methods typically prioritize semantic relevance while overlooking temporal validity, event order, and evolutionary dependencies, resulting in evidence that is relevant in isolation but temporally fragmented. Meanwhile, conventional PEFT methods usually employ fixed and input-agnostic low-rank updates, making it difficult to capture time-dependent entity semantics and relation drift. To address these limitations, we propose Temporal Evidence-Parameter Co-Alignment (TEPCA), a framework for LLM reasoning over TKGs. TEPCA aligns LLM reasoning with temporal knowledge at both the evidence and parameter levels. At the evidence level, it introduces time-constrained Dynamic Relevance-Guided Path (DRGP) pruning to preserve globally coherent temporal paths, together with Mutual-Information (MI)-based pruning to retain query-informative local facts under temporal constraints. At the parameter level, it integrates Dynamic-Gated LoRA (DG-LoRA), a timestamp-conditioned low-rank adaptation mechanism that dynamically modulates the effective adaptation subspace according to temporal context. This design enables LLMs to better capture fine-grained entity evolution and time-dependent relation semantics while preserving parameter efficiency. Experimental results on two TKG benchmarks demonstrate that TEPCA achieves state-of-the-art performance. Additional evaluations of DG-LoRA on eight commonsense QA datasets further verify its general input-adaptive capacity, scalability across LLM backbones, and interpretability.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）的静态参数记忆与现实世界知识的动态演变并不匹配，因此往往难以进行有时间依据的推理。尽管检索增强生成（RAG）和参数高效微调（PEFT）提供了增强 LLM 的实用方法，但对于时序推理仍然不够充分。现有检索方法通常优先考虑语义相关性，却忽略时间有效性、事件顺序和演化依赖关系，因此检索到的证据单独看虽相关，时间上却支离破碎。与此同时，传统 PEFT 方法通常采用固定且与输入无关的低秩更新，难以捕捉依赖时间的实体语义和关系漂移。为解决这些局限，我们提出面向时序知识图谱（TKG）推理的框架——时序证据—参数协同对齐（TEPCA）。TEPCA 在证据和参数两个层面上，使 LLM 推理与时序知识对齐。在证据层面，它引入受时间约束的动态相关性引导路径（DRGP）剪枝，以保留全局连贯的时序路径；同时采用基于互信息（MI）的剪枝，在时间约束下保留对查询有信息价值的局部事实。在参数层面，它整合动态门控 LoRA（DG-LoRA），这是一种由时间戳条件化的低秩适配机制，可根据时间上下文动态调节有效的适配子空间。该设计使 LLM 能够更好地捕捉细粒度的实体演变和依赖时间的关系语义，同时保持参数高效。两个 TKG 基准上的实验结果表明，TEPCA 达到了当前最优性能。对 DG-LoRA 在八个常识问答数据集上的额外评估进一步验证了其通用的输入自适应能力、在不同 LLM 骨干网络上的可扩展性以及可解释性。

    Matteo Cercola, Katie Z Luo, Simone Formentin, Marco Pavone

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses counterfactual analysis to show that hazards are represented in a driving VLA but weakly control trajectory generation, then adds hazard-conditioned guidance at sampling time. This provides a substantial mechanistic account of model behavior, while its reasoning-trace analysis is secondary and it does not study compositionality or model-system organization.

    本文通过反事实分析表明，危险虽已在驾驶 VLA 中得到表征，却难以控制轨迹生成；随后在采样时加入以危险为条件的引导。这为模型行为提供了有力的机制性解释，而对推理轨迹的分析是次要的，且未研究组合性或模型系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reasoning-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) driving models can perceive and reason about safety-critical hazards yet fail to translate that evidence into safe actions. We characterize this failure as a perception-action binding gap: hazard information is available inside the model but exerts insufficient control over trajectory generation. Using matched simulated counterfactuals and logged driving replay, we show that in-path hazards are actually encoded in the visual representation, but longitudinal plans are dominated by ego-speed history and respond only weakly to hazard proximity or the model's own reasoning trace. Further analysis shows that the trajectory generator is capable of braking but sometimes fails to do so due to the perception-action binding gap. Without retraining or modifying any weights, we inject a hazard-conditioned energy into the frozen flow-matching sampler of Alpamayo-1.5, restoring the missing coupling at generation time. With exact obstacle geometry, guidance cuts footprint intrusion from 58.1% to 14.5% and recovers safe braking whenever sufficient stopping distance remains, eliminating collisions entirely in our braking-relevant closed-loop battery. It also reverses the diagnosed dependence of the plan, from tracking ego speed to responding to obstacle range. These results separate hazard perception from hazard control in driving VLAs, show that unsafe behavior can arise even when the model has both the evidence and the ability to act on it, and propose a simple fix for bridging this binding gap.

    中文

    增强了推理能力的视觉—语言—动作（VLA）驾驶模型能够感知安全关键型危险并进行推理，却无法将这些证据转化为安全动作。我们将这种失败界定为感知—动作绑定鸿沟：危险信息存在于模型内部，却无法充分控制轨迹生成。通过匹配的模拟反事实实验和记录的驾驶回放，我们表明，路径上的危险实际上已编码在视觉表征中，但纵向规划主要受自车速度历史支配，对危险接近程度或模型自身推理轨迹的响应都很弱。进一步分析表明，轨迹生成器具备制动能力，但有时会因感知—动作绑定鸿沟而未能制动。无需重新训练或修改任何权重，我们将一种以危险为条件的能量注入 Alpamayo-1.5 的冻结流匹配采样器，在生成时恢复缺失的耦合。在障碍物几何信息精确的情况下，该引导将车身轮廓侵入率从 58.1% 降至 14.5%；只要剩余制动距离足够，就能恢复安全制动，并在我们的制动相关闭环测试组中彻底消除碰撞。它还逆转了规划中已诊断出的依赖关系：规划从跟踪自车速度转为响应障碍物距离。这些结果将驾驶 VLA 中的危险感知与危险控制区分开来，表明即使模型既掌握相关证据又具备据此行动的能力，也可能出现不安全行为，并提出了一种弥合这一绑定鸿沟的简单修复方法。

    Offline Makes Online Better: Calibrated Cache Compression for Video Generation

    离线校准提升在线效果：面向视频生成的校准缓存压缩

    Zhen Wang, Ning Lai, Qingtao Yu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CALM calibrates layer- and head-specific token merging offline, then uses dynamic programming to allocate cache compression under an inference-time memory budget; this is a substantial systems contribution to video generation. Its attention-error proxy is for compression risk, not a study of internal representations or reasoning.

    CALM 离线校准特定于各层和注意力头的令牌合并，再使用动态规划，在推理时的内存预算内分配缓存压缩；这是对视频生成系统的一项重要贡献。其注意力误差代理指标用于评估压缩风险，并非研究内部表征或推理。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Token merging is an effective approach to reducing KV-cache memory consumption in autoregressive video generation by clustering temporally redundant tokens and retaining only a small set of representatives. Existing methods, however, typically apply a uniform merging ratio across all attention layers and heads. We observe that different layers and heads exhibit substantially different yet jointly correlated sensitivities to token merging, and that these sensitivity patterns remain consistent across prompts. Based on this observation, we introduce CALM, a Calibrated Allocation for Layer-Head Merging that uses offline calibration to improve online cache compression. Exhaustively evaluating all possible layer-head allocations is prohibitively expensive. To enable efficient calibration, we show that attention-output error strongly correlates with end-to-end video quality and can therefore serve as a lightweight proxy for allocation risk assessment. We evaluate different allocation strategies using this proxy and construct a fixed layer-head risk map offline. Given a cache budget at inference time, CALM uses dynamic programming to determine the best allocation of merging ratios. Experiments across three different autoregressive video models demonstrate that CALM consistently outperforms uniform token merging under the same memory budget, by reducing the LPIPS to original videos by around 21% with higher video-quality scores.

    中文

    在自回归视频生成中，令牌合并通过聚类时间上冗余的令牌并仅保留少量代表令牌，是降低 KV 缓存内存消耗的有效方法。然而，现有方法通常对所有注意力层和注意力头采用统一的合并比例。我们观察到，不同层和注意力头对令牌合并的敏感度差异显著，但彼此相关；并且这些敏感模式在不同提示之间保持一致。基于这一观察，我们提出 CALM，即用于层—头合并的校准分配方法，通过离线校准改进在线缓存压缩。穷举评估所有可能的层—头分配方案，成本高得难以承受。为实现高效校准，我们表明注意力输出误差与端到端视频质量高度相关，因此可作为轻量级代理指标来评估分配风险。我们使用这一代理指标评估不同的分配策略，并离线构建固定的层—头风险图。在推理时给定缓存预算后，CALM 使用动态规划确定合并比例的最佳分配。在三种不同自回归视频模型上的实验表明，在相同内存预算下，CALM 始终优于统一令牌合并：与原始视频相比，其 LPIPS 降低约 21%，视频质量得分也更高。

    Adaptive Pullback: Reweighting Supervision at Penalty Jumps in On-Policy Distillation

    自适应回拉：在策略蒸馏中对惩罚跃升处的监督重新加权

    Guangyu Liu, Siyuan Gan, Shilong Zhou, Linjian Meng, Boyan Wang, Jing Huo

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AP-OPD changes on-policy distillation supervision in response to local penalty jumps and improves mathematical reasoning and code generation, providing an algorithmic contribution to developing problem-solving capabilities. The abstract does not investigate reasoning mechanisms or systematic composition; distillation alone is only an incidental systems connection.

    AP-OPD 根据局部惩罚跃升调整在策略蒸馏的监督，并提升数学推理和代码生成的表现，为培养问题解决能力提供了算法贡献。摘要未研究推理机制或系统性组合；蒸馏与系统的联系仅属次要。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises student-generated responses using sampled-token student-teacher log-ratios. A positive log-ratio penalizes a token that the student assigns higher probability to than the teacher, but its current value does not distinguish sustained high penalties from abrupt increases along a response. We examine these local changes by comparing consecutive blocks of tokens within the same response. Our diagnostic identifies penalty jumps, abrupt increases in average penalty that persist on held-out tokens. Across these jumps, penalties rise while teacher confidence decreases. We call this pattern penalty-confidence tension. Boundaries into high-penalty blocks do not exhibit comparable confidence changes, showing that local changes provide information beyond the current penalty value. Motivated by this observation, we propose Adaptive Pullback OPD (AP-OPD). At each detected jump, AP-OPD uses the preceding block as a local reference and uniformly scales all supervision coefficients in the following block so that its weighted average penalty matches the preceding block's original mean. This reference determines the scaling factor without an additional strength constant. AP-OPD improves performance on both mathematical reasoning and code generation.

    中文

    在策略蒸馏（OPD）使用学生生成的响应，并通过采样令牌的学生—教师对数比值提供监督。正对数比值会惩罚学生赋予高于教师概率的令牌，但其当前值无法区分持续较高的惩罚与响应过程中突然的惩罚上升。我们通过比较同一响应中连续的令牌块来考察这些局部变化。我们的诊断方法识别出惩罚跃升，即平均惩罚突然升高且在留出令牌上仍持续的情况。在这些跃升处，惩罚上升，而教师置信度下降。我们将这种模式称为惩罚—置信度张力。进入高惩罚令牌块的边界并未表现出类似的置信度变化，这表明局部变化提供了当前惩罚值之外的信息。受此观察启发，我们提出自适应回拉 OPD（AP-OPD）。每当检测到跃升，AP-OPD 就使用前一个令牌块作为局部参照，并对后续令牌块中的所有监督系数进行统一缩放，使其加权平均惩罚与前一块的原始均值相匹配。该参照可确定缩放因子，无需额外的强度常数。AP-OPD 在数学推理和代码生成任务上均提升了性能。

    Cedric Derstroff, Jannis Bl\"uml, Janosch Moos, Michael Girstl, Zihan Ye, Debora Clever, Kristian Kersting

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces anchor-relative representations and an architecture that improve shift robustness and generalization to unseen distractor counts. This substantially advances compositional representation and transfer; the reinforcement learning setting connects to reasoning and agent systems, but the abstract does not claim a core advance in reasoning mechanisms or system organization.

    本文提出锚点相对表征及相应架构，提升了对场景平移的鲁棒性，并能泛化到未见过数量的干扰对象。这对组合式表征和迁移能力有显著推进；强化学习场景与推理和智能体系统相关，但摘要未声称在推理机制或系统组织方面取得核心进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Object-centric reinforcement learning agents typically receive each object's position in a fixed global frame, even though their decisions usually depend on where objects are relative to one another. These absolute views often fail to capture the local context that is most relevant to the agent's behavior. As a result, an agent must relearn the same response at every location where a configuration can occur, and its performance collapses when the scene is merely shifted. In this work, we propose a shift toward Object-Relative Coordinates fixed to Anchor (ORCA), where entities are described in a relative frame of reference. To operationalize this idea, we introduce Object-Relative inductive-Bias Transformers (ORBiT), a transformer-based architecture for processing anchor-relative inputs in reinforcement learning. Our results suggest these relative representations improve performance for both MLP and transformer agents. Furthermore, we demonstrate that ORBiT outperforms the pixel-based PPO baseline, achieving an aggregate HNS IQM greater than 1.0 over 13 Atari games. ORBiT learns the game of Foosball from scratch, dominating all baselines. In our controlled Tag environment, we further show that ORCA extends to rotations, that ORBiT generalizes to unseen numbers of distractors, and that these gains require a decision-relevant anchor.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    MaD-RSI optimizes a shared agent harness using failure trajectories from multiple LLMs, improving cross-model generalization and reducing training cost. This substantially advances agent-system design, while model diversity is used for optimization rather than studying internal mechanisms or compositional generalization; reasoning improvement is indirect.

    MaD-RSI 利用多个 LLM 的失败轨迹优化共享的智能体框架，提升了跨模型泛化能力并降低了训练成本。这对智能体系统设计有重要推进；其中模型多样性被用于优化，而非用于研究内部机制或组合式泛化；对推理能力的提升则是间接的。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Recursive self-improvement (RSI) of agent harnesses has emerged as an effective approach to enhancing the capabilities of large language model (LLM) agents. By searching the harness space for a specific LLM on a given dataset, RSI can discover a harness tailored to the capabilities and behavioral characteristics of that model. However, such optimization often creates a strong coupling between the learned harness and its target LLM, limiting generalization across models and requiring substantial computational resources to adapt to new LLMs. Moreover, existing RSI methods typically optimize a harness using feedback from a single model and evaluate its generalization to other models only after training. This paradigm treats model differences primarily as a criterion for evaluating generalization rather than as valuable evidence for optimization. In this paper, we introduce a new perspective that treats models as data and places the harness at the center of optimization. Building on this perspective, we propose \textsc{MaD-RSI}, a framework that directly optimizes a shared harness across multiple heterogeneous LLMs by incorporating their diverse failure trajectories into the training process. Rather than assessing model differences only after optimization, \textsc{MaD-RSI} leverages these differences as training evidence to guide the self-improvement of a shared harness. Furthermore, we introduce a new evaluation framework with two complementary metrics designed to assess the effectiveness of harness optimization across models. Experiments across multiple datasets and LLMs demonstrate that \textsc{MaD-RSI} improves generalization over existing approaches while reducing training costs.

    中文

    智能体框架的递归自我改进（RSI）已成为提升大型语言模型（LLM）智能体能力的一种有效方法。通过针对特定 LLM 在给定数据集上搜索框架空间，RSI 可以发现适配该模型能力和行为特征的框架。然而，这类优化往往会使学到的框架与其目标 LLM 高度耦合，从而限制跨模型泛化，并需要大量计算资源才能适配新的 LLM。此外，现有 RSI 方法通常利用单个模型的反馈来优化框架，并且只在训练后评估其向其他模型的泛化能力。这种范式主要将模型差异视为评估泛化能力的标准，而没有将其作为优化的有价值证据。在本文中，我们提出一种新的视角：将模型视为数据，并以框架为优化中心。基于这一视角，我们提出 extsc{MaD-RSI}，一种通过将多个异构 LLM 的不同失败轨迹纳入训练过程，直接优化跨模型共享框架的框架。与只在优化后评估模型差异不同， extsc{MaD-RSI} 将这些差异作为训练证据，指导共享框架的自我改进。此外，我们提出一种新的评估框架，其中包含两项互补指标，用于评估框架优化在不同模型间的有效性。在多个数据集和 LLM 上进行的实验表明， extsc{MaD-RSI} 提升了相较于现有方法的泛化能力，同时降低了训练成本。
