    Pratik Worah, Randall Bateman

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper compares how ablation of model components affects language abilities across architectures, finding distinct failure profiles for attention and feedforward pathways; this is a substantial mechanistic study of component function, while the aphasia analogy and task outcomes do not address compositionality, reasoning mechanisms, or system organization.

    本文比较了模型组件消融对不同架构语言能力的影响，并发现注意力通路和前馈通路具有不同的失效特征；这是一项重要的组件功能机制研究，而失语症类比和任务结果并未涉及组合性、推理机制或系统组织。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Progressive neuronal loss is the hallmark of neurodegenerative disease, yet how loss of neurons shapes the pattern of cognitive decline remains poorly understood. Here we systematically ablate neurons (computational units) in language models spanning recurrent long short-term memory (LSTM) and Transformer architectures and apply limited fine-tuning as a simple proxy for compensatory plasticity. With whole-unit ablation, LSTMs degrade gradually with syntactic and semantic faculties declining in parallel across mild-to-moderate damage. By contrast, Transformers exhibit late threshold-like collapse under feedforward multi-layer perceptron (MLP) ablation and smoother sigmoid-like decline under attention-head ablation. Qualitatively, MLP-ablated models continue to make within-category semantic substitutions (semantic paraphasias) alongside rising non-responses, paralleling Wernicke-type aphasia, while attention-head ablation produces a trend toward loss of semantic specificity similar to the semantic variant of primary progressive aphasia (svPPA). These findings indicate that feedforward and attentional pathways have functionally distinct failure modes, suggesting that architecture-dependent failure profiles may offer new computational perspectives on aphasic syndromes and neurodegenerative diseases as an in silico model. Notably, early accuracy retention under Transformer attention-head ablation qualitatively parallels pre-symptomatic reserve before the 40--60% neuronal loss reported by Gomez-Isla et al. (1996) when clinical symptoms emerge in Alzheimer's disease, whereas the steadier LSTM decline parallels the symptomatic progression described by DeKosky and Scheff (1990) and Terry et al. (1991).

    神经元进行性丧失是神经退行性疾病的标志，但神经元丧失如何塑造认知衰退模式仍未得到充分理解。在此，我们系统地消融横跨循环长短期记忆（LSTM）和 Transformer 架构的语言模型中的神经元（计算单元），并进行有限的微调，作为代偿性可塑性的简单代理。在整体单元消融下，LSTM 的性能逐步下降，轻度至中度损伤期间句法和语义能力同步衰退。相比之下，在前馈多层感知器（MLP）消融下，Transformer 会在后期出现阈值式崩溃；在注意力头消融下，则呈现更平缓的类 sigmoid 衰退。从定性上看，经过 MLP 消融的模型仍会产生类别内语义替换（语义性错语），同时无响应现象不断增加，这与 Wernicke 型失语症相似；而注意力头消融会导致语义具体性丧失的趋势，类似原发性进行性失语症的语义变异型（svPPA）。这些发现表明，前馈通路和注意力通路具有功能上不同的失效模式，说明依赖架构的失效特征或能以计算机内模拟模型的方式，为失语综合征和神经退行性疾病提供新的计算视角。值得注意的是，Transformer 在消融注意力头后早期仍能保持准确率，这在定性上类似于 Gomez-Isla et al. (1996) 报告的临床症状出现前储备期：临床症状在阿尔茨海默病中于神经元丧失 40--60% 后出现；而 LSTM 较为平稳的衰退则类似 DeKosky and Scheff (1990) 以及 Terry et al. (1991) 所描述的有症状期进展。

    长上下文 LLM 的本地推理：数据系统视角

    Mattias D\"urrmeier and Alberto Lerner

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper analyzes GPU bottlenecks in local long-context inference and identifies data-management issues involving attention, KV-cache paging, cache use, and synchronization; this advances inference systems, while complex tasks are context rather than a study of reasoning or internal representations.

    本文分析本地长上下文推理中的 GPU 瓶颈，并指出涉及注意力、KV 缓存分页、缓存利用和同步的数据管理问题；这推动了推理系统的发展，而复杂任务只是背景，并非对推理或内部表征的研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language models can solve complex problems across a variety of subjects, such as mathematics and coding. For such complex analytical tasks, models with a long context perform better. Serving models with long context is currently mostly done on powerful systems with multiple GPUs, which are too expensive for most users. An alternative is local inference, or serving a model on a user's own machine, which removes per-token costs and rate limits, besides keeping sensitive data private and giving users full control over the models they run. The common understanding, however, is that local LLMs need compression (e.g., quantization) to run on a single GPU. In this paper, we set out to study the limitations that prevent serving long-context models for single users, besides the capacity issue. Rather than characterizing a single model on one GPU, we analyze how different models behave across several GPU generations. This lets us uncover not just individual bottlenecks but broader trends in where inefficiencies arise. Our analysis confirms that, as expected, self-attention dominates the runtime for long-context inference. More unexpectedly, our evaluation reveals that the current structure of self-attention leaves key GPU resources significantly underutilized, and the newest GPU is often the least well served. Many of these findings are fundamentally data management problems, from paging the KV cache to improving cache utilization and synchronization in the GPU, which is why we bring this study to the Data Systems community. To engage this community, we present our findings as a series of experimental observations and formulate recommendations for future work.

    中文

    大型语言模型能够解决数学和编程等各个领域的复杂问题。对于这类复杂分析任务，长上下文模型表现更好。目前，长上下文模型的服务大多依赖配备多块 GPU 的强大系统，这对大多数用户而言成本过高。本地推理，即在用户自己的机器上运行模型，是一种替代方案；它可以免除按令牌计费和速率限制，同时保护敏感数据隐私，并让用户完全掌控所运行的模型。然而，普遍看法是，本地 LLM 需要经过压缩（例如量化）才能在单块 GPU 上运行。在本文中，我们着手研究除容量问题之外，妨碍单用户使用长上下文模型的限制因素。我们没有仅在一块 GPU 上描述单个模型，而是分析不同模型在多代 GPU 上的表现。这使我们能够发现个别瓶颈，也能揭示低效之处的更广泛趋势。我们的分析证实，如预期所料，自注意力在长上下文推理中主导运行时间。更出乎意料的是，我们的评估发现，当前自注意力的结构导致关键 GPU 资源利用率严重不足，而最新一代 GPU 往往最无法得到充分利用。这些发现中的许多从根本上说都是数据管理问题，涉及 KV 缓存分页、提升 GPU 中的缓存利用率与同步等；因此我们将这项研究带给数据系统领域的研究群体。为促进该领域的讨论，我们将发现整理为一系列实验观察，并提出未来工作的建议。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Adapting Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) to medical imaging via LoRA has become standard practice, yet model selection is guided almost entirely by downstream task metrics, treating backbones with similar performance as interchangeable. We investigate whether equal performance implies equal internal representational shift. We analyse four ViT-B/16 backbones, DINOv3, SigLIP2, MerMED-FM, and BiomedCLIP, pre-trained with different objectives (self-distillation vs. contrastive vision-language) and on different data domains (natural vs. medical images). We adapt each to brain tumour segmentation and evaluate on six datasets covering both segmentation and Alzheimer's disease classification. Using attention divergence, weight-change analysis, and activation patching, we find that the four models converge to similar segmentation performance (mean Dice 78-81%) through markedly different internal dynamics, yet diverge in cross-task transfer: segmentation adaptation improves Alzheimer's disease classification for DINOv3 but degrades it for the other three backbones. We reveal a dissociation between modification magnitude and causal importance: the most heavily modified layers are not the causally relevant ones, with early-to-mid layers identified as sufficient for segmentation recovery. Restricting LoRA to these layers matches or approaches full-layer segmentation while reducing classification degradation in the three affected backbones, providing a mechanistically grounded strategy that is more parameter-efficient and more robust than standard full-layer adaptation.

    Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced chart understanding and reasoning, yet their performance remains highly uneven across chart types. Tool-augmented agents can improve complex chart reasoning by introducing specialized visual capabilities, but manually engineering strategies and tools for the heterogeneous and evolving long tail is difficult to scale.     自适应重放细化：在修订与重新采样之间分配测试时计算量

    Ahsan Bilal, Muhammad Ahmed Mohsin, Muhammad Umer, Ayesha Mohsin, Sarmad Bilal, Dean F. Hougen

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    ARR detects when iterative revision has reached a fixed point and reallocates inference compute to independent sampling, improving efficiency on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. This is a substantial algorithmic contribution to test-time reasoning, with an incidental systems connection through compute allocation; it does not investigate model internals or composition.

    ARR 能检测迭代修订何时达到不动点，并将推理计算量重新分配给独立采样，从而提升数学推理基准上的效率。这是对测试时推理的一项重要算法贡献，并通过计算量分配与系统领域有所关联；本文没有研究模型内部机制或组合性。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Test-time scaling allocates additional inference compute to refining existing solutions or generating new ones. This raises a fundamental question: Should I keep improving this solution, or stop working on it and try a completely new solution? Existing methods make this decision using fixed refinement schedules, self-verification judgments, or learned controllers, which can waste compute or rely on signals that may be incorrect or require additional training. We introduce Adaptive Replay Refinement (ARR), a training-free method that detects when a stationary revision reaches a fixed point and reallocates the released compute to a new independent sample; replay decoding treats the current solution as a draft and verifies unchanged tokens in parallel, enabling efficient fixed-point detection. Across seven models from five families and seven benchmarks, ARR matches majority voting on three of five mathematical reasoning benchmarks at equal compute, while reducing critical-path serial passes by up to 2.4 times. On MATH500, ARR achieves 84.6% accuracy with only 41% of the serial passes required by majority voting. These results demonstrate that detecting refinement exhaustion enables adaptive reallocation from revision to independent sampling, improving inference efficiency while highlighting the limits of self-revision. Code is available at https://github.com/AhsanBilal7/adaptive_refine.

    测试时扩展会将额外推理计算量分配给已有解的细化或新解的生成。这引出了一个根本问题：我应该继续改进这个解，还是停止处理它并尝试一个全新的解？现有方法通过固定的细化计划、自我验证判断或学习得到的控制器来做出这一决定，这些方法可能浪费计算量，也可能依赖不准确的信号，或需要额外训练。我们提出自适应重放细化（ARR），这是一种无需训练的方法，可检测固定的修订过程何时达到不动点，并将释放出的计算量重新分配给一个新的独立样本；重放解码将当前解视为草稿，并并行验证未改变的词元，从而高效检测不动点。在来自五个系列的七个模型和七项基准测试中，在计算量相同的条件下，ARR 在五项数学推理基准中的三项上达到与多数投票相当的表现，同时将关键路径上的串行轮次最多减少至原来的 1/2.4。在 MATH500 上，ARR 仅使用多数投票所需串行轮次的 41%，就达到了 84.6% 的准确率。这些结果表明，检测细化过程何时耗尽能够将计算量自适应地从修订重新分配给独立采样，从而提高推理效率，并凸显自我修订的局限。代码见 https://github.com/AhsanBilal7/adaptive_refine。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper shows that reward misspecification makes chain-of-thought less monitorable and tests reward-description training as a mitigation, directly advancing understanding and training of reasoning behavior. Its RL and safety context is incidental to model-system design, and it does not study internal representations or compositional generalization.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Monitoring the chain-of-thought (CoT) of language models (LMs) is a key strategy for detecting and preventing misbehaviors for AI safety. As such, it is critical to identify reinforcement learning (RL) practices that lead to unmonitorable chain-of-thought. One such practice may be unavoidable: reward misspecification. As RL environments become more complex, it is infeasible to have perfect verification, and models are rewarded for behaviors that are different from the true task intent. We show that reward misspecification alone already degrades monitorability. We create a testbed with pairs of true reward aligned with task intent and misspecified rewards that favor a different behavior, so that reward hacking can be induced by training and labeled verifiably. Across three models and three tasks, CoT monitorability remains low as models' hack rates increase: the CoTs keep reasoning about the task intent while the outputs violate the intent and get rewarded. To mitigate unmonitorability without prior knowledge of the true reward or the hack, we collect rollouts with diverse rewards across training steps and use a LM to infer a reward description. We then inject the description into the input, which teaches the model to verbalize the reward. This reward description training improves monitorability by an average of 24% or 42% absolute, depending on the metric, across all models and tasks, and yields CoTs that reason about the misspecified reward explicitly. Code is available at https://github.com/Lorenayannnnn/reward-misspecification-degrades-cot-monitorability.

    中文

    监控语言模型（LM）的思维链（CoT）是检测并防止有害行为的一项关键 AI 安全策略。因此，识别会导致思维链无法监控的强化学习（RL）实践至关重要。其中一种实践或许不可避免：奖励设定错误。随着 RL 环境日益复杂，完美验证变得不可行，模型获得奖励的行为可能偏离任务的真实意图。我们表明，仅奖励设定错误本身就会削弱可监控性。我们构建了一个测试平台，其中包含与任务意图一致的真实奖励，以及偏向另一种行为的错误设定奖励，从而能通过训练诱发奖励劫持，并以可验证的方式标注。在三个模型和三项任务中，随着模型的劫持率上升，CoT 的可监控性仍然很低：CoT 仍围绕任务意图进行推理，但输出违背了该意图并因此获得奖励。为了在事先不知道真实奖励或劫持行为的情况下缓解不可监控性，我们收集不同训练步骤、对应多种奖励的轨迹，并使用一个 LM 推断奖励描述。随后，我们将该描述注入输入，以教会模型用语言表达奖励。跨所有模型和任务，这种奖励描述训练使可监控性平均提高 24% 或 42%（绝对值，具体取决于所用指标），并使 CoT 能明确围绕错误设定的奖励进行推理。代码见 https://github.com/Lorenayannnnn/reward-misspecification-degrades-cot-monitorability。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies how DSL representations let models expand abstract instructions into concrete actions, with strong empirical gains that advance compositional representation and generalization. Instruction execution connects secondarily to reasoning and agent behavior, but the abstract does not establish a broader reasoning mechanism or agent-system contribution.

    本文研究 DSL 表示如何使模型将抽象指令展开为具体动作，并通过显著的实证提升推进组合式表征与泛化。指令执行与推理及智能体行为也有次要关联，但摘要并未证明更广泛的推理机制或智能体系统贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Natural-language instructions often rely on high-level abstractions, such as asking an agent to ``stack blocks in a pyramid.'' Interpreting abstract instructions requires models to both identify the abstraction intended by the speaker, and unroll it into the many concrete actions that instantiate it. Language models struggle here: prior work has shown that performance degrades as the level of abstraction in the instruction rises. To bridge the gap between natural language abstraction and concrete actions, we propose to borrow from coding environments the notion of a {\em domain-specific language} (DSL), an explicit representation layer whose documented primitives name recurring abstractions that expand into concrete actions. We demonstrate the efficacy of DSLs for NL interpretation on \textsc{Hexagons}, a visually-grounded instruction-following task graded for abstraction. We further ask whether language models can induce such DSLs themselves from domain data. Our results show that while code generation consistently improves over direct inference, code generation over a human-curated DSL yields dramatic gains, up to 10 absolute F1 points, reaching the human skyline, with gains concentrated at {\em higher} abstraction levels. We confirm this pattern on the \textsc{Text2CAD} benchmark. At the same time, model-induced DSLs recover only part of this gain, remaining inconsistent across runs and short of their human-curated counterpart. Overall, the right representation closes much of the gap caused by high abstraction --- but inducing that layer of representation automatically is where models still fall short, and where we see a strong opportunity for the community to make progress.

    中文

    自然语言指令常常依赖高层抽象，例如要求智能体“把积木堆成金字塔”。解释抽象指令要求模型既识别说话者意图中的抽象概念，又将其展开为构成该概念的许多具体动作。语言模型在这方面表现不佳：已有研究表明，指令的抽象程度越高，模型表现越差。为了弥合自然语言抽象与具体动作之间的差距，我们提出借鉴编程环境中的领域专用语言（DSL）概念：这是一种显式表示层，其中有文档说明的基本操作命名了反复出现的抽象概念，并可将其展开为具体动作。我们在 Hexagons 上展示了 DSL 对自然语言（NL）解释的有效性；这是一项以视觉为基础、按抽象程度评分的指令遵循任务。我们还进一步探究语言模型能否根据领域数据自行归纳出此类 DSL。结果显示，尽管代码生成始终优于直接推理，但基于人工整理的 DSL 进行代码生成能带来显著提升，绝对 F1 分数最高提高 10 分，达到人类表现的上限；提升主要集中在更高的抽象层级。我们在 Text2CAD 基准上验证了这一模式。同时，模型归纳出的 DSL 仅能取得部分提升，在不同运行之间表现不稳定，且不及人工整理的 DSL。总体而言，恰当的表示能够弥合高抽象程度造成的大部分差距；但模型自动归纳这一表示层的能力仍然不足，这也为社区进一步研究提供了重要机会。

    Disclosure Begets Disclosure: A Self-Reinforcing Privacy Loop in LLM Agents with Persistent Memory

    披露催生披露：具有持久记忆的 LLM 智能体中的自我强化隐私循环

    Masahiro Kaneko, Hiromi Arai, Timothy Baldwin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper identifies and evaluates a self-reinforcing privacy loop in LLM agents with persistent memory, and shows that response-level constraints can reduce leakage while preserving much of the quality gain. This is a substantial contribution to agent memory behavior and design; its behavioral analysis does not directly study internal representations or reasoning mechanisms.

    本文识别并评估了具有持久记忆的 LLM 智能体中的自我强化隐私循环，并表明回复层面的约束可以在保留大部分质量收益的同时减少泄露。这对智能体记忆行为与设计作出了重要贡献；其行为分析并未直接研究内部表征或推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use persistent memory to personalize responses, and personal attributes in this memory pose a privacy risk if exposed. We ask how consulting memory during dialogue changes what users go on to say, and thus what the memory comes to reveal. In multi-session simulations, a simulated user with 24 personal attributes talks with a support agent that does or does not consult memory, and in both settings attributes are inferred from the full accumulated record. Across four support models, memory raises response quality but also empirical leakage, the share of attribute values correctly inferred from the record, by a margin that widens over sessions. The cause is a loop in ordinary, non-adversarial assistance. Memory-conditioned responses carry earlier values forward, often as presuppositions, and users affirm them or leave them uncorrected, so that cues and the agent's own guesses become recorded values. The loop reinforces itself, and removing the agent's mentions of an attribute lowers its later disclosure about twice as much as single-turn effects predict. Users cannot leave it on their own, since correcting a value discloses the attribute, declining to discuss it shifts later predictions toward sensitive values, and incorrect values left in place become entrenched. The loop is best weakened at the agent's response. Instructing the agent not to state or presuppose attributes brings leakage to about the no-memory level while keeping most of the quality gains, whereas filtering or anonymizing what users say or what is stored gives up much of them.

    中文

    大型语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越多地使用持久记忆来个性化回复，而记忆中的个人属性一旦泄露就会带来隐私风险。我们探究对话中查阅记忆会如何改变用户后续表达的内容，进而改变记忆所揭示的信息。在多轮会话模拟中，拥有 24 项个人属性的模拟用户与支持型智能体交谈；智能体可能查阅记忆，也可能不查阅。在两种情况下，系统都会根据累积的完整记录推断属性。在四种支持型模型中，记忆既提升了回复质量，也增加了实测泄露程度（即根据记录正确推断出的属性值占比），且这一差距会随会话轮数增加而扩大。其成因是一个发生在普通、非对抗性协助中的循环。受记忆条件影响的回复会延续先前的属性值，常常将其作为预设；用户会予以确认或不加纠正，因此线索和智能体自己的猜测便成为记录在案的属性值。该循环不断自我强化；移除智能体对某项属性的提及，会使其后续披露减少，幅度约为单轮效应预测值的两倍。用户无法自行跳出这一循环，因为纠正属性值会泄露该属性，拒绝讨论会使后续预测转向敏感值，而留存的错误值则会逐渐根深蒂固。削弱循环的最佳位置是智能体的回复。指示智能体不要陈述或预设属性，可将泄露程度降至接近不使用记忆时的水平，同时保留大部分质量提升；过滤或匿名化用户所说内容或存储内容，则会牺牲其中大部分质量收益。

    谄媚迎合是一种上下文内更新吗？

    Itai Shapira, Myra Cheng, Hadas Orgad

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses behavioral and causal evidence to argue that sycophancy reflects excessive weighting in the broader mechanism of in-context updating, with implications for separating useful updating from deference. The mechanistic analysis strongly advances interpretability; updating is not presented as reasoning, composition, or a systems contribution.

    本文通过行为证据和因果证据提出，谄媚迎合反映了更广泛的上下文内更新机制中过度加权的现象，并指出了将有益更新与顺从行为分离的意义。其机制分析有力推进了可解释性研究；文中并未将更新视为推理、组合或系统方面的贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Factual sycophancy, a language model's deference to a user's false beliefs, is usually understood as a bid for the user's approval at the expense of truthfulness. We argue that this framing over-emphasizes the user and propose viewing sycophancy as a failure within the broader and generally useful process of in-context updating, by which models revise their answers based on information supplied during an interaction. We support this view with behavioral and mechanistic evidence. First, models' responses to user claims sit within a broader pattern of source-sensitive updating. They revise their answers in response to information attributed to external sources as well, more so when it appears better supported, and their deference to the user persists even when no user approval is at stake. Second, the internal components that support deference to the user are also causally important for in-context updating more broadly. Our results suggest that factual sycophancy arises when in-context updating gives a user's assertion excessive weight relative to its evidence. Because sycophancy is embedded in this process, reducing it risks reducing useful updating as well, a trade-off that calls for evaluations measuring both behaviors and mitigations that decouple them.

    中文

    事实性谄媚迎合，即语言模型顺从用户错误信念的倾向，通常被理解为以牺牲真实性为代价来博取用户认可。我们认为这种解释过度强调了用户，并提出将谄媚迎合视为更广泛且通常有益的上下文内更新过程中的一种失误；在这一过程中，模型会根据互动中提供的信息修正答案。我们通过行为证据和机制层面的证据支持这一观点。首先，模型对用户主张的回应属于更广泛的、对信息来源敏感的更新模式。模型也会根据归因于外部来源的信息修正答案；信息看起来越有依据，模型修正的程度就越大；即使不存在获得用户认可的利害关系，模型对用户的顺从仍会持续。其次，支持模型顺从用户的内部组件，对更广泛的上下文内更新也具有因果上的重要作用。我们的结果表明，当上下文内更新赋予用户主张相对于其证据过高的权重时，就会产生事实性谄媚迎合。由于谄媚迎合嵌在这一过程中，减少谄媚迎合也可能削弱有益的信息更新；这一权衡意味着需要同时衡量这两种行为，并采用能将二者分离的缓解方法。

    Spatial reasoning asks a model to work out where objects are in 3D space, how they relate to one another, and how they move. With the open backbone S-Agent 2.0 reaches 66.5 on MMSI-Bench and 82.3 on ReVSI, ahead of the specialized system SpatialClaw on the same backbone (62.6 and 74.5), and with Gemini-3.8-Flash it reaches 74.1 and 90.5 against its 67.0 and 79.7. Both tool gains shrink as the backbone grows more capable, but SpatialClaw's shrinks far more on ReVSI, from +13.2 to +2.7, while ours stays at +9.6. S-Agent 2.0 also works across different general coding agent harnesses, such as Codex and Claude Code.

    Zijun Dou, Kun Luo, Chaofan Li, Shuqi Lu, Zheng Liu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    FALCA develops a falsification loop and hierarchical credit assignment for training long-horizon search agents, targeting error accumulation and confirmation bias through reasoning and state revision. Its Searcher-Falsifier organization is also a substantial agent-architecture contribution, while decomposition and sub-answer composition are present but not a main compositional-generalization result.

    FALCA 为长时程搜索智能体训练开发了证伪循环与分层信用分配，旨在通过推理和状态修订应对错误累积与确认偏差。Searcher-Falsifier 组织方式也对智能体架构作出了重要贡献；虽然其中涉及分解和子答案组合，但组合泛化并非其主要结果。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-horizon deep search requires LLM agents to iteratively decompose complex information needs, gather evidence from external sources, and maintain a reliable research state under multiple constraints. A central challenge is that early mistakes can be amplified over the search trajectory: agents may anchor on an incorrect candidate, collect partially supporting evidence, overlook contradictions, and accumulate errors that misguide subsequent reasoning. We propose FALCA, a falsification-aware framework that formulates deep search as a propose-falsify process. FALCA adopts a collaborative Searcher-Falsifier architecture, where the Searcher proposes candidate answers or sub-answers, while independent Falsifiers actively seek counterevidence, check unmet constraints, identify conflicts, and produce concise falsification reports for research-state revision. To strengthen this loop, we introduce falsification-aware training, combining SFT warmup on falsification trajectories with agentic RL based on parallel rollouts and hierarchical credit assignment over research stages, state transitions, and actions. Experiments on five search benchmarks show that FALCA improves long-horizon deep search performance over backbone and harness ablations, while reducing confirmation bias and error accumulation through more effective falsification and research-state revision.

    长时程深度搜索要求 LLM 智能体迭代分解复杂的信息需求、从外部来源收集证据，并在多重约束下维持可靠的研究状态。一项核心挑战是，早期错误可能沿搜索过程不断放大：智能体可能锚定于错误候选项，收集部分支持性证据，忽略矛盾，并累积错误，进而误导后续推理。我们提出 FALCA，这是一种伪证感知框架，将深度搜索建模为“提出—证伪”过程。FALCA 采用协作式 Searcher-Falsifier 架构：Searcher 提出候选答案或子答案，而独立的 Falsifier 主动寻找反证、检查未满足的约束、识别冲突，并生成简洁的证伪报告以修订研究状态。为了强化这一循环，我们引入伪证感知训练，将基于证伪轨迹的 SFT 预热与智能体式 RL 相结合；后者基于并行轨迹采样，并针对研究阶段、状态转移和动作进行分层信用分配。在五项搜索基准上的实验表明，相较于骨干模型和框架消融版本，FALCA 提升了长时程深度搜索表现，同时通过更有效的证伪和研究状态修订减少确认偏差与错误累积。

    相对表征使跨语言模型的白盒监控具备可移植性

    Tim Bakker, Christos Louizos

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper introduces globally anchored activation representations that reveal cross-model compatibility and enable transfer of white-box probes, a substantial contribution to representation geometry and monitoring. Mathematical reasoning is one evaluation task, but the work does not advance reasoning methods; its monitoring use is not a systems-architecture contribution.

    本文引入全局锚定的激活表征，揭示跨模型兼容性并实现白盒探针迁移，对表征几何与监控作出了重要贡献。数学推理只是其中一项评估任务，本文并未推进推理方法；监控方面的应用也不构成系统架构贡献。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Independently trained autoregressive language models often acquire similar capabilities, but it remains unclear whether their internal representations organize behaviorally relevant information in compatible ways. We show that models do in fact organize information similarly by using specific behavioral probes that operate on compatible representations. This unlocks portable white-box monitoring: a probe developed and validated on one model can be reused when the model changes, without requiring labeled target data. To overcome incompatible native activation coordinates, we express each example through its angular distances to a shared set of anchors. We introduce a global anchored construction that summarizes information from all transformer layers and removes model-specific layer selection, so the same frozen probe can be straightforwardly applied to another model. We evaluate cross-model probe transfer across monitoring tasks on trivia datasets, safety monitoring, and mathematical reasoning. On average, transferred global anchored probes preserve at least 85% of same-model probe AUROC over chance. Anchored probes also support transfer to related datasets, remain robust across model scale and prompt changes, and retain performance better than standard probes after model updates. Transfer is nevertheless task- and target-dependent and can fail even when the monitored property remains strongly decodable in the target model. Overall, global anchoring reveals substantial task-relevant compatibility across independently trained models and provides a practical basis for portable white-box monitoring.

    中文

    独立训练的自回归语言模型往往会获得相似能力，但它们的内部表征是否以兼容的方式组织与行为相关的信息，仍不清楚。我们通过使用在兼容表征上运行的特定行为探针，表明模型确实以相似方式组织信息。这使可移植的白盒监控成为可能：在一个模型上开发并验证的探针，在模型更换后可以重复使用，而不需要带标签的目标模型数据。为克服原生活化坐标系彼此不兼容的问题，我们用每个样例到一组共享锚点的角距离来表示它。我们提出一种全局锚定构造，它汇总所有 Transformer 层的信息，并免去针对具体模型选择层的步骤，因此同一个冻结探针可以直接应用于另一个模型。我们在琐事数据集、安全监控和数学推理等监控任务上评估跨模型探针迁移。平均而言，迁移后的全局锚定探针保留了同模型探针相对于随机水平至少 85% 的 AUROC。锚定探针也支持迁移到相关数据集，在模型规模和提示发生变化时仍保持稳健，并且在模型更新后比标准探针更能保留性能。不过，迁移效果取决于任务和目标模型；即使目标模型中被监控属性仍可被强烈解码，迁移也可能失败。总体而言，全局锚定揭示了独立训练模型之间在任务相关方面存在显著兼容性，并为可移植的白盒监控提供了实用基础。

    Don't Skip the Baseline: A Controlled Comparison of Dynamic Expert Skipping in MoEs

    别跳过基线：对 MoE 中动态专家跳过方法的受控比较

    Jakob Steimle, Thomas Elsken, Daniel Ehrhardt, Lukas Rinder, Daniel Cremers, Xi Wang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper provides a controlled, matched-compute comparison of dynamic MoE expert skipping against static expert reduction across models and modalities, finding that the simple baseline is difficult to beat. This is a substantial empirical contribution on conditional computation; other directions are not substantively addressed.

    本文在跨模型和模态、计算量匹配的条件下，对动态 MoE 专家跳过方法与静态专家缩减进行了受控比较，发现简单基线很难被超越。这是关于条件计算的重要实证贡献；其他研究方向并未得到实质性探讨。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    A growing body of work proposes dynamic expert-skipping methods for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models that adjust the number of experts activated per token during inference, aiming to preserve model quality while further reducing the number of active parameters. These methods have added calibrated importance scores, inter-expert similarity metrics, or learned per-token allocators in order to identify experts to skip. However, different calibration regimes, different reductions in the effective number of experts, and evaluation suites make comparisons difficult. We classify four representative prior methods into a unified taxonomy and benchmark them against a natural, simple baseline: statically reducing the number of experts $k$ (i.e., same reduced $k$ across all layers and tokens). We provide a fair comparison of these methods at matched expert-compute budget, on two modern MoEs (Gemma4-26B-A4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B) in a text-only setting and a contemporary vision-language model (Qwen3-VL) in a multimodal setting. Surprisingly, we find that the simple baseline is hard to outperform consistently across models, modalities, benchmarks, and calibration settings. The methods we benchmark often underperform the baseline and achieved gains, when present, are minor. We further find that the effective $k$ achieved (or optimized for) in calibration can diverge from the effective $k$ in testing, resulting in over- or under-estimating the compute at inference time. Based on these findings, we recommend a calibration-free per-modality static $k$ reduction and validate this on a held-out model and modality. We further argue that a static control at matched measured compute is the baseline any dynamic skipping method must beat.

    中文

    越来越多的研究提出了面向混合专家（MoE）模型的动态专家跳过方法，这些方法会在推理期间调整每个词元激活的专家数量，旨在保持模型质量，同时进一步减少激活参数的数量。这些方法引入了校准后的重要性分数、专家间相似度指标或学习得到的逐词元分配器，以识别要跳过的专家。然而，不同的校准方案、有效专家数量的不同缩减幅度以及不同的评测套件，使得比较变得困难。我们将四种具有代表性的既有方法归纳到统一分类体系中，并将它们与一个自然且简单的基线进行比较：静态减少专家数量$k$（即所有层和词元采用相同的缩减后$k$）。我们在专家计算预算匹配的条件下，对这些方法进行公平比较，测试对象包括两种现代 MoE（Gemma4-26B-A4B 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B）的纯文本设置，以及一种当代视觉语言模型（Qwen3-VL）的多模态设置。令人意外的是，我们发现，无论模型、模态、基准测试还是校准设置如何变化，这一简单基线都很难被持续超越。我们测试的方法往往表现不及基线，即便取得提升，幅度也很小。我们还发现，校准时达到（或作为优化目标）的有效$k$可能与测试时的有效$k$存在偏差，导致对推理时计算量的估计过高或过低。根据这些发现，我们建议采用无需校准、按模态进行静态$k$缩减，并在一个留出模型和模态上对此进行了验证。我们还主张，任何动态跳过方法都必须超越在实测计算量匹配条件下的静态对照基线。

    OO-Harness evolves specialized executable agent harnesses and routes tasks among them, with benchmark gains as its main contribution.     OO-Harness 演进专用的可执行智能体 harness，并在它们之间路由任务，其主要贡献体现在基准测试性能提升。基于继承的专门化与可复用组合只有有限关联，而其主要贡献在于智能体系统组织，而非推理机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agent harnesses are executable code that specifies the prompts, tools, and control flow around a language model. A single global harness can struggle with heterogeneous tasks that require different execution strategies. In this work, we introduce Object-Oriented Harness (OO-Harness), a harness optimization framework that evolves a hierarchy of executable harness classes using object-oriented design. During training, an evolution agent uses execution records to create a family of specialized harnesses, each implemented as a subclass of the base or an existing specialized harness via inheritance. At test time, a harness router uses routing lessons accumulated during training to select a specific harness for each task. Across three long-horizon benchmarks spanning business workflows, workspace tasks, and tool use, OO-Harness achieves the best performance among the compared methods, with an absolute improvement of up to 15% over the base. Extensive ablation studies examine the contributions of its core components.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CAPSafe contributes a benchmark that measures contextual safety judgments and long-horizon safe planning, and its evaluation exposes a gap between hazard recognition and planning.     CAPSafe 提出了用于衡量情境化安全判断和安全长时程规划的基准，其评估揭示了危险识别与规划之间的差距。这是对推理研究的重要评估贡献；具身智能体的背景本身只与系统领域偶然相关。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Reasoning about safety is essential for embodied agents powered by large language models (LLMs). We introduce the Contextual Action and Plan Safety benchmark (CAPSafe), designed to evaluate safety reasoning at two levels: (1) an action-level dataset that tests whether a single action is safe given its environmental context, and (2) a plan-level dataset that evaluates whether agents can generate safe long-horizon plans for complex hazardous household tasks. CAPSafe models safety conditions where hazards are situational (inferred from object properties), multiple hazards can co-occur within the same environment, and each is annotated with a relative severity level for fine-grained analysis. Evaluating nine closed and open-source LLMs reveals a substantial gap between hazard recognition and safe long-horizon planning. Several models achieve high accuracy in recognizing unsafe actions (exceeding 90% in the best cases), yet safe long-horizon planning remains substantially harder. Gemini-3-pro achieves the highest safe success rate (78.19%), while other models remain below 65%. These results highlight that robust safety reasoning over long action sequences remains an open challenge.

    RACE: RoPE-Aligned Attention Compression Based on Query-Key Activation Energies

    RACE：基于查询—键激活能量的 RoPE 对齐注意力压缩

    Irene Tenison, Abdulrahman Alabdulkareem, Daniel Karl I. Weidele, Nima Dehmamy, Dan Gutfreund

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    RACE develops and theoretically characterizes a post-training method for reducing attention dimensions, KV-cache memory, and inference computation while preserving query-key interactions. This is a substantial systems contribution; its use of activation energies is for compression, not mechanistic interpretation, so that connection remains low.

    RACE 提出并从理论上刻画了一种训练后方法，在保留查询—键交互的同时降低注意力维度、KV 缓存内存和推理计算量。这是一项重要的系统贡献；它使用激活能量是为了压缩，而非机制解释，因此与机制解释的关联较弱。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Head-dimension compression can reduce the memory required by the key-value (KV) cache, but existing methods often reconstruct full-dimensional representations during inference, adding significant decoding FLOPs overhead. We formalize the design considerations for converting pretrained attention into a natively reduced-dimensional form that reduces both KV-cache storage and attention computation using a calibration set. Specifically, we consider reductions that (1) apply a shared projection to queries and keys so that they remain in a common reduced feature space, (2) derive this projection jointly from query and key activations to better preserve their interaction, and (3) are compatible with the pretrained RoPE transformation. To obtain a reconstruction-free realization of this reduction, we restrict it to coordinate selection and theoretically show that RoPE compatibility then holds if and only if complete rotary pairs are retained. Building on this characterization, we introduce RACE, a post-training method that selects rotary pairs using their joint query-key activation energy. We theoretically show that this criterion minimizes a separable, calibration-dependent upper bound on post-RoPE query-key product approximation error. The resulting reductions are folded into the model weights and require neither runtime reconstruction nor specialized kernels. Across three model families and different compression levels, RACE outperforms structured pruning and remains competitive with reconstruction-based methods on language-modeling, zero-shot, and long-context tasks. At 50% KV-cache retention and 256K context, RACE reduces total inference FLOPs by 47.8%, yielding 1.79x higher throughput, 43.2% lower time-to-first-token (TTFT), and 28.1% lower allocated GPU memory in comparison to an uncompressed model.

    中文

    头维度压缩可以减少键值（KV）缓存所需的内存，但现有方法往往会在推理期间重建完整维度的表示，从而显著增加解码 FLOPs 开销。我们形式化了设计考量：如何利用校准集将预训练注意力转换为原生的降维形式，同时减少 KV 缓存存储和注意力计算。具体而言，我们考虑的降维方式需满足以下条件：（1）对查询和键应用共享投影，使二者保留在共同的降维特征空间中；（2）联合根据查询和键的激活计算该投影，以更好地保留二者的交互；（3）与预训练的 RoPE 变换兼容。为了实现无需重建的降维方案，我们将其限制为坐标选择，并从理论上证明，只有保留完整的旋转对时，才与 RoPE 兼容。基于这一刻画，我们提出 RACE，这是一种训练后方法，通过查询和键的联合激活能量选择旋转对。我们从理论上证明，该准则使一个可分离且依赖校准数据的上界最小化，该上界衡量 RoPE 变换后查询—键乘积的近似误差。由此得到的降维结果会折叠进模型权重中，无需运行时重建或专用内核。在三个模型系列和不同压缩率下，RACE 的表现优于结构化剪枝，并且在语言建模、零样本和长上下文任务上与基于重建的方法相比仍具竞争力。在保留 50% KV 缓存且上下文长度为 256K 时，与未压缩模型相比，RACE 将总推理 FLOPs 降低 47.8%，吞吐量提高 1.79 倍，首次生成时间（TTFT）降低 43.2%，分配的 GPU 内存减少 28.1%。

    Jiawei Wang, Yucun Li, Xueqi Li, Shenghao Wang, Xinquan Gong, Dan Zhang, Zheqi Lv, Yuquan Le, Shaozu Yuan, An Zhang, Da Cao, Tat-Seng Chua

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    VisualEvolve develops a cycle for evolving reusable visual operations and tool-use strategies, with snapshot selection and progressive evidence access to support visual reasoning. Its transferable contributions concern reasoning and agent skill management; reusable skills alone provide only limited evidence about compositional generalization, and it does not study internal representations.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Visual tool use enables vision-language models (VLMs) to acquire task-relevant evidence, but its effectiveness can be limited by predefined visual operations and the tool-use strategies learned during training. Representing these operations and strategies as reusable external skills allows them to be refined through self-evolution without updating model parameters. However, skill refinement can introduce performance regressions. Meanwhile, inspecting accumulated task execution trajectories together with skill evolution history may lead to evolution evidence overload. To address these challenges, we propose VisualEvolve, a self-evolving framework that evolves executable visual operations and tool-use strategies for VLMs through a Select--Execute--Evolve--Evaluate cycle. Skill-Library Snapshot Selection uses performance on a fixed validation set disjoint from execution tasks to select an effective historical snapshot for subsequent evolution, limiting the propagation of performance regressions. Progressive Evidence Access (PEA) guides capability-gap diagnosis through a coarse-to-fine hierarchy comprising the Skill-Performance Report, Evolution Log, Trajectory Summaries, and relevant raw trajectory segments. Across four VLM backbones and six evaluation sets from three benchmarks, VisualEvolve improves over the Initial Skill Library in 23 of 24 settings, with a maximum gain of 15.1 percentage points on VisualProbe Hard using Qwen3.5-Plus. Ablation studies support the contributions of Snapshot Selection and PEA, while further experiments show that skills can be improved using experience from different data settings and directly reused across backbones. Moreover, VisualEvolve enables effective skill self-evolution with over an order of magnitude fewer task-solving trajectories than estimated for representative RL-based methods.

    Mohammad Kachuee, Phu Mon Htut, Sheng Li, Nikolaos Pappas, Miguel Ballesteros Martinez, Yassine Benajiba, Sujith Ravi, and Dan Roth

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper presents layered guardrails and enforcement for single- and multi-agent LLM systems, with benchmarked safety and utility results. Agent coordination is part of the application, but the abstract does not describe substantive advances in compositional reasoning or model mechanisms.

    本文提出面向单智能体和多智能体 LLM 系统的分层防护与执行机制，并通过基准测试评估安全性和效用。智能体协调属于应用背景，但摘要没有描述组合推理或模型机制方面的实质性进展。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agentic AI extends large language models (LLMs) from generating responses to planning and executing complex workflows, substantially expanding their utility while exposing applications to unsafe actions, information leakage, and adversarial manipulation. Multi-agent systems further expand these capabilities through specialization and collaboration, but distributed authority, heterogeneous roles, and opaque or potentially compromised participants make safeguarding even more challenging. Existing defenses address important individual threats but provide fragmented coverage across local execution, system-level interactions, and enforcement mechanisms. We introduce MAS-Guard, a unified framework that closes this gap for safeguarding single- and multi-agent AI applications containing both instrumentable and opaque agents. Within instrumentable agents, the proposed local Agent Guardrail (A-Guard) layer applies task-specific experts to assess agentic events. At the system level, developer-owned Agent Charters and a Control Plane combine deterministic structural checks of routes, agent capabilities, and message formats with semantic assessments of roles and message content. These complementary layers enable enforcement through a shared set of interventions: allow, reflection, confirmation, and block. Evaluated across six benchmarks covering diverse single- and multi-agent scenarios with three agent LLMs from different providers, MAS-Guard reduces the overall attack success rate by 71.5-86.3% relative to unguarded agents, while meeting the utility reference criterion on benign tasks.

    中文

    智能体 AI 将大型语言模型（LLM）的能力从生成响应扩展到规划和执行复杂工作流，大幅提升其效用，同时也使应用面临不安全操作、信息泄露和对抗性操纵的风险。多智能体系统通过专业分工与协作进一步扩展这些能力，但分布式权限、异构角色以及不透明或可能遭到入侵的参与者，使安全防护更具挑战。现有防御措施应对了一些重要的单项威胁，但对本地执行、系统级交互和执行机制的覆盖较为零散。我们提出 MAS-Guard，这是一种统一框架，用于弥补这一缺口，保护包含可检测和不透明智能体的单智能体与多智能体 AI 应用。在可检测的智能体内部，所提出的本地智能体防护层（A-Guard）会应用针对特定任务的专家模型来评估智能体事件。在系统层面，由开发者管理的智能体章程和控制平面，将对路由、智能体能力和消息格式的确定性结构检查，与对角色和消息内容的语义评估结合起来。这些互补层通过一组统一的干预措施执行防护：允许、反思、确认和阻止。在涵盖多种单智能体与多智能体场景的六个基准上，使用来自不同提供方的三种智能体 LLM 进行评估后发现，与未设防的智能体相比，MAS-Guard 将总体攻击成功率降低了 71.5%–86.3%，同时满足良性任务的效用参考标准。

    面向预算感知多轮智能体的奖励：适应任意测试时约束

    Tom A. Lamb, Adam Golinski, Eleonora Gualdoni, Sinead Williamson, Michael Kirchhof

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper compares reward designs that teach agents to allocate resources across turns and adapt to task difficulty and arbitrary budgets, with transfer to unseen budgets and tasks. This advances agent computation allocation, while its reasoning connection is limited to budget-sensitive task execution and it does not study internal mechanisms or compositional generalization.

    本文比较了多种奖励设计，用于教会智能体在多个回合中分配资源，并适应任务难度和任意预算；这种能力还可迁移到未见过的预算和任务。该研究推进了智能体的计算资源分配，而其与推理的关联仅限于预算敏感的任务执行，并未研究内部机制或组合泛化。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Large language model agents are often given an inference budget and asked to maximise success within it. A multi-turn agent has to allocate this budget across many environment interactions. An external harness can enforce the budget, but it remains unclear whether the agent itself can learn when and how much to spend. We ask whether agents can learn this allocation across dynamically specified budgets and which rewards best teach this behaviour. We adapt existing length penalties to budget constraints spanning multiple resource types, introduce new reward formulations, and compare eleven objectives in a shared training pipeline. We train Qwen3.5 models at 4B and 9B on AppWorld with budgets over tokens, API calls, and environment steps, and on the BabyAI gridworld with turn budgets. We train a separate policy for each environment and resource type, with each policy trained across budget values. Training with rewards that penalise overspending substantially improves within-budget success and natural compliance over untrained models and over training on task success alone, with agents learning to adapt their resource use to stated budgets and task difficulty. These gains extend to unseen budgets and, zero-shot, to a shifted task distribution and a new benchmark. Reward objectives trade off success within budget and natural compliance. A sigmoid penalty for overspending most often achieves the highest within-budget success at an individual budget, while a fixed negative reward for overspending generally yields the strongest natural compliance. Combining penalties for overspend frequency and magnitude gives the smallest average gap to the best method at each budget. Overall, we show that a single agent can learn to allocate resources across turns and adapt its behaviour to user-specified budgets using budget feedback without external budget-allocation controllers.

    中文

    大型语言模型智能体通常会获得推理预算，并被要求在预算内尽可能提高成功率。多轮智能体必须在多次环境交互中分配预算。外部 harness 可以强制执行预算，但智能体本身能否学会何时以及用多少预算，仍不清楚。我们探究智能体能否针对动态指定的预算学会这种分配，以及哪些奖励最有利于教会这一行为。我们将现有的长度惩罚调整为适用于多种资源类型预算约束的形式，提出新的奖励形式，并在统一训练流程中比较十一种目标。我们在 AppWorld 上训练了 4B 和 9B 的 Qwen3.5 模型，预算涉及 token、API 调用和环境步数；还在 BabyAI 网格世界上使用回合预算进行训练。我们针对每种环境和资源类型分别训练策略，每种策略都在多个预算值下进行训练。与未训练模型以及仅在任务成功时给予奖励的训练相比，采用惩罚超支的奖励进行训练，显著提高了预算内成功率和自然遵从度，使智能体学会根据指定预算和任务难度调整资源使用。这些提升也能迁移到未见过的预算，并且以零样本方式迁移到分布偏移的任务和新基准。不同奖励目标需要在预算内成功率和自然遵从度之间权衡。超支时采用 sigmoid 惩罚，通常能在单个预算下取得最高的预算内成功率；超支时给予固定负奖励，通常能实现最强的自然遵从度。结合对超支频率和幅度的惩罚，在各预算下与最佳方法之间的平均差距最小。总的来说，我们表明，单个智能体能够学会在多个回合中分配资源，并利用预算反馈适应用户指定的预算，而无需外部预算分配控制器。

    Dan Zlotnikov, Ohad Ben-Shahar

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper uses representation probes and activation patching to identify when text information affects visual tracking decisions, offering substantial mechanistic evidence about internal states and behavior.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Vision-language trackers (VLTs) accept descriptions intended to assist tracking, but accepting text does not establish that its content changes tracking decisions, particularly as visual evidence deteriorates. We introduce DISTRACT, a matched-intervention benchmark that holds video, target, and distractor fixed while crossing four text priors with four image degradations along a controlled severity axis. We evaluate five VLTs on four datasets using behavioral contrasts, layerwise representation probes, and activation patching. Molmo2 and JointNLT exhibit directed text use. Some effects contract under degradation, whereas others show no significant endpoint change after multiplicity correction. UVLTrack, MMTrack, and DUTrack respond only weakly to changes in text semantics, with no directed behavioral effect surviving FDR correction in the tested settings. Model-internal analyses reveal that at decision-near states, correct-versus-conflicting text is decodable in Molmo2 and JointNLT but not in the other three systems. In the responsive models, decodability peaks at late states where replacement produces little behavioral change, whereas replacing selected earlier states redirects conflict-associated trajectories toward the target. Because matched-correct donors do not significantly outperform unrelated donors, these interventions identify earlier intervention-sensitive states without establishing target-specific semantic rescue. DISTRACT thus exposes when and where text affects tracking under degraded visual evidence.

    中文

    视觉语言跟踪器（VLT）接受旨在辅助跟踪的描述，但接受文本并不能证明其内容会改变跟踪决策，尤其是在视觉证据退化时。我们提出 DISTRACT，这是一个匹配干预基准：固定视频、目标和干扰物，同时沿受控严重程度轴交叉组合四种文本先验和四种图像退化。我们在四个数据集上使用行为对比、逐层表征探测和激活修补评估五种 VLT。Molmo2 和 JointNLT 表现出有指向性的文本使用。有些效应在退化时减弱，而另一些在多重比较校正后，终点变化并不显著。在所测试的设置中，UVLTrack、MMTrack 和 DUTrack 对文本语义变化的响应较弱，没有任何有指向性的行为效应通过 FDR 校正。模型内部分析显示，在接近决策的状态下，Molmo2 和 JointNLT 中可解码出正确文本与冲突文本的差异，而其他三个系统中则无法解码。在有响应的模型中，可解码性在较晚状态达到峰值，而在这些状态中替换文本几乎不会改变行为；相比之下，替换选定的较早状态会将与冲突相关的轨迹重新导向目标。由于匹配的正确文本供体并未显著优于无关供体，这些干预识别出了较早的干预敏感状态，但并未证明能够针对特定目标实现语义补救。因此，DISTRACT 揭示了在视觉证据退化时，文本会在何时、何处影响跟踪。

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    CarryoverBench measures how planted payloads persist and re-trigger through agent memory and scheduled tasks, and its results point to runtime-layer defenses as a substantive systems concern.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Modern LLM agents persist state across sessions via two channels: long-lived memory files silently prepended to the system prompt, and scheduled tasks waking the agent without user input. A one-time indirect prompt injection committed to either channel can re-fire across sessions long after the attacker leaves, threats we term carryover attacks. Existing prompt-injection benchmarks evaluate attacks only in the session where malicious content is first observed, leaving the gate governing when and how often a planted payload later re-fires unmeasured. We present CarryoverBench: 12 personal-assistant scenarios and 101 attack tasks across three trigger channels: Instant, same-turn IPI; Autonomous, heartbeat-scheduled; and Latent, memory-resurfaced. A rule-based verifier scores planting and triggering as independent stages. Across five frontier models, planted payloads re-fire without measurable decay over five rounds; conditional on successful planting, the trigger stage often provides little additional protection. Porting the Latent channel to a second runtime, Hermes, attenuates but does not eliminate the effect, suggesting that carryover defense requires runtime-layer controls in addition to prompt-level interventions.

    现代 LLM 智能体通过两种渠道跨会话持久化状态：被悄然预置到系统提示中的长期记忆文件，以及无需用户输入即可唤醒智能体的计划任务。一次性间接提示注入若写入任一渠道，就可能在攻击者离开很久之后仍跨会话再次触发，我们将此类威胁称为持续攻击。现有提示注入基准只评估恶意内容首次出现的会话中的攻击，因此没有测量控制已植入载荷之后何时以及多频繁再次触发的关卡。我们提出 CarryoverBench：包含 12 个个人助理场景和 101 项攻击任务，覆盖三种触发渠道：即时，即同一轮次的 IPI；自主，即按心跳计划触发；以及潜伏，即从记忆中重新浮现。基于规则的验证器将植入和触发作为两个独立阶段评分。对五种前沿模型的测试显示，已植入的载荷在五轮内再次触发，且没有可测量的衰减；若植入成功，触发阶段通常无法额外提供多少保护。将潜伏渠道移植到第二种运行时 Hermes 后，其影响有所减弱但并未消失，这表明防御持续攻击除了提示层干预之外，还需要运行时层控制。

    World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied generalist policies by jointly modeling future world evolution and robot actions across diverse manipulation tasks. However, representing diverse futures is only the first step: a capable WAM must also generate futures that match the requirements of the current task and execution progress. In long-horizon manipulation where similar observation-action segments occur across different tasks and stages, existing approaches may generate locally plausible yet misdirected rollouts to drift toward wrong task stage, i.e., a phenomenon we term Stage Confusion. To address this problem, we propose TaskWAM, a closed-loop, stage-aware framework that represents fine-grained task requirements with Mode Tokens and tracks execution progress with State Tokens, forming a structured task state to steer world--action generation toward intended future. We further introduce StageBench, a controlled multi-stage manipulation benchmark with parameterized stage variations and automated evaluation.Extensive experiments on both simulation benchmarks and real-world tasks demonstrate that TaskWAM effectively reduces confusion and achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods.     阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agents are starting to sell to other agents. Seller agents write the listings of tools, services and products, and buyer agents read these listings when they choose what to use. We show that seller agents told only to be selected more often practice generative engine optimization on their own, and that this distorts the market for sellers and for buyers. We build tool markets from real data tools on Amazon and Instagram and run every tool on every question, so we know which tools can answer each question. Under all five production models we test, sellers rewrite their descriptions to claim more and more fields, including fields that their tools return for fewer than half of the targets. We call this process toolflation. Nothing in the market limits it, and how far it goes depends on the model, as the number of claims that contradict the sellers' own evidence differs by an order of magnitude between models. Toolflation shifts the buyers' choices between sellers, and the most capable tool loses share in seven of the ten combinations of seller model and platform. Under four models, the choices stay with capable tools and buyer agents keep their task success. Under the fifth, sellers copy one another until the descriptions no longer tell the tools apart. Buyer agents then pick tools by their position in the list, tools that answer almost nothing win a quarter to two fifths of the choices, and task success falls from 89% to about 30% on Amazon, close to random choice, and from 77% to 40% on Instagram. The sellers did only what their vendors asked, and the cost fell on buyers they never dealt with. We therefore argue that honesty toward third parties under competition is part of safety alignment, and that models should be tested as sellers before they are deployed as sellers.

    智能体开始向其他智能体出售商品。卖家智能体撰写工具、服务和产品的商品列表，买家智能体在选择使用什么时阅读这些列表。我们表明，只被要求提高入选频率的卖家智能体会自行进行生成式引擎优化，而这会扭曲卖家和买家的市场。我们基于 Amazon 和 Instagram 上的真实数据工具构建工具市场，并让每个工具回答每个问题，因此我们知道哪些工具能够回答每个问题。在我们测试的全部五种生产模型下，卖家都会改写描述，声称自己能处理越来越多的字段，其中包括其工具对不到一半目标返回相关结果的字段。我们将这一过程称为工具膨胀。市场中没有任何机制能限制这一现象，其程度取决于模型：不同模型中与卖家自身证据相矛盾的声明数量相差一个数量级。工具膨胀改变了买家在卖家之间的选择；在卖家模型与平台的十种组合中，能力最强的工具有七种失去了市场份额。在四种模型下，买家仍选择有能力的工具，买家智能体也保持了任务成功率。在第五种模型下，卖家彼此抄袭，直到商品描述再也无法区分这些工具。随后，买家智能体按工具在列表中的位置选择工具；几乎无法回答任何问题的工具赢得了四分之一到五分之二的选择，任务成功率在 Amazon 上从 89% 降至约 30%，接近随机选择，在 Instagram 上则从 77% 降至 40%。卖家只是在执行其提供方的要求，代价却由它们从未打过交道的买家承担。因此，我们主张，在竞争环境中对第三方保持诚实是安全对齐的一部分，并且模型在作为卖家部署之前应先作为卖家接受测试。

    Claims of emergence in AI should be grounded in information decomposition

    关于 AI 中涌现现象的主张应以信息分解为基础

    Christoph Riedl, Fernando E. Rosas

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper proposes information decomposition as a formal, falsifiable way to assess synergy and emergence, applying it to attention heads, autonomous agents, and human-AI teams. This provides transferable insight into component and system interactions, but does not directly study representation composition or reasoning capability.

    本文提出以信息分解作为评估协同和涌现现象的形式化、可证伪方法，并将其应用于注意力头、自主智能体和人机团队。这为理解组成部分与系统之间的相互作用提供了可迁移的见解，但并未直接研究表征组合或推理能力。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    When a language model develops capabilities not traceable to its individual components, when a multi-agent AI system outperforms each agent on its own, or when a human-AI pair succeeds where either fails in isolation, AI researchers describe it as a case of ``synergy'' or ``emergence''. However, these are usually informal assessments not supported by a theoretical framework, making these claims impossible to compare or even meaningfully dispute. Here we argue that \emph{information decomposition can serve as a unifying formal framework to operationalize assessments about synergy in AI systems}. Information decomposition provides a way to distinguish qualitatively different \emph{types} of information, including unique information available from individual components, redundant information shared across multiple components, and synergistic information accessible only from parts taken together. This gives claims of emergence a precise, falsifiable criterion: a system's behavior is emergent only if it carries synergistic information about task-relevant outcomes. We apply this lens to attention heads, autonomous agents, and human-AI teams, showing how it organizes existing knowledge across scales and substrates, while also generating cross-level conjectures that siloed fields would miss.

    中文

    当语言模型发展出无法追溯到其单个组成部分的能力时，当多智能体 AI 系统的表现超过每个单独智能体时，或者当人机组合能够成功完成双方单独都无法完成的任务时，AI 研究者会将其描述为“协同”或“涌现”的案例。然而，这些通常只是缺乏理论框架支持的非正式判断，因此此类主张无法相互比较，甚至无法进行有意义的争论。我们在此主张，\emph{信息分解可以作为一个统一的形式化框架，将对 AI 系统协同现象的评估具体化}。信息分解提供了一种区分不同性质信息的方式，包括各个组成部分独有的信息、多个组成部分共享的冗余信息，以及只有将多个部分结合起来才能获得的协同信息。这为涌现主张提供了精确且可证伪的判据：只有当系统行为携带关于任务相关结果的协同信息时，该行为才是涌现的。我们将这一视角应用于注意力头、自主智能体和人机团队，展示它如何梳理跨尺度、跨载体的现有知识，同时还能提出被各自领域隔阂所遮蔽的跨层级猜想。

    Proof-Carrying Contracts: Commitments AI Agents Cannot Break

    携带证明的契约：AI 智能体无法违背的承诺

    Carlo Ciliberto, Alessandro Rudi, Enrico Tassi

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    PC2 enforces agent commitments with machine-checkable proofs checked before operations, and proves constraints hold during execution even for adversarial agents. Reusable capability modules offer a limited compositional connection, while the central contribution is an agent execution and safety architecture rather than a study of reasoning mechanisms.

    PC2 通过在操作执行前检查机器可检验的证明来强制执行智能体承诺，并证明即便面对对抗性智能体，约束在执行期间仍然成立。可复用能力模块带来有限的组合性关联，但核心贡献是智能体执行与安全架构，而不是对推理机制的研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    AI agents increasingly act on behalf of people or other agents, purchasing services, exchanging information and delegating work. What an agent must respect is written in instructions, policies or agreements, but text alone cannot make it comply. It may make mistakes, be redirected by what it reads, or pursue different interests. For an economy of such agents to function, parties need agreements they can rely on without inspecting or trusting one another's agents. We introduce Proof-Carrying Contracts (PC2), a framework for making agreed constraints enforceable throughout an agent's interactions with a system. Before a requested operation can run, the agent must supply a machine-checkable proof that it preserves the agreed constraints in every case allowed by its model. An execution system called the Airlock checks the proof and controls access to the operation. The parties specify the conditions to preserve, while the agent supplies the reasoning needed to justify its decisions and remains free to adapt its strategy. This avoids having to design a separate permission policy and prove that every decision it permits is safe. We prove that the constraints hold at every instant during execution, even for an adversarial agent, and identify when this implies safety in the world. Reusable capability modules provide tools and guarantees from which contracts can be constructed. PC2 provides a foundation for an agent economy whose agreements protect both those delegating work and those carrying it out.

    中文

    AI 智能体越来越多地代表个人或其他智能体行事，购买服务、交换信息并委托工作。智能体必须遵守的事项写在指令、政策或协议中，但仅靠文本无法确保它遵守。它可能犯错、被所读内容引导偏离，或追求不同的利益。要让这样的智能体经济运转，各方需要能够信赖协议，而不必检查或信任彼此的智能体。我们提出携带证明的契约（PC2），这是一个使约定约束在智能体与系统交互的整个过程中都可强制执行的框架。在执行所请求的操作之前，智能体必须提供机器可检验的证明，证明在其模型允许的所有情形下都能维持约定约束。名为 Airlock 的执行系统会检查证明并控制对操作的访问。各方规定需要维持的条件，而智能体提供证明其决策合理所需的推理，同时仍可自由调整策略。这样就无需另行设计权限策略，也无需证明该策略允许的每项决策都是安全的。我们证明，即使面对对抗性智能体，约束在执行期间的每一时刻都成立，并指出这何时意味着现实世界中的安全。可复用的能力模块提供构建契约所需的工具和保证。PC2 为智能体经济奠定基础，使协议能够保护委托工作的一方以及执行工作的一方。

    Asymmetric Looped Transformers: Fixed Global Representations for an Iterative Decoder

    非对称循环 Transformer：用于迭代解码器的固定全局表征

    Cheng Liang, Tengfei Zhang, Wenjie DU, Jianyu Wu, Changlian Ma, Shuchen Pu, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang, Zhouhan Lin

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    AsymLoop separates fixed context encoding from recurrent state refinement, with joint attention over persistent and evolving KV caches; experiments show improved language-model performance. Its iterative computation makes reasoning an incidental connection, while the abstract gives no evidence of compositional generalization or interpretability insight.

    AsymLoop 将固定上下文编码与循环状态细化分开，并对持久和演变中的 KV 缓存进行联合注意力计算；实验显示其提升了语言模型性能。其迭代计算与推理存在附带关联，而摘要没有提供其在组合泛化或可解释性方面取得进展的证据。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Looped Transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying shared layers, offering a way to scale computation without increasing parameter count. However, full-stack looping places context construction and iterative state refinement within the same recurrent computation, without explicitly distinguishing their roles. We introduce the Asymmetric Looped Transformer (AsymLoop), which separates single-pass context encoding from recurrent state refinement. A single-pass causal encoder produces layer-specific Global key-value (KV) caches that remain fixed across iterations, while a weight-tied recurrent decoder generates Local KV from its evolving state. Joint attention over both sources under a single softmax allows each update to integrate persistent contextual information with the current intermediate state. For training, we apply a heavy-tail-guided layerwise learning-rate method to the encoder and decoder. Experiments on FineWeb-Edu across four model scales, from 60M to 1B, show consistently lower validation perplexity and higher average downstream accuracy than Full Loop under matched effective depth and training token budgets. At 1B, AsymLoop improves average zero-shot accuracy across seven commonsense reasoning benchmarks from 49.58% to 50.85%. Further experiments extend these benefits to longer training budgets, an OLMo-style backbone, and sparse mixture-of-experts models. These results support asymmetric context encoding and state refinement as an effective design for recurrent language models.

    中文

    循环 Transformer 通过反复应用共享层来增加有效深度，从而提供一种无需增加参数量即可扩展计算的方法。然而，全栈循环将上下文构建和迭代状态细化置于同一循环计算中，没有明确区分二者的作用。我们提出非对称循环 Transformer（AsymLoop），将单次前向的上下文编码与循环状态细化分开。单次前向的因果编码器会生成特定于各层的全局键值（KV）缓存，并在各次迭代中保持不变；权重绑定的循环解码器则根据其不断演变的状态生成局部 KV。在单个 softmax 下对这两个来源进行联合注意力计算，使每次更新都能将持久的上下文信息与当前中间状态结合起来。在训练中，我们对编码器和解码器采用由重尾分布引导的逐层学习率方法。在 FineWeb-Edu 上对四种模型规模（从 60M 到 1B）进行的实验表明，在有效深度和训练 token 预算相同的条件下，与 Full Loop 相比，AsymLoop 始终具有更低的验证困惑度和更高的下游任务平均准确率。在 1B 规模下，AsymLoop 将七项常识推理基准上的零样本平均准确率从 49.58% 提高到 50.85%。进一步实验表明，这些收益也适用于更长的训练预算、OLMo 风格骨干网络以及稀疏混合专家模型。这些结果表明，非对称上下文编码与状态细化是循环语言模型的一种有效设计。

    OptionWorld diagnoses long-term assistant failures involving task state, missed actions, and mistaken restrictions, and tests targeted interventions in simulated tasks.     OptionWorld 诊断了长期助理在任务状态、行动遗漏和错误限制方面的失败，并在模拟任务中测试了有针对性的干预。这为智能体行为和任务跟进提供了重要的基准贡献，但摘要没有描述推理机制或组合泛化机制。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Long-term assistants must follow unfinished tasks across days as information and circumstances change. Finding information or starting an action, however, does not ensure that the task gets completed. We introduce OptionWorld, a benchmark that traces information acquisition, judgments, actions, and outcomes in simulated daily-life tasks to identify where current LLMs fall short as long-term personal assistants. In runs with archived decision inputs, the key facts remain in the model's last input before the deadline in 35.5% of failed instances. Failure analysis identifies the three most frequent problems: needed information is not obtained or combined, available opportunities to act go unused, and agents impose restrictions that the task does not require. Three follow-up experiments show that supplying missing facts restores task success in some cases; action reminders can restart work while subsequent steps still miss the deadline; and correcting a supplied note that wrongly forbids contact restores permitted inquiry. These findings locate shortcomings in maintaining task state: connecting facts to unfinished work, following through before deadlines, and separating actual restrictions from the agent's assumptions.

    长期助理必须在信息和情况不断变化的情况下，跨越数日跟进尚未完成的任务。然而，找到信息或开始行动并不意味着任务一定能够完成。我们提出 OptionWorld，这是一项基准，通过追踪模拟日常任务中的信息获取、判断、行动和结果，识别当前 LLM 作为长期个人助理时的不足。在存档了决策输入的运行中，在 35.5% 的失败实例里，关键事实仍出现在模型截止时间前的最后一次输入中。失败分析识别出三个最常见的问题：没有获取或整合所需信息、没有利用可采取行动的机会，以及智能体自行施加了任务并未要求的限制。三项后续实验表明，在某些情况下提供缺失事实可以恢复任务成功；行动提醒可以让工作重新启动，但后续步骤仍可能错过截止时间；纠正错误禁止联系的附带说明，可以恢复原本获准的询问。这些发现指出，维持任务状态方面存在不足：未能将事实与未完成的工作关联、未能在截止时间前跟进，以及未能区分实际限制与智能体自身的假设。

    BitMTP：多词元预测与低比特大型语言模型的结合

    Ning Zhang, Shihao Wang, Jinrui Zhang, Chaodong Xiao, Lei Zhang

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    BitMTP co-designs training objectives, decoding strategies, and KV/cache execution to speed low-bit language-model generation while maintaining task quality. Its contribution is substantial to model systems, while token prediction and benchmark results provide no substantive insight into reasoning or compositional generalization.

    BitMTP 协同设计训练目标、解码策略和 KV 缓存执行，以在保持任务质量的同时加速低比特语言模型生成。它对模型系统作出了重要贡献，而词元预测和基准结果并未提供关于推理或组合泛化的实质性见解。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    For efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs), methods of ultra-low-bit backbones reduce weight storage, memory traffic, and linear-layer execution cost, while multi-token prediction (MTP) methods reduce sequential decoding steps by predicting multiple future tokens in parallel. Although complementary, the direct combination of these methods cannot accelerate decoding at comparable quality: masked drafting lacks intermediate token input supplied in next-token training, while wider computation and causal key-value (KV) updates can offset the savings from fewer steps. To address these challenges, we propose BitMTP, an algorithm-system co-design framework for efficient MTP on ultra-low-bit LLM backbones. A joint next-token prediction and MTP objective equips a single model with both autoregressive (AR) generation and block-causal drafting. Confidence-only decoding, speculative-only decoding, and hybrid decoding provide different quality-throughput operating points without using separate draft and verifier models. Accepted-prefix alignment keeps the committed prefix, materialized causal KV boundary, and CUDA Graph replay state consistent for continued generation. BitMTP uses this contract to select width-specialized low-bit execution and reuse captured graphs over shared KV storage. On NVIDIA H20, BitMTP with hybrid decoding achieves five-task mean speedups of 2.2x on BitNet b1.58-2B and 2.1-2.4x on 1.7B-4B Bonsai models at comparable task quality. On RTX 3090 and Jetson Orin, it further achieves up to 2.0x in five-task mean throughput and 3.3x on MBPP+, respectively. These results demonstrate that BitMTP accelerates ultra-low-bit LLM generation across backbones, model sizes, and GPU types. The source code is released at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/BitMTP

    中文

    为了高效部署大型语言模型（LLM），超低比特骨干网络方法可以减少权重存储、内存流量和线性层执行成本，而多词元预测（MTP）方法则通过并行预测多个未来词元来减少顺序解码步数。尽管二者互补，直接结合这些方法却无法在质量相当的情况下加速解码：掩码草拟缺少下一词元训练中提供的中间词元输入，而更宽的计算和因果键值（KV）更新可能抵消减少解码步数带来的收益。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 BitMTP，这是一种面向超低比特 LLM 骨干网络的高效 MTP 算法与系统协同设计框架。联合的下一词元预测与 MTP 目标使单个模型同时具备自回归（AR）生成和块因果草拟能力。仅置信度解码、仅推测解码和混合解码提供了不同的质量与吞吐量权衡点，且无需使用独立的草拟模型和验证模型。已接受前缀对齐使已提交前缀、物化的因果 KV 边界和 CUDA Graph 重放状态保持一致，以便继续生成。BitMTP 利用这一约定选择针对不同宽度优化的低比特执行方式，并在共享 KV 存储上复用已捕获的计算图。在 NVIDIA H20 上，BitMTP 配合混合解码，在任务质量相当的情况下，在五项任务上的平均加速比分别为 BitNet b1.58-2B 的 2.2x，以及 1.7B-4B Bonsai 模型的 2.1-2.4x。在 RTX 3090 和 Jetson Orin 上，它还分别实现了五项任务平均吞吐量最高 2.0x 的提升，以及 MBPP+ 上 3.3x 的提升。这些结果表明，BitMTP 能够在不同骨干网络、模型规模和 GPU 类型上加速超低比特 LLM 生成。源代码已发布于 https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/BitMTP

    REACT combines contact-aware policy learning, deployable onboard sensing, and partner-state prediction to support humanoid interaction under occlusion.     REACT 结合接触感知策略学习、可部署的机载传感和伙伴状态预测，以支持遮挡条件下的人形机器人交互。其主要贡献在于推进智能体控制与传感系统；语义接触和动作预测与组合泛化或一般推理仅有附带关联。

    ENGLISH

    Humanoid-human interaction requires robots to operate under severe partial observability: during close physical contact, the human partner is occluded, truncated, or outside the robot's field of view, causing pose estimation to fail and often necessitating external tracking or privileged human state. At the same time, heavy mutual occlusions introduce errors into the human-human motion-capture data used for learning. We present REACT, a framework for learning deployable humanoid-human interaction policies from human-human demonstrations. REACT treats semantic contact structure as the key supervisory signal connecting demonstration processing, interaction learning, and onboard control. First, a VLM-guided contact modeling and retargeting pipeline identifies semantically meaningful contacts and transfers them onto humanoid-human geometry while preserving interaction structure. Using these annotations, privileged interaction policies learn physically grounded behaviors through interaction-aware contact rewards and are then distilled into deployable egocentric depth policies trained entirely from onboard sensing using photorealistic human depth rendering. To address severe partial observability, we introduce generative partner-state modeling objectives that predict partner motion from occluded egocentric views. We evaluate REACT in simulation and on a real Unitree G1 humanoid across five contact-rich interactions. Semantic contact modeling substantially improves preservation of demonstrated interactions, while generative partner-state modeling improves contact recall on four of five interactions, most under heavy occlusion. On real hardware, REACT performs all five interactions using onboard sensing alone.

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper studies how quantization representation and jointly chosen calibration and recovery data preserve model quality at very low bit widths, offering a practical compression recipe.     本文研究如何通过量化表示以及联合选择的校准数据和恢复数据，在极低比特宽度下保持模型质量，并给出实用的压缩方案。这是对模型效率的重要贡献，而 QA 性能只是评估指标，并非对推理机制的研究。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Post-training quantization (PTQ) compresses the weights of a trained model with limited compute and data. Down to 4 bits it is near-lossless, but at 2 bits scalar PTQ configurations fall to chance-level accuracy. We study three choices usually treated as implementation details that matter little at 4 bits but decide 2-bit quality: the quantization representation, the calibration data, and the recovery fine-tuning data, across six dense and mixture-of experts models (ranging from $3.8$ to $32$B parameters). Representation is the largest factor and vector codebooks restore usable models where scalar PTQ pipelines collapse. Most of the remaining loss in accuracy is on \emph{generative} tasks, and the amount of performance drop is model-dependent. Furthermore, at a short recovery budget, calibration and recovery data are coupled. The best recovery data depends on the calibration data, so the two must be chosen jointly. The resulting recipe involves a vector codebook representation, a small task-aligned calibration mixture, and an inexpensive codebook-only recovery stage. Including codebooks, it uses about $2.3$ effective bits per weight and retains $89$ to $97\%$ of full-precision question-answering (QA) accuracy where scalar PTQ is at chance, and, including recovery, uses $1.4$ to $30\times$ less compute than the strongest quantization-aware-training (QAT) baseline.

    Humans Correct Their Judgments Through Debate, but Weaker AI Models Do Not

    人类通过辩论修正判断，而较弱的 AI 模型不会

    Maria Victoria Carro, Denise Alejandra Mester, Facundo Nieto, Oscar Agustin Stanchi, Guido Ernesto Bergman, Giovanni Franco Gabriel Marrafini, Trinidad Borrell, Guido Freire, Joaquin Salvador Machulsky, Mario Alejandro Leiva, Ana Lopez, Nicolas Spinelli, Luca Nicolas Forziati Gangi, Eitan Sprejer, Federico Barrera Lemarchand, Gerardo Simari, Maria Vanina Martinez

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    The paper evaluates whether debate, deliberation, and voting help human and weaker-model judges correct prior beliefs, finding gains for humans but not reliably for models. It substantially investigates reasoning and judgment protocols; multi-judge coordination is relevant to agent systems, but is secondary to the accuracy question.

    本文评估辩论、审议和投票能否帮助人类裁判及较弱模型裁判修正先验信念，发现这些方法能提升人类的判断准确率，但对模型而言效果并不稳定。本文深入研究推理和判断协议；多裁判协作与智能体系统相关，但相较于准确率问题属于次要内容。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    How can we effectively oversee AI systems that surpass human intelligence? AI Safety via Debate proposes that two AI systems argue opposing positions and a judge, either a human or a weaker model, decides which is correct. By facilitating supervisors in providing high-quality training signals, debate aims to encourage truthful and safe behavior from AI systems whose capabilities exceed our own. However, human judgment is not neutral: people often rely on biases which advanced AI systems may learn to exploit. Drawing on insights from collective intelligence and social cognition, this paper investigates whether debate can guide human and LLM supervisors toward the truth despite their prior beliefs. We evaluate several protocol configurations. We also explore setups inspired by the wisdom of the crowd such as the number and diversity of judges, as well as interaction mechanisms including deliberation and voting. Overall, we find that debate increases accuracy relative to prior beliefs for human judges, whereas the consultancy baseline, in which a single expert argues for one answer, does not. For weaker language models, however, the results are mixed: debate provides no comparable gains in most settings and can even reduce accuracy. Among multi-judge protocols, weighted voting produces the highest accuracy for human supervisors, whereas for LLMs none of them significantly improves group accuracy, even as the number of judges increases. Notably, the behavior of minority judges in non-diverse deliberation protocols suggests that, under symmetric settings, incorrect positions could be more persuasive than correct ones. These findings support debate as a viable path toward scalable human oversight, but cast doubt on its benefits for weaker AI supervisors, raising concerns about fully automated training and control pipelines in high-stakes settings.

    中文

    我们如何有效监督超越人类智能的 AI 系统？AI 安全辩论方法提出，让两个 AI 系统就相反立场展开辩论，再由一名裁判（可以是人类或较弱的模型）判断谁是正确的。辩论旨在帮助监督者提供高质量的训练信号，从而鼓励能力超越我们自身的 AI 系统表现真实且安全。然而，人类判断并不中立：人们常常依赖偏见，而先进的 AI 系统可能学会利用这些偏见。本文借鉴集体智慧和社会认知领域的见解，研究辩论能否引导人类和 LLM 监督者不受既有信念影响、走向真相。我们评估了若干种协议配置。我们还探索了受群体智慧启发的设置，例如裁判的人数和多样性，以及审议和投票等互动机制。总体而言，我们发现，与人类裁判的先验判断相比，辩论能提高其准确率；而咨询基线（即由一名单独的专家为一个答案辩护）则无法做到这一点。然而，对于较弱的语言模型，结果喜忧参半：在大多数设置下，辩论未能带来同等程度的提升，甚至可能降低准确率。在多裁判协议中，加权投票使人类监督者的准确率最高；而对 LLM 来说，即使裁判人数增加，也没有任何一种协议能显著提高群体准确率。值得注意的是，非多样化审议协议中少数裁判的行为表明，在对称设置下，错误立场可能比正确立场更有说服力。这些发现支持将辩论作为实现可扩展人类监督的一条可行路径，但也使人们对其能否惠及较弱的 AI 监督者产生怀疑，并引发了对高风险场景中全自动训练和控制流程的担忧。

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Continuous flow language models offer a path to parallel generation with tools for control and acceleration unavailable to discrete diffusion, yet effective techniques for building them at the billion-parameter scale remain less established. We present Lafa (Large flow language model), a fast, high-performing flow language model scaled to 8B parameters in a data-efficient manner. Lafa is a blockwise flow model with causal attention on the prefix and bidirectional, asynchronous flow within each block. This design enables efficient training by adapting pretrained autoregressive (AR) models and fast inference via prefix caching and blockwise parallel decoding. We train Lafa at 0.5B, 7B, and 8B scales with fewer than 30B tokens, more efficient than previous diffusion models, and evaluate it on instruction following, reasoning, and coding, where the learned flow matches or surpasses the quality of AR and can be distilled into flow maps for one- and few-step generation. Notably, flow training preserves or even improves pretrained AR capabilities via a multi-token prediction effect, which we leverage in a self-speculative decoding scheme that verifies flow-based drafts autoregressively within a single model. This yields 2.54x the throughput of an AR model at comparable quality, outperforming multi-token prediction and discrete diffusion methods. Our findings show that continuous flows can serve as a scalable foundation for language modeling.

    Continuous-time reinforcement learning seeks an optimal policy under unknown dynamics driven by stochastic differential equations using observations collected at discrete times. We develop a policy gradient framework that combines rigorous convergence analysis with learning from discrete data. We first establish a performance difference lemma and derive policy gradient formulas for randomized and parametrized policies. We then prove exponential convergence of an entropy-regularized policy flow to the regularized optimum. For discrete parametrized updates, we derive a convergence bound that explicitly separates the contributions of critic error, policy-regression error, and the learning step size. To enable learning under unknown dynamics, we integrate this framework with PhiBE, which constructs a continuous-time surrogate generator from discrete transition data. The resulting on-policy and off-policy model-free actor-critic algorithms preserve the continuous-time structure of the control problem. Numerical experiments on an entropy-regularized linear-quadratic regulator and a nonlinear wheeled robot demonstrate the performance and stability of the proposed methods with both known and data-driven dynamics.

To train the Planner effectively, we introduce Reward-Guided Denoising for CoT (RDC), which integrates outcome-based rewards into the diffusion process to steer it toward goal-directed reasoning. Experiments on vision-language benchmarks show that CoRAL significantly outperforms prior diffusion-based methods and achieves competitive performance against strong ARMs, achieving both superior efficiency and quality.

    自回归模型 (ARM) 在推理中面临“序列性瓶颈”，而扩散语言模型 (DLM) 虽可并行处理，却缺乏语义连贯性。为解决这两项局限，我们提出协作式推理非对称学习 (CoRAL)，这是一种采用非对称规划器—执行器 (APE) 架构的混合框架：DLM 规划器并行生成 K 条多样化的推理轨迹，大型 ARM 执行器则选出最优方案并综合生成最终答案。为有效训练规划器，我们提出面向思维链 (CoT) 的奖励引导去噪 (RDC)，将基于结果的奖励融入扩散过程，引导其进行目标导向推理。在视觉语言基准上的实验表明，CoRAL 显著优于以往基于扩散的方法，性能达到强大 ARM 的竞争水平，同时兼具更高效率和更优质量。

    Capable Teacher, Myopic Scorer: Reward-Free Teacher Repair for Agentic On-Policy Distillation

    能力出色的教师，目光短浅的评分器：面向智能体在线策略蒸馏的免奖励教师修复

    Shu Zhao, Tan Yu

    Recommendation Reason 推荐理由

    R2S identifies a rollout-scorer gap caused by next-token myopia and repairs teacher scoring using takeover outcomes, substantially improving on-policy agent training. This advances reasoning-capability training and agent systems, while token scoring alone offers no internal interpretability insight and composition is not a focus.

    阅读摘要 Abstract

    ENGLISH

    Agentic on-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student agent on its own trajectories while a teacher scores every token. A natural explanation of where it goes wrong is compounding error: the student's mistakes carry its trajectories beyond the region where the teacher is reliable, so recent methods keep training inside that region, through episode-length curricula, teacher-guided turns, prefix replay, or teacher intervention where the two disagree. We show this explanation is incomplete. From the states where the student departs most from the teacher, the teacher's own takeovers still finish the task, yet the student trained on its token scores keeps running out of turns. We attribute this to the myopia of next-token scoring. The teacher rates each token without seeing where the episode ends, so its scores let through the safe, delaying moves that outcome-based RL would punish with zero reward, a penalty agentic OPD lacks. We call this difference between what the teacher does and what it scores the rollout-scorer gap. We propose Rollout-to-Scorer Distillation (R2S), which repairs the scorer before distillation by mining high-disagreement states from the untrained student, running teacher takeovers from them, keeping the states where enough takeovers pass a reward-free check such as consensus or an LLM judge, and fine-tuning the teacher to give its takeover-informed scores on every assistant token from the divergence turn onward, without the takeover in context. The repaired teacher is frozen as the sole scorer for standard OPD, requiring no task reward during repair or training. Across three environments, two teachers and four students, R2S outperforms three state-of-the-art agentic-OPD methods in all twelve teacher-student-environment cells, by 12.8 success points on average over the best of them in each cell. Project page: https://tree-shu-zhao.github.io/r2s/.

    中文

    智能体在线策略蒸馏 (OPD) 让学生智能体沿自身轨迹训练，同时由教师为每个 token 打分。对于其失效原因，一种自然的解释是误差累积：学生的错误使其轨迹偏离教师可靠的状态区域，因此近期方法通过回合长度课程、教师引导的回合、前缀回放或在双方意见不一致时由教师介入，将训练限制在该区域内。我们表明，这种解释并不完整。在学生偏离教师最远的状态下，教师接手后仍能完成任务，但依据教师 token 分数训练的学生却会不断耗尽回合数。我们将此归因于下一 token 评分的短视性。教师为每个 token 评分时看不到回合最终结果，因此它的分数会放过安全但拖延的操作；基于结果的 RL 会因这些操作而给予零奖励，而智能体 OPD 缺少这种惩罚。我们将教师实际采取的行动与其所评分的内容之间的差异称为“轨迹—评分器差距”。我们提出轨迹到评分器蒸馏 (R2S)，在蒸馏前修复评分器：从未经训练的学生中挖掘分歧较大的状态，从这些状态开始由教师接手执行，保留足够多次接手都通过免奖励检查（例如共识判断或 LLM 裁判）的状态，并微调教师，使其从发生偏离的回合开始，为此后每个助手 token 给出依据接手执行结果的分数，同时不在上下文中提供接手过程。修复后的教师被冻结，作为标准 OPD 的唯一评分器；修复和训练过程都不需要任务奖励。在三个环境、两位教师和四名学生上，R2S 在全部十二种教师—学生—环境组合中都优于三种最先进的智能体 OPD 方法；相对于每种组合下表现最佳的基线，平均成功率高出 12.8 个百分点。项目页面：https://tree-shu-zhao.github.io/r2s/。
